local character = script.Parent.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animations = {}

for i, animation in pairs(character:WaitForChild("Animations"):GetChildren()) do
	animations[animation.Name] = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
end

local state = "None"

local function Grounded()
	local ray = Ray.new(character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -4.3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
	local hit, position = game.Workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, character)
	if hit and hit.CanCollide then
		return(true)
	else
		return(false)
	end
end

local function StopAll()
	for i, animation in pairs(animations) do
		animation:Stop()
	end
end

local function ChangeState(newState)
	if state ~= newState then
		StopAll()
		state = newState
		if animations[state] then
			animations[state]:Play()
		end
	end
end

while true do
	game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:wait()
	if humanoid.Health > 0 then
		if Grounded() then
			local speed = Vector3.new(character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.X, 0, character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Z).magnitude
			if speed > 1 then
				ChangeState("Walk")
			else
				ChangeState("Idle")
			end
		else
			local ySpeed = character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Y
			if ySpeed > 0 then
				ChangeState("Jump")
			else
				ChangeState("Fall")
			end
		end
	else
		ChangeState("Dead")
	end
end

local humanoid = script.Parent.Parent.Humanoid

humanoid.MaxHealth = math.huge
humanoid.Health = math.huge

local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local itemSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemSetting"))
local ConfigHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("ConfigHelper"))

local flag = true

local function TweenScale(model, targetScale, duration, steps)
	local startScale = model:GetScale()
	local function lerp(a, b, t)
		return a + (b - a) * t
	end

	for i = 0, steps do
		local alpha = i / steps
		-- Sine ease-in-out
		local eased = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * alpha)
		local scale = lerp(startScale, targetScale, eased)
		model:ScaleTo(scale)
		task.wait(duration / steps)
	end
	model:ScaleTo(targetScale)
end

local soundService =  game:GetService('SoundService')

script.Parent.Touched:Connect(function(obj)

	if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(obj) and flag then
		--如果是物品那就弄他
		flag = false

		local item= ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(obj)
		local lo:itemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(itemSetting,item.id)

		if lo.ItemType == 'Iron' or lo.ItemType == 'Wood' then

			local item = CommonFunc:GetModel(obj)
			--item:PivotTo(script.Parent.intoBio.WorldCFrame)
			local newThread = coroutine.create(function()
				
				TweenScale(item,0.01,1,60)
				ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
				script:WaitForChild('rubble crash'):Play()
				
			end)
			coroutine.resume(newThread)
		else
			--DO NOTHING
		end
		wait(0.1)
		flag = true

	end

end)

function onTouched(otherPart: BasePart)
	local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
	if not character then return end
	if character.PrimaryPart ~= otherPart then return end
	if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then return end

	--print("碰到了泥沼泽",character.Name)

	-- 增加碰到泥沼泽的数量
	local inNum = character:GetAttribute(attName) or 0
	inNum += 1
	character:SetAttribute(attName,inNum)

	-- 减速
	character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.InMarshGas)
end

function onTouchEnded(otherPart: BasePart) 
	local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.InMarshGas)
	if not character then return end
	if character.PrimaryPart ~= otherPart then return end

	-- 减少碰到泥沼泽的数量
	local inNum = character:GetAttribute(attName) or 0
	inNum -= 1
	if inNum <= 0 then -- 需要判断还有没有碰到其他泥沼泽，没有的情况下才算是离开泥沼
		--print("离开泥沼泽",character.Name)
		inNum = 0 
		character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.InMarshGas)
	end
	character:SetAttribute(attName,inNum)
end

function onTouched(part)

		player.Jump = true --Make sure the player isn't glitched
		model.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
		debounce = true
		wait(2) --Wait 2 seconds
		flag = false

	end

local groupNames = {
    "线路1",
    "线路2",
    "线路3",
    "线路4",
    "大灯线路",
}

local groups = {}
local maxStep = 0
for _, groupName in ipairs(groupNames) do
    local folder = wires:FindFirstChild(groupName)
    if not folder then
        configurationError("Missing wire group " .. groupName)
        return
    end

    local partsByStep = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        local step = tonumber(child.Name)
        if step and child:IsA("BasePart") then
            partsByStep[step] = child
            maxStep = math.max(maxStep, step)
        end
    end

    if next(partsByStep) == nil then
        configurationError("Wire group has no numbered parts " .. groupName)
        return
    end

    table.insert(groups, partsByStep)
end

local poweredColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0)
local greenColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
local handleTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
local indicatorTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local wireTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local wireStepInterval = 0.32

switch:SetAttribute("Powered", false)

local busy = false

local function isRuntimeObject()
    return switch.Parent ~= nil and switch:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
end

local function isValidPlayer(player)
    if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then
        return false
    end

    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not rootPart then
        return false
    end

    local maxDistance = prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 2
    return (rootPart.Position - indicator.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end

local function animateHandle()
    local startPivot = handle:GetPivot()
    local targetPivot = startPivot * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(80))

    local pivotValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
    pivotValue.Name = "HandlePivot"
    pivotValue.Value = startPivot
    pivotValue.Parent = script

    local pivotConnection = pivotValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
        if isRuntimeObject() then
            handle:PivotTo(pivotValue.Value)
        end
    end)

    local tween = TweenService:Create(pivotValue, handleTweenInfo, {Value = targetPivot})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()

    pivotConnection:Disconnect()
    tween:Destroy()
    pivotValue:Destroy()

    if isRuntimeObject() then
        handle:PivotTo(targetPivot)
    end

    return isRuntimeObject()
end

local function animateIndicator()
    if not isRuntimeObject() then
        return false
    end

    local tween = TweenService:Create(indicator, indicatorTweenInfo, {Color = greenColor})
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()
    tween:Destroy()

    return isRuntimeObject()
end

local function animateWires()
    for step = 1, maxStep do
        if not isRuntimeObject() then
            return false
        end

        local tweens = {}
        for _, partsByStep in ipairs(groups) do
            local part = partsByStep[step]
            if part and part.Parent then
                local tween = TweenService:Create(part, wireTweenInfo, {Color = poweredColor})
                tween:Play()
                table.insert(tweens, tween)
            end
        end

        task.wait(wireStepInterval)

        for _, tween in ipairs(tweens) do
            if tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
                tween:Cancel()
            end
            tween:Destroy()
        end
    end

    return isRuntimeObject()
end

local highlight = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    if busy or switch:GetAttribute("Powered") == true then
        return
    end
    if not isRuntimeObject() or not isValidPlayer(player) then
        return
    end

    busy = true
    disablePrompt()
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("打开保险箱", indicator)
    if highlight then
        highlight.Enabled = false
    end

    if not animateHandle() then
        return
    end
    if not animateIndicator() then
        return
    end
    if not animateWires() then
        return
    end

    switch:SetAttribute("Powered", true)
end)

local HEAL_AMOUNT = 50
local MAX_HEAL_DISTANCE = 16
local REQUEST_COOLDOWN = 0.25

local tool = script.Parent
local event = tool:WaitForChild("Heal")
local lastRequestAt = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function getRoot(character)
    return character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
end

event.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,targetHumanoid)
    if player.Parent ~= Players
        or typeof(targetHumanoid) ~= "Instance"
        or not targetHumanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or tool.Parent ~= character then
        return
    end

    local targetCharacter = targetHumanoid.Parent
    local targetPlayer = targetCharacter and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetCharacter)
    if not targetPlayer
        or targetPlayer.Parent ~= Players
        or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local playerRoot = getRoot(character)
    local targetRoot = getRoot(targetCharacter)
    if not playerRoot
        or not playerRoot:IsA("BasePart")
        or not targetRoot
        or not targetRoot:IsA("BasePart")
        or (playerRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude > MAX_HEAL_DISTANCE then
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (lastRequestAt[player] or 0) < REQUEST_COOLDOWN then
        return
    end
    lastRequestAt[player] = now

    GameHelper:CharacterForceHeal(targetCharacter,HEAL_AMOUNT)
end)

		canBewash = true

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (config ~= nil) then
--		print("Loading anims " .. name)
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		local idx = 1
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject == nil) then
					animTable[name][idx].weight = 1
				else
					animTable[name][idx].weight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
	--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId .. " (" .. animTable[name][idx].weight .. ")")
				idx = idx + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
--			print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. anim.id .. " (" .. anim.weight .. ")")
		end
	end
end

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end
	return oldAnim
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
		currentAnimSpeed = speed
		currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then

		local repeatAnim = currentAnim
		-- return to idle if finishing an emote
		if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
			repeatAnim = "idle"
		end
		
		local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
		playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.0, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
	end
end

-- Preload animations
function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid) 
		
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
--		print(animName .. " " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	-- switch animation		
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then
		
		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0
	
		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		 
		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		
	end

end

function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)	 
		
		local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
		local origRoll = roll
		local idx = 1
		while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
			roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
			idx = idx + 1
		end
--		print(animName .. " * " .. idx .. " [" .. origRoll .. "]")
		local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

		if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then
			
			if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
				toolAnimTrack:Stop()
				toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
				transitionTime = 0
			end
					
			-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
			toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
			if priority then
				toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
			end
			 
			-- play the animation
			toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
			toolAnimName = animName
			toolAnimInstance = anim

			currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()
		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end


	return oldAnim
end

function moveSit()
	RightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	LeftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(3.14 /2)
	LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-3.14 /2)
	RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(3.14 /2)
	LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-3.14 /2)
end

local lastTick = 0

function move(time)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = time - lastTick
  	lastTick = time

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.1, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
--		print("Wha " .. pose)
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	if (setAngles) then
		local desiredAngle = amplitude * math.sin(time * frequency)

		RightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle + climbFudge)
		LeftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(desiredAngle - climbFudge)
		RightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
		LeftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-desiredAngle)
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = getTool()
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
	
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = time + .3
		end

		if time > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

function initTouchPart(touchPart:Part,randomId:number)
	local PrisonCenter:Attachment = touchPart:FindFirstChild("监狱中心点")
	local prisonerParent:Folder = touchPart:FindFirstChild("囚犯们")
	if not prisonerParent then
		prisonerParent = Instance.new("Folder")
		prisonerParent.Name = "囚犯们"
		prisonerParent.Parent = touchPart
	end
	touchPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart) 
		local resItem:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.DeadBody)
		if not resItem then return end

		local lastDragPlayer:Player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(resItem,DragItemValue.lastDragPlayer)
		if lastDragPlayer then
			-- 移除
			ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(resItem)
			
			if #prisonerParent:GetChildren() <= 10 then
				-- 创建囚犯
				local prisoner = prisonerPrefab:Clone()
				local prisonerPos = PrisonCenter.WorldPosition + CommonFunc:RandomVector3(2) * CommonEnum.XZ

				prisoner.Parent = prisonerParent
				game.Debris:AddItem(prisoner,60)
			end

			-- 警官感谢音效
			sir.HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("谢谢"):Play()
			playBubble(sir,"Thank you sir!")
			sirCheer:Play()
			
			-- 飞点额外奖励出来
			local startPos = touchPart.Position
			local newResItems = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(randomId,startPos)
			local character = lastDragPlayer.Character
			
			if character then
				-- 飞玩家脸上
				for _,newResItem in ipairs(newResItems) do
					--local playerPos = character:GetPivot().Position
					--local offset = playerPos - startPos
					--local dir = (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit
					--local force = dir * 30 + Vector3.new(0,20,0)
					local force = Vector3.new(0,50,0)
					newResItem.PrimaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = force
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

gun.FireC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player,hit:BasePart,endPos:Vector3) 
	if v_bulletNum.Value <= 0 then return end
	
	local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if timeNow <= v_nextFireTime.Value then return end
	
	v_lastAddBulletTime.Value = timeNow -- 重置时间，要停止射击才会恢复子弹
	
	-- 下一次开火时间
	v_nextFireTime.Value = timeNow + c_shotCD.Value
	v_bulletNum.Value -= 1
	
	local isNpc,npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
	if isNpc then
		local damage = c_damage.Value
		if hit.Name == "Head" then
			damage *= 2
			GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(endPos - player.Character:GetPivot().Position).Unit)
		end
		GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage)
		GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
	end
	--GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C:FireAllClients(gun,endPos)
	gun.FireS2C:FireAllClients(endPos)
end)

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(c_addBulletCD.Value)
	local lastTime = v_lastAddBulletTime.Value
	local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	v_lastAddBulletTime.Value = timeNow
	if v_bulletNum.Value < c_bulletMax.Value then
		local addNum = math.floor((timeNow - lastTime) / c_addBulletCD.Value) * c_addBullet.Value
		v_bulletNum.Value = math.clamp(v_bulletNum.Value + addNum,1,c_bulletMax.Value)
	end
end

function playLaser(endPos:Vector3)
	FireSound:Play()
	local FirePoint:Attachment = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	local startPos
	if FirePoint then
		startPos = FirePoint.WorldCFrame.Position
	else
		local humanoidRootPart:Part = LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		startPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
	end
	local offset = endPos - startPos
	local dir = offset.Unit
	local distance = offset.Magnitude

	local effect = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("激光"):Clone()
	effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startPos + distance * 0.5 * dir,endPos))
	effect.Parent = workspace
	
	local tweenPart = effect:WaitForChild("激光")
	local originSize = tweenPart.Size
	tweenPart.Size = Vector3.new(distance,originSize.Y,originSize.Z)
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1)
	game.TweenService:Create(tweenPart,tweenInfo,{
		Size = Vector3.new(distance,0.1,0.1),
		Transparency = 1
	}):Play()
	game.Debris:AddItem(effect,tweenInfo.Time)
	
	-- 发光
	pointLight.Enabled = true
	par.Enabled = true
	task.wait(c_shotCD.Value)
	pointLight.Enabled = false
	par.Enabled = false
end

	local lastTime = v_lastAddBulletTime.Value

		local addNum = math.floor((timeNow - lastTime) / v_addBulletCD.Value) * c_addBullet.Value
		v_bulletNum.Value = math.clamp(v_bulletNum.Value + addNum,1,v_bulletNumMax.Value)
	end

local function reload(player)
	if tool.Parent~=player.Character or v_reloading.Value then return end
	local bulletLo=ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(c_bulletId.Value)
	local playerBullet=bulletLo and GameHelper:GetCurBulletValue(player,bulletLo.ItemType)
	if not playerBullet then return end
	if playerBullet.Value<=0 then AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"Empty Gun Sound") UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"Insufficient ammunition!",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn) return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value==c_reloadNum.Value then return end
	v_reloading.Value=true
	v_reloadCompleteTime.Value=workspace.DistributedGameTime+config:FindFirstChild("装填时长").Value
	local cost=math.min(playerBullet.Value,c_reloadNum.Value-v_bulletAmount.Value)
	playerBullet.Value-=cost
	task.wait(config:FindFirstChild("装填时长").Value)
	if not tool.Parent then return end
	v_reloading.Value=false
	v_bulletAmount.Value+=cost
end
local function finite(v) return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and v.X==v.X and v.Y==v.Y and v.Z==v.Z end

tool.TryFireC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,claimedHit,endPos,firePoint,shotToken)
	if tool.Parent~=player.Character or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or v_reloading.Value then return end
	if not finite(endPos) or not firePoint or not firePoint:IsA("Attachment") or not firePoint:IsDescendantOf(tool.FirePoints) then return end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local key=type(shotToken)=="number" and shotToken or "legacy"
	if key~=burstKey or now-burstStarted>0.25 then
		if now-burstStarted<math.max(0.1,c_shotCD.Value*0.9) then return end
		burstKey=key burstStarted=now burstCount=0
	end
	burstCount+=1
	if burstCount>#tool.FirePoints:GetChildren() then return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value<=0 then task.spawn(reload,player) return end
	local origin=firePoint.WorldPosition
	local delta=endPos-origin
	if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 or delta.Magnitude>55 then return end
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	end
	tool.FireS2C:FireAllClients(actualEnd,firePoint,isNpc==true)

local function spreadDirection(direction:Vector3)
	local frame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,direction)
	local angle=math.rad(1.15)
	local radius=math.sqrt(math.random())*math.tan(angle)
	local theta=math.random()*math.pi*2
	return frame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.cos(theta)*radius,math.sin(theta)*radius,-1)).Unit
end
local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character or v_reloading.Value then return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value<=0 then GameHelper.GunReloadC2S:FireServer() return end
	local now=workspace.DistributedGameTime
	if now<nextFireTime then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then shotContext=RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext) if not shotContext then return end end
	nextFireTime=now+c_shotCD.Value
	if fireTrack then fireTrack:Play() end
	local aimTarget=shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	local points=tool.FirePoints:GetChildren()
	local fireTimes=math.min(v_bulletAmount.Value,#points)
	for index=1,fireTimes do
		local firePoint=points[index]
		local origin=firePoint.WorldPosition
		local delta=aimTarget-origin
		if delta.Magnitude>0.001 then
			local direction
			if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
				direction=spreadDirection(delta.Unit)
			else
				local distance=(LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot().Position-aimTarget).Magnitude
				local legacyTarget=aimTarget+CommonFunc:RandomVector3(distance/50)
				local legacyDelta=legacyTarget-origin
				if legacyDelta.Magnitude<=0.001 then continue end
				direction=legacyDelta.Unit
			end
			local params=RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction*50,params)
			local hit=result and result.Instance or nil
			local actualEnd=result and result.Position or origin+direction*50
			local hitCharacter=GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)==true
			task.spawn(function() GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(tool,actualEnd,firePoint,hitCharacter) end)
			tool.TryFireC2S:FireServer(hit,actualEnd,firePoint,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
		end
	end
end

	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)

	local arrow = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("毒箭"):Clone()
	arrow.Position = startPos
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	arrow.Transparency = 1
	RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	arrow.Anchored = false
	game.Debris:AddItem(arrow,5)
	local delta = endPos - startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 then arrow:Destroy() return end
	arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = delta.Unit * 500
	local lastPos = arrow.Position
	while arrow and arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		if lastPos ~= arrow.Position then
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
			params:AddToFilter(arrow)
			local offset = arrow.Position - lastPos
			local hitResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset,params)
			if hitResult then
				local hit = hitResult.Instance
				if isLocalPlayer and GameHelper:IsNPC(hit) then
					bow.ArrowHitC2S:FireServer(hit,shotToken)
				end
				arrow:WaitForChild("Trail").Enabled = false
				local dir = arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.001 and arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit or offset.Unit
				arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position,hitResult.Position+dir)
				arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)
				break
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
		end
		RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	end
end

local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or bow:GetAttribute("Reload") or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		shotContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
		if not shotContext then return end
	end
	local endPos = shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
	bow:SetAttribute("Reload",true)
	bow.Arrow.Transparency = 1
	local reloadBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.bowReloadBonus)
	local reloadTime = GameHelper:CalculateCDDiminishing(c_reloadTime.Value,reloadBonus)
	task.delay(reloadTime,function()
		if bow.Parent then
			bow:SetAttribute("Reload",false)
			bow.Arrow.Transparency = 0
		end
	end)
	task.wait(0.1)
	if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local startPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
	bow.Attack:FireServer(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
	fireArrow(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)

	local doubleArrowBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.doubleArrowBonus)
	if math.random() <= doubleArrowBonus then
		if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
		task.delay(0.1,function()
			if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			local secondContext
			if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
				secondContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
				if not secondContext then return end
			end
			local secondEndPos = secondContext and secondContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
			local secondStartPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
			bow.Attack:FireServer(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
			fireArrow(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
		end)
	end
end

local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(bow)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(bow,shoot)
	end
end

local function validEquipped(player)
	return player.Character ~= nil and bow.Parent == player.Character and GameHelper:isAlive(player)
end
local function validVector(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
end
local function validToken(token)
	return type(token) == "number" and token % 1 == 0 and token >= 1 and token <= 2147483647
end
local function simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	local delta=endPos-startPos
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(startPos,delta.Unit*math.min(delta.Magnitude,1100),params)
	pendingShots[player]=pendingShots[player] or {}
	pendingShots[player][shotToken]={
		hit=result and result.Instance or nil,
		position=result and result.Position or nil,
		expires=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3,
		consumed=false,
	}
end

bow.Attack.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not validVector(startPos) or not validVector(endPos) then return end
	local firePoint = bow:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	if not firePoint or not firePoint:IsA("Attachment") or (startPos-firePoint.WorldPosition).Magnitude > 5 then return end
	local delta = endPos-startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 or delta.Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local previous=lastAttackAt[player] or 0
	if now-previous < 0.075 then return end
	lastAttackAt[player]=now
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local shots=pendingShots[player]
		local previousShot=shots and shots[shotToken]
		if previousShot and now<=previousShot.expires then return end
		simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	end
	bow.Attack:FireAllClients(startPos,endPos)
end)

bow.ArrowHitC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,hitPart,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not hitPart or not hitPart:IsA("BasePart") or not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	local authoritativeHit=hitPart
	local hitPosition=hitPart.Position
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local record=pendingShots[player] and pendingShots[player][shotToken]
		if not record or record.consumed or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>record.expires then return end
		record.consumed=true
		authoritativeHit=record.hit
		hitPosition=record.position
		if not authoritativeHit or not hitPosition then return end
		local _,clientNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hitPart)
		local _,serverNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
		if not clientNpc or clientNpc~=serverNpc then return end
	end
	local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (hitPosition-root.Position).Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
	if not isNpc or not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then return end
	local isHeadshot=authoritativeHit.Name=="Head"
	local damage=c_damage.Value*(isHeadshot and 2 or 1)
	local applied=GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=hitPosition,IsCritical=isHeadshot,ShotToken=shotToken,RangedWeapon=true})
	if applied then
		if isHeadshot then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(hitPosition-root.Position).Unit) end
		GameHelper:SetNPCPoisoned(player,npc)
		GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
		if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.posionBowKill,1) end
	end
end)

local function validEquipped(player)
	return player.Character ~= nil and bow.Parent == player.Character and GameHelper:isAlive(player)
end
local function validVector(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3" and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
end
local function validToken(token)
	return type(token) == "number" and token % 1 == 0 and token >= 1 and token <= 2147483647
end
local function simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	local delta=endPos-startPos
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(startPos,delta.Unit*math.min(delta.Magnitude,1100),params)
	pendingShots[player]=pendingShots[player] or {}
	pendingShots[player][shotToken]={
		hit=result and result.Instance or nil,
		position=result and result.Position or nil,
		expires=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3,
		consumed=false,
	}
end

bow.Attack.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not validVector(startPos) or not validVector(endPos) then return end
	local firePoint = bow:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
	if not firePoint or not firePoint:IsA("Attachment") or (startPos-firePoint.WorldPosition).Magnitude > 5 then return end
	local delta = endPos-startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 or delta.Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local previous=lastAttackAt[player] or 0
	if now-previous < 0.075 then return end
	lastAttackAt[player]=now
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local shots=pendingShots[player]
		local previousShot=shots and shots[shotToken]
		if previousShot and now<=previousShot.expires then return end
		simulateShot(player,startPos,endPos,shotToken)
	end
	bow.Attack:FireAllClients(startPos,endPos)
end)

bow.ArrowHitC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,hitPart,shotToken)
	if not validEquipped(player) or not hitPart or not hitPart:IsA("BasePart") or not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	local authoritativeHit=hitPart
	local hitPosition=hitPart.Position
	if validToken(shotToken) then
		local record=pendingShots[player] and pendingShots[player][shotToken]
		if not record or record.consumed or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>record.expires then return end
		record.consumed=true
		authoritativeHit=record.hit
		hitPosition=record.position
		if not authoritativeHit or not hitPosition then return end
		local _,clientNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hitPart)
		local _,serverNpc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
		if not clientNpc or clientNpc~=serverNpc then return end
	end
	local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or (hitPosition-root.Position).Magnitude > 1100 then return end
	local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(authoritativeHit)
	if not isNpc or not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then return end
	local isHeadshot=authoritativeHit.Name=="Head"
	local damage=c_damage.Value*(isHeadshot and 2 or 1)
	local applied=GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=hitPosition,IsCritical=isHeadshot,ShotToken=shotToken,RangedWeapon=true})
	if applied then
		if isHeadshot then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(hitPosition-root.Position).Unit) end
		GameHelper:PlayerIceAttack(player,npc)
		GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
		if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.bowKill,1) end
	end
end)

local function fireArrow(startPos:Vector3,endPos:Vector3,shotToken:number?)
	local isLocalPlayer = bow.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character
	bow:WaitForChild("Model"):WaitForChild("Fire"):Play()
	local arrow = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("冰箭"):Clone()
	arrow.Position = startPos
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.Parent = workspace
	arrow.Transparency = 1
	RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	arrow.Anchored = false
	game.Debris:AddItem(arrow,5)
	local delta = endPos - startPos
	if delta.Magnitude <= 0.001 then arrow:Destroy() return end
	arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = delta.Unit * 500
	local lastPos = arrow.Position
	while arrow and arrow:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
		if lastPos ~= arrow.Position then
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
			params:AddToFilter(arrow)
			local offset = arrow.Position - lastPos
			local hitResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset,params)
			if hitResult then
				local hit = hitResult.Instance
				if isLocalPlayer and GameHelper:IsNPC(hit) then
					bow.ArrowHitC2S:FireServer(hit,shotToken)
				end
				arrow:WaitForChild("Trail").Enabled = false
				local dir = arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.001 and arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit or offset.Unit
				arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position,hitResult.Position+dir)
				arrow.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)
				break
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
		end
		RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	end
end

local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or bow:GetAttribute("Reload") or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		shotContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
		if not shotContext then return end
	end
	local endPos = shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
	bow:SetAttribute("Reload",true)
	bow.Arrow.Transparency = 1
	local reloadBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.bowReloadBonus)
	local reloadTime = GameHelper:CalculateCDDiminishing(c_reloadTime.Value,reloadBonus)
	task.delay(reloadTime,function()
		if bow.Parent then
			bow:SetAttribute("Reload",false)
			bow.Arrow.Transparency = 0
		end
	end)
	task.wait(0.1)
	if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	local startPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
	bow.Attack:FireServer(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
	fireArrow(startPos,endPos,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)

	local doubleArrowBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(LocalPlayer.Character,CharacterValue.doubleArrowBonus)
	if math.random() <= doubleArrowBonus then
		if atkTrack then atkTrack:Play() end
		task.delay(0.1,function()
			if not active or bow.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			local secondContext
			if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
				secondContext = RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext)
				if not secondContext then return end
			end
			local secondEndPos = secondContext and secondContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
			local secondStartPos = FirePoint.WorldPosition
			bow.Attack:FireServer(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
			fireArrow(secondStartPos,secondEndPos,secondContext and secondContext.ShotToken)
		end)
	end
end

local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(bow)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(bow,shoot)
	end
end

local function finite(v) return typeof(v)=="Vector3" and v.X==v.X and v.Y==v.Y and v.Z==v.Z end
tool.TryFire.OnServerInvoke=function(player,claimedHit,endPos,shotToken,burstIndex)
	if tool.Parent~=player.Character or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or not finite(endPos) then return false end
	local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local indexedBurst=type(shotToken)=="number" and type(burstIndex)=="number"
	if indexedBurst then
		if burstIndex%1~=0 or burstIndex<1 or burstIndex>fireCount then return false end
		if shotToken~=lastToken or burstPlayer~=player or now-burstStarted>2 then
			if burstIndex~=1 or isFire.Value or now-lastFireAt<0.15 then return false end
			lastToken=shotToken burstPlayer=player burstStarted=now burstNextIndex=1 lastFireAt=now isFire.Value=true
			burstExpiresSerial+=1
			local expirySerial=burstExpiresSerial
			task.delay(math.max(1.5,fireCount*0.1+0.5),function()
				if burstExpiresSerial==expirySerial and isFire.Value then isFire.Value=false end
			end)
		end
		if burstIndex~=burstNextIndex then return false end
		burstNextIndex+=1
	else
		if isFire.Value or now-lastFireAt<0.15 then return false end
		lastToken=shotToken burstPlayer=player burstStarted=now burstNextIndex=fireCount+1 lastFireAt=now isFire.Value=true
	end

	local function fireOne(requestedEnd:Vector3,currentToken:number?)
		if tool.Parent~=player.Character or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or not finite(requestedEnd) then return false end
		local origin=tool.Main.Position
		local delta=requestedEnd-origin
		if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 or delta.Magnitude>110 then return false end
		local bullets=ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.GatlinBullet)
		if not bullets or bullets.Value<=0 then
			AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"Empty Gun Sound")
			UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"Insufficient ammunition!",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
			return false
		end
		local params=RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
		params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
		local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,delta.Unit*100,params)
		local hit=result and result.Instance or nil
		local actualEnd=result and result.Position or origin+delta.Unit*100
		local isNpc,npc=GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
		local cost=1
		if isNpc and player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GatlinMasterV2) and math.random()<=0.1 then cost=0 end
		bullets.Value-=cost
		if isNpc then
			local critical=hit.Name=="Head"
			local damage=bulletDamage*(critical and 2 or 1)
			local wasAlive=GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc)
			if GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,nil,{HitPosition=actualEnd,IsCritical=critical,ShotToken=currentToken,RangedWeapon=true}) then
				if critical then GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc,(actualEnd-player.Character:GetPivot().Position).Unit) end
				if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GatlinMasterV3) and math.random()<=0.1 then GameHelper:SetNPCBurning(player,npc) end
				GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
				if wasAlive and not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then
					GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.gatlinKill,1)
				end
			end
		end
		tool.FireS2C:FireAllClients(hit,actualEnd)
		return true,bullets.Value
	end

	if indexedBurst then
		local accepted,remaining=fireOne(endPos,shotToken)
		if not accepted or burstIndex>=fireCount or remaining<=0 then isFire.Value=false end
		return accepted
	end

	local legacyEnd=endPos
	task.spawn(function()
		for _=1,fireCount do
			if not isFire.Value or tool.Parent~=player.Character then break end
			local accepted,remaining=fireOne(legacyEnd,nil)
			if not accepted or remaining<=0 then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		isFire.Value=false
	end)
	return true
end

local function sampleAndInvoke(context,token,burstIndex)
	local aim
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then aim=RangedCombatClient.SampleAim(context) end
	local endPos=aim and aim.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	local origin=Main.Position
	local delta=endPos-origin
	if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 then return false end
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,delta.Unit*100,params)
	return TryFire:InvokeServer(result and result.Instance or nil,result and result.Position or origin+delta.Unit*100,token,burstIndex)
end
local function beginFire(context)
	if not active or holding or isFire.Value or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	holding=true
	fireSerial+=1
	local serial=fireSerial
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then shotContext=RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(context) if not shotContext then holding=false return end end
	if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		sampleAndInvoke(context,nil,nil)
		holding=false
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		for burstIndex=1,fireCount do
			if not active or not holding or serial~=fireSerial or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then break end
			local accepted=sampleAndInvoke(context,shotContext.ShotToken,burstIndex)
			if accepted~=true then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if serial==fireSerial then holding=false end
	end)
end
local function endFire()
	holding=false
	fireSerial+=1
end
local function cancelFire()
	holding=false
	fireSerial+=1
end
local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(tool,beginFire,endFire) end
end
local function onIsFireChanged()
	if fireTrack then if isFire.Value then fireTrack:Play() else fireTrack:Stop() end end
	FX.Enabled=isFire.Value
	if isFire.Value then
		while isFire.Value do
			boltIndex=1-boltIndex
			FlashFX.Enabled=boltIndex==1
			Bolt.Transparency=boltIndex==1 and 1 or 0
			BoltBack.Transparency=boltIndex==0 and 1 or 0
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	else FlashFX.Enabled=false end
end

function digSand()

	--TODO不同的地方挖的土颜色会不同，还可以洗出不同的矿石，特殊土壤有特殊道具，但是现在就先这样，也许该用

		pan:WaitForChild('BillboardGui'):WaitForChild('t_num').TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
		--定好奖励
		local randomNum = math.random(1,3) --随机数量

			table.insert(gemArr,gemInfo.id)

			gem:ScaleTo(math.random(1,2))
			gem:PivotTo(arr[i].CFrame) --设置位置 --gem.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/3
			--将宝石和盘焊接
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part1 = arr[i]
			weld.Parent = pan
			weld.Part0 = gem.PrimaryPart
			gem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
		end

	end

	end

function findNearbyTower(tower:Model)
	local op = OverlapParams.new()
	op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG))
	op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	
	local v_range:NumberValue = tower:FindFirstChild("range")
	local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(tower:GetPivot().Position,v_range.Value,op)
	
	local ret = {}
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local newTower = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,TAG)
		if newTower == tower then continue end
		if table.find(ret,newTower) then continue end
		table.insert(ret,newTower)
	end
	
	return ret
end

function hasProbability(p)
	local sum = 0
	-- 累加随机小数直到超过1，统计累加次数
	while sum < 1 do
		sum = sum + math.random()

		if sum < p then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function growGarden()
	local foodBirthArr = script.Parent.SetPlace:GetChildren()

	local isSpawn = false
	for	k,v in ipairs(foodBirthArr) do	
		if v:GetAttribute("busy") then continue end
		local id = 216
		if hasProbability(0.2) then
			id = selectRandomVegetable()
		end
		
		local offset = Vector3.zero
		if id == 216 then
			offset = Vector3.new(0,-1,0)
		end
		local temp = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(id)
		GameHelper:PlayDuang(temp)
		--temp.Parent = script.Parent.Food
		temp:PivotTo(v.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,temp.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/2,0)+offset)
		temp.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
		onItemSpawn(temp,v)
		isSpawn = true
	end
	
	return isSpawn
end

local function TweenScale(model, targetScale, duration, steps)
	local startScale = model:GetScale()
	local function lerp(a, b, t)
		return a + (b - a) * t
	end

	for i = 0, steps do
		local alpha = i / steps
		-- Sine ease-in-out
		local eased = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * alpha)
		local scale = lerp(startScale, targetScale, eased)
		model:ScaleTo(scale)
		task.wait(duration / steps)
	end
	model:ScaleTo(targetScale)
end

		playAddHeatEffect()

		overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

function findExistingAnimationInSet(set, anim)
	if set == nil or anim == nil then
		return 0
	end
	
	for idx = 1, set.count, 1 do 
		if set[idx].anim.AnimationId == anim.AnimationId then
			return idx
		end
	end
	
	return 0
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	local allowCustomAnimations = true

	local success, msg = pcall(function() allowCustomAnimations = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations end)
	if not success then
		allowCustomAnimations = true
	end

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (allowCustomAnimations and config ~= nil) then
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		
		local idx = 0
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				local newWeight = 1
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject ~= nil) then
					newWeight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				idx = animTable[name].count
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				animTable[name][idx].weight = newWeight
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildAdded:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildRemoved:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
		end
	end
	
	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do
			if PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
				PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end				
		end
	end
end

function stopAllAnimations()

	end

		runAnimTrack:Stop()
		runAnimTrack:Destroy()
		runAnimTrack = nil
	end
	
	return oldAnim
end

function getHeightScale()
	if Humanoid then
		if not Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
			-- When auto scaling is not enabled, the rig scale stands in for
			-- a computed scale.
			return getRigScale()
		end
		
		local scale = Humanoid.HipHeight / HumanoidHipHeight
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject == nil then
			AnimationSpeedDampeningObject = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
		end
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject ~= nil then
			scale = 1 + (Humanoid.HipHeight - HumanoidHipHeight) * AnimationSpeedDampeningObject.Value / HumanoidHipHeight
		end
		return scale
	end	
	return getRigScale()
end

local function rootMotionCompensation(speed)
	local speedScaled = speed * 1.25
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()
	local runSpeed = speedScaled / heightScale
	return runSpeed
end

local smallButNotZero = 0.0001
local function setRunSpeed(speed)
	local normalizedWalkSpeed = 0.5 -- established empirically using current `913402848` walk animation
	local normalizedRunSpeed  = 1
	local runSpeed = rootMotionCompensation(speed)

	local walkAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local runAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local timeWarp = 1

	if runSpeed <= normalizedWalkSpeed then
		walkAnimationWeight = 1
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedWalkSpeed
	elseif runSpeed < normalizedRunSpeed then
		local fadeInRun = (runSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)/(normalizedRunSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)
		walkAnimationWeight = 1 - fadeInRun
		runAnimationWeight  = fadeInRun
	else
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedRunSpeed
		runAnimationWeight = 1
	end
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(walkAnimationWeight)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(runAnimationWeight)
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if currentAnim == "walk" then
			setRunSpeed(speed)
	else
		if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
			currentAnimSpeed = speed
			currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		if currentAnim == "walk" then
			if userNoUpdateOnLoop == true then
				if runAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
					runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
				end
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
					currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
				end
			else
				runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
				currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
		else
			local repeatAnim = currentAnim
			-- return to idle if finishing an emote
			if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
				repeatAnim = "idle"
			end
			
			if currentlyPlayingEmote then
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped then
					-- Allow the emote to loop
					return
				end
				
				repeatAnim = "idle"
				currentlyPlayingEmote = false
			end
			
			local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
			playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.15, Humanoid)
			setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function rollAnimation(animName)
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
	return idx
end

local function switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	-- switch animation		
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then
		
		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			runAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			runAnimTrack:Destroy()
			if userNoUpdateOnLoop == true then
				runAnimTrack = nil
			end
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0
	
		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		 
		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		
		-- check to see if we need to blend a walk/run animation
		if animName == "walk" then
			local runAnimName = "run"
			local runIdx = rollAnimation(runAnimName)

			runAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animTable[runAnimName][runIdx].anim)
			runAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			runAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)		
			
			if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
				runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
			end
			runAnimKeyframeHandler = runAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)	
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid) 	
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = false
end

function playEmote(emoteAnim, transitionTime, humanoid)
	switchToAnim(emoteAnim, emoteAnim.Name, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = true
end

function toolKeyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		playToolAnimation(toolAnimName, 0.0, Humanoid)

end


function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)	 		
		local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
		local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

		if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then
			
			if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
				toolAnimTrack:Stop()
				toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
				transitionTime = 0
			end
					
			-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
			toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
			if priority then
				toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
			end
			 
			-- play the animation
			toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
			toolAnimName = animName
			toolAnimInstance = anim

			currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()
		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function onRunning(speed)
	local heightScale = if userAnimateScaleRun then getHeightScale() else 1
	
	local movedDuringEmote = currentlyPlayingEmote and Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local speedThreshold = movedDuringEmote and (Humanoid.WalkSpeed / heightScale) or 0.75
	if speed > speedThreshold * heightScale then
		local scale = 16.0
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(speed / scale)
		pose = "Running"
	else
		if emoteNames[currentAnim] == nil and not currentlyPlayingEmote then
			playAnimation("idle", 0.2, Humanoid)
			pose = "Standing"
		end
	end
end

	pose = "Dead"
end

	playAnimation("jump", 0.1, Humanoid)
	jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimDuration
	pose = "Jumping"

function getToolAnim(tool)
	for _, c in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == "toolanim" and c.className == "StringValue" then
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local lastTick = 0

function stepAnimate(currentTime)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = currentTime - lastTick
  	lastTick = currentTime

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = currentTime + .3
		end

		if currentTime > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(set, anim)
	if set == nil or anim == nil then

	end
	
	for idx = 1, set.count, 1 do 
		if set[idx].anim.AnimationId == anim.AnimationId then
			return idx
		end
	end
	
	return 0
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0	
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	local allowCustomAnimations = true

	local success, msg = pcall(function() allowCustomAnimations = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations end)
	if not success then
		allowCustomAnimations = true
	end

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (allowCustomAnimations and config ~= nil) then
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		
		local idx = 0
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				local newWeight = 1
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject ~= nil) then
					newWeight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				idx = animTable[name].count
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				animTable[name][idx].weight = newWeight
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildAdded:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildRemoved:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
		end
	end
	
	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do
			if PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
				PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end				
		end
	end
end

				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				idx = idx + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
			-- print(name .. " [" .. idx .. "] " .. anim.id .. " (" .. anim.weight .. ")")
		end
	end
	
	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do 
			Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
		end
	end
end

-- functions

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end
	
	if currentlyPlayingEmote then
		oldAnim = "idle"
		currentlyPlayingEmote = false
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end

	-- clean up walk if there is one
	if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end
	
	if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		runAnimTrack:Stop()
		runAnimTrack:Destroy()
		runAnimTrack = nil
	end
	
	return oldAnim
end

function getHeightScale()
	if Humanoid then
		if not Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
			return 1
		end
		
		local scale = Humanoid.HipHeight / HumanoidHipHeight
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject == nil then
			AnimationSpeedDampeningObject = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
		end
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject ~= nil then
			scale = 1 + (Humanoid.HipHeight - HumanoidHipHeight) * AnimationSpeedDampeningObject.Value / HumanoidHipHeight
		end
		return scale
	end	
	return 1
end

local function rootMotionCompensation(speed)
	local speedScaled = speed * 1.25
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()
	local runSpeed = speedScaled / heightScale
	return runSpeed
end

local smallButNotZero = 0.0001
local function setRunSpeed(speed)
	local normalizedWalkSpeed = 0.5 -- established empirically using current `913402848` walk animation
	local normalizedRunSpeed  = 1
	local runSpeed = rootMotionCompensation(speed)

	local walkAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local runAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local walkAnimationTimewarp = runSpeed/normalizedWalkSpeed
	local runAnimationTimerwarp = runSpeed/normalizedRunSpeed

	if runSpeed <= normalizedWalkSpeed then
		walkAnimationWeight = 1
	elseif runSpeed < normalizedRunSpeed then
		local fadeInRun = (runSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)/(normalizedRunSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)
		walkAnimationWeight = 1 - fadeInRun
		runAnimationWeight  = fadeInRun
		walkAnimationTimewarp = 1
		runAnimationTimerwarp = 1
	else
		runAnimationWeight = 1
	end
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(walkAnimationWeight)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(runAnimationWeight)
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(walkAnimationTimewarp)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(runAnimationTimerwarp)
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if currentAnim == "walk" then
			setRunSpeed(speed)
	else
		if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
			currentAnimSpeed = speed
			currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		if currentAnim == "walk" then
			if userNoUpdateOnLoop == true then
				if runAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
					runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
				end
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
					currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
				end
			else
				runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
				currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
		else
			local repeatAnim = currentAnim
			-- return to idle if finishing an emote
			if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
				repeatAnim = "idle"
			end
			
			if currentlyPlayingEmote then
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped then
					-- Allow the emote to loop
					return
				end
				
				repeatAnim = "idle"
				currentlyPlayingEmote = false
			end
			
			local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
			playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.15, Humanoid)
			setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function rollAnimation(animName)
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight) 
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
	return idx
end

local function switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	-- switch animation		
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then
		
		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			runAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			runAnimTrack:Destroy()
			if userNoUpdateOnLoop == true then
				runAnimTrack = nil
			end
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0
	
		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		 
		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		
		-- check to see if we need to blend a walk/run animation
		if animName == "walk" then
			local runAnimName = "run"
			local runIdx = rollAnimation(runAnimName)

			runAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animTable[runAnimName][runIdx].anim)
			runAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			runAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)		
			
			if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
				runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
			end
			runAnimKeyframeHandler = runAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)	
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid) 	
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = false
end

function playEmote(emoteAnim, transitionTime, humanoid)
	switchToAnim(emoteAnim, emoteAnim.Name, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = true
end

local toolAnimName = ""
local toolAnimTrack = nil

local currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = nil

function toolKeyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		playToolAnimation(toolAnimName, 0.0, Humanoid)
	end
end


function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)	 		
		local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
		local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

		if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then
			
			if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
				toolAnimTrack:Stop()
				toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
				transitionTime = 0
			end
					
			-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
			toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
			if priority then
				toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
			end
			 
			-- play the animation
			toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
			toolAnimName = animName
			toolAnimInstance = anim

			currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()
		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function onRunning(speed)
	local movedDuringEmote =
		userEmoteToRunThresholdChange and currentlyPlayingEmote and Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local speedThreshold = movedDuringEmote and Humanoid.WalkSpeed or 0.75
	if speed > speedThreshold then
		local scale = 16.0
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(speed / scale)
		pose = "Running"
	else
		if emoteNames[currentAnim] == nil and not currentlyPlayingEmote then
			playAnimation("idle", 0.2, Humanoid)
			pose = "Standing"
		end
	end
end

function animateTool()

		return
	end

		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	end

		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	end
end

function getToolAnim(tool)
	for _, c in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == "toolanim" and c.className == "StringValue" then
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local lastTick = 0

function stepAnimate(currentTime)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
  	local deltaTime = currentTime - lastTick
  	lastTick = currentTime

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

  	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
  		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
  	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = currentTime + .3
		end

		if currentTime > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()		
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

function triggerAttack(atkType:number?)
	--if atkType == ATK_TYPE.special then
	--	atkType = ATK_TYPE.fart
	--	if v_Mad.Value then
	--		-- 愤怒状态
	--		if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
	--			atkType = ATK_TYPE.dash -- 冲撞
	--		end
	--	else
	--		if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
	--			atkType = ATK_TYPE.snowball -- 扔雪球
	--		end
	--	end
	--end	
	
	if atkType == ATK_TYPE.atk then
		--print("普攻")
		v_Busy.Value = true
		local t = 1
		attackTrack:Play()
		humanoidRootPart.attackbefore:Play()
		task.wait(t)
		bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,15,t)
		task.wait(t)
		bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,15,t)
		task.wait(t+1)
	elseif atkType == ATK_TYPE.snowball then
		--print("雪球")
		v_Busy.Value = true
		humanoidRootPart.skillbefore:Play()
		if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
			local character:Model = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
			bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,character)
			snowballTrack:Play()
			task.wait(4)
		end
	elseif atkType == ATK_TYPE.fart then
		--print("放屁")
		v_Busy.Value = true
		fartTrack:Play()
		--humanoidRootPart.skillbefore:Play()

		ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,EnemyValue.walkSpeed,"想放屁",0)
		task.wait(1)
		humanoidRootPart.fart:Play()
		
		local LowerTorso = bull.LowerTorso
		local fart = workspace.Prefabs.Others:FindFirstChild("屁"):Clone()
		fart.CFrame = CFrame.new(LowerTorso.Position)
		fart.Parent = workspace
		
		task.wait(1)
		fartTrack:Stop()
	elseif atkType == ATK_TYPE.dash then
		--print("冲刺")
		local preTime = 2
		local duration = 1.5
		v_Busy.Value = true
		humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
		
		-- 冲刺预备
		humanoidRootPart.skillbefore:Play()
		dashbeforeTrack:Play()
		dashStartPar.Enabled = true
		task.wait(preTime)
		dashbeforeTrack:Stop()
		dashStartPar.Enabled = false
		
		-- 开始冲刺
		DashTrail.Enabled = true
		DashPar.Enabled = true
		dashTrack:Play()
		bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,duration)
		
		-- 计算方向
		if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
			local character:Model = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
			local lastDir:Vector3 = ((character:GetPivot().Position - bull:GetPivot().Position) * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit
			humanoid:Move(lastDir)
			ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"冲撞",100)
		end
		task.wait(duration)
		-- 停止冲刺动画
		DashTrail.Enabled = false
		DashPar.Enabled = false
		dashTrack:Stop()
		
		-- 停止移动
		humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
		ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"冲撞",0)
		
		-- 晕
		dashafterTrack:Play()
		giddyPar.Enabled = true
		humanoidRootPart.dizzy:Play()
		humanoidRootPart.strike:Play()
		--GameHelper:KickAss(bull,humanoidRootPart.Position)
		task.wait(3)
		dashafterTrack:Stop()
		giddyPar.Enabled = false
		humanoidRootPart.dizzy:Stop()
	end

	local curAtkMode = _stage1AtkTypes
	if v_Mad.Value then
		curAtkMode = _stage2AtkTypes 
	end
	_atkTypeIndex += 1
	if _atkTypeIndex > #curAtkMode then
		_atkTypeIndex = 1
	end
	
	-- 随机下次攻击类型
	local newAtkType = curAtkMode[_atkTypeIndex]
	if newAtkType == ATK_TYPE.special then
		newAtkType = ATK_TYPE.fart
		if v_Mad.Value then
			-- 愤怒状态
			if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
				newAtkType = ATK_TYPE.dash -- 冲撞
			end
		else
			if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
				newAtkType = ATK_TYPE.snowball -- 扔雪球
			end
		end
	end	
	
	if newAtkType == ATK_TYPE.fart then
		-- 移速加成
		ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,EnemyValue.walkSpeed,"想放屁",10)
		-- 想放屁的音效
		humanoidRootPart.fartbefore:Play()
	end
	_curAtkType = newAtkType
	
	if not GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
		updateTarget()
	end
	
	v_Busy.Value = false
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(t:number,dt:number)
	if bull.PrimaryPart.Anchored then return end
	if v_Sleep.Value then return end

	if workspace.DistributedGameTime >= nextMoveTime then
		nextMoveTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.1
		if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
			if not v_Busy.Value then
				local character:Model = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
				local bullPos = bull:GetPivot().Position
				local targetPos = character:GetPivot().Position
				local offset = (targetPos - bullPos) * CommonEnum.XZ
				local distance = offset.Magnitude
				
				if _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.atk then
					if distance <= 10 then
						humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 近战攻击
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end
				elseif _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.snowball then
					if distance <= 50 then
						humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 雪球攻击
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end	
				elseif _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.dash then
					if distance <= 50 then
						--humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 冲撞攻击
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end	
				elseif _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.fart then
					if distance <= 10 then
						humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 放屁
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			--humanoid:MoveTo(spawnPosition)
		end	
	end
end)
