local function disconnectBonusConnections()
	for _, connection in ipairs(bonusConnections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(bonusConnections)
end

local function getRidingPlayer()
	if not occupant then return end
	return game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent)
end

local function getPlayerAttributeBonus(player:Player, valueObject:ValueBase)
	if not player or not valueObject then return 0 end
	local value = ValueHelper:FindValue(player, valueObject)
	return value and value.Value or 0
end

local function updateHorseMovementStats()
	local player = getRidingPlayer()
	local speedBonus = getPlayerAttributeBonus(player, PlayerAttributeValue.horseSpeedBonus)
	local jumpPowerBonus = getPlayerAttributeBonus(player, PlayerAttributeValue.horseJumpPowerBonus)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = (v_IsRun.Value and baseRunSpeed or baseMoveSpeed) * (1 + speedBonus)
	humanoid.JumpPower = baseJumpPower * (1 + jumpPowerBonus)
end

local function bindHorseBonusChanged(player:Player)
	disconnectBonusConnections()
	if not player then return end
	for _, valueObject in ipairs({PlayerAttributeValue.horseSpeedBonus, PlayerAttributeValue.horseJumpPowerBonus}) do
		local value = ValueHelper:FindValue(player, valueObject)
		if value then
			table.insert(bonusConnections, value.Changed:Connect(updateHorseMovementStats))
		end
	end
end

local function onIsRunChanged()
	updateHorseMovementStats()
end

local function setIsOnHorse(occupant:Humanoid,onHorse:boolean)
	if not occupant then return end
	local character:Model = occupant.Parent
	if onHorse then
		character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding)
		
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player then
			v_lastRidePlayer.Value = player
			bindHorseBonusChanged(player)
			updateHorseMovementStats()
			DataHelper:AddStats(v_lastRidePlayer.Value,CommonEnum.Stats.RideHorse,1)
		end
	else
		disconnectBonusConnections()
		character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding)
	end
end

-- 击飞
function kickAss(character:Model)
	if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then return end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	local offset = (character:GetPivot().Position - model:GetPivot().Position)
	local dir = (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit

	local velocity = dir * 30 + Vector3.new(0,10,0)
	local a = 30

	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	local owner = Torso:GetNetworkOwner()
	Torso:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	Torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
	Torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(a,math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
	task.wait(0.1)
	Torso:SetNetworkOwner(owner)
end

-- 刷新目标
function updateTarget()
	-- 1.目标是否存活
	-- 2.目标是否在战场
	if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) and v_targetPlayer.Value.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround) then
		return
	end
	
	v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
	if not v_targetPlayer.Value then
		local characters = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround)
		while #characters > 0 do
			local character = table.remove(characters,math.random(1,#characters))
			if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then
				v_targetPlayer.Value = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
				break
			end
		end	
	end
end

	local t = 1.5

function triggerAttack()
	local pattern = _attackPatterns[_attackIndex]
	_attackIndex += 1
	if _attackIndex > #_attackPatterns then
		_attackIndex = 1
	end
	--print("triggerAttack",pattern)
	if pattern == 1 then
		normalAttack()
	elseif pattern == 2 then
		skill_PoundGround()
	end

end

		if not sleepTrack.IsPlaying then sleepTrack:Play() end

		task.delay(1,function()

		idleTrack:Play()
		v_Busy.Value = false
	end

local function setIsOnHorse(occupant:Humanoid,onHorse:boolean)
	if not occupant then return end
	local character:Model = occupant.Parent
	if onHorse then
		character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding)
		
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player then
			v_lastRidePlayer.Value = player
			bindHorseBonusChanged(player)
			updateHorseMovementStats()
			DataHelper:AddStats(v_lastRidePlayer.Value,CommonEnum.Stats.RideHorse,1)
		end
	else
		disconnectBonusConnections()
		character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding)
	end
end

function setTorchEnable(torch:Model,enabled:boolean)
	local att = torch:FindFirstChild("火3"):FindFirstChild("Attachment")
	for _,eff:ParticleEmitter in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
		if eff:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or eff:IsA("PointLight") then
			eff.Enabled = enabled
		end
	end
end

function updateEnterCharacters()
	local characters:{Model} = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player)

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartsInPart(folder.ZonePart,overlapParams)
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
		local index = table.find(characters,character)
		if index then
			table.remove(characters,index)
			if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround) then
				print(character.Name, "进入列车副本")
				character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround)
			end
		end
	end

	for _,character in ipairs(characters) do
		if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround) then
			print(character.Name, "离开列车副本")
			character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnTrainBattleGround)
		end
	end
	--for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
	--	local character
	--end
end

function tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
	local model = rootModel:FindFirstChild(string.format("车厢%d",_wave))
	return model
end

function trySpawnEnemys()
	local model = tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
	local suc = false
	if model then
		print(string.format("生成 %s 敌人",model.Name))
		local enemyAttFolder = model:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点")
		if enemyAttFolder then
			for _,att in ipairs(enemyAttFolder:GetChildren()) do
				if not att:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
				local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(tonumber(att.Name))
				if enemy then
					enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)
					enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
					enemy.Parent = enemysParent

					local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
					humanoid.Died:Once(function() 
						enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
						enemy.Parent = workspace
					end)
					suc = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	return suc
end

function trySpawnBoss()
	local model = tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
	local suc = false
	if model then
		print(string.format("生成 %s Boss",model.Name))
		local bossAtt:Attachment = model:FindFirstChild("Boss")
		if bossAtt then
			-- 不生成Boss先
			local boss = workspace.Prefabs:FindFirstChild("敌人"):FindFirstChild("Mr.Doge"):Clone()
			--local boss = EnemyHelper:Create(215) -- 生成机枪佬
			boss:PivotTo(bossAtt.WorldCFrame)
			boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
			boss.Parent = enemysParent

			local humanoid:Humanoid = boss:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

			-- 每击杀一次+1000血
			humanoid.MaxHealth += v_CompleteTimes.Value * 1000
			humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth

			humanoid.Died:Once(function() 
				boss:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit)
				boss.Parent = workspace

				-- 掉落奖励
				ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(15,boss:GetPivot().Position)

				-- 统计击杀拳击狗
				for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
					DataHelper:AddStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.KillDoge,1)
				end
			end)
			suc = true
		end
	end

	return suc
end

game.CollectionService.TagRemoved:Connect(function(tag: string) 
	if tag == GameEnum.Tag.TrainBattleGroundBandit then
		
		local lastModel = tryGetCurrentRoundModel()
		if lastModel then
			print(string.format("已清空 %s 敌人",lastModel.Name))
			-- 打开当前已清空的车厢的门
			local DoorPart:Part = lastModel:FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
			if DoorPart then
				local ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt = DoorPart:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
				if not ProximityPrompt.Enabled then
					ProximityPrompt.Enabled = true
					ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered: Player) 
						trySpawnBoss()
						DoorPart:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			
			-- 生成宝箱
			local tresuresFolder = lastModel:FindFirstChild("宝箱生成点")
			if tresuresFolder then
				for _,att:Attachment in ipairs(tresuresFolder:GetChildren()) do
					GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName(att.Name,att.WorldCFrame,lastModel)
				end
				tresuresFolder:Destroy()
			end
		end
		
		-- 尝试初始化下一节车厢
		_wave += 1
		if tryGetCurrentRoundModel() then
			trySpawnEnemys()
		else
			print("通关火车大劫案")
			_wave = 0
			-- 赋值重置时间
			v_ResetCD.Value = 25*60
			v_CompleteTimes.Value += 1
			
			-- 成就统计
			local players = game.Players:GetPlayers()
			for _,player:Player in ipairs(players) do
				for _,otherPlayer:Player in ipairs(players) do
					if player == otherPlayer then continue end
					if player:IsFriendsWith(otherPlayer.UserId) then
						print(player.DisplayName,"和朋友一起通关火车大劫案成就统计+1")
						DataHelper:AddStats(player,CommonEnum.Stats.TheGreatTrainRobbery,1)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end	
end)

local Slide = BillboardGui:WaitForChild("Bg"):WaitForChild("Slide")
local t_health = BillboardGui:WaitForChild("t_health")
local maxHP = v_HP.Value

function onHPChanged()
	local alpha = math.clamp(v_HP.Value / maxHP,0,1)
	Slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha,Slide.Size.Y.Scale)
	t_health.Text = string.format("%d/%d",v_HP.Value,maxHP)
	
	if v_HP.Value <= 0 then
		BillboardGui.Enabled = false
		local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
		explosion.Position = HumanoidRootPart.Position
		explosion.BlastPressure = 0
		explosion.BlastRadius = 50
		explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
		explosion.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.Craters
		explosion.TimeScale = 0.5
		explosion.Visible = true
		explosion.Parent = workspace
		
		local isHit = false
		explosion.Hit:Connect(function(hitPart: BasePart, distance: number) 
			--print(part.Name)
			if isHit then return end
			local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
			if not character or not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then return end
			if hitPart:IsDescendantOf(character) then
				isHit = true
				local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
				if humanoid then
					humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
				end

				local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
				if Torso then
					local offset = (Torso.Position - explosion.Position) * CommonEnum.XZ
					Torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = offset.Unit * ((explosion.BlastRadius - distance) * 2) + Vector3.yAxis * 50
					local a = 30
					Torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
				end
			end
		end)
		
		HumanoidRootPart:WaitForChild("Bomb"):Play()
	end
end
onHPChanged()
v_HP.Changed:Connect(onHPChanged)

function playSmash(pos:Vector3)
	local color = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	local size = Vector3.one * 4
	local cframe = CFrame.new(pos)
	local material = Enum.Material.Snow

	local force = 50

	local lifeTime = 3
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifeTime * 0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)

	for i = 1,5 do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Color = color
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Snow
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part:AddTag("SnowballDebris")

		local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
		part.Size = Vector3.one * (1 + math.random() * 2)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + offset)
		part.Parent = workspace

		local force3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-force,force),force,math.random(-force,force)) 
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = force3
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = force3.Unit * 20

		local tween = game.TweenService:Create(part,tweenInfo,{
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(part,lifeTime)
	end
end

script.Parent:WaitForChild("hide").Changed:Once(function(value: boolean) 
	if value then
		for _,child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				playSmash(child.Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0))
			end
		end
	end	
end)

function updateEnterCharacters()
	local characters:{Model} = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player)

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartsInPart(folder.ZonePart,overlapParams)
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
		local index = table.find(characters,character)
		if index then
			table.remove(characters,index)
			if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround) then
				print(character.Name, "进入牛牛洞穴")
				character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround)
			end
		end
	end

	for _,character in ipairs(characters) do
		if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround) then
			print(character.Name, "离开牛牛洞穴")
			character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround)
		end
	end
end

		end
	end

function triggetAttack()
	_nextAttackTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + rootModel:FindFirstChild("Config"):FindFirstChild("雪球发射间隔").Value
	--_nextAttackTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.5
	
	local startPosition = rootModel.AttackStart.WorldPosition
	local targetCharacter = v_snowballTarget.Value
	local targetPlayer = targetCharacter and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetCharacter)
	for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local otherRoot = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local inRange = false
		if otherRoot then
			local delta = otherRoot.Position - startPosition
			inRange = delta:Dot(delta) <= 120 * 120
		end
		if otherPlayer == targetPlayer or inRange then
			rootModel.SnowballAttackS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, startPosition, targetCharacter)
		end
	end
end

function checkSnowBallHit(hitPos:Vector3)
	if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end
	
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	
	local op = OverlapParams.new()
	op:AddToFilter(character)
	op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
	op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(hitPos,snowballPrefab.Size.X * 2,op)
	local isHitMyCharacter = false
	local hitEnemys:{Model} = {}
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do 
		if hit:IsDescendantOf(character) then
			isHitMyCharacter = true
		end
		local enemy = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
		if enemy and not table.find(hitEnemys,enemy) then
			table.insert(hitEnemys,enemy)
		end
	end
	if isHitMyCharacter then
		--print("中了")
		SnowballHitC2S:FireServer()
		if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
			kickAss(character,hitPos) -- 在暴风雪里，会被击飞
		end
	end
	
	for _,enemy in ipairs(hitEnemys) do
		SnowballHitEnemyC2S:FireServer(enemy,hitPos)
	end
end

function playSmash(pos:Vector3)
	local color = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	local size = Vector3.one * 4
	local cframe = CFrame.new(pos)
	local material = Enum.Material.Snow

	local force = 50

	local lifeTime = 3
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifeTime * 0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)

	for i = 1,20 do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Color = color
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Snow
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part:AddTag("SnowballDebris")

		local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
		part.Size = Vector3.one * (1 + math.random() * 2)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + offset)
		part.Parent = workspace

		local force3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-force,force),force,math.random(-force,force)) 
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = force3
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = force3.Unit * 20

		local tween = game.TweenService:Create(part,tweenInfo,{
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(part,lifeTime)
	end
end

	Torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
	Torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(a,math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
end

SnowballAttackS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(startPos:Vector3,target:Model) 
	if not target then return end
	
	bullAttackTrack:Play()
	updateBullRotation()
	
	local ball = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Others"):WaitForChild("雪球"):Clone()
	ball.Position = startPos
	ball.Parent = workspace
	
	game.Debris:AddItem(ball,10)
	
	local FlySound = ball:WaitForChild("Fly")
	FlySound:Play()
	
	local snowballSourceKey = "snowball:" .. tostring(os.clock()) .. ":" .. tostring(startPos)
	local hitOnce = false
	local onHit = function()
		if hitOnce then return end
		hitOnce = true
		local impactPosition = ball.Position
		FlySound:Stop()
		checkSnowBallHit(impactPosition)
		playSmash(impactPosition)
		ball.Transparency = 1
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect("雪球命中", ball, {
			FallbackPosition = impactPosition,
			SourceKey = snowballSourceKey,
			TargetUserId = target == LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.UserId or nil,
		})
		game.Debris:AddItem(ball,3)
	end
	
	local endPos = target:GetPivot().Position
	local offset = endPos - startPos
	local offsetY = offset.Y
	
	local distance = offset.Magnitude -- 距离
	local duration = distance / 300 -- 运动时长
	--duration = 1
	local t = 0
	local snowfieldFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("雪原")	
	while true do
		local dt = RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		
		t += dt
		local alpha = math.clamp(t / duration,0,1)
		local xz = startPos:Lerp(endPos,alpha)
		local y = startPos.Y + offsetY * (1 - math.cos(alpha * HALF_PI))
		local pos = Vector3.new(xz.X,y,xz.Z)
		ball:PivotTo(ball.CFrame.Rotation + pos)
		--ball.Position = pos
		
		if alpha >= 1 then
			onHit()
			break
		else
			local op = OverlapParams.new()
			if snowfieldFolder then
				local shan = snowfieldFolder:FindFirstChild("山")
				if shan then
					op:AddToFilter(shan)
				end
			end
			op:AddToFilter(rootModel)
			op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem))
			op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged("SnowballDebris")) -- 雪球碎片
			
			op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

			local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos,ball.Size.X,op)
			if #hits > 0 then
				onHit()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

	local talkBubble = model:WaitForChild("火堆"):WaitForChild("RootPart"):WaitForChild("talkBubble")
	local BillboardGui = model:WaitForChild("火堆"):WaitForChild("RootPart"):WaitForChild("BillboardGui")

	local t_value = BillboardGui:WaitForChild("t_value")

	local percent = math.clamp(math.ceil(unit * 100),0,100)
	t_value.Text = string.format("progress:%d/100", percent)
	Slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(unit, 1)
	
	talkBubble:WaitForChild("img_tick").Visible = percent >= 100

	if percent >= 100 then

	end
end

function playAddHeatEffect()
	AudioHelper:PlayEffect("补充营火燃料",RootPart)
	_addHeatEff.Enabled = true

	 _addHeatEff.Size = 2
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,0)

model:FindFirstChild("火堆").TouchPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart) 
	if v_heat.Value >= v_heatMax.Value then 
		model:FindFirstChild("火堆").TouchPart.CanTouch = false
		return 
	end
	
	local isResItem,resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(otherPart)
	if not isResItem then return end
	
	local resItemLo:ResourcesItemSetting.Type = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(resItem)
	if resItemLo.isLightFire then 
		-- 湿的物品
		if resItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Wet) then
			if not resItem:HasTag("WetTips") then
				local lastDragPlayer:Player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(resItem,DragItemValue.lastDragPlayer)
				if lastDragPlayer then
					UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(lastDragPlayer,"The wet fuel cannot be used to light the campfire.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
					resItem:AddTag("WetTips")
				end
			end
			return
		end

		-- 添加数值
		local addHeat = tonumber(resItemLo.param) or 1
		v_heat.Value = math.clamp(v_heat.Value + addHeat,0,v_heatMax.Value)
		
		-- 删除物品
		ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(resItem)
		
		-- 添加火特效
		playAddHeatEffect()
		
		-- 点燃火把
		_fireEffect.Enabled = v_heat.Value >= v_heatMax.Value

	end
end)

	local axeId = v_axeId.Value
	if axeId == 0 then
		axeId = 104
	end
	local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(axeId)
	local param = resLo.param:split(",")

	local damage = tonumber(param[2] or param[1])
	return damage

	--print("攻击目标")
	if v_target.Value then
		if v_target.Value:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree) then
			local toolAxe = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if toolAxe then
				toolAxe:Activate()
			end
			-- 砍树
			GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(nil,v_target.Value,getAxeDamage())
			-- 播放砍树声音

			-- 记录下次攻击事件

			if GameHelper:GetTreeHP(v_target.Value) <= 0 then

				v_target.Value = nil
				_nextFindTreeTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1
			end
			stopMove()
		end
	end

	local waypoint:PathWaypoint = table.remove(waypoints,1)

	end)

function onTrigger()
	local downStore = Store:Clone()
	downStore:ScaleTo(originScale)
	downStore.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
	downStore.TouchPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart) 
		if not downStore.TouchPart.CanTouch then return end
		if otherPart:IsDescendantOf(downStore) or otherPart:IsDescendantOf(Store) then return end
		if not otherPart.CanCollide then return end
		downStore.TouchPart.CanTouch = false
		downStore.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
		
		--print("碰到了",otherPart.Name)
		
		for _,child in ipairs(downStore:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		
		for _,child in ipairs(downStore:GetDescendants()) do
			if child == downStore.PrimaryPart then continue end
			if child == downStore.TouchPart then continue end

			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Anchored = false
				child:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
				child.CanCollide = true
				child.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.OnlyDefault
				local r = math.random(40,60)
				local a = 10
				child.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),r,math.random(-r,r))
				child.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
			end
		end
		
		local king:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.WildBoarKing)
		if king then
			local characters = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround)
			if #characters then
				-- 受伤
				local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(table.remove(characters,1,#characters))
				GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,king,500)	
				-- 给个hight light
				Hightlight.Adornee = king
				task.delay(0.5,function()
					Hightlight.Adornee = nil
				end)
				
				-- 播放命中音效
				local sound = script.Hit:Clone()
				sound.Parent = king.PrimaryPart
				sound:Play()
				game.Debris:AddItem(sound,3)
				
			end
		end
		downStore.RootPart.broken:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(downStore.TouchPart,3)
		--downStore.TouchPart:Destroy()
	end)
	downStore.Parent = workspace
	game.Debris:AddItem(downStore,10)
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.WildBoarKing,function(king: Model, connections: {RBXScriptConnection}) 
	local LocalOrder:BindableEvent = king:WaitForChild("LocalOrder")
	table.insert(connections,LocalOrder.Event:Connect(function(cmd:string) 
		if cmd == "砸地" then
			if Store:GetScale() >= originScale then
				Store:ScaleTo(0.001)

				onTrigger()

				local t = 0
				while true do
					local dt = task.wait()
					t = math.clamp(t+dt,0.001,10)
					local alpha = t/10
					Store:ScaleTo(alpha * originScale)
					if alpha >= 1 then break end
				end
				popReadyTips()
			end
		end
	end)) 
end)

-- Variables used in tracking if the character is using a ControllerManager.
-- This implementation assumes the common case of the ControllerManager being a
-- child of the character, and that only one ControllerManager exists under a given
-- character. If a ControllerManager is not placed under its associated character,
-- then it will not be detected by this script.
-- The basis for this decision is performance: A ChildAdded listener on the
-- character is less of a performance hit than a ChildAdded listener on the
-- Workspace. And a FindFirstChild is more performant than checking for multiple
-- controllers via GetChildren.
local groundSensorChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerRootChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local managerParentChangedListener:RBXScriptSignal? = nil
local charGroundSensor:ControllerPartSensor? = nil
local charControllerManager:ControllerManager? = nil

local CCLAnimationFixed
do
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return UserSettings():IsUserFeatureEnabled("UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed")
	end)
	CCLAnimationFixed = success and result
end

-- Clean up listeners associated with the character's ControllerManager
function resetManagerListeners()
	if groundSensorChangedListener then
		groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
		groundSensorChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerRootChangedListener then
		managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerRootChangedListener = nil
	end
	if managerParentChangedListener then
		managerParentChangedListener:Disconnect()
		managerParentChangedListener = nil
	end
end

-- Clean up all listeners and reset state.
function teardownManager()
	resetManagerListeners()
	charGroundSensor = nil
	charControllerManager = nil
end

-- Returns true if checkManager controls the character associated with this script
-- If so, then checkManager is assigned to charControllerManager.
-- TODO: Remove this method when UserAnimationAbilityManagerFixed is made permanently true.
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager:ControllerManager):boolean
	if checkManager.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
		if charControllerManager ~= checkManager then
			resetManagerListeners()
			charGroundSensor = checkManager.GroundSensor
			groundSensorChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					groundSensorChangedListener:Disconnect()
					groundSensorChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerRootChangedListener = checkManager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
				if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(checkManager) then
					managerRootChangedListener:Disconnect()
					managerRootChangedListener = nil
				end
			end)
			managerParentChangedListener = checkManager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
				if parent == nil then
					resetManagerListeners()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			charControllerManager = checkManager
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Attach to a confirmed-valid manager: record it, read its current GroundSensor,
-- and watch for GroundSensor changes, RootPart changes, and removal.
function setupManager(manager:ControllerManager)
	charControllerManager = manager
	charGroundSensor = manager.GroundSensor

	groundSensorChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		charGroundSensor = charControllerManager.GroundSensor
	end)

	managerRootChangedListener = manager:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		if manager.RootPart ~= Character.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)

	managerParentChangedListener = manager.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end

-- Looks for the first ControllerManager directly childed to the character. If such
-- a controller does not exist or if it does not control that character, then a listener
-- is set up to check if a controller is ever added.
function lookForControllerManager()
	if CCLAnimationFixed then
		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(child)
			else
				-- Manager exists but RootPart not yet assigned; wait for it.
				local rootPartListener:RBXScriptSignal
				rootPartListener = child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					if child.RootPart == Character.PrimaryPart then
						rootPartListener:Disconnect()
						setupManager(child)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(newChild)
				if newChild:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		charGroundSensor = nil
		charControllerManager = nil

		local child:ControllerManager? = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if child then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child)
		end
		-- The call to processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter above will have
		-- assigned charControllerManager on success
		if charControllerManager == nil then
			local managerAddedListener:RBXScriptSignal
			managerAddedListener = Character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(child) then
						managerAddedListener:Disconnect()
						managerAddedListener = nil
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(set, anim)
	if set == nil or anim == nil then
		return 0
	end

	for idx = 1, set.count, 1 do
		if set[idx].anim.AnimationId == anim.AnimationId then
			return idx
		end
	end

	return 0
end

function configureAnimationSet(name, fileList)
	if (animTable[name] ~= nil) then
		for _, connection in pairs(animTable[name].connections) do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
	end
	animTable[name] = {}
	animTable[name].count = 0
	animTable[name].totalWeight = 0
	animTable[name].connections = {}

	local allowCustomAnimations = true

	local success, msg = pcall(function() allowCustomAnimations = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations end)
	if not success then
		allowCustomAnimations = true
	end

	-- check for config values
	local config = script:FindFirstChild(name)
	if (allowCustomAnimations and config ~= nil) then
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildAdded:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
		table.insert(animTable[name].connections, config.ChildRemoved:connect(function(child) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))

		local idx = 0
		for _, childPart in pairs(config:GetChildren()) do
			if (childPart:IsA("Animation")) then
				local newWeight = 1
				local weightObject = childPart:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				if (weightObject ~= nil) then
					newWeight = weightObject.Value
				end
				animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
				idx = animTable[name].count
				animTable[name][idx] = {}
				animTable[name][idx].anim = childPart
				animTable[name][idx].weight = newWeight
				animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + animTable[name][idx].weight
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.Changed:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildAdded:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
				table.insert(animTable[name].connections, childPart.ChildRemoved:connect(function(property) configureAnimationSet(name, fileList) end))
			end
		end
	end

	-- fallback to defaults
	if (animTable[name].count <= 0) then
		for idx, anim in pairs(fileList) do
			animTable[name][idx] = {}
			animTable[name][idx].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			animTable[name][idx].anim.Name = name
			animTable[name][idx].anim.AnimationId = anim.id
			animTable[name][idx].weight = anim.weight
			animTable[name].count = animTable[name].count + 1
			animTable[name].totalWeight = animTable[name].totalWeight + anim.weight
		end
	end

	-- preload anims
	for i, animType in pairs(animTable) do
		for idx = 1, animType.count, 1 do
			if PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				Humanoid:LoadAnimation(animType[idx].anim)
				PreloadedAnims[animType[idx].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function stopAllAnimations()
	local oldAnim = currentAnim

	-- return to idle if finishing an emote
	if (emoteNames[oldAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[oldAnim] == false) then
		oldAnim = "idle"
	end

	if currentlyPlayingEmote then
		oldAnim = "idle"
		currentlyPlayingEmote = false
	end

	currentAnim = ""
	currentAnimInstance = nil
	if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		currentAnimTrack:Stop()
		currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		currentAnimTrack = nil
	end

	-- clean up walk if there is one
	if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		runAnimTrack:Stop()
		runAnimTrack:Destroy()
		runAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function getHeightScale()
	if Humanoid then
		if not Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
			-- When auto scaling is not enabled, the rig scale stands in for
			-- a computed scale.
			return getRigScale()
		end

		local scale = Humanoid.HipHeight / HumanoidHipHeight
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject == nil then
			AnimationSpeedDampeningObject = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
		end
		if AnimationSpeedDampeningObject ~= nil then
			scale = 1 + (Humanoid.HipHeight - HumanoidHipHeight) * AnimationSpeedDampeningObject.Value / HumanoidHipHeight
		end
		return scale
	end
	return getRigScale()
end

local function rootMotionCompensation(speed)
	local speedScaled = speed * 1.25
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()
	local runSpeed = speedScaled / heightScale
	return runSpeed
end

local smallButNotZero = 0.0001
local function setRunSpeed(speed)
	local normalizedWalkSpeed = 0.5 -- established empirically using current `913402848` walk animation
	local normalizedRunSpeed  = 1
	local runSpeed = rootMotionCompensation(speed)

	local walkAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local runAnimationWeight = smallButNotZero
	local timeWarp = 1

	if runSpeed <= normalizedWalkSpeed then
		walkAnimationWeight = 1
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedWalkSpeed
	elseif runSpeed < normalizedRunSpeed then
		local fadeInRun = (runSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)/(normalizedRunSpeed - normalizedWalkSpeed)
		walkAnimationWeight = 1 - fadeInRun
		runAnimationWeight  = fadeInRun
	else
		timeWarp = runSpeed/normalizedRunSpeed
		runAnimationWeight = 1
	end
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(walkAnimationWeight)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustWeight(runAnimationWeight)
	currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
	runAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(timeWarp)
end

function setAnimationSpeed(speed)
	if currentAnim == "walk" then
		setRunSpeed(speed)
	else
		if speed ~= currentAnimSpeed then
			currentAnimSpeed = speed
			currentAnimTrack:AdjustSpeed(currentAnimSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)
	if (frameName == "End") then
		if currentAnim == "walk" then
			if runAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				runAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
			if currentAnimTrack.Looped ~= true then
				currentAnimTrack.TimePosition = 0.0
			end
		else
			local repeatAnim = currentAnim
			-- return to idle if finishing an emote
			if (emoteNames[repeatAnim] ~= nil and emoteNames[repeatAnim] == false) then
				repeatAnim = "idle"
			end

			if currentlyPlayingEmote then
				if currentAnimTrack.Looped then
					-- Allow the emote to loop
					return
				end

				repeatAnim = "idle"
				currentlyPlayingEmote = false
			end

			local animSpeed = currentAnimSpeed
			playAnimation(repeatAnim, 0.15, Humanoid)
			setAnimationSpeed(animSpeed)
		end
	end
end

function rollAnimation(animName)
	local roll = math.random(1, animTable[animName].totalWeight)
	local origRoll = roll
	local idx = 1
	while (roll > animTable[animName][idx].weight) do
		roll = roll - animTable[animName][idx].weight
		idx = idx + 1
	end
	return idx
end

local function switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	-- switch animation
	if (anim ~= currentAnimInstance) then

		if (currentAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			currentAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			currentAnimTrack:Destroy()
		end

		if (runAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			runAnimTrack:Stop(transitionTime)
			runAnimTrack:Destroy()
			runAnimTrack = nil
		end

		currentAnimSpeed = 1.0

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		currentAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		currentAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

		-- play the animation
		currentAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		currentAnim = animName
		currentAnimInstance = anim

		-- set up keyframe name triggers
		if (currentAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
			currentAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
		end
		currentAnimKeyframeHandler = currentAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)

		-- check to see if we need to blend a walk/run animation
		if animName == "walk" then
			local runAnimName = "run"
			local runIdx = rollAnimation(runAnimName)

			runAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animTable[runAnimName][runIdx].anim)
			runAnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			runAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)

			if (runAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
				runAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
			end
			runAnimKeyframeHandler = runAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
	end
end

function playAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	switchToAnim(anim, animName, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = false
end

function playEmote(emoteAnim, transitionTime, humanoid)
	switchToAnim(emoteAnim, emoteAnim.Name, transitionTime, humanoid)
	currentlyPlayingEmote = true
end

function toolKeyFrameReachedFunc(frameName)

function playToolAnimation(animName, transitionTime, humanoid, priority)
	local idx = rollAnimation(animName)
	local anim = animTable[animName][idx].anim

	if (toolAnimInstance ~= anim) then

		if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
			toolAnimTrack:Stop()
			toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
			transitionTime = 0
		end

		-- load it to the humanoid; get AnimationTrack
		toolAnimTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
		if priority then
			toolAnimTrack.Priority = priority
		end

		-- play the animation
		toolAnimTrack:Play(transitionTime)
		toolAnimName = animName
		toolAnimInstance = anim

		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler = toolAnimTrack.KeyframeReached:connect(toolKeyFrameReachedFunc)
	end
end

function stopToolAnimations()
	local oldAnim = toolAnimName

	if (currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler ~= nil) then
		currentToolAnimKeyframeHandler:disconnect()
	end

	toolAnimName = ""
	toolAnimInstance = nil
	if (toolAnimTrack ~= nil) then
		toolAnimTrack:Stop()
		toolAnimTrack:Destroy()
		toolAnimTrack = nil
	end

	return oldAnim
end

function onRunning(speed)
	local heightScale = getHeightScale()

	-- Adjust the walking speed if a ControllerManager is being used.
	-- "speed" is world speed, whereas we want local speed.
	-- IE, do not animate a walk if the character is stationary atop
	-- a moving platform.
	if charGroundSensor ~= nil and Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local hrp = Humanoid.RootPart
		local sensedPart = charGroundSensor.SensedPart
		if sensedPart then
			local pos = charGroundSensor.HitFrame.Position
			local floorVel = sensedPart:GetVelocityAtPosition(pos)
			local assemblyVel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			-- Ignore y-velocity, so that jumping does not influence the animation speed
			local relVel = Vector3.new(assemblyVel.X - floorVel.X, 0, assemblyVel.Z - floorVel.Z)
			local relSpeed = relVel.Magnitude
			local moveMag = charControllerManager.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if moveMag < 0.1 then
				relSpeed = 0
				moveMag = 0
			elseif moveMag > 1.0 then
				moveMag = 1.0
			end
			speed = relSpeed * moveMag
		end
	end

	local movedDuringEmote = currentlyPlayingEmote and Humanoid.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local speedThreshold = movedDuringEmote and (Humanoid.WalkSpeed / heightScale) or 0.75
	if speed > speedThreshold * heightScale then
		local scale = 16.0
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
		setAnimationSpeed(speed / scale)
		pose = "Running"
	else
		if emoteNames[currentAnim] == nil and not currentlyPlayingEmote then
			playAnimation("idle", 0.2, Humanoid)
			pose = "Standing"
		end
	end
end

function animateTool()
	if (toolAnim == "None") then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", toolTransitionTime, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
		return
	end

	if (toolAnim == "Slash") then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, Humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)

	end

	if (toolAnim == "Lunge") then

		return
	end
end

function getToolAnim(tool)
	for _, c in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == "toolanim" and c.className == "StringValue" then
			return c
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local lastTick = 0

function stepAnimate(currentTime)
	local amplitude = 1
	local frequency = 1
	local deltaTime = currentTime - lastTick
	lastTick = currentTime

	local climbFudge = 0
	local setAngles = false

	if (jumpAnimTime > 0) then
		jumpAnimTime = jumpAnimTime - deltaTime
	end

	if (pose == "FreeFall" and jumpAnimTime <= 0) then
		playAnimation("fall", fallTransitionTime, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Seated") then
		playAnimation("sit", 0.5, Humanoid)
		return
	elseif (pose == "Running") then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, Humanoid)
	elseif (pose == "Dead" or pose == "GettingUp" or pose == "FallingDown" or pose == "Seated" or pose == "PlatformStanding") then
		stopAllAnimations()
		amplitude = 0.1
		frequency = 1
		setAngles = true
	end

	-- Tool Animation handling
	local tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local animStringValueObject = getToolAnim(tool)

		if animStringValueObject then
			toolAnim = animStringValueObject.Value
			-- message recieved, delete StringValue
			animStringValueObject.Parent = nil
			toolAnimTime = currentTime + .3
		end

		if currentTime > toolAnimTime then
			toolAnimTime = 0
			toolAnim = "None"
		end

		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		toolAnim = "None"
		toolAnimInstance = nil
		toolAnimTime = 0
	end
end

	if Player ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then
		if Handle then

			local Distance = (MuzzlePos-EndPos).magnitude/2

			Muzzle.Anchored = false
			Muzzle.CanCollide = false
			Muzzle.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines
			Muzzle.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines
			local Particle = MuzzleEffect:Clone()
			Particle.Parent = Muzzle
			local Weld = Instance.new("Weld",Muzzle)

			Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(MuzzleOffset.X,MuzzleOffset.Y,MuzzleOffset.Z)
			Muzzle.Position = MuzzlePos
			Muzzle.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			Spawn(function() Particle:Emit(5) end)
			game.Debris:AddItem(Muzzle,10)

			HitPart.Transparency = 1
			HitPart.Anchored = true
			HitPart.CanCollide = false
			HitPart.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines
			HitPart.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines

			Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://"..HitSound
			Sound.Volume = 1
			HitPart.Position = EndPos
			HitPart.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			Spawn(function() Particle:Emit(2) Sound:Play() end)
			game.Debris:AddItem(HitPart,10)	
			
			if ExplosiveData[1] and VisualizeExplosion then
				local Explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
				Explosion.BlastRadius = ExplosiveData[2]
				Explosion.BlastPressure = 0
				Explosion.Position = EndPos
				Explosion.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			end
			if VisualizeEnabled then
				local Bullet = Instance.new("Part")
				Bullet.Name = "Bullet"
				Bullet.Size = Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)
				Bullet.BrickColor = BulletData[3]
				Bullet.Transparency = BulletData[4]
				Bullet.Material = BulletData[5]
				Bullet.Anchored = true
				Bullet.CanCollide = false
				Bullet.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines
				Bullet.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines
				local Mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh",Bullet)
				Mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick
				Mesh.Scale = BulletData[2] * 5
				Mesh.Offset =  Vector3.new(0,0,-Mesh.Scale.Z/10)
				Bullet.CFrame = CFrame.new(MuzzlePos,EndPos)
				Bullet.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
				game.Debris:AddItem(Bullet,10)
				if BulletData[1] ~= math.huge then
					for i = 0,Distance,BulletData[1] do
						if i ~= 0 then Bullet.CFrame = Bullet.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,-BulletData[1]) end
						if (Bullet.Position - EndPos).magnitude < BulletData[2].Z then
							Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(BulletData[2].X,BulletData[2].Y,(Bullet.Position - EndPos).magnitude) * 5
							Mesh.Offset =  Vector3.new(0,0,-Mesh.Scale.Z/10)
						end
						game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:wait()
					end
				else
					Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(BulletData[2].X,BulletData[2].Y,(Bullet.Position - EndPos).magnitude) * 5
					Mesh.Offset =  Vector3.new(0,0,-Mesh.Scale.Z/10)
					local Time = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
					while Bullet.Transparency < 1 do
						Bullet.Transparency = Bullet.Transparency + (Time/BulletData[6])
						Time = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
					end
				end
				if Bullet then Bullet:Destroy() end
			end
		end
	end

local NEVER_BREAK_JOINTS = false -- If you set this to true it will never break joints (this can create some welding issues, but can save stuff like hinges).


local function CallOnChildren(Instance, FunctionToCall)
	-- Calls a function on each of the children of a certain object, using recursion.  

	FunctionToCall(Instance)

	for _, Child in next, Instance:GetChildren() do
		CallOnChildren(Child, FunctionToCall)
	end
end

local function GetNearestParent(Instance, ClassName)
	-- Returns the nearest parent of a certain class, or returns nil

	local Ancestor = Instance
	repeat
		Ancestor = Ancestor.Parent
		if Ancestor == nil then
			return nil
		end
	until Ancestor:IsA(ClassName)

	return Ancestor
end

local function GetBricks(StartInstance)
	local List = {}

	-- if StartInstance:IsA("BasePart") then
	-- 	List[#List+1] = StartInstance
	-- end

	CallOnChildren(StartInstance, function(Item)
		if Item:IsA("BasePart") then
			List[#List+1] = Item;
		end
	end)

	return List
end

local function Modify(Instance, Values)
	-- Modifies an Instance by using a table.  

	assert(type(Values) == "table", "Values is not a table");

	for Index, Value in next, Values do
		if type(Index) == "number" then
			Value.Parent = Instance
		else
			Instance[Index] = Value
		end
	end
	return Instance
end

local function Make(ClassType, Properties)
	-- Using a syntax hack to create a nice way to Make new items.  

	return Modify(Instance.new(ClassType), Properties)
end

local Surfaces = {"TopSurface", "BottomSurface", "LeftSurface", "RightSurface", "FrontSurface", "BackSurface"}
local HingSurfaces = {"Hinge", "Motor", "SteppingMotor"}

local function HasWheelJoint(Part)
	for _, SurfaceName in pairs(Surfaces) do
		for _, HingSurfaceName in pairs(HingSurfaces) do
			if Part[SurfaceName].Name == HingSurfaceName then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

local function ShouldBreakJoints(Part)
	--- We do not want to break joints of wheels/hinges. This takes the utmost care to not do this. There are
	--  definitely some edge cases. 

	if NEVER_BREAK_JOINTS then
		return false
	end
	
	if HasWheelJoint(Part) then
		return false
	end
	
	local Connected = Part:GetConnectedParts()
	
	if #Connected == 1 then
		return false
	end
	
	for _, Item in pairs(Connected) do
		if HasWheelJoint(Item) then
			return false
		elseif not Item:IsDescendantOf(script.Parent) then
			return false
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

local function WeldTogether(Part0, Part1, JointType, WeldParent)
	--- Weld's 2 parts together
	-- @param Part0 The first part
	-- @param Part1 The second part (Dependent part most of the time).
	-- @param [JointType] The type of joint. Defaults to weld.
	-- @param [WeldParent] Parent of the weld, Defaults to Part0 (so GC is better).
	-- @return The weld created.

	JointType = JointType or "Weld"
	local RelativeValue = Part1:FindFirstChild("qRelativeCFrameWeldValue")
	
	local NewWeld = Part1:FindFirstChild("qCFrameWeldThingy") or Instance.new(JointType)
	Modify(NewWeld, {
		Name = "qCFrameWeldThingy";
		Part0  = Part0;
		Part1  = Part1;
		C0     = CFrame.new();--Part0.CFrame:inverse();
		C1     = RelativeValue and RelativeValue.Value or Part1.CFrame:toObjectSpace(Part0.CFrame); --Part1.CFrame:inverse() * Part0.CFrame;-- Part1.CFrame:inverse();
		Parent = Part1;
	})

	if not RelativeValue then
		RelativeValue = Make("CFrameValue", {
			Parent     = Part1;
			Name       = "qRelativeCFrameWeldValue";
			Archivable = true;
			Value      = NewWeld.C1;
		})
	end

	return NewWeld
end

local function WeldParts(Parts, MainPart, JointType, DoNotUnanchor)
	-- @param Parts The Parts to weld. Should be anchored to prevent really horrible results.
	-- @param MainPart The part to weld the model to (can be in the model).
	-- @param [JointType] The type of joint. Defaults to weld. 
	-- @parm DoNotUnanchor Boolean, if true, will not unachor the model after cmopletion.
	
	for _, Part in pairs(Parts) do
		if ShouldBreakJoints(Part) then
			Part:BreakJoints()
		end
	end
	
	for _, Part in pairs(Parts) do
		if Part ~= MainPart then
			WeldTogether(MainPart, Part, JointType, MainPart)
		end
	end

	if not DoNotUnanchor then
		for _, Part in pairs(Parts) do
			Part.Anchored = false
		end
		MainPart.Anchored = false
	end
end

local function PerfectionWeld()	
	local Tool = GetNearestParent(script, "Tool")

	local Parts = GetBricks(script.Parent)
	local PrimaryPart = Tool and Tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") and Tool.Handle:IsA("BasePart") and Tool.Handle or script.Parent:IsA("Model") and script.Parent.PrimaryPart or Parts[1]

	if PrimaryPart then
		WeldParts(Parts, PrimaryPart, "Weld", false)
	else
		warn("qWeld - Unable to weld part")
	end
	
	return Tool
end

function wait(TimeToWait)
	if TimeToWait ~= nil then
		local TotalTime = 0
		TotalTime = TotalTime + game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
		while TotalTime < TimeToWait do
			TotalTime = TotalTime + game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
		end
	else
		game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:wait()
	end
end

function RayCast(Start,Direction,Range,Ignore)
	local Hit,EndPos = game.Workspace:FindPartOnRay(Ray.new(Start,Direction*Range),Ignore)
	if Hit then
		if (Hit.Transparency > 0.75
			or Hit.Name == "Handle"
			or Hit.Name == "Effect"
			or Hit.Name == "Bullet"
			or Hit.Name == "Laser"
			or string.lower(Hit.Name) == "water"
			or Hit.Name == "Rail"
			or Hit.Name == "Arrow"
			or (Hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and Hit.Parent.Humanoid.Health == 0)
			or (Hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and Hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("TEAM") and TEAM and Hit.Parent.TEAM.Value == TEAM.Value))
			or (Hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and PiercedHumanoid[Hit.Parent.Humanoid]) then
			Hit,EndPos = RayCast(EndPos+(Direction*.01),Direction,Range-((Start-EndPos).magnitude),Ignore)
		end
	end
	return Hit,EndPos
end

function ShakeCamera()
	if Module.CameraShakingEnabled then
		local Intensity = Module.Intensity/(AimDown and Module.MouseSensitive or 1)
		for i = 1, 10 do
			local cam_rot = Camera.CoordinateFrame - Camera.CoordinateFrame.p
			local cam_scroll = (Camera.CoordinateFrame.p - Camera.Focus.p).magnitude
			local ncf = CFrame.new(Camera.Focus.p)*cam_rot*CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ((-Intensity+(math.random()*(Intensity*2)))/100, (-Intensity+(math.random()*(Intensity*2)))/100, 0)
			Camera.CoordinateFrame = ncf*CFrame.new(0, 0, cam_scroll)
			wait()
		end
	end
end

function Reload()
	if Enabled and not Reloading and (Clips > 0 or not Module.LimitedClipEnabled) and Ammo < Module.AmmoPerClip then
		Reloading = true
		if AimDown then
			Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
			--[[local GUI = game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ZoomGui")
			if GUI then GUI:Destroy() end]]
			GUI.Scope.Visible = false
			game.Players.LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
			script["Mouse Sensitivity"].Disabled = true
			AimDown = false
			Mouse.Icon = "rbxassetid://"..Module.MouseIconID
		end
		UpdateGUI()
		if Module.ShotgunReload then
			for i = 1,(Module.AmmoPerClip - Ammo) do
				if ShotgunClipinAnim then ShotgunClipinAnim:Play(nil,nil,Module.ShotgunClipinAnimationSpeed) end
				Handle.ShotgunClipin:Play()
				wait(Module.ShellClipinSpeed)
			end
		end
		if ReloadAnim then ReloadAnim:Play(nil,nil,Module.ReloadAnimationSpeed) end
		Handle.ReloadSound:Play() script.Parent.Model.reload:FireServer()
		wait(Module.ReloadTime)
		if Module.LimitedClipEnabled then Clips = Clips - 1 end
		Ammo = Module.AmmoPerClip
		ChangeAmmoAndClip:FireServer(Ammo,Clips)
		Reloading = false
		UpdateGUI()
	end
end

	GUI.Frame.Ammo.Max.Visible = not Reloading
	GUI.Frame.Ammo.Frame.Visible = not Reloading

local asin=math.asin
local abs=math.abs

local cf=CFrame.new
local components=cf().components
local Angles=CFrame.Angles
local tau=2*math.pi

local function EulerAnglesYX(c)--No z, I don't care about z.
	local _,_,_,m00,m01,m02,m10,m11,m12,m20,m21,m22=components(c)
	return abs(m12)>0.99999 and -atan2(-m20,m00) or -atan2(-m02,m22),-asin(m12)
end

local ly,lx=EulerAnglesYX(Camera.CoordinateFrame)
function Update()
	local cy,cx=EulerAnglesYX(Camera.CoordinateFrame)
	ly,lx=ly*(1-t)+(cy+tau*floor((ly-cy)/tau+0.5))*t,lx*(1-t)+(cx+tau*floor((lx-cx)/tau+0.5))*t
	--print(ly,lx)
	Camera.CoordinateFrame=Angles(0,ly,0)*Angles(lx,0,0)*cf(0,0,0.5)+Camera.Focus.p--Head.Position	
end

local function spreadDirection(direction:Vector3)
	local frame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,direction)
	local angle=math.rad(1.15)
	local radius=math.sqrt(math.random())*math.tan(angle)
	local theta=math.random()*math.pi*2
	return frame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.cos(theta)*radius,math.sin(theta)*radius,-1)).Unit
end
local function shoot(inputContext)
	if not active or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character or v_reloading.Value then return end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value<=0 then GameHelper.GunReloadC2S:FireServer() return end
	local now=workspace.DistributedGameTime
	if now<nextFireTime then return end
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then shotContext=RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(inputContext) if not shotContext then return end end
	nextFireTime=now+c_shotCD.Value
	if fireTrack then fireTrack:Play() end
	local aimTarget=shotContext and shotContext.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	local points=tool.FirePoints:GetChildren()
	local fireTimes=math.min(v_bulletAmount.Value,#points)
	for index=1,fireTimes do
		local firePoint=points[index]
		local origin=firePoint.WorldPosition
		local delta=aimTarget-origin
		if delta.Magnitude>0.001 then
			local direction=spreadDirection(delta.Unit)
			local params=RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
			params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
			local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction*50,params)
			local hit=result and result.Instance or nil
			local actualEnd=result and result.Position or origin+direction*50
			local hitCharacter=GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)==true
			task.spawn(function() GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(tool,actualEnd,firePoint,hitCharacter) end)
			tool.TryFireC2S:FireServer(hit,actualEnd,firePoint,shotContext and shotContext.ShotToken)
		end
	end
end

	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)

local Core = Body:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local IsR6 = (Hum.RigType.Value==0)	--[Checking if the player is using R15 or R6.]
local Trso = (IsR6 and Body:WaitForChild("Torso")) or Body:WaitForChild("UpperTorso")
local Neck = (IsR6 and Trso:WaitForChild("Neck")) or Head:WaitForChild("Neck")	--[Once we know the Rig, we know what to find.]
local Waist = (not IsR6 and Trso:WaitForChild("Waist"))	--[R6 doesn't have a waist joint, unfortunately.]

--[[
	[Whether rotation follows the camera or the mouse.]
	[Useful with tools if true, but camera tracking runs smoother.]
--]]
local MseGuide = true
--[[
	[Whether the whole character turns to face the mouse.]
	[If set to true, MseGuide will be set to true and both HeadHorFactor and BodyHorFactor will be set to 0]
--]]
local TurnCharacterToMouse = true
--[[
	[Horizontal and Vertical limits for head and body tracking.]
	[Setting to 0 negates tracking, setting to 1 is normal tracking, and setting to anything higher than 1 goes past real life head/body rotation capabilities.]
--]]
local HeadHorFactor = 1
local HeadVertFactor = 0.6
local BodyHorFactor = 0.5
local BodyVertFactor = 0.4

--[[
	[How fast the body rotates.]
	[Setting to 0 negates tracking, and setting to 1 is instant rotation. 0.5 is a nice in-between that works with MseGuide on or off.]
	[Setting this any higher than 1 causes weird glitchy shaking occasionally.]
--]]
local UpdateSpeed = 0.5

local NeckOrgnC0 = Neck.C0	--[Get the base C0 to manipulate off of.]
local WaistOrgnC0 = (not IsR6 and Waist.C0)	--[Get the base C0 to manipulate off of.]

--[Setup]:

Neck.MaxVelocity = 1/3

-- Activation]:
if TurnCharacterToMouse == true then
	MseGuide = true
	HeadHorFactor = 0
	BodyHorFactor = 0
end

game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if shooting then
		if tool.Parent == plr.Character then
			if mouse.Hit and mouse.Target ~= plr.Character then
				remote:FireServer(mouse.hit.p)
			end
		end
	end
	
	if tool.Parent == plr.Character then
		local CamCF = Cam.CoordinateFrame
		if ((IsR6 and Body["Torso"]) or Body["UpperTorso"])~=nil and Body["Head"]~=nil then	--[Check for the Torso and Head...]
			local TrsoLV = Trso.CFrame.lookVector
			local HdPos = Head.CFrame.p
			if IsR6 and Neck or Neck and Waist then	--[Make sure the Neck still exists.]
				if Cam.CameraSubject:IsDescendantOf(Body) or Cam.CameraSubject:IsDescendantOf(Plr) then
					local Dist = nil;
					local Diff = nil;
					if not MseGuide then	--[If not tracking the Mouse then get the Camera.]
						Dist = (Head.CFrame.p-CamCF.p).magnitude
						Diff = Head.CFrame.Y-CamCF.Y
						if not IsR6 then	--[R6 and R15 Neck rotation C0s are different; R15: X axis inverted and Z is now the Y.]
							Neck.C0 = Neck.C0:lerp(NeckOrgnC0*Ang((aSin(Diff/Dist)*HeadVertFactor), -(((HdPos-CamCF.p).Unit):Cross(TrsoLV)).Y*HeadHorFactor, 0), UpdateSpeed/2)
							Waist.C0 = Waist.C0:lerp(WaistOrgnC0*Ang((aSin(Diff/Dist)*BodyVertFactor), -(((HdPos-CamCF.p).Unit):Cross(TrsoLV)).Y*BodyHorFactor, 0), UpdateSpeed/2)
						else	--[R15s actually have the properly oriented Neck CFrame.]
							Neck.C0 = Neck.C0:lerp(NeckOrgnC0*Ang(-(aSin(Diff/Dist)*HeadVertFactor), 0, -(((HdPos-CamCF.p).Unit):Cross(TrsoLV)).Y*HeadHorFactor),UpdateSpeed/2)
						end
					else
						local Point = Mouse.Hit.p
						Dist = (Head.CFrame.p-Point).magnitude
						Diff = Head.CFrame.Y-Point.Y
						if not IsR6 then
							Neck.C0 = Neck.C0:lerp(NeckOrgnC0*Ang(-(aTan(Diff/Dist)*HeadVertFactor), (((HdPos-Point).Unit):Cross(TrsoLV)).Y*HeadHorFactor, 0), UpdateSpeed/2)
							Waist.C0 = Waist.C0:lerp(WaistOrgnC0*Ang(-(aTan(Diff/Dist)*BodyVertFactor), (((HdPos-Point).Unit):Cross(TrsoLV)).Y*BodyHorFactor, 0), UpdateSpeed/2)
						else
							Neck.C0 = Neck.C0:lerp(NeckOrgnC0*Ang((aTan(Diff/Dist)*HeadVertFactor), 0, (((HdPos-Point).Unit):Cross(TrsoLV)).Y*HeadHorFactor), UpdateSpeed/2)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if TurnCharacterToMouse == true then
			Hum.AutoRotate = false
			Core.CFrame = Core.CFrame:lerp(CFrame.new(Core.Position, Vector3.new(Mouse.Hit.p.x, Core.Position.Y, Mouse.Hit.p.z)), UpdateSpeed / 2)
		else
			Hum.AutoRotate = true
		end
	else
		Hum.AutoRotate = true
	end
end)

--[[
	Based on the bear trap created by TheDrakCarlos. I removed the need to click it to reset. 
	Instead it autoresets so it can be used as an automated trap
--]]	
	
debounce = true
local trap = script.Parent.Parent

function onTouched(part)
	local player = part.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if (player ~= nil and debounce == true and part.Parent:HasTag('Player') ) then --If the part is a player then
		if script.Parent.Captured.Value == false then
			debounce = false
			player.Health = player.Health - 10 --Take 10% of the player's health away
			trap.Open.Transparency = 1 --Close the trap
			trap.Close.Transparency = 0
			script.Parent.Bang:Play() --Play audios
			--script.Parent.Ow:Play()
			wait(0.5)
			part.Parent.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true --Anchor their torso so they don't flail around
			script.Parent.Captured.Value = true
			wait(3) --Wait 3 seconds
			script.Parent.Parent.Open.Transparency = 0 --Open the trap
			script.Parent.Parent.Close.Transparency = 1
			player.Jump = true --Make sure the player isn't glitched
			part.Parent.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
			debounce = true
			wait(2) --Wait 2 seconds
			script.Parent.Captured.Value = false
		end
	end
end

				AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

			av.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

function onActivateChanged()
	local activate = v_activate.Value
	
	-- 播放动画
	local tweens = v_activate.Value and _stratTweens or _stopTweens
	for _,tween:Tween in ipairs(tweens) do
		tween:Play()
	end

	for _,par in ipairs(_rootModel.Center:GetDescendants()) do
		if par:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			par.Enabled = v_activate.Value
		end
	end
	
	-- 设置UI显示
	_rootModel.Main.BillboardGui.Enabled = not activate

	-- 设置交互按钮开关
	_rootModel.Main.ProximityPrompt.Enabled = not activate

	if activate then
		_rootModel.Main.ActivateSound:Play()
	end
end

local function getOldCowboyQuestTarget(targetKind)
	if targetKind ~= "STAGE1" and targetKind ~= "CEMETERY" then
		return nil, nil, "INVALID_TARGET"
	end

	local stage1Building
	local stage2Building
	for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if instance:IsA("Model") then
			local stage = instance:GetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestStage")
			if stage == 1 then
				stage1Building = instance
			elseif stage == 2 then
				stage2Building = instance
			end
		end
	end

	local building = targetKind == "STAGE1" and stage1Building or stage2Building
	if not building then
			if targetKind == "CEMETERY" and stage1Building then
				return nil, nil, "CEMETERY_NOT_READY"
			end
			return nil, nil, "EVENT_NOT_SELECTED"
		end

	local anchor = building
	if targetKind == "CEMETERY" then
		anchor = building:FindFirstChild("触发剧情")
			or building:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
			or building
	end

	local targetCFrame
	if anchor:IsA("BasePart") then
		targetCFrame = anchor.CFrame
	else
		targetCFrame = anchor:GetPivot()
	end
	return targetCFrame, building:GetAttribute("OldCowboyQuestState")
end

                else
                    spawnPos = startPos + dir

function updateBagTextByPlayer(player:Player)
    local bag:Tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if not bag or not bag:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bag) then return end
    local storeParent:Folder = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    local curNum = #storeParent:GetChildren()
    -- local size:IntValue = bag:FindFirstChild("Size")
    local size = BagHelper:GetSize(player) or 0
    local t_num:TextLabel = bag:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true)
    t_num.TextColor3 = curNum < size and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.new(1)
    if t_num then
        t_num.Text = string.format("%d/%d",curNum,size)
    end
end

function onCharacterAdded(player:Player,character:Model)
    if not character then return end

    local storeParent:Folder = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    local updateBagText = function()
        updateBagTextByPlayer(player)
    end
    updateBagText()

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(updateBagText)
    character.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateBagText)
    storeParent.ChildAdded:Connect(updateBagText)
    storeParent.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateBagText)
end

function onInitPlayerVo(player:Player)
    if not DataHelper:IsInit(player) then return end

    local v_HorseBagSize = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HorseBagSize)
    local v_BagSizeBonus = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.BagSizeBonus)
    onCharacterAdded(player,player.Character)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        onCharacterAdded(player,character)
    end)
    v_HorseBagSize.Changed:Connect(function()
        updateBagTextByPlayer(player)
    end)
    v_BagSizeBonus.Changed:Connect(function()
        updateBagTextByPlayer(player)
    end)
end

for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    onInitPlayerVo(player)
end

BagHelper.BagStoreC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player,item:Model)
    if item and not BagHelper:IsCanStore(item) then
        -- 物品不能储存
        warn(item.Name,"物品不能储存")
        return false,item:GetPivot()
    end
    if item and BagHelper:GetInWhoBag(item) then
        -- 在别人的背包里
        warn(item.Name,"在别人的背包里")
        return false
    end

    local storeParent:Folder = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    local size = BagHelper:GetSize(player)
    if #storeParent:GetChildren() < size then

function playDuang(model:Model)
	task.spawn(function()
		local originScale = model:GetScale()
		local t = 0
		local tt = 0.2
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(0.5 * originScale + alpha * 0.8 * originScale)
		end
		
		t = 0
		tt = 0.1
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = 1 - math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(originScale + 0.3 * originScale * alpha)
		end
		--Enum.EasingDirection.
		model:ScaleTo(originScale)
	end)
end

-- 核心 ‘ProcessReceipt’ 回调函数
local function processReceipt(receiptInfo)
	-- PurchaseId—唯一标识符。
	-- PlayerId—进行购买的用户ID。
	-- ProductId—购买产品的ID。
	-- placeidwherepurbought——购买的地点ID。根据用户在游戏过程中的位置，购买地点的ID可能与当前地点的ID相同，也可能不同。
	-- CurrencySpent—交易中花费的货币金额。
	-- CurrencyType—购买时使用的货币类型；总是Enum.CurrencyType.Robux。
	-- ProductPurchaseChannel——用户如何获得开发者的产品。枚举. productpurchasechannel之一。
	-- print(string.format("onProcessReceipt:%s",game.HttpService:JSONEncode(receiptInfo)))

	-- 检查数据存储，判断产品是否已经发放  
	local playerProductKey = receiptInfo.PlayerId .. "_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId
	local purchased = false
	local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
		purchased = purchaseHistoryStore:GetAsync(playerProductKey)
	end)

	-- 如果购买流程被记录下来，则说明产品已发放
	if success and purchased then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	elseif not success then
		error("Data store error:" .. errorMessage)
	end

	-- 找到服务器中进行购买的玩家
	local player = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		-- 玩家可能离开了游戏
		-- 玩家返回游戏时将会再次调用回调函数
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- 从上面的 ‘productFunctions’ 表格中查找处理函数
	local handler = productFunctions[receiptInfo.ProductId]

	-- 调用处理函数并捕捉错误
	local success, result = pcall(handler, receiptInfo, player)
	if not success or not result then
		warn("Error occurred while processing a product purchase")
		print("\nProductId:", receiptInfo.ProductId)
		print("\nPlayer:", player)
		
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- 在数据存储中记录好交易内容，确保同样的产品不会被再次发放
	local success, errorMessage = pcall(function()
		purchaseHistoryStore:SetAsync(playerProductKey, true)
		-- 记录购物统计
		-- AnalyticsHelper:LogPurchased(player,receiptInfo.ProductId)
	end)
	if not success then
		error("Cannot save purchase data:" .. errorMessage)
	end

	-- OnProcessReceipt:Fire(receiptInfo)
	-- 重要：告知 Roblox 购买流程已被成功处理
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

        end

        for _, attach in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if attach:IsA("Attachment") and attach.Name == "BallSocketAttachment" then
                attach:Destroy()
            end
        end

        for _, jointData in ipairs(jointsBackup) do
            local newJoint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
            newJoint.Name = jointData.Name
            newJoint.Part0 = jointData.Part0
            newJoint.Part1 = jointData.Part1
            newJoint.C0 = jointData.C0
            newJoint.C1 = jointData.C1
            newJoint.Parent = jointData.Part0
        end
        jointsBackup = {}

        for part:BasePart,collisionGroup  in pairs(originCollisionGroups) do
            part.CollisionGroup = collisionGroup
        end
        originCollisionGroups = {}

        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end

    local enable = character:GetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable)
    if enable == true or enable == nil then
        enableRagdoll()
        character:SetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable,true)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) do
            if not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                return
            end
            -- print("ragdolling...")
            task.wait()
        end
        disableRagdoll()
        character:SetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable,nil)
    end)

    table.insert(connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable):Connect(function()
        -- task.wait(0.5)
        -- 至少5帧之后，再取消Ragdoll
        for i=1,2 do
            task.wait()
        end
        if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
        local enable = character:GetAttribute(GameEnum.Attribute.RagdollEnable)
        if enable then
            enableRagdoll()
        else
            disableRagdoll()
        end
    end))
end

v_day.Changed:Connect(function(value)
    -- 所有玩家的统计天数增加
    local newDays = v_day.Value
    local gameMode = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("游戏模式").Value
    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        GameAnalytics:LogDay(player,v_day.Value,gameMode)
        DataHelper:SetStatsMax(player,CommonEnum.Stats.Days,newDays) -- 记录累计天数

        if gameMode == CommonEnum.Mode.Mares then
            DataHelper:SetStatsMax(player,CommonEnum.Stats.NightmaresDays,newDays) -- 记录噩梦累计天数
        elseif gameMode == CommonEnum.Mode.Lites then
            DataHelper:SetStatsMax(player,CommonEnum.Stats.LitesDays,newDays) -- 记录简单模式天数
        end

        if newDays > 99 then
            local gameTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            DataHelper:SetStatsMin(player,CommonEnum.Stats.Days99Time,gameTime) -- 记录度过99天的时长

            -- 100 天没有抓到任何神枪手
            local wantedDonesNum = 0
            for _,v_wantedDone in pairs(v_wantedDones) do
                if v_wantedDone.Value then
                    wantedDonesNum += 1
                end
            end
            if wantedDonesNum == 0 then
                DataHelper:AddStatsOnce(player,CommonEnum.Stats.NoWanted100,1) -- 100 天没有抓到任何神枪手
            end

            -- 朋友度过 100 天
            for _,friendPlayer:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if friendPlayer == player then continue end
                if player:IsFriendsWith(friendPlayer.UserId) then
                    DataHelper:AddStatsOnce(player,CommonEnum.Stats.withFriend100,1)
                end
            end
        end

        -- 多少天没吃那啥
        local eatMark = GameHelper:GetEatMark(player)
        local eatVeg = false
        local eatMeat = false
        for _,resItemId in ipairs(eatMark) do
            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(resItemId)
            if not resItemLo then continue end
            if resItemLo.ItemType == GameEnum.Tag.Vegetable then
                eatVeg = true
            end
            if resItemLo.ItemType == GameEnum.Tag.Meat then
                eatMeat = true
            end
        end

        if not eatVeg then
            DataHelper:SetStatsMax(player,CommonEnum.Stats.NotEatVeg,newDays)
        end

        if not eatMeat then
            DataHelper:SetStatsMax(player,CommonEnum.Stats.NotEatMeat,newDays)
        end
    end
end)

function getPlayerStreamingTag(player:Player)
    return "StreamingIn_"..player.UserId
end

function isAllPlayerStreamingOut(obj:Model)
	local players = game.Players:GetPlayers()
	if #players == 0 then return true end

	for _,player:Player in ipairs(players) do
        local tag = getPlayerStreamingTag(player)
        if obj:HasTag(tag) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- 是否自由的可拖拽物品
function isFreeObj(obj:Model)
    if not obj then return false end -- 空对象
    if not obj:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end -- 不在workspace中
    if not obj:IsA("Model") then return false end -- 不是Model or Tool
    if not obj.PrimaryPart then return false end -- 没有主要部件
    if not obj:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject) then return end -- 不是串流对象
    if obj:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Equipped) then return false end -- 装备中
    if obj:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) then return false end -- 在背包中
    -- 以上情况都不是，则为自由物品
    return true
end

function onStreamingC2S(player:Player,obj:Model,streamingIn:boolean)
    if not isFreeObj(obj) then return end
    if streamingIn then
        -- obj.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
        if obj:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then
            obj.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
            -- print("串流解除锚定",obj.Name)
        end
        obj:AddTag(getPlayerStreamingTag(player))
    else
        obj:RemoveTag(getPlayerStreamingTag(player))
        if isAllPlayerStreamingOut(obj) then
            if obj:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy) then
                obj:Destroy()
                -- print("串流销毁",obj.Name)
            else
                obj.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
                -- print("串流锚定",obj.Name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function onTagAdded(tool:Tool,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_ownerPlayer:ObjectValue = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
    v_ownerPlayer.Name = "OwnerPlayer"
    v_ownerPlayer.Parent = tool

    local parts:{BasePart} = {}
    local onAncestryChanged = function(child, parent)
        if parent then
            if parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) then
                -- ownerPlayer = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent)
                if #parts == 0 then
                    -- 解除碰撞
                    for _,toolChild:BasePart in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
                        if toolChild:IsA("BasePart") and toolChild.CanCollide then
                            toolChild.CanCollide = false
                            table.insert(parts,toolChild)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif tool:IsDescendantOf(game.Players) then
                if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then
                    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if tool:IsDescendantOf(ToolHelper:GetBackpack(player)) then
                            v_ownerPlayer.Value = player
                            -- print("储存到了背包",ownerPlayer.DisplayName)
                            ToolHelper.OnPinkupToolS2C:FireClient(player,tool)
                            ToolHelper.onPinkupTool:Fire(player,tool)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                -- 恢复碰撞
                for _,toolChild:BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
                    toolChild.CanCollide = true
                end
                table.clear(parts)

                if v_ownerPlayer.Value then
                    -- print("被扔出来了",ownerPlayer.DisplayName)
                    ToolHelper.OnDropToolS2C:FireClient(v_ownerPlayer.Value,tool)
                    ToolHelper.onDropTool:Fire(v_ownerPlayer.Value,tool)
                    v_ownerPlayer.Value = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
    onAncestryChanged(tool,tool.Parent)
    table.insert(connections,tool.Equipped:Connect(function(mouse)
        tool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Equipped)
        if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem) then
            tool:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
            tool:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
            tool.Unequipped:Once(function()
                tool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
                tool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
            end)
        end

        local character:Model = tool.Parent
        local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
        if player then
            ToolHelper.onEquipTool:Fire(player, tool)

            -- local parts:{BasePart} = {}
            -- for _,toolChild:BasePart in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            --     if toolChild:IsA("BasePart") and toolChild.CanCollide then
            --         toolChild.CanCollide = false
            --         table.insert(parts,toolChild)
            --     end
            -- end

            tool.Unequipped:Once(function()
                tool:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Equipped)
                ToolHelper.onUnequipTool:Fire(player, tool)
                -- for _,toolChild:BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
                --     toolChild.CanCollide = true
                -- end
                -- table.clear(parts)
            end)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(onAncestryChanged))
end
