function initAreaSide()
    local parent = Instance.new("Model")
    parent.Name = "边界"
    parent.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    parent:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.zero))
    parent.Parent = workspace

    local prefab:Part = workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("区域格挡空气墙")
    local wallCount = math.ceil(MapHelper.mapSize_1 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 / prefab.Size.X)
    local wallStartPos = Vector3.new(-(prefab.Size.X * wallCount / 2) + prefab.Size.X / 2,0,0)
            -- print(wallCount)
    local _walls = {}
    for i=1,4 do
        local rootPart:Part = Instance.new("Part")
        rootPart.Name = string.format("空气墙%d", i)
        rootPart.Size = Vector3.one
        rootPart.Transparency = 1
        rootPart.CastShadow = false
        rootPart.Anchored = true
        rootPart.CanCollide = false
        rootPart.CanTouch = false
        rootPart.CanQuery = false
        rootPart:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
        rootPart.Parent = parent
        table.insert(_walls, rootPart)

        for j = 1,wallCount do
            local wall = prefab:Clone()
            wall.Anchored = false
            wall.Transparency = 1
            wall:PivotTo(CFrame.new(wallStartPos + Vector3.new((j-1) * prefab.Size.X,0,0)))
            CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(rootPart,wall)
            wall.Parent = rootPart
        end
    end

    local wallT = _walls[1]
    local wallB = _walls[2]
    local wallL = _walls[3]
    local wallR = _walls[4]

    local maxLv = #CampfireSetting.data
    local gridSize = MapHelper.gridSize_1 * MapHelper.gridSize_2
    local distance = gridSize / 2 + (maxLv-1) * gridSize
    local originPosition = Vector3.zero
    -- 上
    wallT:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0,0,-distance) + originPosition,originPosition))
    -- 下
    wallB:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0,0,distance) + originPosition,originPosition))
    -- 左
    wallL:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-distance,0,0) + originPosition,originPosition))
    -- 右
    wallR:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(distance,0,0) + originPosition,originPosition))
end

function createNormalLand(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,posY:number,prefabName:string?)
    if not prefabName then
        -- prefabName = string.format("%d级地块",zoneLv)
        local zoneLv = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if zoneLv == 5 then
            prefabName = "5级地块"
        elseif zoneLv == 6 then
            prefabName = "6级地块"
        else
            prefabName = "Grassland"
        end
    end
    local groundFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("地块")
    local groundPrefab = groundFolder:FindFirstChild(prefabName)
    if not groundPrefab then
        groundPrefab = groundFolder:FindFirstChild("Grassland")
    end
    local ground:Part = groundPrefab:Clone()
    local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X,grid1Z)
    -- if MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z) then
    --     error("重复创建了")
    -- end

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(ground,GroundValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(ground,GroundValue.grid,Vector3.new(grid1X,0,grid1Z))

    ground.Name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
    -- ground.Size = Vector3.new(MapHelper.gridSize_1,ground.Size.Y,MapHelper.gridSize_1)
    ground:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(math.random(0,3) * 90),0) + Vector3.new(posX,posY or 0,posZ))
    ground.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Ground
    ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground)
    
    ground.Parent = _mapParent

    local surface:SurfaceGui = ground:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui",true)
    if surface then
        if RunService:IsStudio() and GameHelper.GridInfoEnable then
            surface.Enabled = true
            -- local grid2X = math.ceil(grid1X / MapHelper.gridSize_2)
            -- local grid2Z = math.ceil(grid1Z / MapHelper.gridSize_2)
            local grid2X,grid2Z = MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z)

            end

            surface.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    return ground
end

function initDefaultBuilding()
    local SpawnLocation:SpawnLocation = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnLocation")
    local centerGrid = MapHelper.centerGrid1

    local groundY:number
    for offsetX =-2,2 do
        for offsetZ=-2, 2 do
            local grid1X = offsetX + centerGrid
            local grid1Z = offsetZ + centerGrid

            local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
            -- 如果是树池，删掉重新创建
            if ground and MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) == GridType.pond then
                groundY = ground.Position.Y
                ground:Destroy()
                ground = nil
            end
            if not ground then
                ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundY)
            end
            if groundY then
                local pos = ground.Position
                ground:PivotTo(ground.CFrame.Rotation + Vector3.new(pos.X,groundY,pos.Z))
                -- ground.Position = Vector3.new(pos.X,groundY,pos.Z)
            else
                groundY = ground.Position.Y
            end
            ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ClearFog)
            MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.campfireLand)
        end
    end
    local centerGround:Part = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(centerGrid,centerGrid)
    local posY = centerGround.Position.Y + centerGround.Size.Y / 2
    -- ground.Size = Vector3.new(MapHelper.gridSize_1,ground.Size.Y,MapHelper.gridSize_1)

    local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(centerGrid,centerGrid)
    local campfireCFrame = CFrame.new(posX,posY,posZ)

    -- 创建营火
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:CreateCampfire()
    campfire:PivotTo(campfireCFrame)
    SpawnLocation.CFrame = campfireCFrame

    -- 创建制作台
    local craftingBench:Model = MapHelper:CreateCraftingBench()
    local craftCFrame = craftingBench:GetPivot()
    craftingBench:PivotTo(craftCFrame.Rotation + Vector3.new(craftCFrame.Position.X,posY,craftCFrame.Position.Z))

    -- 悬赏公告板
    local wantedBoard:Model = MapHelper:CreatWantedBoard()
    local wantedCFrame = wantedBoard:GetPivot()
    wantedBoard:PivotTo(wantedCFrame.Rotation + Vector3.new(wantedCFrame.Position.X,posY,wantedCFrame.Position.Z))

    -- 随机一个水池
    local offsetX = math.random(0,2)
    local offsetZ = math.random(0,2)
    if offsetX ~= 2 and offsetZ ~= 2 then
        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
            offsetX = 2
        else
            offsetZ = 2
        end
    end
    local grid1X = centerGrid + CommonFunc:RandomSign() * offsetX
    local grid1Z = centerGrid + CommonFunc:RandomSign() * offsetZ
    local pondPosY
    -- 生成池塘
    local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
    if ground then
        pondPosY = ground.Position.Y
        ground:Destroy()
    else
        pondPosY = math.random() * math.random(-1,1)
    end
    local pondGround = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,pondPosY,"池塘")
    pondGround:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ClearFog)
    MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.pond)
    
    GameHelper:TryRemoveObstaclesAround(wantedBoard) -- 清理障碍
    GameHelper:TryRemoveObstaclesAround(craftingBench) -- 清理障碍
end

-- 创建专属齿轮资源点
function initGearSourcePoints()
    if not GameHelper.Switch.WeaponWorkshop then return end

    local gearSourceFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
        and workspace.Prefabs:FindFirstChild("Map")
        and workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("齿轮资源点")
    if not gearSourceFolder then
        warn("[MapService] Missing gear source prefab folder")
        return
    end

    local runtimeFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("齿轮资源点")
    if not runtimeFolder then
        runtimeFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        runtimeFolder.Name = "齿轮资源点"
        runtimeFolder.Parent = workspace
    end

    local setting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("GearSourceSetting"))
    for _, config in ipairs(setting.data) do
        local prefab = gearSourceFolder:FindFirstChild(config.prefabName)
        if not prefab then
            warn("[MapService] Missing gear source prefab:", config.prefabName)
            continue
        end

        local zoneGridVos = MapHelper.ZoneMap2[config.zoneLevel]
        local candidates = {}
        if zoneGridVos then
            for _, gridVo in ipairs(zoneGridVos) do
                table.insert(candidates, gridVo)
            end
        end

        local created
        while #candidates > 0 do
            local candidate = table.remove(candidates, math.random(1, #candidates))
            local source = prefab:Clone()
            if tryInitLandmark(
                candidate.x,
                candidate.z,
                1,
                1,
                GridType.building,
                source
            ) then
                local embeddedGear = source:FindFirstChild(tostring(config.gearItemId), true)
                if not embeddedGear or not embeddedGear:IsA("Model") then
                    warn("[MapService] Missing embedded gear in prefab:", config.prefabName)
                    source:Destroy()
                    source = nil
                else
                    local gearSpawnCFrame = embeddedGear:GetPivot()
                    embeddedGear:SetAttribute("GearSourceId", config.id)
                    embeddedGear:SetAttribute("GearSourceZone", config.zoneLevel)
                    embeddedGear:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Guarded")
                    embeddedGear:SetAttribute("GearSourceConsumed", false)
                    source:SetAttribute("GearSpawnCFrame", gearSpawnCFrame)
                    source.Parent = runtimeFolder
                end
            else
                source:Destroy()
                source = nil
            end
            if source then
                source.Name = string.format("齿轮资源点_%d", config.id)
                source.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
                source:SetAttribute("GearSourceId", config.id)
                source:SetAttribute("GearSourceZone", config.zoneLevel)
                source:SetAttribute("GearSourceState", "Guarded")
                source:SetAttribute("GearSourceActivated", false)
                source:SetAttribute("AliveGuards", 0)
                source:SetAttribute("Grid2X", candidate.x)
                source:SetAttribute("Grid2Z", candidate.z)
                created = source
                print("[MapService] Gear source created:", config.id, "zone", config.zoneLevel, candidate.x, candidate.z)
                break
            end
        end

        if not created then
            warn("[MapService] Could not place gear source in zone", config.zoneLevel)
        end
    end
end

function tryInitLandmark(grid2X:number,grid2Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,gridType:number,landmark:Model,groundName:string?)
    -- local gird1XMax
    local gird1XMax = grid2X * MapHelper.gridSize_2 - sizeX + 1
    local gird1XMin = (grid2X - 1) * MapHelper.gridSize_2 + 1
    local gird1ZMax = grid2Z * MapHelper.gridSize_2 - sizeZ + 1
    local gird1ZMin = (grid2Z - 1) * MapHelper.gridSize_2 + 1

    if sizeX ~= sizeZ and math.random(1,2) == 1 then
        local oldZ = sizeZ
        sizeZ = sizeX
        sizeX = oldZ
    end
    -- print("grid2",grid2X, grid2Z)
    -- print("size2",sizeX, sizeZ)
    
    for i=1,10 do
        local match = true
        -- 随机10次，如果找不到就不创建了
        local spawnGrid1X = math.random(gird1XMin,gird1XMax)
        local spawnGrid1Z = math.random(gird1ZMin,gird1ZMax)

        -- print("start",grid1XStart, grid1ZStart)
        for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
            for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
                local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - 1
                local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - 1
                local tempGridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
                if tempGridType and tempGridType ~= GridType.land then
                    match = false
                    break
                end
                -- print(grid1X, grid1Z)
            end
            if not match then break end
        end

        if not match then continue end

        local groundPosY = nil
        for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
            for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
                local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - 1
                local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - 1
                -- print(grid1X, grid1Z)
                local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                if groundName and ground then
                    if not groundPosY then
                        groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                    end
                    ground:Destroy()
                    ground = nil
                end
                if not ground then
                    ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                end
                if groundPosY then
                    local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                    ground:PivotTo(cframe.Rotation + Vector3.new(cframe.Position.X,groundPosY,cframe.Position.Z))
                else
                    groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                end
                
                MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,gridType or GridType.building)
            end
        end

        local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
        posX += sizeX / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
        posZ += sizeZ / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
        local ground:Part = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
        local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
        local position = Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ)
        local rotationY:number
        if sizeX == sizeZ then
            -- 360度随机旋转
            -- building:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position,position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),0,math.random(-1,1))))
            -- rotationY = math.random() * 360
            -- 90度随机旋转
            rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
        else
            -- 只接受180度旋转
            rotationY = math.random(1,2) == 1 and 0 or 180
            if sizeZ > sizeX then
                rotationY += 90
            end
        end
        landmark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))

        return true
    end
end

function tryCreateMountain(centerGrid1X:number,centerGrid1Z:number,r:number,groundPrefabName:string,gridType:number?)
    -- local centerGridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z)
    -- if centerGridType then return end

    if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyRange(centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z,r) then return end
    local sign = 1

    for offsetX =-r,r do
        for offsetZ=-r, r do
            local grid1X = offsetX + centerGrid1X
            local grid1Z = offsetZ + centerGrid1Z

            if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end
            -- if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end

            local height = (r - math.max(math.abs(offsetX),math.abs(offsetZ))) * 5 * sign
            local offset = sign * math.random() * 2
            local posY = height + offset

            createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,groundPrefabName)
            MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,gridType)
        end
    end
    return true
end

function tryCreateTerrain(centerGrid1X:number,centerGrid1Z:number,r:number,sign:number,specialGridType:number?)
    -- local centerGridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z)
    -- if centerGridType then return end

    if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyRange(centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z,r) then return end
    if not sign then sign = 1 end

    for offsetX =-r,r do
        for offsetZ=-r, r do
            local grid1X = offsetX + centerGrid1X
            local grid1Z = offsetZ + centerGrid1Z

            if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end

            local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if gridType then continue end

            -- print(grid1X,grid1Z)
            local height = (r - math.max(math.abs(offsetX),math.abs(offsetZ))) * 5 * sign
            local offset = sign * math.random() * 2
            local posY = height + offset
            local prefabName:string
            local absOffsetX = math.abs(offsetX)
            local absOffsetZ = math.abs(offsetZ)
            if sign > 0 then
                local max = 2
                if absOffsetX <= max and absOffsetZ <= max then
                    if absOffsetX < max and absOffsetZ < max then
                        prefabName = "高原地区地块"
                    elseif absOffsetX == max or absOffsetZ == max then
                        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
                            prefabName = "高原地区地块"
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                local max = 2
                if absOffsetX <= max and absOffsetZ <= max then
                    if absOffsetX < max and absOffsetZ < max then
                        prefabName = "低位地区地块"
                    elseif absOffsetX == max or absOffsetZ == max then
                        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
                            prefabName = "低位地区地块"
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            -- if absOffsetX < 2 and absOffsetZ < 2 then
            --     prefabName = "高原地区地块"
            -- elseif posY <= -35 then
            --     prefabName = "低位地区地块"
            -- end

            createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,prefabName)
            MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,specialGridType or GridType.land)
        end
    end
    return true
end

function initMarsh()
    if not GameHelper.Switch.Marsh then return end
    -- local minGrid = 10
    -- local maxGrid = MapHelper.mapSize_1 - minGrid
    local r = GameHelper.MarshWidth

    local centerGrid1X
    local centerGrid1Z

    -- local grid1Vos = MapHelper.ZoneMap1[4]

    local grid1Vos:{GameType.GridVo} = {
        -- {x=10,z=10},
        -- {x=30,z=10},
        -- {x=10,z=30},
        -- {x=45,z=30},
        -- {x=10,z=45},
        -- {x=30,z=45},
        -- {x=45,z=45},
        {x=10,z=45},
        {x=45,z=10},
        {x=10,z=10},
        {x=45,z=45}
    }
    for i=1,100 do
        local index = math.random(1,#grid1Vos)
        local grid1Vo = grid1Vos[index]
        local grid1X = grid1Vo.x
        local grid1Z = grid1Vo.z
        -- local grid1X = math.random(minGrid,maxGrid)
        -- local grid1Z = math.random(minGrid,maxGrid)

        -- local zoneLv = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        -- if zoneLv <= 2 then continue end

        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyRange(grid1X,grid1Z,r) then continue end

        centerGrid1X = grid1X
        centerGrid1Z = grid1Z
        break
    end

    if not centerGrid1X or not centerGrid1Z then return end
    -- centerGrid1X = 10
    -- centerGrid1Z = 10
    print("初始化沼泽，沼泽中心点",centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z)
    -- 生成水池
    local maxPondNum = math.random(10,20)
    local curPondNum = 0
    for i=1,5 do
        if curPondNum >= maxPondNum then break end

        local offsetX = math.random(-r,r)
        local offsetZ = math.random(-r,r)
        local grid1X = centerGrid1X + offsetX
        local grid1Z = centerGrid1Z + offsetZ
        if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end

        local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if gridType then continue end
        local isEdgeGround = math.abs(offsetX) == r or math.abs(offsetZ) == r
        local posY = math.random() * math.random(-1,1)

        local ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,"沼泽池塘")
        MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.MarshPond)
        ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshPond)

        curPondNum += 1
        if isEdgeGround then
            ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshEdgeGround)
        end
    end

    local specialGroundPercents = {}
    specialGroundPercents[1] = 0
    specialGroundPercents[2] = 0
    specialGroundPercents[3] = 0
    specialGroundPercents[4] = 10
    specialGroundPercents[5] = 15
    specialGroundPercents[6] = 20

    local marshGrid1Vos:{GameType.GridVo} = {}
    -- 生成地块
    for offsetX =-r,r do
        for offsetZ=-r, r do
            local grid1X = offsetX + centerGrid1X
            local grid1Z = offsetZ + centerGrid1Z
            if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end
            -- if grid1X < 1 or grid1X > MapHelper.mapSize_1 or grid1Z < 1 or grid1Z > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
            --     continue
            -- end

            local isEdgeGround = math.abs(offsetX) == r or math.abs(offsetZ) == r
            if isEdgeGround then
                if math.random(1,2) == 1 then continue end -- 在边缘时随机生成，造成不规则形状
            end

            local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if gridType then continue end

            local posY = math.random() * math.random(-1,1)

            local zoneLv = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)

            local ground:Part
            if math.random(1,100) <= specialGroundPercents[zoneLv] then
                -- 等级越高的区域，越容易生成特殊沼泽地块
                -- ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,"沼泽地块-泥沼")
                if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
                    ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,"沼泽地块-泥沼泽")
                    MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.Marsh)
                else
                    ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,"沼泽地块-毒沼泽")
                    MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.ToxicSwamp)
                end
            else
                -- 沼泽普通地块
                ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,posY,math.random(1,2) == 1 and "沼泽地块" or "沼泽水地块")
                MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.Marsh)
            end
            ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround)
            if isEdgeGround then
                ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshEdgeGround)
            end
            table.insert(marshGrid1Vos,{x=grid1X,z=grid1Z})
        end
    end
end

-- 火车大劫案
function initTrain()
    if not GameHelper.Switch.Train then return end

    -- print("初始化火车大劫案，沼泽中心点",centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z)
    local offset = MapHelper.gridSize_2 * 2 + math.floor(MapHelper.gridSize_2 / 2) -- 应该是10
    local pointConfigs = {
        {
            x = MapHelper.centerGrid1 - offset,
        },
        {
            x = MapHelper.centerGrid1 + offset,
        },
        {
            z = MapHelper.centerGrid1 - offset,
        },
        {
            z = MapHelper.centerGrid1 + offset,
        },
    }

    local suc = false
    while #pointConfigs > 0 do
        local pointConfig = table.remove(pointConfigs,math.random(1,#pointConfigs))
        local startGrid1X = pointConfig.x or 1
        local startGrid1Z = pointConfig.z or 1
        local endGrid1X = pointConfig.x or MapHelper.mapSize_1
        local endGrid1Z = pointConfig.z or MapHelper.mapSize_1

        -- 寻找一条合法的路
        local isMatch = true
        for grid1X = startGrid1X, endGrid1X do
            for grid1Z = startGrid1Z, endGrid1Z do
                local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
                if gridType then
                    isMatch = false
                    break
                end
            end
            if not isMatch then
                break
            end
        end
        if not isMatch then continue end

        local rotationOffset = 0
        if startGrid1X ~= endGrid1X then
            rotationOffset = 90
        end

        local startGround:Part = nil
        local endGround:Part = nil
        for grid1X = startGrid1X, endGrid1X do
            for grid1Z = startGrid1Z, endGrid1Z do
                local groundPrefabName = "铁轨路"
                if grid1X  == startGrid1X and grid1Z == startGrid1Z then
                    groundPrefabName = "铁轨出入口"
                elseif grid1X == endGrid1X and grid1Z == endGrid1Z then
                    groundPrefabName = "铁轨出入口"
                end

                local ground = createNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,0,groundPrefabName)
                local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                ground:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationOffset),0) + cframe.Position)
                ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RailwayGround)
                MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,GridType.Railway)

                if grid1X  == startGrid1X and grid1Z == startGrid1Z then
                    startGround = ground
                elseif grid1X == endGrid1X and grid1Z == endGrid1Z then
                    endGround = ground
                end
            end
        end

        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
            -- 换方向
            local markStartGround = startGround
            startGround = endGround
            endGround = markStartGround
        end

        startGround:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startGround:GetPivot().Position,endGround:GetPivot().Position))
        endGround:PivotTo(CFrame.new(endGround:GetPivot().Position,startGround:GetPivot().Position))

        startGround:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RailwayGroundStart)
        endGround:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.RailwayGroundEnd)
        suc = true
        break
    end

    if not suc then
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("火车大劫案")
        if folder then
            folder:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

function initKingMooseNest()
    if not GameHelper.Switch.KingMoose then return end

    local prefab = _specialHouse and _specialHouse:FindFirstChild("1x1,驼鹿巢穴")
    if not prefab then
        warn("[MapService] King Moose nest prefab is missing")
        return
    end

    local candidates = {}
    for zoneLv = 3,6 do
        local zoneGridPoints = MapHelper.ZoneMap1[zoneLv] or {}
        for _,gridPoint in ipairs(zoneGridPoints) do
            local grid1X = gridPoint.x
            local grid1Z = gridPoint.z
            if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) ~= GridType.land then continue end
            if not MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z) then continue end
            if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,1,1,GridType.land) then continue end
            table.insert(candidates,{
                x = grid1X,
                z = grid1Z,
                zoneLv = zoneLv,
            })
        end
    end

    for i = #candidates,2,-1 do
        local swapIndex = math.random(1,i)
        candidates[i],candidates[swapIndex] = candidates[swapIndex],candidates[i]
    end

    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(candidate.x,candidate.z) ~= GridType.land then continue end
        if not MapHelper:FindGroundPart(candidate.x,candidate.z) then continue end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(candidate.x,candidate.z,1,1,GridType.land) then continue end

        local grid2X,grid2Z = MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(candidate.x,candidate.z)
        local nest = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(
            candidate.x,
            candidate.z,
            1,
            1,
            GridType.building,
            prefab
        )
        if not nest then continue end

        initBuilding(nest,grid2X,grid2Z)
        nest:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.KingMooseNest)
        nest:SetAttribute("KingMooseNestZone",candidate.zoneLv)
        print("生成驼鹿巢穴",candidate.zoneLv,candidate.x,candidate.z)
        return
    end

    warn("[MapService] Could not place King Moose nest in zones 3-6")
end

local function createMarkerModel(markerVo)
    local prefab = workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("MapMarker")
    if not prefab then return end

    destroyMarkerModel(markerVo.userId)

    local markerModel:Model = prefab:Clone()
    markerModel.Name = getMarkerName(markerVo.userId)
    markerModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(markerVo.position + Vector3.new(0,1.25,0)))
    markerModel.Parent = _mapMarkerFolder
    markerModel:SetAttribute("userId",markerVo.userId)
    markerModel:SetAttribute("nickname",markerVo.nickname)

    local root:BasePart = markerModel.PrimaryPart or markerModel:FindFirstChild("Root")
    if root then
        local billboard:BillboardGui = root:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
        if billboard then
            local t_name:TextLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("t_name")
            if t_name then
                t_name.Text = markerVo.nickname
            end
        end
    end
end

local function isMarkerPositionUnlocked(position:Vector3,campfireLevel:number)
    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position)
    if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then
        return false
    end
    return MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) <= campfireLevel
end

local function resolveMarkerWorldPosition(scale:Vector2)
    local worldPos = MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scale.X,scale.Y)
    local groundPoint = MapHelper:GetGroundPoint(Vector3.new(worldPos.X,10,worldPos.Z))
    if groundPoint then
        return groundPoint
    end
    return MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(worldPos)
end

local function getMarkerSnapshot()

    for _,markerVo in pairs(_mapMarkersByUserId) do
        table.insert(markers,markerVo)
    end
    table.sort(markers,function(a,b)
        return a.userId < b.userId
    end)
    return markers
end

local function sendMarkerSnapshot(player:Player)

end

    if heat <= 0 then return end
    if mapScale.X < 0 or mapScale.X > 1 or mapScale.Y < 0 or mapScale.Y > 1 then return end

    local position = resolveMarkerWorldPosition(mapScale)
    if not position then return end
    if not isMarkerPositionUnlocked(position,level) then return end

    upsertPlayerMarker(player,position)

local function destroyMarkerModel(userId:number)
    local folder = getMarkersFolder()
    local markerModel = folder:FindFirstChild(getMarkerName(userId))
    if markerModel then
        markerModel:Destroy()
    end
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player:Player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return false end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function getCampfireState()
    local campfire = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    if not campfire then return end

    local v_heat:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(campfire, CampfireValue.heat)
    if not v_heat then
        v_heat = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire, CampfireValue.heat)
    end

    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(campfire, CampfireValue.level)
    if not v_level then
        v_level = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire, CampfireValue.level)
    end

    return campfire, v_heat, v_level
end

local function isMarkerPositionUnlocked(position:Vector3, campfireLevel:number)
    local grid1X, grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position)
    if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X, grid1Z) then
        return false
    end
    return MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X, grid1Z) <= campfireLevel
end

local function resolveMarkerWorldPosition(scaleX:number, scaleZ:number)
    local worldPos = MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scaleX, scaleZ)
    local groundPoint = MapHelper:GetGroundPoint(worldPos)
    if groundPoint then
        return groundPoint
    end

    local safePoint = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(worldPos)
    if safePoint then
        return safePoint
    end
end

local function buildMarkerVo(player:Player, position:Vector3)
    return {
        userId = player.UserId,
        nickname = player.DisplayName or player.Name,
        position = position,
    }
end

local function isPlayerNearMarker(player:Player, markerVo:{userId:number, nickname:string, position:Vector3})
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return false end

    local humanoidRootPart:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return false end

    return (humanoidRootPart.Position - markerVo.position).Magnitude <= MARKER_AUTO_REMOVE_DISTANCE
end

local function applyNickname(model:Model, nickname:string)
    for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") and descendant.Name == "t_name" then
            descendant.Text = nickname
        end
    end
end

local function ensurePrimaryPart(model:Model)
    if model.PrimaryPart then
        return model.PrimaryPart
    end

    local primaryPart = model:FindFirstChild("Root")
    if primaryPart and primaryPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        model.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
        return primaryPart
    end

    primaryPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if primaryPart then
        model.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
        return primaryPart
    end

    local root = Instance.new("Part")
    root.Name = "Root"
    root.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    root.Anchored = true
    root.CanCollide = false
    root.CanQuery = false
    root.CanTouch = false
    root.Transparency = 1
    root.Parent = model
    model.PrimaryPart = root
    return root
end

local function createMarkerModel(markerVo:{userId:number, nickname:string, position:Vector3})
    destroyMarkerModel(markerVo.userId)

    local markerModel = getMarkerModelTemplate():Clone()
    markerModel.Name = getMarkerName(markerVo.userId)
    markerModel.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent

    local primaryPart = ensurePrimaryPart(markerModel)
    primaryPart.Anchored = true
    primaryPart.CanCollide = false
    primaryPart.CanQuery = false
    primaryPart.CanTouch = false

    applyNickname(markerModel, markerVo.nickname)

    markerModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(markerVo.position + MARKER_HEIGHT_OFFSET))
    markerModel.Parent = getMarkersFolder()
end

local function getMarkerSnapshot()
    local snapshot = {}
    for _, markerVo in pairs(markersByUserId) do
        table.insert(snapshot, markerVo)
    end
    table.sort(snapshot, function(a, b)
        return a.userId < b.userId
    end)
    return snapshot
end

local function sendMarkerSnapshot(player:Player)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerSnapshotS2C:FireClient(player, getMarkerSnapshot())
end

local function upsertPlayerMarker(player:Player, position:Vector3)
    local markerVo = buildMarkerVo(player, position)
    markersByUserId[player.UserId] = markerVo
    createMarkerModel(markerVo)
    GameHelper.MapMarkerUpsertS2C:FireAllClients(markerVo)
end

local function removePlayerMarker(player:Player, shouldBroadcast:boolean?)
    if not markersByUserId[player.UserId] then return end
    markersByUserId[player.UserId] = nil
    destroyMarkerModel(player.UserId)
    if shouldBroadcast ~= false then
        GameHelper.MapMarkerRemoveS2C:FireAllClients(player.UserId)
    end
end

GameHelper.PlaceMapMarkerC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player:Player, mapScale:Vector2)
    if typeof(mapScale) ~= "Vector2" then return end
    if not isPlayerAlive(player) then return end

    local _, v_heat, v_level = getCampfireState()
    if not v_heat or not v_level then return end
    if v_heat.Value <= 0 then return end

    local scaleX = mapScale.X
    local scaleZ = mapScale.Y
    if scaleX < 0 or scaleX > 1 or scaleZ < 0 or scaleZ > 1 then
        return
    end

    local markerPosition = resolveMarkerWorldPosition(scaleX, scaleZ)
    if not markerPosition then return end
    if not isMarkerPositionUnlocked(markerPosition, v_level.Value) then return end

    upsertPlayerMarker(player, markerPosition)
end)

function onTagAdded(tree:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    table.insert(connections,tree:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hp"):Connect(function()

            -- 播放音效

            tree:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree)

            for _,child in ipairs(tree:GetDescendants()) do
                if child == tree.PrimaryPart then continue end
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local basePart:BasePart = child
                    basePart.Anchored = false
                    basePart.CanCollide = true
                    basePart.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.OnlyGround
                    local r = math.random(20,40)

                    child.Enabled = false
                end
            end
            -- CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(tree,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.OnlyGround)
        end
    end))
end

    for _,child:BasePart in ipairs(tree:GetChildren()) do
        if child == tree.PrimaryPart then continue end
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then
            child.Anchored = false
        end
    end
    Debris:AddItem(tree,3)
end

local StrongholdValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.StrongholdValue
local WantedManValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.WantedManValue

function onTagAdded(stronghold:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local id = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(stronghold, StrongholdValue.id)
    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetWantedLo(id)

    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(stronghold:GetPivot().Position)
    local spawnGround:Part = MapHelper:GetGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)

    local parent = Instance.new("Folder")
    parent.Name = string.format("据点%d敌人",lo.id)
    parent.Parent = stronghold.Parent

    -- 创建宝箱
    local treasureAtt:Attachment = stronghold.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("宝箱")
    if treasureAtt and lo.zoneLv then
        GameHelper:CreateTreasure(lo.zoneLv,treasureAtt.WorldCFrame)
        treasureAtt:Destroy()
    end

    -- 创建boss
    local bossAtt:Attachment = stronghold.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("BossAttachment")
    local boss = EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(lo.bossId,parent)
    boss.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    boss:PivotTo(bossAtt.WorldCFrame)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(boss,WantedManValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(boss,WantedManValue.WantedId,id)
    boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.WantedMan)
    bossAtt:Destroy()

    local onEnterGround = function()
        if not lo.enemyIds then return end
        -- 创建小弟
        local enemyIds = lo.enemyIds:split(",")
        local attachments:{Attachment} = stronghold.PrimaryPart:GetChildren()
        for _,enemyIdStr in ipairs(enemyIds) do
            if #attachments <= 0 then break end

            local att = table.remove(attachments,math.random(1,#attachments))
            local enemyId = tonumber(enemyIdStr)
            local enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,parent)
            enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)
        end
    end
    if MapHelper.EnterGroundMarks[spawnGround] then
        onEnterGround()
    else
        local con:RBXScriptConnection
        con = GameHelper.GroundEnterC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,ground:Part)
            if spawnGround == ground then
                con:Disconnect()
                onEnterGround()
            end
        end)
    end
end

function onTagAdded(item:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if item:IsDescendantOf(workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")) then return end

    -- 齿轮资源点的模型使用 ResourceItemId 标记；替换完成后的克隆已初始化，
    -- 不应再次被 NatureResItemService 当成原始资源处理。
    local id = item:GetAttribute("id")
    if typeof(id) ~= "number" then
        id = item:GetAttribute("ResourceItemId")
    end
    if typeof(id) ~= "number" then
        id = tonumber(item.Name)
    end
    if not id then
        warn("[NatureResItemService] Missing resource id:", item:GetFullName())
        return
    end
    if id == 248 and item:HasTag("DragItemValue_InitComplete") then
        return
    end

    if ResourcesItemHelper:FindPrefab(id) then
        -- 替换掉
        local cframe = item:GetPivot()
        local newItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(id,cframe)
        if newItem then
            -- 248 的新对象已经完成初始化，不再保留原始资源标签，避免二次替换。
            if id == 248 then
                newItem:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.NatureResItem)
            end
            for _, attributeName in ipairs({"GearSourceId", "GearSourceZone", "GearSourceState", "GearSourceConsumed"}) do
                local attributeValue = item:GetAttribute(attributeName)
                if attributeValue ~= nil then
                    newItem:SetAttribute(attributeName, attributeValue)
                end
            end
        end
        if item.PrimaryPart and newItem and newItem.PrimaryPart then
            newItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = item.PrimaryPart.Anchored
        end
        item:Destroy()
    else
        -- 直接用
        ResourcesItemHelper:InitItem(id,item)
    end
end

function getRewardCFrame(name:string)
    if not _rewardCFrames[name] then
        local part:Part = _towerController:FindFirstChild("奖励点")

        local model:Model = part:FindFirstChild(name)
        _rewardCFrames[name] = model:GetPivot()
        model:Destroy()
    end
    return _rewardCFrames[name]
end

function createReward()
    for _,rewardItem in ipairs(_rewards) do
        rewardItem:Destroy()
    end

    table.clear(_rewards)

    local treasure6:CFrame = getRewardCFrame("神器宝箱")
    local GemTreasure:CFrame = getRewardCFrame("宝石宝箱")
    local iornTreasure:CFrame = getRewardCFrame("铁保险箱")
    local goldTreasure:CFrame = getRewardCFrame("黄金保险箱")

    table.insert(_rewards,GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName("神器宝箱",treasure6))
    table.insert(_rewards,GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName("宝石宝箱",GemTreasure))
    table.insert(_rewards,GameHelper:CreateSafeBoxByName("铁保险箱",iornTreasure))
    table.insert(_rewards,GameHelper:CreateSafeBoxByName("黄金保险箱",goldTreasure))
    -- table.insert(_rewards,ResourcesItemHelper:CreateGold(attGold1.WorldCFrame.Position))
    -- table.insert(_rewards,ResourcesItemHelper:CreateGold(attGold2.WorldCFrame.Position))
    -- table.insert(_rewards,ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(215,attIron1.WorldCFrame))
    -- table.insert(_rewards,ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(215,attIron2.WorldCFrame))

    setRewardsEnable(false)
end

function setRewardsEnable(eanble:boolean)
    for _,rewardItem in ipairs(_rewards) do
        if rewardItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Treasure) then
            ValueHelper:SetValue(rewardItem,TreasureValue.enable,eanble)
        elseif rewardItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SafeBox) then
            setDoorEnableByRoot(rewardItem,eanble)
        elseif ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(rewardItem) then
            ValueHelper:SetValue(rewardItem,DragItemValue.enable,eanble)
        end
    end
end

function openSafeBox()
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("打开保险箱")
    for _,safeBox in ipairs(_rewards) do
        if safeBox:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SafeBox) then
            setDoorOpenByRoot(safeBox,true)
            local ItemPoint:Attachment = safeBox:FindFirstChild("ItemPoint",true)
            -- 创建道具
            local randomId = safeBox:GetAttribute("RandomId")
            ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(randomId,ItemPoint.WorldCFrame.Position)
        end
    end
end

function upLevel()
    local newLevel = _level + 1
    local newLos = ConfigHelper:Get(GemTowerSetting,GemTowerSetting.k.lv,newLevel,true)
    if newLos and #newLos then
        _level = newLevel
        _los = newLos
    end
end

function checkNextWave()
    if #_enemyParent:GetChildren() > 0 then return end

    _wave += 1
    if _wave > #_los then
        changeState(STATE.result)
    else
        -- 创建敌人
        print(string.format("宝石塔刷新第%d波敌人，共%d波",_wave,#_los))
        local r = 5
        local lo = _los[_wave]
        local enemyIds = lo.enemyIds:split(",")
        local att:Attachment = _towerController:FindFirstChild("刷怪点"):FindFirstChild(tostring(_wave))
        for _,enemyIdStr in ipairs(enemyIds) do
            local enemyId = tonumber(enemyIdStr)
            local enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,_enemyParent)
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),0,math.random(-r,r))
            enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame + offset)
        end
    end
end

function changeState(state:number)
    if _state == state then return end
    _state = state

    _TriggerPart.CanTouch = _state == STATE.free
    t_time.Visible = _state == STATE.cd
    if _state == STATE.free then
        -- 1.启动大门
        -- 2.重置小门
        upLevel()
        createReward()
        setDoorEnableByRoot(enterDoor,true)
        setDoorOpenByRoot(door1,false)
        setDoorOpenByRoot(door2,false)

        _wave = 0
        _cd = 0
        print("宝石塔已就绪")
    elseif _state == STATE.fighting then
        print("宝石塔战斗开始")
        _bgm:Play()
    elseif _state == STATE.result then
        print("宝石塔结算")
        setRewardsEnable(true)
        openSafeBox()
        local tipsText = "The challenge has been completed. The timer will reset in 180 seconds. Please collect your rewards as soon as possible."
        UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients(tipsText,UIHelper.TipsStyle.Event)
        task.delay(180,function()
            if _state == STATE.result then
                changeState(STATE.cd)
            end
        end)

        GameHelper.onGemTowerComplete:Fire()

    elseif _state == STATE.cd then
        _bgm:Stop()
        -- 1.关闭大门
        print("宝石塔冷却")
        setDoorEnableByRoot(enterDoor,false)
        setDoorOpenByRoot(enterDoor,false)
        _cd = 1200
        -- _cd = 60
        t_time.Text = string.format("💎 %s refresh",CommonFunc:TimeToStrAuto(_cd))
    end
end

function setDoorOpenByRoot(doorRoot:Model,isOpen:boolean)
    for _,door in ipairs(doorRoot:GetChildren()) do
        if door:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GameDoor) then
            GameHelper:SetDoorOpen(door,isOpen)
        end
    end
end

function setDoorEnableByRoot(doorRoot:Model,enable:boolean)
    for _,door in ipairs(doorRoot:GetChildren()) do
        if door:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GameDoor) then
            GameHelper:SetDoorEnable(door,enable)
        end
    end
end

init()
_TriggerPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
    if not CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player) then return end
    if _state ~= STATE.free then return end
    changeState(STATE.fighting)
end)
GameHelper.SetGemTowerCD.Event:Connect(function(cd:number)
    _cd = cd
end)

while true do
    local dt = task.wait(1)

    if _state == STATE.cd then
        _cd -= dt
        t_time.Text = string.format("💎 %s refresh",CommonFunc:TimeToStrAuto(_cd))
        if _cd <= 0 then
            -- 启动塔
            changeState(STATE.free)
        end
    elseif _state == STATE.fighting then
        checkNextWave()
    end
end

function onTagAdded(door:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if GameHelper:IsPrefab(door) then return end
    local rootPart:Part = door.PrimaryPart or door:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
    local DoorPart:Part = door:FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
    local closeCFrame:CFrame = DoorPart:GetPivot()
    local openAtt:Attachment = rootPart:FindFirstChild("Open")
    local ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
    ProximityPrompt.ActionText = "Open"
    ProximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance = 5
    ProximityPrompt.Parent = DoorPart

    if door:GetAttribute("Enable") == nil then
        door:SetAttribute("Enable",true)
    end
    local open = function()
        ProximityPrompt.Enabled = false
        DoorPart:PivotTo(openAtt.WorldCFrame)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("Door",DoorPart)
    end

    local close = function()
        ProximityPrompt.Enabled = door:GetAttribute("Enable")
        DoorPart:PivotTo(closeCFrame)
    end

    local onEnableChanged = function()
        local enable = door:GetAttribute("Enable")
        if enable and not GameHelper:GetDoorOpen(door) then
            ProximityPrompt.Enabled = enable
        end
    end

    onEnableChanged()
    door:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOpen"):Connect(function()
        local isOpen = door:GetAttribute("IsOpen")
        if isOpen then
            open()
        else
            close()
        end
    end)

    door:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Enable"):Connect(onEnableChanged)
    ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered)
        GameHelper:SetDoorOpen(door,true)
    end)
end

function trySpawnLittleTurkey(ground:Part,gridPoint:Vector3)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.land  then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel ~= 3 then return end

    local enemyId = 110
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= 10
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal

    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
end

function onTagAdded(lamp:Tool, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_isLight:BoolValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("isLight")
    local v_Oil:NumberValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("Oil")
    local v_OilMax:NumberValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("OilMax")
    local SpotLight:SpotLight = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpotLight",true)
    local Beam:Beam = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Beam",true)
    local Burning:Sound = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound",true)
    if Burning then
        Burning.Looped = true
    end

    local b_fill:ImageLabel = lamp:FindFirstChild("b_fill",true)

    -- 保暖功能
    local v_warmValue:NumberValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("每秒降低寒冷值")
    local warmValue = 0
    if v_warmValue then
        warmValue = v_warmValue.Value
    end

    local player:Player = nil

    SpotLight.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
    Beam.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
    local onOilChanged = function()
        local rate = math.clamp(v_Oil.Value / v_OilMax.Value,0,1)
        b_fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(rate,1)

        if v_Oil.Value <= 0 then
            v_isLight.Value = false
        end
    end

    local onIsLightChanged = function()
        SpotLight.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
        Beam.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
        if Burning then
            if v_isLight.Value then
                Burning:Play()
            else
                Burning:Stop()
            end
        end

        if player and player.Character then
            local character = player.Character
            if warmValue > 0 then
                if v_isLight.Value then
                    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff)
                else
                    character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    onOilChanged()
    onIsLightChanged()
    table.insert(connections,v_Oil.Changed:Connect(onOilChanged))
    table.insert(connections,v_isLight.Changed:Connect(onIsLightChanged))
    table.insert(connections,lamp.Activated:Connect(function()
        if v_Oil.Value > 0 then
            v_isLight.Value = not v_isLight.Value
        else
            v_isLight.Value = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,lamp.Equipped:Connect(function()
        player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(lamp.Parent)
        if not player then return end

        onOilChanged()
        onIsLightChanged()
    end))
    table.insert(connections,lamp.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if player and player.Character then
            local character = player.Character
            character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff)
        end

        if Burning then
            Burning:Stop()
        end

        player = nil
    end))

    table.insert(connections,lamp.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
        if parent then
            if not parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GameBackpack) and not parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) then
                v_isLight.Value = false
            end
        end
    end))

    local nextHBTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if workspace.DistributedGameTime < nextHBTime then return end
        nextHBTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1

        if v_isLight.Value and player and player.Character then
            v_Oil.Value = math.max(v_Oil.Value - 1,0)

            if warmValue > 0 then
                -- 升温
                GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,-warmValue)
            end
        end
    end))
end

local function getFireOrigin(player:Player, gun:Tool)
	local firePoint = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
	if firePoint and firePoint:IsA("Attachment") then
		return firePoint.WorldPosition
	end
	if firePoint and firePoint:IsA("BasePart") then
		return firePoint.Position
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return rootPart and rootPart.Position
end

local function isFiniteVector3(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3"
		and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
		and math.abs(value.X) < math.huge and math.abs(value.Y) < math.huge and math.abs(value.Z) < math.huge
end

local function createRaycastParams(character:Model)
	local filter = {character}
	for _, fog in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog)) do
		table.insert(filter, fog)
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
	return params, filter
end

local function dealNpcDamage(player:Player, npc:Model, hitPart:BasePart?, baseDamage:number, direction:Vector3, hitPosition:Vector3?, shotToken:number?)
	local damage = baseDamage
	local isHeadshot = hitPart ~= nil and hitPart.Name == "Head"
	if isHeadshot then
		damage *= 2
	end

	local applied = GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player, npc, damage, nil, {
		HitPosition = hitPosition,
		HitDirection = direction,
		IsCritical = isHeadshot,
		ShotToken = shotToken,
		RangedWeapon = true,
	})
	if not applied then
		return false
	end

	if isHeadshot then
		GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc, direction)
	end
	GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player, npc, damage)
	return true
end

local function applyBlastKnockback(npc:Model, blastPosition:Vector3)
	if not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) or npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss) then
		return
	end
	local rootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
	if not rootPart or not rootPart:IsA("BasePart") or rootPart.Anchored then
		return
	end
	local offset = rootPart.Position - blastPosition
	if offset.Magnitude <= 0.01 then
		return
	end
	local impulseDirection = offset.Unit * 8 + Vector3.yAxis * 2
	rootPart:ApplyImpulse(impulseDirection * rootPart.AssemblyMass)
end

local function fireVisualNearby(shooter:Player, gun:Tool, visualOrigin:Vector3, endPosition:Vector3, effectData)
	for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local rootPart = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local inRange = false
		if rootPart then
			local delta = rootPart.Position - visualOrigin
			inRange = delta:Dot(delta) <= 250 * 250
		end
		if otherPlayer == shooter or inRange then
			GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, gun, endPosition, effectData)
		end
	end
end

local function fireSteamBurst(player:Player, gun:Tool, origin:Vector3, direction:Vector3, config, damage:number, shotToken:number?)
	local raycastParams = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * config.range, raycastParams)
	local endPosition = result and result.Position or origin + direction * config.range
	local effectData = {
		EffectType = config.effectType,
		ImpactPosition = nil,
		BlastRadius = config.blastRadius,
		HitPositions = {},
	}

	if result then
		effectData.ImpactPosition = result.Position
		local isNpc, directNpc = GameHelper:IsNPC(result.Instance)
		if isNpc then
			dealNpcDamage(player, directNpc, result.Instance, damage, direction, result.Position, shotToken)
		end

		local candidates = GameHelper:NPCCollect(result.Position, config.blastRadius)
		local blastRaycastParams, blastFilter = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
		for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
			table.insert(blastFilter, candidate)
		end
		if directNpc then
			table.insert(blastFilter, directNpc)
		end
		blastRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = blastFilter

		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
			return (a:GetPivot().Position - result.Position).Magnitude < (b:GetPivot().Position - result.Position).Magnitude
		end)

		local blastOrigin = result.Position + result.Normal * 0.08
		local damagedTargets = 0
		for _, npc in ipairs(candidates) do
			if npc == directNpc or not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then
				continue
			end
			local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				continue
			end

			local rootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
			local targetPosition = rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") and rootPart.Position or npc:GetPivot().Position
			local blocked = workspace:Raycast(blastOrigin, targetPosition - blastOrigin, blastRaycastParams)
			if blocked then
				continue
			end

			if GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player, npc, config.blastDamage, GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion, {
				HitPosition = targetPosition,
				HitDirection = direction,
				SuppressHitReaction = true,
				ShotToken = shotToken,
				RangedWeapon = true,
			}) then
				GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player, npc, config.blastDamage)
				applyBlastKnockback(npc, result.Position)
				table.insert(effectData.HitPositions, targetPosition)
				damagedTargets += 1
				if damagedTargets >= config.maxBlastTargets then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	fireVisualNearby(player, gun, origin, endPosition, effectData)
	return endPosition
end

local function getPierceTargetPosition(npc:Model)
	local rootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
	if rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		return rootPart.Position
	end
	return npc:GetPivot().Position
end

local function getPrecisePierceHit(npc:Model, origin:Vector3, direction:Vector3, maxDistance:number)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {npc}
	return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * maxDistance, params)
end

local function fireSteamPierce(player:Player, gun:Tool, origin:Vector3, direction:Vector3, config, damage:number, shotToken:number?)
	local corridorRadius = config.pierceRadius
	local corridorCenter = origin + direction * (config.range * 0.5)
	local corridorCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(corridorCenter, corridorCenter + direction)
	local candidates = GameHelper:NPCCollectInBox(corridorCFrame, Vector3.new(corridorRadius * 2, corridorRadius * 2, config.range))

	local terminalParams, terminalFilter = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
	for _, npc in ipairs(candidates) do
		table.insert(terminalFilter, npc)
	end
	terminalParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = terminalFilter

	local terminalResult = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * config.range, terminalParams)
	local endPosition = terminalResult and terminalResult.Position or origin + direction * config.range
	local terminalDistance = terminalResult and terminalResult.Distance or config.range

	local orderedCandidates = {}
	for _, npc in ipairs(candidates) do
		local targetPosition = getPierceTargetPosition(npc)
		local distanceAlong = (targetPosition - origin):Dot(direction)
		if distanceAlong >= 0 and distanceAlong <= terminalDistance then
			table.insert(orderedCandidates, {
				npc = npc,
				distance = distanceAlong,
				position = targetPosition,
			})
		end
	end
	table.sort(orderedCandidates, function(a, b)
		return a.distance < b.distance
	end)

	local hitPositions = {}
	local piercedTargets = 0
	for _, candidate in ipairs(orderedCandidates) do
		if piercedTargets >= config.maxPierceTargets then
			break
		end

		local exactResult = getPrecisePierceHit(candidate.npc, origin, direction, terminalDistance)
		local hitPart = exactResult and exactResult.Instance or nil
		local hitPosition = exactResult and exactResult.Position or candidate.position
		if dealNpcDamage(player, candidate.npc, hitPart, damage, direction, hitPosition, shotToken) then
			piercedTargets += 1
			table.insert(hitPositions, candidate.position)
		end
	end

	fireVisualNearby(player, gun, origin, endPosition, {
		EffectType = config.effectType,
		ImpactPosition = endPosition,
		PierceRadius = corridorRadius,
		HitPositions = hitPositions,
	})
	return endPosition
end

function reload(player:Player)
	local gun:Tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
	if not gun or not gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then return end
	if SteamWeaponHeatService:IsSteamWeapon(gun) and not SteamWeaponHeatService:CanUse(player) then
		return
	end

	local configFolder = gun:FindFirstChild("配置")
	if not configFolder then return end

	local v_reloading:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.reloading)
	local c_reloadNum:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("装填子弹数量")
	local c_reloadCD:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("装填时长")
	local v_bulletAmount:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.bulletAmount)
	if not v_reloading or not c_reloadNum or not c_reloadCD or not v_bulletAmount or v_reloading.Value then
		return
	end

	local gunItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(gun)
	if not gunItemLo then return end
	local bulletItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(tonumber(gunItemLo.param))
	if not bulletItemLo then return end
	local v_playerBullet:IntValue = GameHelper:GetCurBulletValue(player, bulletItemLo.ItemType)
	if v_playerBullet.Value <= 0 then
		AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player, "Empty Gun Sound")
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "Insufficient ammunition!", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
		return
	end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value == c_reloadNum.Value then return end

	v_reloading.Value = true
	local reloadNum = c_reloadNum.Value - v_bulletAmount.Value
	local cost = math.min(v_playerBullet.Value, reloadNum)
	v_playerBullet.Value -= cost
	task.wait(c_reloadCD.Value)
	if not gun.Parent then return end
	v_reloading.Value = false
	v_bulletAmount.Value += cost
end

GameHelper.CharacterGunFireC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player, hit:BasePart, requestedEndPosition:Vector3, shotToken:number?)
	local gun:Tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
	if not gun or not gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then return false end

	local configFolder = gun:FindFirstChild("配置")
	if not configFolder then return false end

	local c_damage:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("伤害")
	local c_shotCD:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("发射间隔")
	local v_reloading:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.reloading)
	local v_bulletAmount:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.bulletAmount)
	if not c_damage or not c_shotCD or not v_reloading or not v_bulletAmount or v_reloading.Value then
		return false
	end

	local weaponId = SteamWeaponHeatService:GetWeaponId(gun)
	local steamConfig = STEAM_WEAPON[weaponId]
	local origin
	local direction

	if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or not isFiniteVector3(requestedEndPosition) then
		return false
	end
	origin = getFireOrigin(player, gun)
	local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not origin or not rootPart or (origin - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > 12 then
		return false
	end
	local aimVector = requestedEndPosition - origin
	if aimVector.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
		return false
	end
	direction = aimVector.Unit

	local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if type(shotToken) == "number" then
		local tokenRecord = lastGunShotToken[player]
		if tokenRecord and tokenRecord.token == shotToken and timeNow - tokenRecord.time < 6 then
			return false
		end
	end
	local previousFireAt = lastGunFireAt[player] or 0
	if timeNow - previousFireAt < math.max(0.05, c_shotCD.Value * 0.9) then
		return false
	end
	if steamConfig and not SteamWeaponHeatService:CanUse(player) then
		return false
	end
	lastGunFireAt[player] = timeNow
	if type(shotToken) == "number" then
		lastGunShotToken[player] = {token = shotToken, time = timeNow}
	end

	if v_bulletAmount.Value <= 0 then
		reload(player)
		return false
	end

	local costBullet = 1
	if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.FreeBulletV1) and math.random(1, 10) == 1 then
		costBullet = 0
	end
	v_bulletAmount.Value -= costBullet

	if steamConfig then
		local actualEndPosition
		if weaponId == 614 then
			actualEndPosition = fireSteamBurst(player, gun, origin, direction, steamConfig, c_damage.Value, shotToken)
		else
			actualEndPosition = fireSteamPierce(player, gun, origin, direction, steamConfig, c_damage.Value, shotToken)
		end
		SteamWeaponHeatService:AddHeat(player, steamConfig.heat, steamConfig.overheatDuration)
		return true, actualEndPosition
	end

	local raycastParams = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * 100, raycastParams)
	local actualHit = result and result.Instance or nil
	local actualEndPosition = result and result.Position or origin + direction * 100
	local isNpc, npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(actualHit)
	if isNpc then
		local damage = c_damage.Value
		local isCritical = actualHit.Name == "Head"
		if isCritical then
			damage *= 2
		end
		local applied = GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player, npc, damage, nil, {
			HitPosition = actualEndPosition,
			HitDirection = direction,
			IsCritical = isCritical,
			ShotToken = shotToken,
			RangedWeapon = true,
		})
		if applied then
			if isCritical then
				GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc, direction)
			end
			GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player, npc, damage)
		end
	end
	fireVisualNearby(player, gun, origin, actualEndPosition, {HitCharacter = isNpc == true})
	return true, actualEndPosition
end

    campfire:SetAttribute("EnableFire", enable)
    for _,child:Instance in ipairs(campfire:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            child.Enabled = enable
        elseif child:IsA("Fire") then
            child.Enabled = enable
        end

    Range:PivotTo(enable and RootPart.CFrame or RootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,-100,0))

        local parent = Instance.new("Model")

        parent:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.zero))
        parent.Parent = workspace

        local prefab:Part = workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("区域格挡空气墙")
        local wallCount = math.ceil(MapHelper.mapSize_1 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 / prefab.Size.X)
        local wallStartPos = Vector3.new(-(prefab.Size.X * wallCount / 2) + prefab.Size.X / 2,0,0)
                -- print(wallCount)
        for i=1,4 do
            local rootPart:Part = Instance.new("Part")

            rootPart.Transparency = 1

            rootPart.CanQuery = false

function updateGoldParts(parts:{Part},count:number,prefab:Part)
    local max = math.max(#parts,count)
    for i=1,max do
        local part = parts[i]
        if i <= count then
            if not part then
                part = prefab:Clone()
                part.CFrame = prefab.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,(i-1) * prefab.Size.Y,0)
                part.Name = string.format("金条_%d",i)
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.CanTouch = false
                part.CanQuery = false
                part.Anchored = true
                part.Parent = prefab.Parent
                parts[i] = part
            end
            part.Transparency = 0
        else
            if part then
                part.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
end

function updateCrystalParts(parts:{Part},count:number)
    if _crystalPrefab.Parent then
        _crystalPrefab.Parent = nil
    end
    local max = math.max(#parts,count)
    for i=1,max do
        if i > 10 then break end
        local part = parts[i]
        if i <= count then
            if not part then
                part = _crystalPrefab:Clone()
                -- part.CFrame = prefab.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,(i-1) * prefab.Size.Y,0)
                part.Name = string.format("水晶_%d",i)
                part.Parent = _goldPrefab.Parent
                parts[i] = part
            end
            part.CFrame = _crystalPrefab.CFrame + _crystalPrefab.CFrame.RightVector * (i-1)
        else
            part.Position = Vector3.new(0,-900,0)
        end
    end
end

function updateMaterialParts(_parts:{Part},count:number,prefab:Part)
    local showCount = math.ceil(count/5)
    local max = math.max(#_parts,showCount)
    max = math.clamp(max,0,30)
    for i=1,max do
        local part = _parts[i]
        if i <= showCount then
            if not part then
                part = prefab:Clone()
                part.CFrame = prefab.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,(i-1) * prefab.Size.Y,0)
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.CanTouch = false
                part.CanQuery = false
                part.Anchored = true
                part.Parent = prefab.Parent
                _parts[i] = part
            end
            part.Transparency = 0
        else
            if part then
                part.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
end

function recycleItem(item:Model)
    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item,2)

    local sound:Sound = TouchPart:FindFirstChild("运作")
    -- if not sound.Playing then sound:Play() end
    sound:Play()

    local gears1:Model = craftingBenchModel:FindFirstChild("Crash"):FindFirstChild("齿轮1"):FindFirstChild("齿轮"):GetChildren()
    local gears2:Model = craftingBenchModel:FindFirstChild("Crash"):FindFirstChild("齿轮2"):FindFirstChild("齿轮"):GetChildren()
    local Core = craftingBenchModel:FindFirstChild("Crash"):FindFirstChild("Core")
    local attr:Attachment = Core:FindFirstChild("分解起始点")

    CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(Core,true)

    for i,gear1:Part in ipairs(gears1) do
        local tween:Tween = gear1:FindFirstChild("Tween")
        if not tween then
            tween = TweenService:Create(gear1,TweenInfo.new(3,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{
                Rotation = gear1.Rotation + Vector3.xAxis * -360
            })
            tween.Name = "Tween"
            tween.Parent = gear1
            if i== 1 then
                tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
                    CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(Core,false)
                end)
            end
        end
        tween:Play()
    end

    for _,gear2:Part in ipairs(gears2) do
        local tween:Tween = gear2:FindFirstChild("Tween")
        if not tween then
            tween = TweenService:Create(gear2,TweenInfo.new(3,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{
                Rotation = gear2.Rotation + Vector3.xAxis * 360
            })
            tween.Name = "Tween"
            tween.Parent = gear2
        end
        tween:Play()
    end

    local rootPart = item.PrimaryPart
    rootPart.Anchored = true
    local startCFrame = rootPart.CFrame.Rotation + attr.WorldCFrame.Position
    rootPart.CFrame = startCFrame
    local itemTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(2,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    TweenService:Create(rootPart,itemTweenInfo,{
        CFrame = startCFrame + Vector3.new(0,-3,0)
    }):Play()

    task.spawn(function()
        local t = itemTweenInfo.Time
        local originScale = item:GetScale()
        while item and item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
            local dt = task.wait()
            t -= dt
            item:ScaleTo(math.clamp(t/itemTweenInfo.Time,0.01,1) * originScale)
        end
    end)
end

GameHelper.MakeCraftItemC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player,id:number,source:number)
    if source then return end

    -- 制造台
    local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)

    -- 限制
    local times = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(id).Value
    if lo.ItemLimit and times >= lo.ItemLimit then
        UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"The maximum limit has been reached.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        return
    end

    -- 检测是否足够扣费
    local triggerFree = false
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BuilderV2) then
        -- 建造者职业有概率不消耗材料
        if math.random(1,100) <= 20 then
            triggerFree = true
        end
    end

    if triggerFree then
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("HammerFree",player.Character)
    else
        local needs = CommonFunc:ParseKV_Number(lo.PriceType)
        for k,targetValue in pairs(needs) do
            local v_obj:IntValue = v_map[k]
            if not v_obj or v_obj.Value < targetValue then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,string.format("Need more %s.",k),UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
                return
            end
        end

        -- 扣除
        for k,targetValue in pairs(needs) do
            local v_obj:IntValue = v_map[k]
            v_obj.Value -= targetValue
        end
    end

    -- times += 1
    -- CraftItemHelper:SetMakeTimes(id,times)

    if lo.isEnhance then
        -- 是否加强
        v_level.Value += 1

        -- 累计制作次数
        times += 1
        CraftItemHelper:SetMakeTimes(id,times)
    else
        if lo.ResItemId then
            -- 创建道具
            local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(lo.ResItemId)
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
            else
                local character = player.Character
                local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
                item:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cframe.Position + cframe.LookVector * 5))
            end
            item:AddTag(CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimesTag(id))
        else
            -- 给予蓝图
            local item = CraftItemHelper:CreateItem(id)
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
            item:AddTag(CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimesTag(id))
        end
    end

    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients(string.format("%s Crafted a %s.",player.DisplayName,lo.ItemName))
    return true
end

function spawnStore(ground:Part,folderName:string?)
    if not ground then return end
    local prefab:Model
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("沼泽Map"):FindFirstChild(folderName or "装饰")

            local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
            local stoneX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local stoneZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            local stone = prefab:Clone()
