-- 随机石头
function trySpawnStoreAndTree(ground:Part)
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.Marsh then
        local grid1X = gridPoint.X
        local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z
        local posX = ground.Position.X
        local posZ = ground.Position.Z
        local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2

        -- 随机一些树
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        local treeCount = 0
        if zoneLevel <= 2 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,3)
        elseif zoneLevel <= 4 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,2)
        else
            treeCount = math.random(0,1)
        end
        for i=1,treeCount do
            local prefabName = "TreeL"
            local tag = GameEnum.Tag.Tree
            if math.random(1,5) <= 1 then
                tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTree
                prefabName = "TreeXL"
            end
            local tree:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("沼泽Map"):WaitForChild("树"):WaitForChild(prefabName):Clone()
            local treeX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local treeZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            -- local rotationY:number = math.random() * 360
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treeX,groundY,treeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
            tree.Parent = workspace
            tree:AddTag(tag)
        end

        -- 随机石块
        if math.random(1,3) <= 1 then
            spawnStore(ground)
        end

        -- 生成雪块
        GameHelper:SpawnSnow(ground)
    end

    -- 在沼泽边缘的地块上生成一些装饰
    if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshEdgeGround) then
        local r = 1
        for offsetX =-r,r do
            for offsetZ=-r, r do
                local grid1X = gridPoint.X + offsetX
                local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z + offsetZ
                if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) == MapHelper.GridType.land then
                    local g = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                    if g:HasTag("SpawnedEdgeStore") then continue end
                    g:AddTag("SpawnedEdgeStore")
                    local num = math.random(1,3)
                    for i=1,num do
                        spawnStore(g,"边缘装饰")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 生成蘑菇
function trySpawnMushroom(ground:Part)
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround) then return end
    if _mushroomSpawnMarks[ground] then return end
    _mushroomSpawnMarks[ground] = true
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    -- local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    -- if zoneLevel > 3 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.Marsh and gridType ~= GridType.ToxicSwamp then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,2) == 1
    if not isSpawn then
        task.delay(300,function()
            _mushroomSpawnMarks[ground] = nil
        end)
        return
    end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    local mushroomId = _mushroomIds[math.random(1,#_mushroomIds)]
    local resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(mushroomId,CFrame.new(posX,posY,posZ))
    if resItem.PrimaryPart then
        resItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
    end
end

-- 生成鳄鱼/野猪/火鸡
function trySpawnAnimals(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.Marsh and gridType ~= GridType.ToxicSwamp then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local enemyIds = _enemyIdsMap[zoneLevel]
    if not enemyIds then
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
        return
    end

    local enemyId = enemyIds[math.random(1,#enemyIds)]
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= enemyLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal
    
    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
    -- animal:SetAttribute("Grid",string.format("%d,%d",gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z))

    -- Debris:AddItem(enemy,_animalLifeTime)
end

local function fireGunVisualNearby(shooter, gun, endPosition)
    local firePoint = gun and gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
    local origin = firePoint and (firePoint:IsA("Attachment") and firePoint.WorldPosition or firePoint.Position)
    origin = origin or (gun and gun:GetPivot().Position)
    if not origin then return end

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local root = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local inRange = false
        if root then
            local delta = root.Position - origin
            inRange = delta:Dot(delta) <= 250 * 250
        end
        if otherPlayer == shooter or inRange then
            GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, gun, endPosition)
        end
    end
end

-- 肌肉技能V1
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.MuscleV1,function(player:Player, connections)
    print(string.format("MuscleV1 已应用到 %s",player.DisplayName))

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local onCharacterAdded = function(character:Model)
        if not character then return end
        local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        ValueHelper:InitByModel(character,MuscleValue)
        local v_muscle:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,MuscleValue.muscle)
        local v_strength:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,MuscleValue.strength)
        local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)

        local armL:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
        local armR:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")

        local originArmSizeL = armL.Size
        local originArmSizeR = armR.Size
        local lastStrength = v_strength.Value
        local onStrengthChanged = function()
            if v_strength.Value > lastStrength then
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("大只佬升级1",character)
                EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("LeveUp",nil,humanoidRootPart,3)
            end
            lastStrength = v_strength.Value
            local armSizeOffset = Vector3.zero
            if v_strength.Value == 3 then
                armSizeOffset = Vector3.new(0.7,0,0.7)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"肌肉加成",1)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"肌肉加成",1)
                -- AudioHelper:PlayEffect("大只佬升级",character)
            elseif v_strength.Value == 2 then
                armSizeOffset = Vector3.new(0.1,0,0.1)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"肌肉加成",0)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"肌肉加成",0)
            else
                armSizeOffset = Vector3.new(-0.5,0,-0.5)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"肌肉加成",-0.25)
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"肌肉加成",-0.25)
            end

            TweenService:Create(armL,tweenInfo,{Size = originArmSizeL + armSizeOffset}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(armR,tweenInfo,{Size = originArmSizeR + armSizeOffset}):Play()
            -- armL.Size = originArmSizeL + armSizeOffset
            -- armR.Size = originArmSizeR + armSizeOffset
        end
        onStrengthChanged()
        v_strength.Changed:Connect(onStrengthChanged)
        v_muscle.Changed:Connect(function()
            local newStrength = 1
            if v_muscle.Value > 75 then
                newStrength = 3
            elseif v_muscle.Value > 25 then
                newStrength = 2
            end
            v_strength.Value = newStrength
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            while GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) do
                local dt = 1
                local handTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
                if not handTool or not handTool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Dumbbell) then
                    local cost = 1
                    if v_hunger.Value > 200 then
                        cost = 0.1
                    elseif v_hunger.Value > 100 then
                        cost = 0.5
                    end

                    GameHelper:AddMuscle(player,-cost)
                end
                task.wait(dt)
            end
        end)
    end
    onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
    table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded))
end)

    local v_isDaytime:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(GameHelper:GetController(),TimeValue.isDaytime)
    local v_suckBloodBonus:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodBonus)

    local onDayTimeChanged = function()
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        local character = player.Character
        ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus) -- 这是为了异步时，等待初始化完成
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"吸血鬼加成",-0.3)

            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0)
        else
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"吸血鬼加成",1.8)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,"吸血鬼加成",0.1)
        end
    end

    local onCharacterAdded = function()
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then return end
        ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus) -- 这是为了异步时，等待初始化完成
        onDayTimeChanged()
    end
    onCharacterAdded()
    -- 吸血鬼有1倍的饥饿恢复加成，但只能吃肉
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HungerRecoveryBonus,"吸血鬼加成",1)

    -- 吸血鬼吸血加成
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodBonus,"吸血鬼加成",20)
    -- 吸血鬼吸血概率加成
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.suckBloodProb,"吸血鬼加成V1",0.1)

    table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded))
    table.insert(connections,v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(onDayTimeChanged))
    table.insert(connections,validatedHit.Event:Connect(function(triggerPlayer,target,tool,profile,damage,targetKind)
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        if triggerPlayer ~= player then return end
        if not tool or not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then return end
        if targetKind ~= "NPC" or not GameHelper:IsNPC(target) then return end

        -- 随机是否吸血
        local isSuckBlood = math.random() <= v_suckBloodProb.Value
        if isSuckBlood then
            -- 吸血
            GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player,v_suckBloodBonus.Value)
            EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("吸血",triggerPlayer.Character,target)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(triggerPlayer,target:Model)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        if triggerPlayer ~= player then return end
        local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
        if not tool or not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) then return end
        if not GameHelper:IsNPC(target) then return end

        if math.random() <= v_suckBloodProb.Value then
            GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player,v_suckBloodBonus.Value)
            EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("吸血",triggerPlayer.Character,target)
        end
    end))
end)

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV1,function(player:Player, connections)
    print(string.format("ThorV1 已应用到 %s",player.DisplayName))
    -- player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV2)
    -- player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV3)

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,ThorValue)
    local v_energy:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,ThorValue.energy)

    local config = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Jobs"):FindFirstChild("雷神")
    local energyUp = config:FindFirstChild("攻击命中充能").Value
    local energyMax = config:FindFirstChild("最大能量").Value
    local radius = config:FindFirstChild("雷神之怒半径").Value
    local skillDamageUp = 0 -- 技能伤害

    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV2) then
        radius = config:FindFirstChild("2级雷神之怒半径").Value -- 2级雷神技能增加雷神之怒半径
    end
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ThorV3) then
        energyUp = config:FindFirstChild("3级攻击命中充能").Value -- 3级雷神技能增加雷神之怒充能更快
        skillDamageUp = config:FindFirstChild("3级雷神之怒伤害增加").Value -- 3级雷神技能增加雷神之怒伤害
    end

    if not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then
        -- 装备雷神锤
        local tool = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(113)
        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,tool)

        -- 装备雷神护甲
        local armor = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(311)
        AccessoryHelper:Equip(player,armor)
    end

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onPlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget.Event:Connect(function(p:Player,npc:Model,damage:number)
        if p ~= player then return end

        if v_energy.Value >= energyMax then
            -- 触发技能
            v_energy.Value = 0 -- 清空能量

            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(npc)
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(npc:GetPivot().Position,radius,overlapParams)

            local hitNpcs:{Model} = {npc}
            for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                local isNpc,hitNpc = GameHelper:IsNPC(hit)
                if not isNpc then continue end

                if not table.find(hitNpcs,hitNpc) then
                    table.insert(hitNpcs,hitNpc)
                end
            end

            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("雷神之怒",player.Character)
            local lastHitNpc:Model = nil
            for index,hitNpc in ipairs(hitNpcs) do
                task.wait(0.1)
                if not hitNpc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then continue end

                -- 伤害
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,hitNpc,damage + skillDamageUp)

                -- 使用雷神技能击杀统计
                if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(hitNpc) then
                    GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.ThorSkillKill,1)
                end

                EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("雷神技能",lastHitNpc,hitNpc)
                lastHitNpc = hitNpc
            end
        else
            v_energy.Value += energyUp
        end
    end))
end)

-- 一无所有之人：数据驱动的永久高难角色
local _nobodyConfig = _Jobs:WaitForChild("一无所有之人")
local _nobodyStates = {}
local _nobodyStartItemsGranted = {}
local NOBODY_BONUS_NAME = "一无所有之人"
local NOBODY_TAGS = {
    GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV1,
    GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV2,
    GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV3,
}

local function hasNobodyTag(player:Player)
    for _,tag in ipairs(NOBODY_TAGS) do
        if player:HasTag(tag) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function getNobodyLevel(player:Player)
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV3) then
        return 3
    elseif player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NobodyV2) then
        return 2
    end
    return 1
end

local function getNobodyMultiplier(player:Player)
    local levels = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("等级倍率")
    local value = levels:FindFirstChild(string.format("%d级",getNobodyLevel(player)))
    return value and value.Value or 1
end

local function getNobodyValue(group:Instance,name:string,defaultValue:number)
    local value = group:FindFirstChild(name)
    return value and value.Value or defaultValue
end

local function setNobodyPlayerBonuses(player:Player,multiplier:number)
    local penalties = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("负面状态")
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.hungerCostBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"饥饿消耗倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HungerRecoveryBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"食物恢复倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.fogEnd,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"视野距离修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.JumpPowerBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"跳跃力修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.openTreasureSpeedBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"开箱速度倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.BagSizeBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,math.round(getNobodyValue(penalties,"背包容量修正",0) * multiplier))
end

local function setNobodyCharacterBonuses(player:Player,character:Model,multiplier:number)
    if not character or player.Character ~= character then return end

    ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus)
    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local removeHat = base:FindFirstChild("移除帽子")
    if multiplier ~= 0 and removeHat and removeHat.Value then
        CharacterHelper:ClearHat(character,true)
    end

    local penalties = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("负面状态")
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.MaxHealthBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"最大生命倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"移动速度修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.damageReduction,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"伤害减免倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.attackBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"通用伤害倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.meleeAttackBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"近战伤害倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.healItemBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"治疗效果倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.healItemSpeedBonus,NOBODY_BONUS_NAME,getNobodyValue(penalties,"治疗速度倍率修正",0) * multiplier)
end

local function clearNobody(player:Player)
    local state = _nobodyStates[player]
    if state and state.characterConnection then
        state.characterConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    _nobodyStates[player] = nil

    setNobodyPlayerBonuses(player,0)
    if player.Character then
        setNobodyCharacterBonuses(player,player.Character,0)
    end
end

local function applyNobodyCampfire()
    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local configuredLevel = getNobodyValue(base,"初始营火等级",1)
    configuredLevel = math.clamp(math.round(configuredLevel),1,#CampfireSetting.data)

    local startLevel:IntValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("初始营火等级")
    if startLevel then
        -- 共享效果只取最大值；多个 Nobody 不叠加，也不会缩小已开放地图。
        startLevel.Value = math.max(startLevel.Value,configuredLevel)
    end
end

local function grantNobodyStartItems(player:Player)
    if _nobodyStartItemsGranted[player] then return end
    _nobodyStartItemsGranted[player] = true
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then return end

    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local idsValue:StringValue = base:FindFirstChild("初始道具Ids")
    local ids = idsValue and idsValue.Value or ""
    if ids == "" then return end

    for _,idText in ipairs(string.split(ids,",")) do
        local cleanIdText = string.gsub(idText,"%s+","")
        local itemId = tonumber(cleanIdText)
        if not itemId or not ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(itemId) then
            warn(string.format("Nobody 初始道具Id无效: %s",idText))
            continue
        end

        local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId)
        if item then
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
        end
    end
end

local function refreshNobody(player:Player)
    if not player or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then return end

    local base = _nobodyConfig:WaitForChild("基础设置")
    local enabled:BoolValue = base:FindFirstChild("启用")
    if enabled and not enabled.Value then
        clearNobody(player)
        return
    end

    local state = _nobodyStates[player]
    if not state then
        state = {}
        _nobodyStates[player] = state
        state.characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
            setNobodyCharacterBonuses(player,character,getNobodyMultiplier(player))
        end)
    end

    local multiplier = getNobodyMultiplier(player)
    setNobodyPlayerBonuses(player,multiplier)
    if player.Character then
        setNobodyCharacterBonuses(player,player.Character,multiplier)
    end
    applyNobodyCampfire()
    grantNobodyStartItems(player)
end

function trySpawnTreeTrunk(ground:Part)
    -- 判断是否为可生成动物的地块
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel > 2 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.land and gridType ~= GridType.campfireLand then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,2) == 1
    if not isSpawn then return end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ResourcesItemHelper:CreateTreeTrunk(Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ))
end

function trySpawnCarrot(ground:Part)
    if _carrotSpawnMarks[ground] then return end
    _carrotSpawnMarks[ground] = true
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel > 3 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.land and gridType ~= GridType.campfireLand then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,2) == 1
    if not isSpawn then
        task.delay(_animalLifeTime,function()
            _carrotSpawnMarks[ground] = nil
        end)
        return
    end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ResourcesItemHelper:CreateCarrot(Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ))

end

function trySpawnHorse(ground:Part)
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.HorseGround) then return end
    local horseNum = math.random(3,6)
    for i=1,horseNum do
        local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
        local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
        local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5

            ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),

    end

    -- if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.LodeGround) then return end
    if ground:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Prefabs) then return end

function trySpawnAnimal(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.land then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
        local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:Get(EnemySetting,EnemySetting.k.refreshZone,zoneLevel)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= enemyLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:Get(EnemySetting,EnemySetting.k.refreshZone,zoneLevel)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal
    
    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
    -- animal:SetAttribute("Grid",string.format("%d,%d",gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z))

    -- Debris:AddItem(enemy,_animalLifeTime)
end

function trySpawnStoreAndTree(ground:Part)
    -- 随机树木，石头
    local parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local grid1X = gridPoint.X
    local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z
    if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.campfireLand or gridType == MapHelper.GridType.land then
        if math.abs(grid1X - MapHelper.centerGrid1) < 1 and  math.abs(grid1Z - MapHelper.centerGrid1) < 1 then return end

        local posX = ground.Position.X
        local posZ = ground.Position.Z
        local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2

        -- 随机一些树
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        local treeCount = 0
        if zoneLevel <= 2 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,3)
        elseif zoneLevel <= 4 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,2)
        else
            treeCount = math.random(0,1)
        end
        for i=1,treeCount do
            local prefabName = "TreeL"
            local tag = GameEnum.Tag.Tree
            if math.random(1,5) <= 1 then
                tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTree
                prefabName = "TreeXL"
            end
            local tree:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("树"):WaitForChild(prefabName):Clone()
            local treeX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local treeZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            -- local rotationY:number = math.random() * 360
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treeX,groundY,treeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
            tree.Parent = parent
            tree:AddTag(tag)
        end

        -- 随机石块
        if math.random(1,3) <= 1 then
            local prefab:Model
            local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Map"):FindFirstChild("石头")
            if folder then
                local childs = folder:GetChildren()
                if #childs > 0 then
                    local stoneX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
                    local stoneZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
                    -- local rotationY = math.random() * 360
                    local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
                    prefab = childs[math.random(1,#childs)]
                    local stone = prefab:Clone()
                    stone:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0)+Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
                    -- stone:PivotTo(prefab:GetPivot().Rotation + Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
                    stone.Parent = workspace
                    stone:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DecorativeStones)
                end
            end
        end

        -- 生成雪块
        GameHelper:SpawnSnow(ground)
    end
end

function isAllStreamingOut(npc:Model)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local ret = true
    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local charater = player.Character
        if not charater then continue end

        local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - charater:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
        if distance < 160 then
            ret = false
            break
        end
    end

    return ret
end

function onGroundSpawnExit(player:Player,ground:Part)
    ground:RemoveTag(getEnterUserTag(player))

    end

    if _groundAnimals[ground] then

            npc:Destroy()
        end
    end
    if _groundBunnys[ground] then
        local npc = _groundBunnys[ground]
        if npc then
            npc:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function normalizeWeight(poolId, entry)
    local weight = entry.weight
    if typeof(weight) ~= "number" or weight < 0 or weight ~= weight or weight == math.huge then
        warn(string.format("NPCEvent: invalid weight in %s for %s", poolId, tostring(entry.eventId)))
        return 0
    end
    return weight
end

local function buildWeightedOrder(pool, forcedEventId)
    local remaining = {}
    local totalWeight = 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(pool.entries) do
        local weight = normalizeWeight(pool.id, entry)
        table.insert(remaining, {
            entry = entry,
            weight = weight,
        })
        totalWeight += weight
    end

    if totalWeight <= 0 then
        warn(string.format("NPCEvent: %s has no positive weights; falling back to equal weights", pool.id))
        for _, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
            candidate.weight = 1
        end
    else
        for index = #remaining, 1, -1 do
            if remaining[index].weight <= 0 and remaining[index].entry.eventId ~= forcedEventId then
                table.remove(remaining, index)
            end
        end
    end

    local order = {}
    local forcedMatched = false
    if forcedEventId ~= "" then
        for index, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
            if candidate.entry.eventId == forcedEventId then
                table.insert(order, candidate.entry)
                table.remove(remaining, index)
                forcedMatched = true
                break
            end
        end
    end

    while #remaining > 0 do
        local currentTotal = 0
        for _, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
            currentTotal += candidate.weight
        end

        local selectedIndex = 1
        if currentTotal > 0 then
            local roll = eventRandom:NextNumber(0, currentTotal)
            local cumulative = 0
            for index, candidate in ipairs(remaining) do
                cumulative += candidate.weight
                if roll <= cumulative then
                    selectedIndex = index
                    break
                end
            end
        else
            selectedIndex = eventRandom:NextInteger(1, #remaining)
        end

        table.insert(order, remaining[selectedIndex].entry)
        table.remove(remaining, selectedIndex)
    end

    return order, forcedMatched
end

local function spawnConfiguredEvent(eventId)
    local definition = EVENT_DEFINITIONS[eventId]
    if not definition then
        warn("NPCEvent: missing definition for", eventId)
        return nil
    end

    local eventFolder = npcEventsFolder:FindFirstChild(definition.folderName)
    local prefab = eventFolder and eventFolder:FindFirstChild(definition.prefabName)
    if not prefab then
        warn("NPCEvent: missing prefab for", eventId)
        return nil
    end

    local spawnOk, buildingOrError = pcall(spawnBuilding, prefab, definition.levels, true)
    if not spawnOk then
        warn(string.format("NPCEvent: failed to spawn %s: %s", eventId, tostring(buildingOrError)))
        return nil
    end

    local building = buildingOrError
    if not building then
        warn("NPCEvent: no safe spawn point for", eventId)
        return nil
    end

    if definition.startsOldCowboyQuest then
        local questOk, questOrError = pcall(function()
            local OldCowboyQuestService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("OldCowboyQuestService"))
            return OldCowboyQuestService.Start(building, spawnBuilding)
        end)
        if not questOk or not questOrError then
            warn(string.format("NPCEvent: failed to start %s: %s", eventId, tostring(questOrError)))
            building:Destroy()
            return nil
        end
    end

    return building
end

local function cleanupUnselectedEvents(selectedEvents)
    for eventId, definition in pairs(EVENT_DEFINITIONS) do
        if not selectedEvents[eventId] then
            local eventFolder = npcEventsFolder:FindFirstChild(definition.folderName)
            if eventFolder then
                eventFolder:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

local function init()
    if not MapHelper.isInit then return end
    if _init then return end

    _init = true

    local forcedEventId = ""
    if RunService:IsStudio() then
        forcedEventId = forcedEventValue.Value
    end

    local selectedEvents = {}
    local forcedMatched = false
    for _, pool in ipairs(NPC_EVENT_POOLS) do
        local order, matched = buildWeightedOrder(pool, forcedEventId)
        forcedMatched = forcedMatched or matched

        local selectedEventId
        for _, entry in ipairs(order) do
            if spawnConfiguredEvent(entry.eventId) then
                selectedEventId = entry.eventId
                selectedEvents[selectedEventId] = true
                break
            end
        end

        if selectedEventId then
            print(string.format("NPCEvent: %s selected %s", pool.id, selectedEventId))
        else
            warn(string.format("NPCEvent: all candidates failed in %s", pool.id))
        end
    end

    if forcedEventId ~= "" and not forcedMatched then
        warn("NPCEvent: invalid Studio override", forcedEventId)
    end

    cleanupUnselectedEvents(selectedEvents)
end

function spawnBuilding(prefab:Model,levels:{number},destroyPrefab:boolean?)
    local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
    local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
    local grounds:{Part} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Ground)
    for i=1,#grounds do
        local ground = table.remove(grounds,math.random(1,#grounds))
        local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
        local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
        local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if table.find(levels,zoneLevel) == nil then
            continue
        end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.land) then continue end
        local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.building,prefab)
        MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
        print("生成",prefab.Name,grid1X,grid1Z)
        if destroyPrefab then
            prefab:Destroy()
        end
        return building
    end
end

function onTagAdded(tool:Tool, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local light = tool.LightPart
    local sound = tool.Blade.Draw
    local v_Energy = tool.Values.Energy
    local energyMax = tool.Values.EnergyMax.Value
    local v_IsBlock = tool.Values.IsBlock
    local Trail = tool.Trail
    local SetBlockC2S = tool.Events.SetBlockC2S
    local character:Model = nil
    local trailCD = 0
    Trail.Enabled = false

    local enableTrail = function(t:number)
        Trail.Enabled = true
        trailCD = math.max(t,trailCD)
    end

    local setBlock = function(isBlock:boolean)
        if v_IsBlock.Value == isBlock then return end
        
        v_IsBlock.Value = isBlock
        
        if character then
            local v_damageReduction:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.damageReduction)
            if isBlock then
                v_damageReduction.Value += 0.2
                character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack)
            else
                v_damageReduction.Value -= 0.2
                character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack)
            end
        end
    end

    local onCheckSkillBuff = function(isEquipped:boolean)
        if not character then return end
        
        local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
        if not player then return end
        
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV1) then
            --local v_walkSpeed:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus)
            local bouns = 3
            if isEquipped then
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"LightSaber",3)
                --v_walkSpeed.Value += bouns
            else
                ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,"LightSaber",0)
                --v_walkSpeed.Value -= bouns
            end
        end
        
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV2) then
            local humanoid:Humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            local bouns = 15
            if isEquipped then
                humanoid.MaxHealth += bouns
            else
                humanoid.MaxHealth -= bouns
            end	
            humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health,humanoid.MaxHealth)
        end
    end

    GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,target:Model)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        local handTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
        if handTool ~= tool then return end

        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        local damage = tonumber(resLo.param)
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV3) then
            damage *= 1.5
        end
        GameHelper:PlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget(player,target,damage)
    end)

    tool.Activated:Connect(function() 
        enableTrail(0.5)
    end)

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        character = tool.Parent
        onCheckSkillBuff(true)

        tool.Blade.PointLight.Enabled = true
        sound:Play()
        light.Part1.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(.07)
        light.Part2.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(.07)
        light.Part3.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(.07)
        light.Part4.Transparency = 0
    end)

    tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        onCheckSkillBuff(false)

        tool.Blade.PointLight.Enabled = false
        light.Part1.Transparency = 1
        light.Part2.Transparency = 1
        light.Part3.Transparency = 1
        light.Part4.Transparency = 1

        -- 这里优先级一定要比 character = nil 高，因为要清空格挡状态相关加成
        setBlock(false)

        if character then
            character = nil
        end
    end)

    v_Energy.Changed:Connect(function(value: number)
        if value <= 0 then
            setBlock(false)
        end
    end)

    SetBlockC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, isBlock:boolean)
        setBlock(isBlock)
    end)

    GameHelper.BlockBulletC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,enemy:Model,damage:number,bulletPrefab:BasePart?)
        if player.Character ~= character then return end

        enableTrail(0.2)
    end)

    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if trailCD > 0 then
            trailCD -= dt
            if trailCD <= 0 then
                Trail.Enabled = false
            end
        end

        if v_IsBlock.Value then
            if v_Energy.Value > 0 then
                v_Energy.Value = math.clamp(v_Energy.Value - dt,0,energyMax)
            end
        else
            if v_Energy.Value < energyMax then
                v_Energy.Value = math.clamp(v_Energy.Value + dt,0,energyMax)
            end
        end
    end))
end

        boss:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss)
        -- boss:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)

        -- 递增最大血量
        humanoid.MaxHealth += killTimes * 1000
        humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth

        -- 创建铃铛
        local bell = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(v_dropBellId.Value,bellCFrame)
        bell.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
        ValueHelper:SetValue(bell,DragItemValue.enable,false)

        -- 生成小怪
        local minionFolder = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParentFromName(battleGround.Name.."小怪")
        local xiaoguaiFolder:Folder = rootFolder:FindFirstChild("小怪出生点")
        if xiaoguaiFolder then
            for _,att:Attachment in ipairs(xiaoguaiFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if att:IsA("Attachment") then
                    local enemyId = tonumber(att.Name)
                    local enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,minionFolder)
                    enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)
                end
            end
        end

        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            killTimes += 1
            -- 创建宝箱
            createTreasures()
            -- 解锁铃铛
            ValueHelper:SetValue(bell,DragItemValue.enable,true)

            -- 击杀所有小怪
            for _,enemy in ipairs(minionFolder:GetChildren()) do
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(nil,enemy,999999)
            end

            -- 创建铃铛特效
            local effect = EffectHelper:PlayEffect("摇铃",bellCFrame.Position,nil)
            local clearEff = function()
                if effect then
                    EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,0)
                    effect = nil
                end
            end
            bell.PrimaryPart:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Once(clearEff)
            bell.AncestryChanged:Once(clearEff)
            -- 赋值刷新时间
            v_BossSpawn_CD.Value = workspace.DistributedGameTime + CD -- 30 分钟刷一次
        end)
    end

    spawnSomething()
    table.insert(connections,v_BossSpawn_CD.Changed:Connect(function()
        local targetTime = v_BossSpawn_CD.Value
        while true do
            task.wait(1)
            if targetTime ~= v_BossSpawn_CD.Value then return end -- 被修改过，废弃这次流程

            local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime

            local cd = math.clamp(targetTime - timeNow,0,CD)
	        BillboardGui.Enabled = cd > 0
	        BillboardGui.t_time.Text = string.format("👑%s",CommonFunc:TimeToStrAuto(cd))
            if cd <= 0 then
                break
            end
        end
        clearTreasures()
        spawnSomething()
    end))

    table.insert(connections,ZonePart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart)
        local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
        if not character then return end
        local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if otherPart ~= Torso then return end
        GameHelper:UpdateCharacterInArea(ZonePart,GameEnum.Tag.OnBellCaveBattleGround)
    end))

    table.insert(connections,ZonePart.TouchEnded:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart)

        if not character then return end
        local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if otherPart ~= Torso then return end

    end))

    table.insert(connections,ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered: Player)

        local part:Part = v_enter.Value:FindFirstChild("铃铛洞穴"):FindFirstChild("DoorPart")

function spawnStore(ground:Part,folderName:string?)
    if not ground then return end
    local prefab:Model
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("雪原Map"):FindFirstChild(folderName or "装饰")
    if folder then
        local childs = folder:GetChildren()
        if #childs > 0 then
            local posX = ground.Position.X
            local posZ = ground.Position.Z
            local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
            local stoneX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local stoneZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            prefab = childs[math.random(1,#childs)]
            local stone = prefab:Clone()
            stone:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0)+Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
            stone.Parent = workspace
        end
    end
end

-- 随机石头
function trySpawnStoreAndTree(ground:Part)
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield then
        local grid1X = gridPoint.X
        local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z
        local posX = ground.Position.X
        local posZ = ground.Position.Z
        local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2

        -- 随机一些树
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        local treeCount = 0
        if zoneLevel <= 2 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,3)
        elseif zoneLevel <= 4 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,2)
        else
            treeCount = math.random(0,1)
        end
        for i=1,treeCount do
            local prefabName = "TreeL"
            local tag = GameEnum.Tag.Tree
            if math.random(1,5) <= 1 then
                tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTree
                prefabName = "TreeXL"
            end
            local tree:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("雪原Map"):WaitForChild("树"):WaitForChild(prefabName):Clone()
            local treeX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local treeZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            -- local rotationY:number = math.random() * 360
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treeX,groundY,treeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
            tree.Parent = workspace
            tree:AddTag(tag)
        end

        -- 随机石块
        if math.random(1,3) <= 1 then
            spawnStore(ground)
        end
    end

    -- 在边缘的地块上生成一些装饰
    if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldEdgeGround) then
        local r = 1
        for offsetX =-r,r do
            for offsetZ=-r, r do
                local grid1X = gridPoint.X + offsetX
                local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z + offsetZ
                if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) == MapHelper.GridType.land then
                    local g = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                    if g:HasTag("SpawnedEdgeStore") then continue end
                    g:AddTag("SpawnedEdgeStore")
                    MapHelper:SpawnSnow(g)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function trySpawnWarnFruit(ground:Part)
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround) then return end
    if _warnFruitSpawnMarks[ground] then return end
    _warnFruitSpawnMarks[ground] = true
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    -- local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    -- if zoneLevel > 3 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,3) == 1
    if not isSpawn then
        task.delay(300,function()
            _warnFruitSpawnMarks[ground] = nil
        end)
        return
    end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    local resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(245,CFrame.new(posX,posY,posZ))
    if resItem.PrimaryPart then
        resItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
    end
end

function trySpawnDocileAnimal(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] == false then return end
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local animalIds = _docileAnimalIdsMap[zoneLevel]
    if not animalIds then
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = false
        return
    end

    local animalId = animalIds[math.random(1,#animalIds)]
    if _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local amimalLo:DocileAnimalSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(DocileAnimalSetting,animalId)
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= amimalLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local amimalLo:DocileAnimalSetting.Type = EnemyHelper:GetDocileAnimalLo(animalId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(amimalLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateDocileAnimal(amimalLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal

    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnDocileAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
end

-- 宝箱点
function initTreasurePoint()
    local parent = Instance.new("Folder")
    parent.Name = "雪原区域宝箱点"
    parent.Parent = _parent

    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("雪原Map"):FindFirstChild("宝箱资源点"):GetChildren()
    local gridType = MapHelper.GridType.building
    -- local num = math.random(15,20)
    local density = GameHelper.SnowfieldSize / 40 -- 计算密度  676
    local num = math.random(math.ceil(density * 0.9),math.ceil(density * 1.1))
    local grounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround)
    for i=1,num do
        if #grounds <= 0 then break end
        local prefab = prefabs[math.random(1,#prefabs)]
        local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
        local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
        local width = math.max(sizeX,sizeZ)
        for j=1,10 do
            local ground = grounds[math.random(1,#grounds)]
            local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
            if not grid1Vo then
                warn("找不到地块坐标值",ground.Name)
            end
            local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
            local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
            -- 避免在边缘生成
            if grid1X <= width or grid1X >= MapHelper.mapSize_1 - width or grid1Z <= width or grid1Z >= MapHelper.mapSize_1 - width then continue end
            -- 非雪地地块
            if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield) then continue end

            local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,gridType,prefab)
            MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
            building.Parent = parent
            break
        end
    end
end

function spawnBuilding(prefab:Model,levels:{number})
    local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
    local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
    local grounds:{Part} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround)
    for i=1,#grounds do
        local ground = table.remove(grounds,math.random(1,#grounds))
        local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
        local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
        local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if table.find(levels,zoneLevel) == nil then
            continue
        end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Snowfield) then continue end
        local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.building,prefab)
        MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
        building.Parent = _parent
        print("生成",prefab.Name,grid1X,grid1Z)
        return building
    end
end

-- 生成驯鹿
function trySpawnReindeer(ground:Part)
    if _reindeerSpawnGrounds then
        if #_reindeerSpawnGrounds == 0 then return end
    else
        _reindeerSpawnGrounds = {}
        local gridPoints = MapHelper.ZoneMap1[2]
        for i=1,100 do
            local gridPoint = gridPoints[math.random(1,#gridPoints)]
            local grid1X = gridPoint.x
            local grid1Z = gridPoint.z

            local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.land then continue end

            local g = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if not g then continue end

            table.insert(_reindeerSpawnGrounds,g)
            if #_reindeerSpawnGrounds >= 6 then break end
        end
    end

    local index = table.find(_reindeerSpawnGrounds,ground)
    if not index then return end
    table.remove(_reindeerSpawnGrounds,index)
    
    print("生成驯鹿",ground.Name)
    local rotationY = math.random(1,359)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local position = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(Vector3.new(        
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)))
    local horse = GameHelper:CreateReindeer(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0) + position + Vector3.yAxis * 3)
    horse:AddTag("Reindeer")
end

function spawnEnemy()
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local ranged = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 20
    local campfireCFrame = campfire:GetPivot()
    local campfirePos = campfireCFrame.Position

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(MapHelper:GetWantedBoard())
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(MapHelper:GetCraftingBenchModels())
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    _enemyParent:ClearAllChildren()
    local lo:CampRaidSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CampRaidSetting,_waveId)
    local enemyIds = string.split(lo.enemyIds,",")
    _enemyNum = 0
    for _,emenyIdStr in ipairs(enemyIds) do
        local enemyId = tonumber(emenyIdStr)
        local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,_enemyParent)
        local spawnPos:Vector3
        for i=1,20 do
            local x,z = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random() * 2 * math.pi)
            spawnPos = MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(Vector3.new(x * ranged,campfirePos.Y,z * ranged))
            local point = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(spawnPos)
            if point then
                -- 检测是否被悬赏牌和马车阻挡
                local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(point,(campfirePos - point).Unit * 100,raycastParams)
                if not hitResult then
                    spawnPos = point
                    break
                else
                    -- print(hitResult.Instance.Name)
                end
            end
        end
        enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spawnPos))

        local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid:MoveTo(campfire:GetPivot().Position)
        _enemyNum += 1
    end
end

CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.GhostBuilding,function(building:Model, connections)
    local canSpawnAttMarks:{Attachment} = {}
    local atts:{Attachment} = building:FindFirstChild("幽灵生成点"):GetChildren()

    -- 幽灵父对象
    local ghostParent:Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    ghostParent.Name = "幽灵"
    ghostParent.Parent = building

    local clearGhost = function()
        for _,ghost:Model in ipairs(ghostParent:GetChildren()) do
            ghost.Parent = nil
            Debris:AddItem(ghost,1)
        end
    end

    local checkSpawn = function()
        if not MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building) then return end
        if v_isDaytime.Value then return end
        if #ghostParent:GetChildren() > 0 then return end

        for att:Attachment,canSpawn in pairs(canSpawnAttMarks) do
            if not canSpawn then continue end
            local ghostId = tonumber(att.Name)
            if not ghostId then continue end

            local ghost = EnemyHelper:Create(ghostId,ghostParent)
            ghost:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame)

            local humanoid:Humanoid = ghost:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            humanoid.Died:Once(function()
                canSpawnAttMarks[att] = false
            end)

            GameHelper.onBuildingSpawnEnemy:Fire(building,ghost)
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections,v_isDaytime.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            -- 白天清理所有幽灵
            -- ghostParent:ClearAllChildren()
            clearGhost()
        else
            if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                for _,att in ipairs(atts) do
                    if not att:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
                    canSpawnAttMarks[att] = true
                end
            end
            checkSpawn()
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onBuildingEnter.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,b:Model)
        if b ~= building then return end

        checkSpawn()
    end))

    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onBuildingExit.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,b:Model)
        if b ~= building then return end

        if not MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building) then
            -- 清理所有幽灵
            -- ghostParent:ClearAllChildren()
            clearGhost()
        end
    end))
end)

local function scheduleTreasureCleanup(userId:number)
    local version = (_treasureCleanupVersions[userId] or 0) + 1
    _treasureCleanupVersions[userId] = version

    task.delay(GameHelper.ReconnectionGraceSeconds,function()
        if _treasureCleanupVersions[userId] ~= version then return end
        if game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId) then return end

        _treasureMark[userId] = nil
        _treasureCleanupVersions[userId] = nil
    end)
end

function initMode(teleportVo:CommonType.TeleportLobbyToWild)
    local v_gameMode = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("游戏模式")

    local modeId = CommonEnum.Mode.Normal
    local IsStudio = RunService:IsStudio()
    -- if (IsStudio and GameHelper.DebugGameMode == CommonEnum.Mode.Mares) or teleportVo.mode == CommonEnum.Mode.Mares then
    --     modeId = CommonEnum.Mode.Mares -- 梦魇模式
    -- elseif (IsStudio and GameHelper.DebugGameMode == CommonEnum.Mode.Lites) or teleportVo.mode == CommonEnum.Mode.Lites then
    --     modeId = CommonEnum.Mode.Lites -- 简单模式
    -- end

    if IsStudio and GameHelper.DebugGameMode ~= CommonEnum.Mode.NotInit then
        modeId = GameHelper.DebugGameMode
    elseif teleportVo.mode then
        modeId = teleportVo.mode
    end

    local values:Configuration = nil
    if modeId == CommonEnum.Mode.Lites then
        values = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("99Lites模式数值"):GetChildren()
    elseif modeId == CommonEnum.Mode.Mares then
        values = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("99NightsMares模式数值"):GetChildren()
    elseif modeId == CommonEnum.Mode.BountyHunter then
        values = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BountyHunter模式数值"):GetChildren()
    elseif modeId == CommonEnum.Mode.TowerDefense then
        values = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TowerDefense模式数值"):GetChildren()
    elseif modeId == CommonEnum.Mode.SleeplessNight then
        values = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("不眠之夜模式数值"):GetChildren()
    end

    if values then
        print(string.format("套用模式 %d 数值 Start ---------------------",modeId))
        for _,v_congfig:NumberValue in ipairs(values) do
            local targetValue:NumberValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild(v_congfig.Name)
            if targetValue then
                print(string.format("%s %s->%s",targetValue.Name,tostring(targetValue.Value),tostring(v_congfig.Value)))
                targetValue.Value = v_congfig.Value
            else
                warn("未定义的数值:",v_congfig.Name)
            end
        end
        print(string.format("套用模式 %d 数值 End ---------------------",modeId))
    else
        -- warn("未找到模式数值配置:",modeId)
    end
    v_gameMode.Value = modeId
    GameHelper.gameModeInit = true
    GameHelper.onGameModeInitComplete:Fire(modeId)

function onCharacterAdded(player:Player,character:Model)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(character,CharacterValue)
    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

    local characterId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.characterId)
    local characterLo = CharacterHelper:GetLo(characterId)
    local chestplateId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId)
    local faceMaskId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId)
    local shoeId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId)
    local scarfId = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId)

    -- 设置串流模式
    character.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    -- 带上帽子；挑战角色可配置为强制无帽
    if characterLo and characterLo.forceNoHat then
        CharacterHelper:ClearHat(character,true)
    else
        CharacterHelper:ChangedHat(character,characterId)
    end
    -- 重新穿上盔甲
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,chestplateId)
    -- 重新穿上面罩
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,faceMaskId)
    -- 重新穿上围巾
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,scarfId)
    -- 重新穿上鞋子
    AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player,shoeId)

    character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        CharacterHelper:ClearHat(character)
    end)

    humanoid.Died:Once(function()
        -- 看看是不是有复活棺材
        local RespawnCoffins:{Model} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.RespawnCoffin)
        for _,coffin in ipairs(RespawnCoffins) do
            local v_activate:BoolValue = coffin:FindFirstChild("activate")
            local v_triggerTimes:IntValue = coffin:FindFirstChild("triggerTimes")
            if v_activate and v_activate.Value then
                -- 有激活的复活棺材，复活玩家
                GameHelper:PlayerDiedButRespawnCoffin(player)
                v_activate.Value = false
                v_triggerTimes.Value += 1

                -- 播放复活特效
                EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),5)

                local RebirthPoint:Attachment = coffin:FindFirstChild("RebirthPoint")
                local Fire:Fire = RebirthPoint:FindFirstChild("Fire")
                local RespawnSound:Sound = coffin:FindFirstChild("Main"):FindFirstChild("RespawnSound")
                Fire.Enabled = true
                task.wait(3)

                GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player)
                local newCharacter = player.Character
                newCharacter:PivotTo(RebirthPoint.WorldCFrame)
                
                -- 播放复活特效
                EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),1)

                RespawnSound:Play()
                task.wait(1)
                Fire.Enabled = false
                return
            end
        end

        -- 有额外的复活次数，消耗并复活
        local v_ReviveTimes:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes)
        if v_ReviveTimes.Value > 0 then
            v_ReviveTimes.Value -= 1
            GameHelper:PlayerDiedButRevive(player)

            EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),5)
            EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("复活光柱",character)
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("复活光柱",character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            task.wait(3)

            local revivePos = character:GetPivot().Position
            GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player)
            local newCharacter = player.Character
            newCharacter:PivotTo(CFrame.new(revivePos))

            -- 播放复活特效
            EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect("Respawn",nil,newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),3)
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("RespawnSound",newCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
            return
        end

        GameHelper:PlayerDied(player)
    end)

    character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
        if parent == nil then
            -- print("移除了")
            local handTool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if handTool and ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(handTool) then
                ToolHelper:Store(player,handTool)
            end
        end
    end)
    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Player)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player)
end

function onInitPlayerVo(player:Player)
    local userId = player.UserId
    GameHelper:CancelPlayerSessionCleanup(userId)
    cancelTreasureCleanup(userId)

    if not DataHelper:IsInit(player) then return end

    ToolHelper:InitBackpack(player)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,PlayerAttributeValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,PlayerValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(player,PlayerStatsValue)

    local playerGameData = GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player)
    if playerGameData then
        player:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId,playerGameData.chestplateId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId,playerGameData.faceMaskId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId,playerGameData.scarfId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId,playerGameData.shoeId)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes,playerGameData.reviveTimes)
        GameHelper:SetRideLv(player,playerGameData.rideLv)

        for _,bulletTag in ipairs(GameEnum.BulletTags) do
            local num = playerGameData.bullets[bulletTag] or 0
            ValueHelper:SetValue(player,bulletTag,num)
        end
    else
        local joinData = player:GetJoinData() or {}
        local teleportVo:CommonType.TeleportLobbyToWild = joinData["TeleportData"]
        if not teleportVo then
            teleportVo = {}
            if RunService:IsStudio() and GameEnum.TestCharacterEnable then
                teleportVo.characterId = GameEnum.TestCharacterId
                teleportVo.level = GameEnum.TestCharacterLv
            else
                local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
                if playerVo then
                    local characterVo = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(player,playerVo.characterId)
                    teleportVo.characterId = characterVo and characterVo.id or 0
                    teleportVo.level = characterVo and characterVo.lv or 1
                else
                    teleportVo.characterId = 0
                    teleportVo.level = 1
                end
            end
        end
        playerGameData = GameHelper:CreatePlayerGameData(player,teleportVo)
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
        initMode(teleportVo)
    end

    local characterId = playerGameData.teleportVo.characterId
    local characterLv = playerGameData.teleportVo.level

    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes).Changed:Connect(function()
        GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
    end)
    for _,bulletTag in ipairs(GameEnum.BulletTags) do
        ValueHelper:FindValue(player,bulletTag).Changed:Connect(function()
            GameHelper:UpdatePlayerGameData(player)
        end)
    end

    -- 初始化相关默认值
    local maxHunger = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.maxHunger)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger,maxHunger)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.characterId,characterId)

    -- 加载角色
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        onCharacterAdded(player,character)
    end)
    player:LoadCharacter()
    
    -- 初始化工具
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    local characterLo = CharacterHelper:GetLo(characterId)
    if not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then
        -- 统计角色使用
        GameAnalytics:LogCharacterUse(player,characterId)

        if characterLo then
            -- 已配置角色只获得明确填写的起始工具；空字符串代表完全空手
            local starterTool = characterLo.starterTool
            if type(starterTool) == "string" and starterTool ~= "" then
                local startToolIds = starterTool:split(",")
                for _,toolId in ipairs(startToolIds) do
                    local itemId = tonumber(toolId)
                    if not itemId then continue end

                    local tool = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId)
                    if tool then
                        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,tool)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            -- 未选择职业时装备默认起始工具
            local bag = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(101)
            local axe = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(104)
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,bag)
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,axe)
        end
    end

    -- 初始化永久性加成
    for key,num in pairs(playerVo.permanentUpgrades) do
        local puId = tonumber(key)
        local puLo:PermanentUpgradeSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(PermanentUpgradeSetting,puId)
        if not puLo then continue end

        if puLo.processor == CommonEnum.PermanentUpgradesType.BagSize then
            local upSize = tonumber(puLo.param)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.BagSizeBonus,string.format("永久加成.%d",puLo.id),upSize)
        elseif puLo.processor == CommonEnum.PermanentUpgradesType.StartItem then
            if characterLo and characterLo.disablePermanentStartItems then continue end
            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then continue end -- 如果是重连，跳过

            local itemId = tonumber(puLo.param)
            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(itemId)
            local resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(itemId)
            if resItemLo.IsTool then
                ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,resItem)
            end
        elseif puLo.processor == CommonEnum.PermanentUpgradesType.Revive then
            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) then continue end -- 如果是重连，跳过

            -- 增加复活机会
            local v_ReviveTimes:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.ReviveTimes)
            v_ReviveTimes.Value += tonumber(puLo.param)
        end
    end

    -- 初始化角色技能天赋
    if characterLo then
        -- 角色视野
        if characterLo.fogEnd then
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.fogEnd,"基础值",characterLo.fogEnd)
        end

        -- 天赋
        for i=1,characterLv do
            local k = string.format("skill%dTag",i)
            local tag = characterLo[k]
            if tag then
                player:AddTag(characterLo[k])
            end
        end
    end

    task.wait(1)
    local character = player.Character
    if not playerGameData.alive then
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.Health = 0
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
    end

    -- 携带道具
    if not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Reconnection) and not (characterLo and characterLo.disableCarryItems) then

GameHelper.OpenTreasureC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player,part:Instance)
    if player.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
    local treasure:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(part,GameEnum.Tag.Treasure)
    if not treasure then return end

    local enabled = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(treasure,TreasureValue.enable)
    if not enabled then return end

    local userId = player.UserId
    if not _treasureMark[userId] then _treasureMark[userId] = {} end

    local openedTreasures = _treasureMark[userId]
    for i = #openedTreasures,1,-1 do
        local openedTreasure = openedTreasures[i]
        if not openedTreasure or not openedTreasure:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            table.remove(openedTreasures,i)
        end
    end

    if table.find(openedTreasures,treasure) then
        warn("OpenTreasureC2S: Player has already opened this treasure.")
        return
    end

    local ItemPoint:Attachment = treasure:FindFirstChild("ItemPoint",true)
    if not ItemPoint then
        warn("OpenTreasureC2S: Treasure does not have ItemPoint attachment.")
        return
    end

    -- 记录这个宝箱已打开
    table.insert(openedTreasures,treasure)

    -- 创建道具
    local randomId = treasure:GetAttribute("RandomId")
    if randomId <= 6 and math.random(1,100) == 1 then
        -- 奖励1个钻石给他吧
        ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(9,ItemPoint.WorldCFrame.Position,player)
    else
        -- 正常随机奖励
        local items = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(randomId,ItemPoint.WorldCFrame.Position,player)
        for _,gun:Tool in ipairs(items) do
            if gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then
                GameHelper:CreateBulletFromGun(gun)
            end
        end
    end

    if randomId == 7 then
        -- 如果是恶魔宝箱，转化成6级宝箱
        treasure:SetAttribute("RandomId",6)
    end

    GameHelper.onOpenTreasure:Fire(player,treasure)
    return true
end

local function setTag(instance, tag, enabled)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return
	end
	local hasTag = CollectionService:HasTag(instance, tag)
	if enabled and not hasTag then
		CollectionService:AddTag(instance, tag)
	elseif not enabled and hasTag then
		CollectionService:RemoveTag(instance, tag)
	end
end

local function getRoot(model)
	return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

end

local function cloneRelative(sourceInstance, sourceRoot, targetRoot, cloneSource)
	if not sourceInstance or not sourceRoot or not targetRoot then
		return nil
	end
	local template = cloneSource or sourceInstance
	local clone = template:Clone()
	local relative = sourceRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(sourceInstance:GetPivot())
	clone:PivotTo(targetRoot.CFrame * relative)
	return clone
end

	self.state = newState
	if self.stage1Building and self.stage1Building.Parent then

	end
	if self.stage2Building and self.stage2Building.Parent then

function OldCowboyQuestService:_isPlayerNearNpc(player, maxDistance)
	if not player or not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if not playerRoot or not npcRoot then
		return false
	end
	return (playerRoot.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_findNearestAlivePlayer(excludedPlayer)
	local npcRoot = getRoot(self.npc)
	if not npcRoot then
		return nil
	end
	local nearest = nil
	local nearestDistance = math.huge
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= excludedPlayer and GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local distance = (root.Position - npcRoot.Position).Magnitude
				if distance < nearestDistance then
					nearest = player
					nearestDistance = distance
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest
end

function OldCowboyQuestService:_assignReplacementOwner(excludedPlayer)
	if self.owner then
		return self.owner
	end
	local replacement = self:_findNearestAlivePlayer(excludedPlayer)
	if replacement then
		self:_setOwner(replacement)
		if self.state == self.State.CEMETERY_FILM then
			self:_finishCemeteryFilm()
		end
	end
	return replacement
end
