function findTargetPlayer()
    local deerPos = LowerPart.Position
    local retPlayer:Player
    local retCharacter:Model
    local lastDistance:number = 9999999
    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then continue end

        local humanoid:Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end

        local distance = (deerPos - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
        if not retCharacter or distance < lastDistance then
            retPlayer = player
            retCharacter = character
            lastDistance = distance
        end
    end
    return retPlayer
end

function robotMoveTo(pos:Vector3)
    if pos then
        local offset = (pos - RootPart.Position) * CommonEnum.XZ
        local dir = offset.Unit
        ControllerManager.MovingDirection = dir
        ControllerManager.FacingDirection = dir
    else
        ControllerManager.MovingDirection = Vector3.zero
    end
end

function onTagAdded(_,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(robot,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer)

    hungrySound:Stop()
    walkSound:Stop()
    runSound:Stop()
    atkSound:Stop()

    -- 走路
    fleeTrack:Stop()
    walkTrack:Stop()
    -- 跑动
    runTrack:Stop()
    -- 震惊
    stunnedTrack:Stop()
    -- 待机
    idleTrack:Play()

    RootPart.Anchored = false
    -- 需要先设置一下位置，不然会因为距离太远找不到目标，触发小鹿离开
    deer:PivotTo(RootPart.CFrame)

    local isHungry:boolean = v_state.Value == GameEnum.DeerState.Hungry
    local state = v_state.Value
    v_stunned.Value = false

    local moveTrack:AnimationTrack = walkTrack
    local moveSound:Sound = walkSound

    local findTargetCD = 0
    local moveToCD = 2
    local damage = _defDamage
    local atkCD = 0
    local ATK_CD = 3
    -- if not v_targetPlayer.Value then
    --     v_targetPlayer.Value = findTargetPlayer()
    -- end

    -- 是否红眼
    if isHungry then
        moveTrack = runTrack
        moveSound = runSound
        damage = _hungryDamage
        ControllerManager.BaseMoveSpeed = _hungrySpeed
        eye.FillColor = Color3.new(1,0,0)
        hungrySound:Play()
        ATK_CD = 1.5
    else
        ControllerManager.BaseMoveSpeed = _defSpeed
        eye.FillColor = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    end

    local moveTo = function(pos:Vector3)
        robotMoveTo(pos)
        if pos then
            if not moveTrack.IsPlaying then moveTrack:Play() end
            if not moveSound.Playing then moveSound:Play() end
            if moveTrack == walkTrack then
                moveTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
            end
        else
            if moveTrack.IsPlaying then moveTrack:Stop() end
            if moveSound.Playing then moveSound:Stop() end
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections,v_stunned.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_stunned.Value then
            -- print("小鹿受到惊吓")
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("小鹿尖叫",humanoidRootPart)
            stunnedTrack:Play()
            -- CommonFunc:StopMove(deer) -- 停止移动
            moveTo() -- 停止移动
            task.wait(2)
            stunnedTrack:Stop()
            atkCD = 1
            v_stunned.Value = false

            if state == GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then
                -- 如果是偷看状态，直接离开
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
            end
        else
            -- print("小鹿结束惊吓")
        end
    end))
    -- table.insert(connections,humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
    --     if speed > 0 then
    --         if not moveTrack.IsPlaying then moveTrack:Play() end
    --         moveTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / 18)

    --         if not moveSound.Playing then moveSound:Play() end
    --     else
    --         if moveTrack.IsPlaying then moveTrack:Stop() end
    --         if moveSound.Playing then moveSound:Stop() end
    --     end
    -- end))

    if state == GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then
        local autoLeaveCD = 20
        local checkCD = 2
        -- 不会攻击
        table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
            checkCD -= dt
            autoLeaveCD -= dt
            if autoLeaveCD <= 0 then
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
                return
            end
            if checkCD > 0 then return end
            checkCD = 2

            if v_stunned.Value then return end
            
            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(LowerPart.Position,15,overlapParams)
            for _,hitPart:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                local character:Model = CommonFunc:GetModel(hitPart)
                if not character then continue end
                if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then continue end

                -- 直接走了
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
                return
            end
        end))
    else
        local attackTracks:{AnimationTrack} = {}
        for i,animId in ipairs(attackAnimIds) do
            local attackTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(deer,animId)
            attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            attackTrack.Looped = false
            attackTrack:Stop()
            table.insert(attackTracks,attackTrack)
        end

        -- 攻击检测
        local atkTimes = 0
        table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
            atkCD -= dt
            if atkCD > 0 then return end
            if v_stunned.Value then return end
            if deer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DeerLeave) then return end
            -- atkCD = 1

            local player:Player = v_targetPlayer.Value
            if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

            local character = player.Character
            local distance = (LowerPart.Position - character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(TouchPart.CFrame,TouchPart.Size,overlapParams)
            if #hits > 0 then
                -- 检测障碍
                local isObs = CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(deer,character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment)
                if isObs then return end

                playAttackUIEffect(player)
                GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,damage)
                local human:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if human.Health <= 0 then
                    v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
                    GameHelper.KilledByBossS2C:FireClient(player,robot)
                end

                atkCD = ATK_CD
                moveToCD = ATK_CD
                findTargetCD = 1
                -- CommonFunc:StopMove(deer) -- 停止移动
                moveTo()
                -- 播放攻击动画
                atkTimes += 1
                local index = atkTimes % #attackTracks + 1
                local atkTrack = attackTracks[index]
                atkTrack:Play()
                atkSound:Play()
                if index == 1 then
                    atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(2)
                end
            elseif distance > 300 then
                -- 距离玩家太远了，离开
                GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
            end
        end))

        -- 移动检测
        table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
            findTargetCD -= dt
            moveToCD -= dt
            if v_stunned.Value then return end
            -- local range = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 10 -- 10是为了避免小鹿在营火范围内时，仍然会被追逐
            if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
                if moveToCD <= 0 then
                    local character = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
                    -- humanoid:MoveTo(character:GetPivot().Position)
                    moveTo(character:GetPivot().Position)
                end
            else
                if findTargetCD <= 0 then
                    findTargetCD = 3
                    v_targetPlayer.Value = findTargetPlayer()
                    if not v_targetPlayer.Value then
                        GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
    end

    -- 检测营火范围
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not v_targetPlayer.Value then return end
        if v_stunned.Value then return end
        if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(LowerPart.Position) then
            -- 如果小鹿在营火范围内，停止追逐，进入僵直
            v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
            findTargetCD = 99999
            moveToCD = 99999
            -- humanoid:MoveTo(deer:GetPivot().Position) -- 停止移动
            -- CommonFunc:StopMove(deer) -- 停止移动
            moveTo()
            -- print("播放小鹿僵直动画")
            GameHelper:DeerStunned()

            task.wait(2)
            -- 小鹿逃跑
            GameHelper:DeerTryLeave()
        end
    end))
end

ValueHelper.onInit.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,model:Configuration)
    if PlayerValue ~= model then return end

    local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
    local v_gamehungerRate:NumberValue = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("饥饿值下降倍率")

    while player do
        local dt = task.wait(1)
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        -- 饥饿衰减
        local baseHungerCost = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.baseHungerCost)
        local hungerCostBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.hungerCostBonus)
        local costHunger = baseHungerCost
        costHunger *= v_gamehungerRate.Value -- -- 乘以该游戏模式的饥饿值下降倍率
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WalkSpeedBuff.Run) then
            local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local speed = (humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * CommonEnum.XZ).Magnitude
            if speed >= 1 and not humanoid.Sit then
                local runHungerCost = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.runHungerCost)
                costHunger += runHungerCost
            end

            -- print(costHunger)
        end
        costHunger += costHunger * hungerCostBonus -- 计算接加成，负是降低，正是增加
        if costHunger < 0 then costHunger = 0 end

        if v_hunger.Value > 0 then
            local newHunger = v_hunger.Value - costHunger
            if newHunger < 0 then
                newHunger = 0
            end
            v_hunger.Value =  newHunger
        else
            local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then
                humanoid:TakeDamage(humanoid.MaxHealth * 0.1)
            end
        end

        -- 血量恢复
        GameHelper:PlayerAutoHeal(player,1)
    end
end)

    v_poisonMeter.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_poisonMeter.Value >= GameEnum.PosionMax then
            -- 中毒值满，标记中毒
            if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned) then
                character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned)
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You're poisoned!😵",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
        elseif v_poisonMeter.Value <= 0 then
            -- 中毒值清零，移除中毒
            if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned) then
                character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned)
            end
        end
    end)
    v_freezeMeter.Changed:Connect(function()
        if v_freezeMeter.Value >= GameEnum.FreezeMax then
            -- 冰冷值满，标记冰冷
            if not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed) then
                character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed)
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You're freezed!❄",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
        elseif v_freezeMeter.Value <= 0 then
            -- 冰冷值清零，移除冰冷
            if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed) then
                character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Freezed)
            end
        end
    end)

    while character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
        -- 中毒相关
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InMarshGas) then
            -- 在下雨的泥沼泽中，提上中毒值
            if v_poisonMeter.Value < GameEnum.PosionMax then
                local poisonResistance = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonResistance)
                local up = math.clamp(10 - poisonResistance,0,10)
                v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value + up,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
            end
        else
            if v_poisonMeter.Value > 0 then
                v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value - 1,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
            end
        end

        -- 寒冷相关
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnSnowfieldGround) then -- 在雪原
            if v_freezeMeter.Value < GameEnum.FreezeMax and
            not character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff) then -- 没有暖暖灯效果

                -- v_freezeMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_freezeMeter.Value - 1,0,GameEnum.FreezeMax)
                GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,-1)
            end

        -- 在暴风雪中，超级寒冷
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
            GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,10)
        end

        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Poisoned) then
            -- 中毒状态下，每秒扣血
            GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,1,nil,true)
        end

local function getClosestPlayer(enemy:Model,aggroDistance:number)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = aggroDistance
	for _, player in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
		if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
		local character:Model = player.Character
		local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if character and character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and playerRoot then
			local playerPos = playerRoot.Position
			local dist = (playerPos - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if dist <= shortestDist then
				if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(playerPos) and dist > 10 then
					continue
				end
				if not CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(enemy,character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment) then
					closest = player
					shortestDist = dist
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest, shortestDist
end

local function getClosestEscort(enemy:Model,aggroDistance:number)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = aggroDistance
	for target in pairs(escortTargets) do
		if target ~= enemy and target.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target) then
			local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart
			if targetRoot then
				local dist = (targetRoot.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
				if dist <= shortestDist then
					if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(targetRoot.Position) and dist > 10 then
						continue
					end
					if not CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(enemy,target,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment) then
						closest = target
						shortestDist = dist
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest, shortestDist
end

function onTagAdded(enemy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
	enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
	if not humanoidRootPart then return end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(enemy,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Enemy)
	local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id)
	local atkDamage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
	local v_targetPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(enemy,EnemyValue.targetPlayer)
	local v_walkSpeed:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed)

	local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
	humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = lo.aggroDistance
	local originWalkSpeed = v_walkSpeed.Value
	local originPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
	local attackWalkSpeedDown = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 0.5
	local attackTrack:AnimationTrack
	local animations = enemy:FindFirstChild("Animations")
	local attackAnimation = animations and animations:FindFirstChild("attack")
	if attackAnimation and attackAnimation:IsA("Animation") then
		local success, loadedTrack = pcall(function()
			return CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(enemy,attackAnimation)
		end)
		if success and loadedTrack then
			attackTrack = loadedTrack
			attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
			attackTrack.Looped = false
			attackTrack:Stop()
		end
	end
	local wander_cd:number = 0
	local atkCD = 0
	local chase_cd:number = 0
	local forceTime = 10
	local campfireBackupCD = 0
	local targetProbeCD = 0
	local targetPlayer:Player = nil
	local targetEscort:Model = nil
	local syncingTargetValue = false

	local function updatePatrolSpeed()
		if targetPlayer or targetEscort then
			ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"巡逻",0)
		else
			ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"巡逻",-originWalkSpeed*0.5)
		end
	end

	local function setTargetPlayer(player:Player)
		targetPlayer = player
		targetEscort = nil
		syncingTargetValue = true
		v_targetPlayer.Value = player
		syncingTargetValue = false
		updatePatrolSpeed()
	end

	local function setTargetEscort(target:Model)
		targetPlayer = nil
		targetEscort = target
		syncingTargetValue = true
		v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
		syncingTargetValue = false
		updatePatrolSpeed()
	end

	local function clearTarget()
		setTargetPlayer(nil)
	end

	local function getTargetModel()
		if targetEscort then
			return targetEscort
		end
		return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
	end

	local function isTargetAlive()
		if targetEscort then
			return escortTargets[targetEscort] == true and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(targetEscort)
		end
		return GameHelper:isAlive(targetPlayer)
	end

	local function acquireClosestTarget(maxDistance)
		local player, playerDistance = getClosestPlayer(enemy,maxDistance)
		local escort, escortDistance = getClosestEscort(enemy,maxDistance)
		if escort and escortDistance < playerDistance then
			setTargetEscort(escort)
			return escort
		end
		setTargetPlayer(player)
		return player
	end

	setTargetPlayer(nil)
	table.insert(connections,v_targetPlayer.Changed:Connect(function()
		if syncingTargetValue then return end
		local value = v_targetPlayer.Value
		if value and value:IsA("Player") then
			targetPlayer = value
			targetEscort = nil
		else
			targetPlayer = nil
			targetEscort = nil
		end
		updatePatrolSpeed()
		if value then
			forceTime = 10
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
		wander_cd = math.random(10, 20)
	end))

	table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
		if health < humanoid.MaxHealth and not isTargetAlive() then
			local newTarget = acquireClosestTarget(lo.aggroDistance)
			if newTarget then
				forceTime = 10
			end
		end

		if health <= 0 then
			GameHelper:EnemyDeathDrop(enemy)
			enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ragdoll)
			enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalDeath)
			enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
			enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Animal)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
		if not enemy or not enemy.PrimaryPart then
			enemy:Destroy()
			return
		end
		if humanoidRootPart.Anchored then return end
		chase_cd -= dt
		wander_cd -= dt
		atkCD -= dt
		forceTime -= dt
		campfireBackupCD -= dt
		targetProbeCD -= dt

		local previousTarget = getTargetModel()
		if targetProbeCD <= 0 and (not isTargetAlive() or forceTime <= 0) then
			targetProbeCD = 0.75
			local newTarget = acquireClosestTarget(lo.aggroDistance)
			if newTarget and getTargetModel() ~= previousTarget then
				forceTime = 10
			end
		end

		if isTargetAlive() then
			local targetModel = getTargetModel()
			local targetHRP = targetModel and (targetModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetModel.PrimaryPart)
			if not targetHRP then
				clearTarget()
				return
			end
			local targetPos = targetHRP.Position
			local offset = targetHRP.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
			local distToTarget = offset.Magnitude
			if forceTime <= 0 and distToTarget > lo.aggroDistance then
				clearTarget()
				return
			end

			if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(humanoidRootPart.Position) and campfireBackupCD <= 0 then
				campfireBackupCD = 10
				clearTarget()
				chase_cd = 1
				wander_cd = 10
				forceTime = 0
				humanoid:MoveTo(originPos)
				return
			end

			if chase_cd <= 0 then
				humanoid:MoveTo(targetPos)
			end

			if atkCD <= 0 then
				local isObs = EnemyHelper:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(enemy,targetModel)
				if not isObs and EnemyHelper:IsInAttackRange(enemy,targetModel,lo.attackDistance)
					and not enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFreezed) then
					atkCD = lo.attackCD
					if attackTrack then
						if attackTrack.IsPlaying then
							attackTrack:Stop(0.05)
						end
						attackTrack:Play(0.05,1,1)
					end
					if targetPlayer then
						GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(targetPlayer,atkDamage,enemy)
						GameHelper.onAnimalAttactPlayer:Fire(enemy,targetPlayer,atkDamage)
					elseif targetEscort then
						GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(enemy,targetEscort,atkDamage)
					end
					AudioHelper:PlayEffect("动物攻击",humanoidRootPart)

					ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"攻击后减速",-attackWalkSpeedDown)
					task.delay(lo.attackCD,function()
						if enemy and enemy.Parent then
							ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"攻击后减速",0)
						end
					end)

					if isTargetAlive() then
						if (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Magnitude > 0.01 then
							humanoid:MoveTo(humanoidRootPart.Position - (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit * 10)
						end
						chase_cd = 1
					else
						clearTarget()
					end
				end
			end

			if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and math.random(1, 1000) == 1 then
				humanoid.Jump = true
			end
		else
			if targetPlayer or targetEscort then
				clearTarget()
			end
			if wander_cd <= 0 then
				local randomOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-lo.wanderRange, lo.wanderRange), 0, math.random(-lo.wanderRange, lo.wanderRange))
				humanoid:MoveTo(originPos + randomOffset)
				wander_cd = math.random(10, 20)
			end
		end
	end))
end

local function fireBuddyVisual(source, target, guaranteedPlayer)
    local sourceRoot = source and (source:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or source.PrimaryPart)
    local sourcePosition = sourceRoot and sourceRoot.Position
    if not sourcePosition then return end
    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local otherRoot = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local inRange = false
        if otherRoot then

        end

            NPCGunVisualS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, source, target)
        end
    end
end

function onTagAdded(buddy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    task.delay(3,function()
        buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
    end)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = buddy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local Head:Part = buddy:WaitForChild("Head")
    humanoidRootPart.Anchored = false

    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("驯服",humanoidRootPart)

    local humanoid:Humanoid = buddy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
    humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    -- humanoid.NameOcclusion = Enum.NameOcclusion.NoOcclusion
    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Subject
    humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = 50

    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(buddy,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Buddy)
    local v_ownerPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
    local v_targetEnemy:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy)

    local v_walkSpeed:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.walkSpeed)
    local v_displayName:StringValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.displayName)
    local v_attackDistance:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackDistance)
    local v_attackCD:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD)
    local v_atkDamage:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage)

    local followOffset:Vector3 = Vector3.zero
    local isOldCowboyCompanion = buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion)
    local followInterval = isOldCowboyCompanion and OLD_COWBOY_FOLLOW_INTERVAL or 1
    local followStopDistance = isOldCowboyCompanion and OLD_COWBOY_FOLLOW_STOP_DISTANCE or 10

    local function getFollowPosition(ownerRootPart:BasePart):Vector3
        if isOldCowboyCompanion then
            return ownerRootPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(OLD_COWBOY_FOLLOW_OFFSET)
        end
        return followOffset + ownerRootPart.Position
    end

    local onWalkSpeedChanged = function()
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = v_walkSpeed.Value
    end

    local updateName = function()
        if isOldCowboyCompanion then
            buddy.Name = v_displayName.Value
            return
        end
        if v_ownerPlayer.Value then
            local p:Player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
            buddy.Name = string.format("%s's %s",p.DisplayName,v_displayName.Value)
        else
            buddy.Name = string.format("Unbound %s",v_displayName.Value)
        end
    end

    updateName()
    onWalkSpeedChanged()
    table.insert(connections,v_walkSpeed.Changed:Connect(onWalkSpeedChanged))
    table.insert(connections,v_ownerPlayer.Changed:Connect(function()
        updateName()
        if v_ownerPlayer.Value then
            if not isOldCowboyCompanion then
                for i=1,10 do
                    local newOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1)*math.random(),0,math.random(-1,1)*math.random())
                    if newOffset == Vector3.zero then continue end -- 必须要随机出不是0的偏移，不然调用Unit 会返回NaN
                    followOffset = newOffset.Unit * 8
                    break
                end
            end
            -- followOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1)*math.random(),0,math.random(-1,1)*math.random()).Unit * 3
        else
            v_targetEnemy.Value = nil
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
        end
    end))

    -- 跟随相关
    local nextFollowTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        if v_targetEnemy.Value then return end

        local gameTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTime < nextFollowTime then return end
        nextFollowTime = gameTime + followInterval

        local ownerPlayer:Player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(ownerPlayer) then return end

        local ownerCharacter = ownerPlayer.Character
        local ownerRootPart = ownerCharacter.PrimaryPart
        local newFollowPos = getFollowPosition(ownerRootPart)

        local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - newFollowPos).Magnitude
        if distance > followStopDistance then
            -- 走路过来
            humanoid:MoveTo(newFollowPos)
        end
    end))

    -- 距离太远时候传送
    local nextTeleportTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        local gameTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTime < nextTeleportTime then return end
        nextTeleportTime = gameTime + 3

        local ownerPlayer:Player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(ownerPlayer) then return end

        local ownerCharacter = ownerPlayer.Character
        local ownerRootPart = ownerCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local newFollowPos = getFollowPosition(ownerRootPart)

        local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - newFollowPos).Magnitude
        if distance > 100 then
            -- 传送过来
            v_targetEnemy.Value = nil
            if isOldCowboyCompanion then
                buddy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(newFollowPos) * ownerRootPart.CFrame.Rotation)
            else
                buddy:PivotTo(ownerRootPart.CFrame)
            end
        end
    end))

    -- 攻击敌人相关
    local nextAttackTime = 0
    local nextFollowTargetTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        if not v_targetEnemy.Value then return end

        local gameTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTime < nextFollowTargetTime then return end
        nextFollowTargetTime = gameTime + 0.1

        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(v_targetEnemy.Value) then
            v_targetEnemy.Value = nil
            return
        end

        local enemy:Model = v_targetEnemy.Value
        -- local offset = enemy.PrimaryPart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
        -- local distance = offset.Magnitude
        local op = OverlapParams.new()
        op:AddToFilter(v_targetEnemy.Value)
        op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoidRootPart.Position,v_attackDistance.Value,op)

        -- if distance <= lo.attackDistance then
        if #hits > 0 then
            if gameTime >= nextAttackTime then
                nextAttackTime = gameTime + v_attackCD.Value
                nextFollowTargetTime = nextAttackTime
                if isOldCowboyCompanion then
                    local tool = buddy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
                    if tool then
                        tool:Activate()
                    end
                    fireBuddyVisual(buddy, enemy, v_ownerPlayer.Value)
                else
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("动物伙伴攻击",humanoidRootPart)
                end
                GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(buddy,enemy,v_atkDamage.Value,GameEnum.DamageSource.AnimalBuddy)
                -- EffectHelper:PlayAnchoredWorldEffect("伙伴攻击",Head.Position,workspace,1)
                
                local ownerPlayer:Player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
                local ownerCharacter = ownerPlayer.Character
                local ownerRootPart = ownerCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                -- 跑向玩家
                if isOldCowboyCompanion then
                    humanoid:MoveTo(getFollowPosition(ownerRootPart))
                else
                    humanoid:MoveTo(ownerRootPart.Position)
                end
            else
                -- 停住
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
            end
        else
            local enemyRootPart:Part = enemy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            humanoid:MoveTo(enemyRootPart.Position)
        end
    end))

    -- 玩家命中敌人
    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,npc:Model,damage:number)
        if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        if player ~= v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then
            v_targetEnemy.Value = npc
        end
    end))

    -- 玩家受击
    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(player:Player,damage:number,attacker:Model)
        if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        if player ~= v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        local isNpc,npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(attacker)
        if isNpc then
            v_targetEnemy.Value = npc
        end
    end))

    -- 暮年牛仔受到攻击时会反击伤害来源。
    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(attacker:Model,npc:Model,damage:number,damageSource:number?)
        if not isOldCowboyCompanion then return end
        if npc ~= buddy or attacker == buddy then return end
        if attacker and GameHelper:IsNPC(attacker) and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(attacker) then
            v_targetEnemy.Value = attacker
        end
    end))

    -- 主动探测：攻击视玩家为目标的敌人（Boss 除外）
    local v_petChaseSwitch: BoolValue = game.ReplicatedStorage["玩法开关"]:WaitForChild("宠物追击")
    local nextProbeTime = 0
    table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not v_petChaseSwitch.Value then return end
        if not v_ownerPlayer.Value then return end
        if v_targetEnemy.Value then return end

        local gameTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTime < nextProbeTime then return end
        nextProbeTime = gameTime + 1

        local ownerPlayer: Player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(ownerPlayer) then return end

        local op = OverlapParams.new()
        op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
        op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit))
        local nearby = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoidRootPart.Position, 100, op)

        local checked = {}
        for _, part in ipairs(nearby) do
            local enemy: Model = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
            if not enemy or checked[enemy] then continue end
            checked[enemy] = true

            if enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss) then continue end
            if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(enemy) then continue end

            local v_ep = ValueHelper:FindValue(enemy, EnemyValue.targetPlayer)
            if v_ep and v_ep.Value == ownerPlayer then
                v_targetEnemy.Value = enemy
                break
            end
        end
    end))

    -- table.insert(connections,GameHelper.)

    humanoid.Died:Once(function()
        buddy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        onInitAnimation(buddy,connections)
    end)
end

function onInitAnimation(buddy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local humanoid:Humanoid = buddy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local tool:Tool = buddy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

    local animations:Folder = buddy:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if not animations then return end

    local v_targetEnemy:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.targetEnemy)

    local walkAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("walk")
    local runAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("run")
    local walkTrack:AnimationTrack
    local runTrack:AnimationTrack
    if walkAnim then
        walkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,walkAnim)
        if not walkTrack then
            warn("找不到敌人动画:",buddy.Name)
        end
        walkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
        walkTrack.Looped = true
        walkTrack:Stop()
    end
    if runAnim then
        runTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,runAnim)
        runTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
        runTrack.Looped = true
        runTrack:Stop()
    end

    local playMoveAnim = function()
        if v_targetEnemy.Value then
            if runTrack then
                if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
                if not runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Play() end
            else
                if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            end
        else
            if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Stop() end
        end
    end

    local stopMoveAnim = function()
        if walkTrack and walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
        if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then runTrack:Stop() end
    end

    stopMoveAnim()
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
        if speed > 1 then
            playMoveAnim()
        else
            stopMoveAnim()
        end
    end))

    if tool then
        local attackAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("attack")
        if attackAnim then
            local attackTrack:AnimationTrack
            table.insert(connections,tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                -- print(enemy.Name)
                if not attackTrack then
                    attackTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,attackAnim)
                    attackTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
                    attackTrack.Looped = false
                end
                attackTrack:Play()
                -- attackTrack:AdjustSpeed(3)
            end))
        end

        local toolAnim:Animation = animations:FindFirstChild("tool")
        if toolAnim then
            local toolTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(buddy,toolAnim)
            toolTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            toolTrack.Looped = true
            toolTrack:Play()
            table.insert(connections,tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
                if not toolTrack.IsPlaying then toolTrack:Play() end
            end))
            table.insert(connections,tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
                if toolTrack.IsPlaying then toolTrack:Stop() end
            end))
        end

    end
end

    local lastHurtTime:number = -1000
    local running:boolean = false
    local originWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed

    local setRunning = function(isRunning)
        if running == isRunning then return end
        running = isRunning
        if running then
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(animal,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"跑",10)
            -- humanoid.WalkSpeed += 10
        else
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(animal,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"跑",-10)
            -- humanoid.WalkSpeed -= 10
        end
    end

    local moveToRandomPoint = function(radius:number)
        if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
			humanoid.Jump = true
		end
        local position = animal:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(
            math.random(-radius, radius),
            0,
            math.random(-radius, radius)
        )
        humanoid:MoveTo(position)
    end

    local onMoveFinished = function()
        local isFear = lastHurtTime + 10 > workspace.DistributedGameTime
        setRunning(isFear)
        if isFear then
            -- 惊恐状态
            moveToRandomPoint(30)
        else
            -- 安逸状态
            -- task.wait( 1 + math.random() * 5)
            -- moveToRandomPoint(10)
            task.delay(1 + math.random() * 5,function()
                moveToRandomPoint(10)
            end)
            -- print("走")
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections,humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
        if speed > 0 and humanoid.Health > 0  then
            if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
            walkTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed / originWalkSpeed)
        else
            if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(onMoveFinished))
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
        if not animal:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DocileAnimal) then return end

        if humanoid.Health > 0 then
            lastHurtTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            onMoveFinished()
        else
            GameHelper:DocileAnimalDeathDrop(animal)

            animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ragdoll)
            animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalDeath)
            animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.DocileAnimal)
            animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
        end
    end))

    -- moveToRandomPoint(10)
    onMoveFinished()

function onTagAdded(bandit:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    bandit:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = bandit.PrimaryPart
    local humanoid:Humanoid = bandit:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
    humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    -- humanoid.NameOcclusion = Enum.NameOcclusion.NoOcclusion
    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(bandit,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Enemy)
    local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(bandit,EnemyValue.id)
    local atkDamage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(bandit,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
    local v_hungerDamage:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(bandit,EnemyValue.hungerDamage)
    local v_targetPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(bandit,EnemyValue.targetPlayer)
    local v_targetCraft:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(bandit,EnemyValue.targetCraft)
    local v_reviveTimes:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(bandit,EnemyValue.reviveTimes)
    local tool:Tool = bandit:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    local targetPlayer:Player
    local targetEscort:Model
    local ambusherRetaliateUntil = 0
    humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = lo.aggroDistance

    local originPos = EnemyHelper:GetCustomOriginPos(bandit) or bandit:GetPivot().Position
    local attackWalkSpeedDown = humanoid.WalkSpeed * 0.5
    local atkCD = lo.attackCD
    local chase_cd:number = 0 -- 追逐cd
    local forceTime = 10
    local targetProbeCD = 0

    local function setTargetPlayer(player:Player)
        targetPlayer = player
        targetEscort = nil
        v_targetPlayer.Value = player
    end

    local function setTargetEscort(target:Model)
        targetPlayer = nil
        targetEscort = target
        if v_targetPlayer.Value then
            v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
        end
    end

    local function clearTarget()
        targetPlayer = nil
        targetEscort = nil
        if v_targetPlayer.Value then
            v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
        end
    end

    local function getTargetModel()
        if targetEscort then
            return targetEscort
        end
        return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character
    end

    local function isTargetAlive()
        if targetEscort then
            return escortTargets[targetEscort] == true and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(targetEscort)
        end
        return GameHelper:isAlive(targetPlayer)
    end

    local function distanceToModel(model)
        local root = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
        if not root then
            return math.huge
        end
        return (root.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
    end

    local function findClosestEscort(maxDistance)
        local closest
        local closestDistance = maxDistance
        for target in pairs(escortTargets) do
            if bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher)
                and not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion) then
                continue
            end
            if target ~= bandit and target.Parent and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(target) then
                local distance = distanceToModel(target)
                if distance <= closestDistance then
                    closest = target
                    closestDistance = distance
                end
            end
        end
        return closest, closestDistance
    end

    local function acquireClosestTarget(maxDistance)
        if bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) then
            local oldCowboy = findClosestEscort(math.max(maxDistance,300))
            if oldCowboy then
                setTargetEscort(oldCowboy)
                return oldCowboy
            end
        end

        local player = GameHelper:GetClosestPlayer(bandit,maxDistance)
        local playerDistance = player and distanceToModel(player.Character) or math.huge
        local escort, escortDistance = findClosestEscort(maxDistance)
        if escort and escortDistance < playerDistance then
            setTargetEscort(escort)
            return escort
        end
        setTargetPlayer(player)
        return player
    end

    table.insert(connections,v_targetPlayer.Changed:Connect(function()
        local value = v_targetPlayer.Value
        if value and value:IsA("Player") then
            targetPlayer = value
            targetEscort = nil
            if bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) then
                ambusherRetaliateUntil = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 3
            end
        else
            targetPlayer = nil
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
        if health < humanoid.MaxHealth and not isTargetAlive() then
            local newTarget = acquireClosestTarget(200)
            if newTarget then
                forceTime = 10
            end
        end

        if health <= 0 then
            GameHelper:EnemyDeathDrop(bandit)

            if tool then
                tool:Destroy()
            end
            if v_reviveTimes.Value <= 0 then
                bandit:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath)
            end
            bandit:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll)
            bandit:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
            bandit:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if humanoidRootPart.Anchored then return end
        if v_targetCraft.Value then return end

        atkCD -= dt
        chase_cd -= dt
        forceTime -= dt
        targetProbeCD -= dt

        local previousTarget = getTargetModel()
        local shouldRestoreAmbushTarget = bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher)
            and workspace.DistributedGameTime >= ambusherRetaliateUntil
            and (not targetEscort or not targetEscort:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion))
        if targetProbeCD <= 0 and (shouldRestoreAmbushTarget or not isTargetAlive() or forceTime <= 0) then
            targetProbeCD = bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) and 0.5 or 0.75
            local newTarget = acquireClosestTarget(lo.aggroDistance)
            if newTarget then
                if getTargetModel() ~= previousTarget then
                    forceTime = 10
                end
            elseif previousTarget then
                humanoid:MoveTo(originPos)
            end
        end

        if not isTargetAlive() then
            if targetPlayer or targetEscort then
                clearTarget()
                humanoid:MoveTo(originPos)
            end
            return
        end

        local targetModel = getTargetModel()
        local targetHRP = targetModel and (targetModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or targetModel.PrimaryPart)
        if not targetHRP then
            clearTarget()
            return
        end

        local targetPos = targetHRP.Position
        local offset = targetHRP.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
        local distToTarget = offset.Magnitude
        local releaseDistance = bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) and 300 or lo.aggroDistance
        if forceTime <= 0 and distToTarget > releaseDistance then
            clearTarget()
            chase_cd = 0
            return
        end

        if chase_cd <= 0 then
            if distToTarget > lo.attackDistance then
                humanoid:MoveTo(targetPos)
            else
                CommonFunc:StopMove(bandit)
            end
        end

        if atkCD <= 0 then
            local isObs = EnemyHelper:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(bandit,targetModel)
            if not isObs and distToTarget <= lo.attackDistance and not bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFreezed) then
                if tool then
                    tool:Activate()
                end
                atkCD = lo.attackCD
                if lo.attackType then
                    if lo.attackType == GameEnum.EnemyAttackType.SuicideBomb then
                        atkCD = 999999
                        if tool then
                            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("引信点燃",tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
                        end
                        task.defer(function()
                            local sec = 3
                            local bombTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + sec
                            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            highlight.Name = "自爆高亮"
                            highlight.Parent = bandit
                            highlight.Enabled = false

                            local waitTime = 0.1
                            while true do
                                task.wait(waitTime)
                                if not bandit:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
                                local cd = bombTime - workspace.DistributedGameTime
                                waitTime = math.max(cd / sec,0.1)
                                if cd > 0 then
                                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("beep",humanoidRootPart)
                                    highlight.Enabled = true
                                    task.delay(waitTime * 0.5,function()
                                        highlight.Enabled = false
                                    end)
                                else
                                    break
                                end
                            end

                            if tool then
                                tool:Destroy()
                                tool = nil
                            end

                            local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
                            explosion.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
                            explosion.BlastPressure = 0
                            explosion.BlastRadius = 10
                            explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
                            explosion.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.Craters
                            explosion.TimeScale = 1
                            explosion.Visible = true
                            explosion.Parent = workspace
                            local damagedTargets = {}
                            explosion.Hit:Connect(function(part:BasePart, distance:number)
                                local hitModel = part and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                                if not hitModel or damagedTargets[hitModel] then return end
                                local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitModel)
                                if player then
                                    if part ~= hitModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
                                    damagedTargets[hitModel] = true
                                    GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,atkDamage,nil,nil,{DamageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion, HitPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position, SuppressHitReaction = true})
                                    EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireClient(player,"震屏",10 - math.max(distance,9))
                                elseif escortTargets[hitModel] and GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(hitModel) then
                                    damagedTargets[hitModel] = true
                                    GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(bandit,hitModel,atkDamage,GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion,{DamageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion, HitPosition = humanoidRootPart.Position, SuppressHitReaction = true})
                                end
                            end)

                            humanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
                            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("爆炸",humanoidRootPart)
                            humanoid:Destroy()
                            GameHelper:DestroyAndSmashTarget(bandit,5,100)
                        end)
                    elseif GameEnum.EnemyAttackType[lo.attackType] then
                        if targetPlayer then
                            fireNearbyNpcVisual(GameHelper.EnemyGunAttackS2C, bandit, targetPlayer, targetPlayer, atkDamage)
                        elseif targetEscort and atkDamage > 0 then
                            fireNearbyNpcVisual(NPCGunVisualS2C, bandit, targetEscort)
                            GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(bandit,targetEscort,atkDamage)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if targetPlayer then
                        if atkDamage > 0 then
                            GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(targetPlayer,atkDamage,bandit)
                        end
                        if v_hungerDamage.Value > 0 then
                            GameHelper:PlayerTakeHungerDamage(targetPlayer,v_hungerDamage.Value,bandit)
                        end
                    elseif targetEscort and atkDamage > 0 then
                        GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(bandit,targetEscort,atkDamage)
                    end
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],humanoidRootPart)
                end

                CommonFunc:StopMove(bandit)
                chase_cd = 0.5
                if isTargetAlive() then
                    local attackedTarget = getTargetModel()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        if not bandit or not bandit:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not bandit:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit) then return end
                        if getTargetModel() ~= attackedTarget then return end
                        chase_cd = 0.5
                        if lo.attackType and GameEnum.EnemyAttackType[lo.attackType] and distToTarget < lo.attackDistance * 0.5 then
                            humanoid:MoveTo(humanoidRootPart.Position - (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit * 10)
                        end
                        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bandit,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"攻击后减速",-attackWalkSpeedDown)
                        task.wait(1)
                        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bandit,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"攻击后减速",0)
                    end)
                else
                    clearTarget()
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

function setPartsTransparency(folder:Folder,Transparency:number)
    for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Transparency = Transparency
        end
    end
end

function onTagAdded(buddy:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = buddy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local SuckBloodFolder = buddy:FindFirstChild("吸血饰品")
    local PlunderFolder = buddy:FindFirstChild("铁饰品")

    local c_valueUpRate = _config:FindFirstChild("每级数值提升")

    local baseAtkDamage = ValueHelper:WaitBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage,"基础")
    local baseAttackCD = ValueHelper:WaitBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD,"基础")
    local baseBodySize = ValueHelper:WaitBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize,"基础")

    local v_ownerPlayer:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)

    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.level)
    local v_meatEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.meatEaten)
    local v_deadBodyEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.deadBodyEaten)
    local v_ironEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.ironEaten)

    local v_bodySize:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize)

    -- 升级/形态变换
    local onLevelUp = function()
        EffectHelper:PlayWeldConstraintEffect("变化形态",humanoidRootPart,3)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("猛兽交互音效",humanoidRootPart)
    end

    setPartsTransparency(SuckBloodFolder,1)
    setPartsTransparency(PlunderFolder,1)
    table.insert(connections,v_meatEaten.Changed:Connect(function()
        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastMaxLevel) then return end
        
        local v_targetNum = _config:FindFirstChild("升级吃肉需求"):FindFirstChild(tostring(v_level.Value + 1))
        if not v_targetNum then
            buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastMaxLevel)
            return
        end

        if v_meatEaten.Value >= v_targetNum.value then
            v_meatEaten.Value -= v_targetNum.value
            v_level.Value += 1

            local curValueRate = v_level.Value * c_valueUpRate.Value
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.atkDamage,"等级加成",curValueRate * baseAtkDamage)
            -- ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.attackCD,"等级加成",curValueRate * -baseAttackCD)
            ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(buddy,BuddyAttributeValue.bodySize,"等级加成",curValueRate * baseBodySize)

            onLevelUp()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_deadBodyEaten.Changed:Connect(function()
        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood) then return end

        local v_targetNum = _config:FindFirstChild("获取吸血技能喂食次数")
        if not v_targetNum then return end

        if v_deadBodyEaten.Value >= v_targetNum.value then
            buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood)
            setPartsTransparency(SuckBloodFolder,0)

            onLevelUp()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_ironEaten.Changed:Connect(function()
        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder) then return end

        local v_targetNum = _config:FindFirstChild("获取掠夺铁技能喂食次数")
        if not v_targetNum then return end

        if v_ironEaten.Value >= v_targetNum.value then
            buddy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder)
            setPartsTransparency(PlunderFolder,0)

            onLevelUp()
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_bodySize.Changed:Connect(function()
        buddy:ScaleTo(v_bodySize.Value)
    end))
    table.insert(connections,GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(attacker:Model,npc:Model,damage:number,damageSource:number?)
        if attacker ~= buddy then return end

        local player = v_ownerPlayer.Value
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end

        if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood) then
            -- 吸血
            local v_rate = _config:FindFirstChild("吸血概率")
            if math.random() <= v_rate.Value then
                local v_value = _config:FindFirstChild("吸取血量")
                GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player,v_value.Value)
                EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireAllClients("吸血",player.Character,npc)
            end
        end

        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(npc) then
            if buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder) then
                -- 爆铁
                local v_rate = _config:FindFirstChild("爆铁概率")
                if math.random() <= v_rate.Value then
                    local v_id = _config:FindFirstChild("爆铁Id")
                    ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(v_id.Value,npc:GetPivot())
                end
            end

            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.beastKill,1)
        end

    end))
end

    local isResItem,resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(resItem)
    if not isResItem then return end

    local onEat = function()
        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(resItem)
        GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.feedBeast,1)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("猛兽喂养",buddy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        local effect:ParticleEmitter = buddy:FindFirstChild("Head"):FindFirstChild("love")
        effect.Enabled = true
        task.delay(2,function()
            effect.Enabled = false
        end)
    end

    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastmasterV1) and resItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
        local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(resItem)
        local v_meatEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.meatEaten)
        v_meatEaten.Value += tonumber(resItemLo.param) or 1
        onEat()
    elseif not buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanPlunder) and player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastmasterV2) and resItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Iron) then
        local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(resItem)
        local v_ironEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.ironEaten)
        v_ironEaten.Value += tonumber(resItemLo.param) or 1
        onEat()
    elseif not buddy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastCanSuckBlood) and player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BeastmasterV3) and resItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DeadBody) then
        local v_deadBodyEaten:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(buddy,BeastAttributeValue.deadBodyEaten)
        v_deadBodyEaten.Value += 1
        onEat()
    end
end)

function onTagAdded(destroyer:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    destroyer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCAutoJump)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = destroyer.PrimaryPart
    local humanoid:Humanoid = destroyer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,false)
    humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    -- humanoid.NameOcclusion = Enum.NameOcclusion.NoOcclusion
    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
    CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(destroyer,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Enemy)
    local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(destroyer,EnemyValue.id)
    local atkDamage = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(destroyer,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
    local v_targetCraft:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(destroyer,EnemyValue.targetCraft)
    local tool:Tool = destroyer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")


    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = lo.aggroDistance

    local nextAtkTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + lo.attackCD
    local nextHeartbeatTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.2
    local nextCheckHitTreeTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1

    local _,modelSize = destroyer:GetBoundingBox()
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
        if health <= 0 then
            GameHelper:EnemyDeathDrop(destroyer)

            if tool then
                tool:Destroy()
            end
            destroyer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll)
            destroyer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath)
            destroyer:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
            destroyer:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Destroyer)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if humanoidRootPart.Anchored then return end

        local gameTimeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if gameTimeNow < nextHeartbeatTime then return end

        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(v_targetCraft.Value) then
            local newTarget = GameHelper:GetClosestDestructibleCraft(destroyer,lo.aggroDistance)
            if not newTarget and v_targetCraft.Value then
                -- 旧目标死了，并且没有新目标，走回出生地
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
            end
            v_targetCraft.Value = newTarget
        end

        if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(v_targetCraft.Value) then        
            if gameTimeNow >= nextAtkTime then
                local op = OverlapParams.new()
                op:AddToFilter(v_targetCraft.Value)
                op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                local cframe,size = destroyer:GetBoundingBox()
                local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe,size,op)
                if #hits > 0 then
                    if not destroyer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.NPCFreezed) then
                        if tool then
                            tool:Activate()
                        end
                        nextAtkTime = gameTimeNow + lo.attackCD
                        GameHelper:CraftTakeDamage(destroyer,v_targetCraft.Value,atkDamage)
                        CommonFunc:StopMove(destroyer)
                        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],humanoidRootPart)
                    end
                    humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
                else
                    local offsetToTarget:Vector3 = v_targetCraft.Value:GetPivot().Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
                    humanoid:Move((offsetToTarget * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit)
                end
            else
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
            end
        end

        if gameTimeNow >= nextCheckHitTreeTime then
            nextCheckHitTreeTime = gameTimeNow + 1

            -- 检测碰撞树木
            local op = OverlapParams.new()
            op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Tree))
            op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree))
            op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(destroyer:GetPivot(),modelSize * 1.1,op)
            local hitTrees = {}
            for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
                local tree:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Tree) or CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.BigTree)
                if not tree or hitTrees[tree] then continue end
                hitTrees[tree] = true
                GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(nil,tree,100)
                if tree.PrimaryPart then
                    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("树被撞击",tree.PrimaryPart)
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

local function getCharacterRoot(character: Model): BasePart?
    return character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart)
end

local function isAlive(character: Model): boolean
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and getCharacterRoot(character) ~= nil
end

local function getQueryData(player: Player, character: Model)
    local cached = queryCache[player]
    if cached and cached.character == character then
        return cached
    end
    local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlap.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    overlap.MaxParts = 128

    local raycast = RaycastParams.new()
    raycast.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycast.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    raycast.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer

    cached = {character = character, overlap = overlap, raycast = raycast}
    queryCache[player] = cached
    return cached
end

local function getValidatedTargetRoot(model: Model): BasePart?
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function isCandidateModel(model: Model, character: Model): Model?
    if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil end

    local isNpc, npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(model)
    npc = npc or model
    if not isNpc or npc == character or not npc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil end

    local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
    if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath) then return nil end
    return npc
end

local function getTreeModel(instance: Instance): Model?
    local bigTree = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(instance, GameEnum.Tag.BigTree)
    if bigTree then return bigTree end
    return CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(instance, GameEnum.Tag.Tree)
end

local function hasLineOfSight(root: BasePart, target: Model, raycast: RaycastParams): boolean
    local targetRoot = getValidatedTargetRoot(target)
    if not targetRoot then return false end
    local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    local destination = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    local direction = destination - origin
    if direction:Dot(direction) <= 0.01 then return true end

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.Server.LineOfSight")
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycast)
    debug.profileend()
    return hit == nil or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)
end

local function getDamage(tool: Tool, targetKind: string): number?
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    if not resLo or not resLo.param then return nil end
    local params = string.split(tostring(resLo.param), ",")
    return tonumber(targetKind == "Tree" and (params[2] or params[1]) or params[1])
end

local function applyNpcHit(player: Player, target: Model, tool: Tool, profile, swingId: number): boolean
    local damage = getDamage(tool, "NPC")
    if not damage then return false end

    if tool:HasTag("LightSaber") and player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.JediV3) then
        damage *= 1.5
    end

    local damageSource
    if profile.id == 147 and target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost) then
        damageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.HolySword
    end
    local didDamage = GameHelper:PlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget(player, target, damage, damageSource)
    if didDamage then
        MeleeHitValidated:Fire(player, target, tool, profile, damage, "NPC", swingId)
    end
    return didDamage == true
end

local function applyTreeHit(player: Player, target: Model, tool: Tool, profile, swingId: number): boolean
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return false end
    if target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) and not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PowerAxe) then return false end

    local damage = getDamage(tool, "Tree")
    if not damage then return false end
    local attackBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character, CharacterValue.attackBonus) or 0
    damage += damage * attackBonus

    local hp = target:GetAttribute("hp")
    if not hp or hp <= 0 then return false end
    local didDamage = GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(player, target, damage)
    if not didDamage then return false end
    GameHelper:AddMuscle(player, 0.5)
    MeleeHitValidated:Fire(player, target, tool, profile, damage, "Tree", swingId)
    return true
end

local function applyResourceSphere(
    player: Player,
    root: BasePart,
    tool: Tool,
    profile,
    swingId: number,
    queryData
): number
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Axe) then return 0 end

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.Server.ResourceSphere")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, profile.reach, queryData.overlap)
    debug.profileend()

    local seen = {}
    local hitCount = 0
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local tree = getTreeModel(part)
        if tree and not seen[tree] then
            seen[tree] = true
            local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
            if hp and hp > 0 and applyTreeHit(player, tree, tool, profile, swingId) then
                hitCount += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return hitCount
end

local function clearPlayer(player: Player)
    states[player] = nil
    queryCache[player] = nil
end

local function handleSwing(player: Player, swingId)
    if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
    if typeof(swingId) ~= "number" or swingId % 1 ~= 0 or swingId < 1 or swingId > 2147483647 then return end
    local character = player.Character
    if not isAlive(character) then return end

    local tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
    if not tool or not (tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MeleeWeapon) or tool:HasTag("LightSaber")) then return end

    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local profile = resLo and MeleeWeaponSetting.GetById(tonumber(resLo.id))
    if not profile then return end

    local now = os.clock()
    local state = states[player]
    if not state or state.character ~= character or state.tool ~= tool then
        state = {character = character, tool = tool, lastTime = 0, lastSwingId = 0}
        states[player] = state
    end
    if swingId <= state.lastSwingId then return end
    if now - state.lastTime < profile.cooldown then return end

    state.lastTime = now
    state.lastSwingId = swingId

    local root = getCharacterRoot(character)
    local queryData = getQueryData(player, character)
    applyResourceSphere(player, root, tool, profile, swingId, queryData)

    local rear = profile.rearAllowance
    local depth = profile.reach + rear
    local boxCFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, (rear - profile.reach) * 0.5)
    local boxSize = Vector3.new(profile.width, profile.height, depth)

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.Server.Hitbox")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, boxSize, queryData.overlap)
    debug.profileend()

    local candidates = {}
    local seen = {}
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        local npc = model and isCandidateModel(model, character)
        if npc and not seen[npc] then
            local targetRoot = getValidatedTargetRoot(npc)
            if targetRoot then
                -- boxCFrame is shifted forward to center the broad-phase query.
                -- The configured reach/rear bounds are relative to the character root,
                -- so the narrow-phase check must use the root coordinate space.
                local rootLocalPosition = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(targetRoot.Position)
                if math.abs(rootLocalPosition.X) <= profile.width * 0.5
                    and math.abs(rootLocalPosition.Y) <= profile.height * 0.5
                    and rootLocalPosition.Z >= -profile.reach
                    and rootLocalPosition.Z <= rear then
                    seen[npc] = true
                    local delta = targetRoot.Position - root.Position
                    table.insert(candidates, {model = npc, kind = "NPC", distance = delta:Dot(delta)})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)

    local hitCount = 0
    local maxTargets = math.min(profile.maxTargets, 12)
    for i = 1, math.min(#candidates, maxTargets) do
        local candidate = candidates[i]
        if not profile.lineOfSight or hasLineOfSight(root, candidate.model, queryData.raycast) then
            if candidate.kind == "NPC" then
                if applyNpcHit(player, candidate.model, tool, profile, swingId) then
                    hitCount += 1
                end
            end
            if hitCount >= maxTargets then break end
        end
    end

    MeleeHitS2C:FireClient(player, swingId, hitCount)
end

-- Mounted riders are not handled by the ordinary Bandit animation stack. Emit the
-- existing spatial impact sound from the server-side damage event so every nearby
-- client hears a hit, including melee hits that touch the horse's collision shell.
GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(_, npc, _, _, hitContext)
    if not npc or not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy) then return end
    if hitContext and hitContext.SuppressHitReaction then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (lastHitSoundAt[npc] or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
    lastHitSoundAt[npc] = now
    local root = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
    if root then
        pcall(function()
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],root,{
                SourceKey = "mounted-hit:" .. tostring(npc),
                FallbackPosition = root.Position,
            })
        end)
    end
end)

-- Outgoing mounted melee feedback is driven by the authoritative player damage
-- event, so a sound is never emitted for a blocked, missed, immune, or stale hit.
GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage.Event:Connect(function(player, _, attacker, hitContext)
    if not player or not attacker or not attacker:IsA("Model") then return end
    if not attacker:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy) then return end
    if not hitContext or hitContext.AttackKind ~= "MountedMelee" then return end
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local playerTimes = lastPlayerHitSoundAt[attacker]
    if not playerTimes then
        playerTimes = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        lastPlayerHitSoundAt[attacker] = playerTimes
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (playerTimes[player] or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
    playerTimes[player] = now
    local key = tostring(attacker) .. ":" .. tostring(player.UserId)
    pcall(function()
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1,#hitSounds)],root,{
            SourceKey = "mounted-player-hit:" .. key,
            FallbackPosition = root.Position,
        })
    end)
end)

end

local function playHorseMovement(record, moving)
    if record.horseFall and record.horseHumanoid then
        local state = record.horseHumanoid:GetState()
        local falling = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
        if falling then
            stopTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.1)
            stopTrack(record.horseRide, 0.1)
            playTrack(record.horseFall, 0.1)
            return
        end
        stopTrack(record.horseFall, 0.1)
    end
    if moving then
        stopTrack(record.horseRide, 0.1)
        playTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.1)
    else
        stopTrack(record.horseWalk, 0.1)
        playTrack(record.horseRide, 0.1)
    end
end

local function findTarget(record)
    local root = record.horseRoot
    if not root then return end

    -- Event ambushers keep the Old Cowboy as their primary target while he is
    -- alive and within the dedicated 300 stud escort threat radius.
    if record.model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher) then
        local closestCompanion
        local closestCompanionSquared = 300 * 300
        for _, companion in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion)) do
            local alive, _, companionRoot = characterIsAlive(companion)
            if alive then
                local offset = companionRoot.Position - root.Position
                local distanceSquared = offset:Dot(offset)
                if distanceSquared <= closestCompanionSquared then
                    closestCompanionSquared = distanceSquared
                    closestCompanion = companion
                end
            end
        end
        if closestCompanion then
            return {model = closestCompanion}
        end
    end

    local maxDistance = tonumber(record.lo.aggroDistance) or 60
    local maxDistanceSquared = maxDistance * maxDistance
    local closestTarget
    local closestSquared = maxDistanceSquared
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local alive, _, playerRoot = characterIsAlive(player.Character)
        if alive then
            local offset = playerRoot.Position - root.Position
            local distanceSquared = offset:Dot(offset)
            if distanceSquared <= closestSquared then
                closestSquared = distanceSquared
                closestTarget = {model = player.Character, player = player}
            end
        end
    end
    return closestTarget
end

local function getTargetData(record)
    local target = record.target

    local player = target.player

    if player and player.Character ~= character then

    local alive, humanoid, root = characterIsAlive(character)
    if not alive then
        return nil
