function GameAnalytics:DebugLog(str:string)
    if RunService:IsStudio() then
        print("[GameAnalytics] "..str)
    end
end

function GameAnalytics:onLogin(player:Player,playerVo:CommonType.PlayerVo)
    if playerVo.registerTime then
        -- 老用户

    else
        -- 新用户
        for _,modeLo:ModeSetting.Type in ipairs(ModeSetting.data) do
            GameAnalytics:LogDay(player,nil,modeLo.id)
        end
    end
end

function GameAnalytics:LogDay(player:Player,day:number,modeId:number)
    local stepName:string
    local step = 1
    local funnelName:string = "到达天数"

    if modeId then
        local modeLo:ModeSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(ModeSetting,modeId)
        if modeLo then
            funnelName = string.format("%d.%s-天数",modeLo.id,modeLo.Name)
        end
    end

    if day == nil then
        step = 1
        stepName = "用户注册"
    else
        step += day
        stepName = string.format("到达第%d天",day)
    end

    local funnelSessionId = ""
    AnalyticsService:LogFunnelStepEvent(player,funnelName,funnelSessionId,step,stepName)

    GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogDay:funnelName=%s,funnelSessionId=%s,step=%d,stepName=%s",funnelName,funnelSessionId,step,stepName))
end

function GameAnalytics:LogCharacterUse(player:Player,characterId:number)
    local eventName:string

    if not characterId or characterId <= 0 then
        eventName = "使用角色 nil 进入荒野"
    else
        local lo:CharaterSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterSetting,characterId)
        if not lo then return end
        eventName = string.format("使用角色 %d.%s 进入荒野",lo.id,lo.Name)
    end

    AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player,eventName,1)
    GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogCharacterUse:eventName=%s",eventName))
end

function GameAnalytics:LogKillWildBoarKing(player:Player)
    local eventName:string = "战胜野猪王"
    AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player,eventName)
    GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogKillWildBoarKing:eventName=%s",eventName))
end

function GameAnalytics:LogPinkupTool(player:Player,id:string)
    pcall(function()
        if _pinkupTools[player] == nil then
            _pinkupTools[player] = {}
        end
        if _pinkupTools[player][id] then
            return
        end
        _pinkupTools[player][id] = true
        local eventName:string = string.format("拾取工具:%d",id)
        AnalyticsService:LogCustomEvent(player,eventName)
        GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogKillWildBoarKing:eventName=%s",eventName))
    end)
end

function GameAnalytics:LogAwardGem(player:Player,amount:number,transactionType:string?)
    if not transactionType then
        transactionType = Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Gameplay.Name
    end
    AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent(
        player,
        Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Source,
        "Gem", -- 货币名称
        amount, -- 获得金额
        DataHelper:GetItem(player,CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem), -- 当前余额
        transactionType -- 交易类型
    )
    GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogAwardGem:amount=%d,itemSku=%s",amount,transactionType))
end

function GameAnalytics:LogCostGem(player:Player,amount:number,transactionType:Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType?,itemSku:string?)
    if not transactionType then
        transactionType = Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Shop
    end
    if not itemSku then
        itemSku = ""
    end
    AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent(
        player,
        Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Sink,
        "Gem", -- 货币名称
        amount, -- 成本
        DataHelper:GetItem(player,CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem), -- 交易后的余额
        transactionType.Name,
        itemSku -- 项目
    )
    GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogCostGem:amount=%d,itemSku=%s",amount,itemSku))
end
















function GameAnalytics:LogAwardItem(player:Player,itemId:number,amount:number,transactionType:string?)
    if itemId == CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem then
        GameAnalytics:LogAwardGem(player,amount,transactionType)
        return
    end

    if not transactionType then
        transactionType = Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Gameplay.Name
    end
    local itemLo:ItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(ItemSetting,itemId)
    if not itemLo then return end

    AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent(
        player,
        Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Source,
        itemLo.ItemName, -- 货币名称
        amount, -- 获得金额
        DataHelper:GetItem(player,itemId), -- 当前余额
        transactionType -- 交易类型
    )
    if RunService:IsStudio() then
        GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogAward %s:amount=%d,itemSku=%s",itemLo.ItemName,amount,transactionType))
    end
end

function GameAnalytics:LogCostItem(player:Player,itemId:number,amount:number,transactionType:Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType?,itemSku:string?)
    if itemId == CommonEnum.ItemId.Gem then
        GameAnalytics:LogCostGem(player,amount,transactionType,itemSku)
        return
    end
    if not transactionType then
        transactionType = Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Shop
    end
    if not itemSku then
        itemSku = ""
    end
    local itemLo:ItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(ItemSetting,itemId)
    if not itemLo then return end
    AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent(
        player,
        Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Sink,
        itemLo.ItemName, -- 货币名称
        amount, -- 成本
        DataHelper:GetItem(player,itemId), -- 交易后的余额
        transactionType.Name,
        itemSku -- 项目
    )
    if RunService:IsStudio() then
        GameAnalytics:DebugLog(string.format("LogCost %s:amount=%d,itemSku=%s",itemLo.ItemName,amount,itemSku))
    end
end

return GameAnalytics

local playerVos:{CommonType.PlayerVo} = {}
local _addStatsOnceMarks:{{boolean}} = {}

function getKey(id:number)
    return tostring(id)
end

function DataHelper:InitPlayerVo(player:Player,playerVo:CommonType.PlayerVo)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end

    _addStatsOnceMarks[player.UserId] = {}
    playerVos[player] = playerVo

    if RunService:IsServer() then
        if CommonFunc:IsNewDay(playerVo.lastLoginTime) then
            playerVo.lastLoginTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end

        if CommonFunc:IsNewDay(playerVo.lastAdRewardTime) then
            playerVo.adRewardTimes = 0
            playerVo.lastAdRewardTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end

        if not playerVo.noobGiftPackStartTime then
            playerVo.noobGiftPackStartTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        end

        -- 31天签到重置检测
        if CommonFunc:IsNewDay(playerVo.lastSign31Time) and playerVo.sign31Times >= #Sign31Setting.data then
            playerVo.sign31Times = 0
        end
    end
    DataHelper.onInitPlayerVo:Fire(player,playerVo)
end

function DataHelper:SetPlayerVo(player:Player,newVo:CommonType.PlayerVo)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local oldVo = playerVos[player]
    playerVos[player] = newVo

    if oldVo then
        -- if oldVo.characterId ~= newVo.characterId then
        --     DataHelper.onCharacterIdChanged:Fire(player)
        -- end
    end

    DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged:Fire(player,newVo)
end

function DataHelper:FireChanged(player:Player)
    local vo = playerVos[player]
    DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged:Fire(player,vo)
end

function DataHelper:IsInit(player:Player)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    return playerVos[player] ~= nil
end

function DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player:Player)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    return playerVos[player]::CommonType.PlayerVo
end

function DataHelper:AddItem(player:Player,itemId:number,add:number?)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not add then add = 1 end
    local vo = playerVos[player]
    if vo then
        local key = getKey(itemId)
        local count = vo.items[key] or 0
        count += add
        vo.items[key] = count
        DataHelper.onItemAdded:Fire(player,itemId,add)
        DataHelper.onItemChanged:Fire(player,itemId)
        DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged:Fire(player,vo)
    end
end

function DataHelper:SetItem(player:Player,itemId:number,count:number?)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not count then count = 1 end
    local vo = playerVos[player]
    if vo then
        local key = getKey(itemId)
        vo.items[key] = count
        DataHelper.onItemChanged:Fire(player,itemId)
        DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged:Fire(player,vo)
    end
end

function DataHelper:CostItem(player:Player,itemId:number,cost:number?)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not cost then cost = 1 end
    local vo = playerVos[player]
    if vo then
        local key = getKey(itemId)
        local count = vo.items[key] or 0
        if count >= cost then
            count -= cost
            vo.items[key] = count
            DataHelper.onItemCost:Fire(player,itemId,cost)
            DataHelper.onItemChanged:Fire(player,itemId)
            DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged:Fire(player,vo)
            return true
        end
    end
end

function DataHelper:GetItem(player:Player,itemId:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local vo = playerVos[player]
    if vo then
        local key = getKey(itemId)
        local count = vo.items[key] or 0
        return count
    end

    return 0
end

function DataHelper:HasGamePass(player:Player,id:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    return table.find(playerVo.gamePass,id) ~= nil
end

function DataHelper:AddGamePass(player:Player,id:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    if not table.find(playerVo.gamePass,id) then
        table.insert(playerVo.gamePass,id)
        DataHelper:FireChanged(player)
        DataHelper.onGamePassAdded:Fire(player,id)
        DataHelper.OnGamePassAddedS2C:FireClient(player,id)
        return true
    end
end

function DataHelper:AddStats(player:Player,name:string,add:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not add then
        add = 1
    end

    local curCount = DataHelper:GetStats(player,name)
    curCount += add
    DataHelper:SetStats(player,name,curCount)
end

-- 每一局游戏只加1次
function DataHelper:AddStatsOnce(player:Player,name:string,add:number)
    if _addStatsOnceMarks[player.UserId][name] then return end
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not add then
        add = 1
    end

    _addStatsOnceMarks[player.UserId][name] = true
    local curCount = DataHelper:GetStats(player,name)
    curCount += add
    DataHelper:SetStats(player,name,curCount)
end

    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    return playerVo.statsDict[name] or 0
end

function DataHelper:SetStats(player:Player,name:string,num:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not num then
        num = 1
    end

    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    playerVo.statsDict[name] = num

    DataHelper.onStatsChanged:Fire(player,name)
    DataHelper:FireChanged(player)

    if RunService:IsServer() then

    end

function DataHelper:SetStatsMax(player:Player,name:string,num:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end

    local curCount = DataHelper:GetStats(player,name)
    if num > curCount then
        DataHelper:SetStats(player,name,num)
    end
end

function DataHelper:SetStatsMin(player:Player,name:string,num:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end

    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    local curCount = playerVo.statsDict[name]
    if not curCount or num < curCount then
        DataHelper:SetStats(player,name,num)
    end
end

function DataHelper:AddCharacterVo(player:Player,id:number,lv:number,timeLimit:number?)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    if not lv then lv = 1 end

    if DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(player,id) then return end

    local key = getKey(id)
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    local characterVo:CommonType.CharacterVo = {
        id = id,
        lv = lv,
        stats = {},
        timeLimit = timeLimit,
        trialPurchaseLimit = timeLimit and 1 or 0,
    }
    table.insert(playerVo.characters,characterVo)
    DataHelper.onAddCharacterVo:Fire(player,characterVo)
    DataHelper:FireChanged(player)
    return characterVo
end

function DataHelper:SetCharacterVo(player:Player,characterVo:CommonType.CharacterVo)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end

    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    local oldVo,index = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(player,characterVo.id)
    if oldVo then
        playerVo.characters[index] = characterVo
        DataHelper.onCharacterVoChanged:Fire(player,characterVo)
    else
        table.insert(playerVo.characters,characterVo)
        DataHelper.onAddCharacterVo:Fire(player,characterVo)
    end

    DataHelper:FireChanged(player)
end

function DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(player:Player,id:number)
    if not player then player = game.Players.LocalPlayer end
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)

    for index,characterVo in ipairs(playerVo.characters) do
        if characterVo.id == id then
            return characterVo,index
        end
    end

function DataHelper:RerollDailyQuest(player:Player,classes:string)
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)

    local los:{DailyQuestsSetting.Type} = ConfigHelper:Get(DailyQuestsSetting,DailyQuestsSetting.k.classes,classes,true)
    local oldDailyQuestVo = playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords[classes]
    for i=1,20 do
        -- 最多随机20次确保不重复，避免极端情况一直随机到相同任务导致死循环
        local randomLo = los[math.random(1,#los)]
        if oldDailyQuestVo and randomLo.id == oldDailyQuestVo.questId then continue end

        -- 随即成功
        local newDailyQuestVo:CommonType.DailyQuestVo = {
            questId = randomLo.id,
            progress = 0,
            awarded = false,
        }
        playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords[classes] = newDailyQuestVo
        break
    end
    DataHelper:FireChanged(player)
    return playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords[classes]
end

    if not add then add = 1 end
    local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo(player)
    for _,dailyQuestVo in pairs(playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords) do
        if dailyQuestVo.questId == questId then
            dailyQuestVo.progress += add
            DataHelper:FireChanged(player)
            if RunService:IsServer() then
                print(string.format("每日任务进度增加：%d.%d",questId,dailyQuestVo.progress))
            end
            break
        end
    end
end

function ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)	
	local suc = false
	local vo = nil
	local rw = rawget(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey) or nil
	if rw then
		suc = true
		if typeof(rw) ~= "table" then
			vo = nil
		else
			vo = ConfigVo.cacheMap[mapKey]
		end
	end
	
	return suc,vo
end

	local map = rawset({},key,value)
	return ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)
end

end

function ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)		
	if not all then
		all = false
	end

	local mapKey = getKey(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(map),all)
	local suc,ret = ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)
	if suc then
		return ret
	end

	local allTable = {}	
	for i,vo in ipairs(ConfigVo.data) do
		local match = true
		for k,v in pairs(map) do
			if rawget(vo,k) ~= v then
				match = false
			end
		end

		if match then
			table.insert(allTable,vo)
			if not all then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if all then
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, allTable)
		return allTable		
	end

	if #allTable > 0 then
		local ret = allTable[1]
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, ret)
		return ret
	end

	rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, -1)
	return nil
end

return ConfigVo

	if not all then

function ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)	
	local suc = false
	local vo = nil
	local rw = rawget(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey) or nil
	if rw then
		suc = true
		if typeof(rw) ~= "table" then
			vo = nil
		else
			vo = ConfigVo.cacheMap[mapKey]
		end
	end
	
	return suc,vo
end

function ConfigVo:Get(key,value,all)
	local map = rawset({},key,value)
	return ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)
end

function ConfigVo:GetById(value,all)
	return ConfigVo:Get("id",value,all)
end

function ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)		
	if not all then
		all = false
	end

	local mapKey = getKey(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(map),all)
	local suc,ret = ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)
	if suc then
		return ret
	end

	local allTable = {}	
	for i,vo in ipairs(ConfigVo.data) do
		local match = true
		for k,v in pairs(map) do
			if rawget(vo,k) ~= v then
				match = false
			end
		end

		if match then
			table.insert(allTable,vo)
			if not all then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if all then
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, allTable)
		return allTable		
	end

	if #allTable > 0 then
		local ret = allTable[1]
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, ret)
		return ret
	end

	rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, -1)
	return nil
end

return ConfigVo

	if not all then
		all = false
	end
	return tableStr.."_"..tostring(all)
end

function ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)	
	local suc = false
	local vo = nil
	local rw = rawget(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey) or nil
	if rw then
		suc = true
		if typeof(rw) ~= "table" then
			vo = nil
		else
			vo = ConfigVo.cacheMap[mapKey]
		end
	end
	
	return suc,vo
end

function ConfigVo:Get(key,value,all)
	local map = rawset({},key,value)
	return ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)
end

function ConfigVo:GetById(value,all)
	return ConfigVo:Get("id",value,all)
end

function ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)		
	if not all then
		all = false
	end

	local mapKey = getKey(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(map),all)
	local suc,ret = ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)
	if suc then
		return ret
	end

	local allTable = {}	
	for i,vo in ipairs(ConfigVo.data) do
		local match = true
		for k,v in pairs(map) do
			if rawget(vo,k) ~= v then
				match = false
			end
		end

		if match then
			table.insert(allTable,vo)
			if not all then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if all then
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, allTable)
		return allTable		
	end

	if #allTable > 0 then
		local ret = allTable[1]
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, ret)
		return ret
	end

	rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, -1)
	return nil
end

return ConfigVo

function getKey(tableStr,all)
	if not all then
		all = false
	end
	return tableStr.."_"..tostring(all)
end

function ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)	
	local suc = false
	local vo = nil
	local rw = rawget(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey) or nil
	if rw then
		suc = true
		if typeof(rw) ~= "table" then
			vo = nil
		else
			vo = ConfigVo.cacheMap[mapKey]
		end
	end
	
	return suc,vo
end

function ConfigVo:Get(key,value,all)
	local map = rawset({},key,value)
	return ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)
end

function ConfigVo:GetById(value,all)
	return ConfigVo:Get("id",value,all)
end

function ConfigVo:GetMulti(map,all)		
	if not all then
		all = false
	end

	local mapKey = getKey(game.HttpService:JSONEncode(map),all)
	local suc,ret = ConfigVo:getCache(mapKey)
	if suc then
		return ret
	end

	local allTable = {}	
	for i,vo in ipairs(ConfigVo.data) do
		local match = true
		for k,v in pairs(map) do
			if rawget(vo,k) ~= v then
				match = false
			end
		end

		if match then
			table.insert(allTable,vo)
			if not all then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if all then
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, allTable)
		return allTable		
	end

	if #allTable > 0 then
		local ret = allTable[1]
		rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, ret)
		return ret
	end

	rawset(ConfigVo.cacheMap, mapKey, -1)
	return nil
end

return ConfigVo

    if not id then
        local resources = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("src")
        local helper = resources and resources:FindFirstChild("Helpers")

                if okLo and lo then

local function copyOptions(options)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(options or {}) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result
end

local function getEffectFolder()
    return SoundService:FindFirstChild("EffectSound")

local function validateRegistry()
    local folder = getEffectFolder()
    if not folder then
        warn("[AudioConfig] SoundService.EffectSound is missing")
        return
    end

    local report = AudioConfig:Validate(folder)
    if #report.Missing > 0 or #report.Extras > 0 then
        local message = string.format(
            "registry mismatch: missing=%s extras=%s",
            table.concat(report.Missing, ","),
            table.concat(report.Extras, ",")
        )
        if RunService:IsStudio() then
            error("[AudioConfig] " .. message)
        else
            warn("[AudioConfig] " .. message)
        end
    end
end

local function getRootPart(character)
    if not character then return nil end
    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character.PrimaryPart
        or character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end

local function resolveEmitter(emitter)
    if typeof(emitter) ~= "Instance" then
        return nil
    end
    if emitter:IsA("Model") then
        return getRootPart(emitter)
    end
    if emitter:IsA("BasePart") or emitter:IsA("Attachment") then
        return emitter
    end
    if emitter:IsA("Sound") then
        return emitter.Parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function resolvePosition(emitter, fallbackPosition)
    if typeof(fallbackPosition) == "Vector3" then
        return fallbackPosition
    end

    local resolved = resolveEmitter(emitter)
    if not resolved then return nil end
    if resolved:IsA("BasePart") then
        return resolved.Position
    end
    if resolved:IsA("Attachment") then
        return resolved.WorldPosition
    end
    return nil
end

local function getPlayerRoot(player)
    return player and getRootPart(player.Character)
end

local playerRoots = {}
local rootConnections = {}

local function bindPlayerRoot(player)
    local function setRoot(character)
        local root = getRootPart(character) or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if player.Character == character then
            playerRoots[player] = root
        end
    end

    if player.Character then
        setRoot(player.Character)
    end

    rootConnections[player] = {
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setRoot),
        player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
            if playerRoots[player] == getRootPart(character) then
                playerRoots[player] = nil
            end
        end),
    }
end

local function unbindPlayerRoot(player)
    playerRoots[player] = nil
    local connections = rootConnections[player]
    if connections then
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    rootConnections[player] = nil
end

if not isClient then
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        bindPlayerRoot(player)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayerRoot)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unbindPlayerRoot)
end

local function tweenVolume(sound, isPlay)
    if not sound then return end

    local originVolume = sound:GetAttribute("OriginVolume")
    if originVolume == nil then
        originVolume = sound.Volume
        sound:SetAttribute("OriginVolume", originVolume)
    end

    local volume = 0
    if isPlay then
        sound.Volume = 0
        volume = originVolume
        if not sound.Playing then
            sound:Play()
        end
    end

    local tween = TweenService:Create(sound, musicTweenInfo, {Volume = volume})
    if not isPlay then
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if sound.Playing then
                sound:Stop()
            end
        end)
    end
    tween:Play()
end

function AudioHelper:PlayMusic(name)
    if not name then return end
    local musicFolder = SoundService:FindFirstChild("MainMusic")
    local music = musicFolder and musicFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not music or not music:IsA("Sound") or currentBGM == music then return end

    if currentBGM then
        tweenVolume(currentBGM, false)
        currentBGM = nil
    end

    tweenVolume(music, true)
    currentBGM = music
end

function AudioHelper:StopMusic(name)
    if not name then return end
    local musicFolder = SoundService:FindFirstChild("MainMusic")
    local music = musicFolder and musicFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not music or not music:IsA("Sound") then return end

    tweenVolume(music, false)
    if currentBGM == music then
        currentBGM = nil
    end
end

local function dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then return end
    OnPlaySound:FireClient(player, name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
end

local function findEmitterPlayer(emitter)
    local resolved = resolveEmitter(emitter)
    local model = resolved and resolved:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    return model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
end

local function dispatchToNearby(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, config)
    local position = resolvePosition(emitter, fallbackPosition)
    local radius = config.Radius or 0
    local radiusSquared = radius * radius
    local targetUserId = options and options.TargetUserId
    local targetPlayer = targetUserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetUserId) or nil
    if not targetPlayer and (config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local") then
        targetPlayer = findEmitterPlayer(emitter)
    end

    if targetPlayer then
        dispatchToPlayer(targetPlayer, name, emitter, position, options)
    end

    if config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local" then
        return
    end

    if config.Scope == "Global" then
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(name, emitter, position, options)
        return
    end
    if not position then
        if not targetPlayer then
            warn("[AudioHelper] spatial sound has no position: " .. tostring(name))
            OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(name, emitter, position, options)
        end
        return
    end

    for player, root in pairs(playerRoots) do
        if player.Parent == Players and root and root.Parent and (not targetPlayer or player ~= targetPlayer) then
            local delta = root.Position - position
            if delta:Dot(delta) <= radiusSquared then
                dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, position, options)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function dispatch(name, emitter, options, command)
    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name)
    if not config then
        warn("[AudioHelper] refusing server broadcast for unregistered sound: " .. tostring(name))
        return
    end

    local fallbackPosition = options and options.FallbackPosition
    local payload = copyOptions(options)
    if not command and config.PlaybackMode == "Exclusive" then
        command = "StartExclusive"
        payload._ExclusiveKey = payload._ExclusiveKey or payload.ExclusiveKey or name
    elseif not command and config.PlaybackMode == "ControlledLoop" then
        command = "StartLoop"
        payload._ExclusiveKey = payload._ExclusiveKey or payload.ExclusiveKey or name
    end
    if command then
        payload._Command = command
    end

    if payload._TargetPlayer then
        payload._TargetPlayer = nil
    end

    if config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local" then
        local player = payload.TargetUserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(payload.TargetUserId) or findEmitterPlayer(emitter)
        if player then
            dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, resolvePosition(emitter, fallbackPosition), payload)
        end
        return
    end

    dispatchToNearby(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, payload, config)
end

local function makeTempEmitter(position)
    if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end

    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "LocalAudioEmitter"
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.Size = Vector3.one
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    part.Parent = workspace
    return part
end

local function sourceToken(emitter, options)
    if options and options.SourceKey ~= nil then
        return tostring(options.SourceKey)
    end
    if options and options.SourceUserId then
        return "user:" .. tostring(options.SourceUserId)
    end
    if typeof(emitter) == "Instance" then
        return emitter
    end
    return "local"
end

local function sourceKey(name, source)
    return name .. "|" .. tostring(source)
end

local function localDistanceScore(position)
    local character = Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = getRootPart(character)
    if not root or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
        return 0
    end

    local delta = root.Position - position
    local distanceSquared = delta:Dot(delta)
    if distanceSquared <= 30 * 30 then return 300 end
    if distanceSquared <= 100 * 100 then return 200 end
    if distanceSquared <= 250 * 250 then return 100 end
    return 0
end

local function priorityFor(name, config, emitter, options)
    local priority = config.BasePriority or 0
    local position = resolvePosition(emitter, options and options.FallbackPosition)

    if config.Category == "Weapon" then
        if options and options.SourceUserId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
            priority += 1000
        end
        if options and options.TargetUserId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
            priority += 800
        end
    elseif config.Category == "Impact" and options and options.TargetUserId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
        priority += 1200
    end

    priority += (tonumber(options and options.Importance) or 0) * 100
    priority += localDistanceScore(position)
    return priority
end

local function removeFromList(list, record)
    for index = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[index] == record then
            table.remove(list, index)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function removeRecord(record, destroySound)
    if not record or record.removed then return end
    record.removed = true

    if record.connection then
        record.connection:Disconnect()
        record.connection = nil
    end
    if record.ancestryConnection then
        record.ancestryConnection:Disconnect()
        record.ancestryConnection = nil
    end

    oneShots[record.sound] = nil
    removeFromList(activeRecords, record)
    activeCount = math.max(0, activeCount - 1)

    local categoryList = byCategory[record.category]
    if categoryList then
        removeFromList(categoryList, record)
    end

    if destroySound and record.sound and record.sound.Parent then
        record.sound:Destroy()
    end
    if record.tempEmitter and record.tempEmitter.Parent then
        record.tempEmitter:Destroy()
    end
end

local function fadeReplace(record)
    if not record or record.removed then return end
    local sound = record.sound
    if not sound or not sound.Parent then
        removeRecord(record, true)
        return
    end

    local tween = TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(0.03, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0})
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        if sound.Parent then sound:Stop() end
        removeRecord(record, true)
    end)
    tween:Play()
end

local function cleanupStale(category)
    local list = byCategory[category]
    if not list then return end
    for index = #list, 1, -1 do
        local record = list[index]
        if record.removed or not record.sound or not record.sound.Parent then
            removeRecord(record, true)
        end
    end
end

local function findEviction(config, newPriority, newSource)
    cleanupStale(config.Category)

    local sourceLimit = config.MaxPerSource or AudioConfig.Budgets.Total
    if sourceLimit > 0 then
        local sourceCount = 0
        local sourceCandidate
        for _, record in ipairs(activeRecords) do
            if not record.removed and record.category == config.Category and record.source == newSource then
                sourceCount += 1
                if not sourceCandidate or record.priority < sourceCandidate.priority or (record.priority == sourceCandidate.priority and record.startedAt < sourceCandidate.startedAt) then
                    sourceCandidate = record
                end
            end
        end
        if sourceCount >= sourceLimit then
            if sourceCandidate and newPriority >= sourceCandidate.priority then
                return sourceCandidate
            end
            return false
        end
    end

    if activeCount >= AudioConfig.Budgets.Total then
        local candidate
        for _, record in ipairs(activeRecords) do
            if not record.removed and (not candidate or record.priority < candidate.priority or (record.priority == candidate.priority and record.startedAt < candidate.startedAt)) then
                candidate = record
            end
        end
        if candidate and newPriority >= candidate.priority then
            return candidate
        end
        return false
    end

    local list = byCategory[config.Category] or {}
    local budget = AudioConfig.Budgets[config.Category] or AudioConfig.Budgets.Total
    if #list >= budget then
        local candidate
        for _, record in ipairs(list) do
            if not record.removed and (not candidate or record.priority < candidate.priority or (record.priority == candidate.priority and record.startedAt < candidate.startedAt)) then
                candidate = record
            end
        end
        if candidate and newPriority >= candidate.priority then
            return candidate
        end
        return false
    end
    return nil
end

local function beginLoad(sound, prefab)
    if sound.IsLoaded then return true end

    local soundId = prefab.SoundId
    if not loadingIds[soundId] and pendingLoads < 8 then
        loadingIds[soundId] = true
        pendingLoads += 1
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({prefab})
            end)
            loadingIds[soundId] = nil
            pendingLoads = math.max(0, pendingLoads - 1)
        end)
    end
    return false
end

local function playWhenReady(record, prefab, config)
    local sound = record.sound
    if not sound or not sound.Parent or record.removed then return end

    local played = false
    local loadedConnection
    local timeoutToken = {}

    local function start()
        if played or record.removed or not sound.Parent then return end
        played = true
        if loadedConnection then
            loadedConnection:Disconnect()
            loadedConnection = nil
        end
        sound:Play()
    end

    if beginLoad(sound, prefab) then
        start()
    else
        loadedConnection = sound.Loaded:Connect(start)
        task.delay(math.max(0.05, config.MaxStartDelay or 0), function()
            if not played then
                if sound.IsLoaded then
                    start()
                else
                    removeRecord(record, true)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    record.connection = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        removeRecord(record, true)
    end)
    record.ancestryConnection = sound.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            removeRecord(record, false)
        end
    end)
end

local function prepareSound(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, config)
    local prefab = AudioHelper:GetEffectSound(name)
    if not prefab or not prefab:IsA("Sound") then
        return nil
    end

    local parent = resolveEmitter(emitter)
    local tempEmitter
    if not parent and typeof(fallbackPosition) == "Vector3" then
        tempEmitter = makeTempEmitter(fallbackPosition)
        parent = tempEmitter
    end
    if not parent then
        parent = SoundService
    end

    local sound = prefab:Clone()
    sound.Name = "Voice_" .. name
    sound.Parent = parent

    local group = getGroup(config.Category)
    if group then
        sound.SoundGroup = group
    end

    if config.Scope == "Spatial" and config.Radius and config.Radius > 0 then
        sound.RollOffMaxDistance = config.Radius
    end

    local pitchJitter = config.PitchJitter or 0
    local volumeJitter = config.VolumeJitter or 0
    if pitchJitter > 0 then
        sound.PlaybackSpeed = math.max(0.05, prefab.PlaybackSpeed * (1 + rng:NextNumber(-pitchJitter, pitchJitter)))
    end
    if volumeJitter > 0 then
        sound.Volume = math.max(0, prefab.Volume * (1 + rng:NextNumber(-volumeJitter, volumeJitter)))
    end

    return sound, tempEmitter, prefab
end

local function playLocal(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
    local prefab = AudioHelper:GetEffectSound(name)
    if not prefab or not prefab:IsA("Sound") then
        return nil
    end

    local source = sourceToken(emitter, options)
    local throttleKey = sourceKey(name, source)
    local now = os.clock()
    local last = lastPlayed[throttleKey]
    if last and now - last < (config.MinInterval or 0) then
        stats.dropped += 1
        return nil
    end
    lastPlayed[throttleKey] = now

    local priority = priorityFor(name, config, emitter, options or {})
    local eviction = findEviction(config, priority, source)
    if eviction == false then
        stats.dropped += 1
        return nil
    end
    if eviction then
        stats.replaced += 1
        fadeReplace(eviction)
    end

    local sound, tempEmitter, sourcePrefab = prepareSound(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options or {}, config)
    if not sound then
        return nil
    end

    local record = {
        sound = sound,
        tempEmitter = tempEmitter,
        category = config.Category,
        source = source,
        priority = priority,
        startedAt = now,
        removed = false,
    }
    oneShots[sound] = record
    activeCount += 1
    stats.played += 1
    stats.peakActive = math.max(stats.peakActive, activeCount)
    byCategory[config.Category] = byCategory[config.Category] or {}
    table.insert(byCategory[config.Category], record)
    table.insert(activeRecords, record)
    playWhenReady(record, sourcePrefab, config)
    return sound
end

local function stopExclusive(key, pause)
    local entry = exclusive[key] or loops[key]
    if not entry then return end
    local sound = entry.sound
    if pause then
        sound:Pause()
    else
        sound:Stop()
        if sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end
        if entry.tempEmitter and entry.tempEmitter.Parent then entry.tempEmitter:Destroy() end
        if exclusive[key] == entry then
            exclusive[key] = nil
        end
        if loops[key] == entry then
            loops[key] = nil
            loopCount = math.max(0, loopCount - 1)
        end
    end
end

local function startExclusive(name, key, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, isLoop)
    if not key then
        key = name
    end
    if isLoop and loops[key] and loops[key].sound and loops[key].sound.Parent then
        return loops[key].sound
    end
    if not isLoop and not (options and options.ForceRestart) and exclusive[key] and exclusive[key].sound and exclusive[key].sound.Parent then
        local existingSound = exclusive[key].sound
        if existingSound.Playing then
            return existingSound
        end
        existingSound:Resume()
        return existingSound
    end
    if not isLoop then
        local requestedConfig = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
        if requestedConfig.Category == "Cinematic" then
            for otherKey in pairs(exclusive) do
                if otherKey ~= key then
                    stopExclusive(otherKey, false)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    stopExclusive(key, false)

    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
    local sound, tempEmitter, prefab = prepareSound(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options or {}, config)
    if not sound then return nil end

    if isLoop then
        if loopCount >= AudioConfig.Budgets.ControlledLoop then
            sound:Destroy()
            if tempEmitter then tempEmitter:Destroy() end
            return nil
        end
        sound.Looped = true
        loops[key] = {sound = sound, tempEmitter = tempEmitter}
        loopCount += 1
    else
        exclusive[key] = {sound = sound, tempEmitter = tempEmitter}
    end

    if beginLoad(sound, prefab) then
        sound:Play()
    else
        local loaded
        loaded = sound.Loaded:Connect(function()
            if loaded then
                loaded:Disconnect()
                loaded = nil
            end
            if sound.Parent then sound:Play() end
        end)
        task.delay(math.max(0.05, config.MaxStartDelay or 2), function()
            if not sound.Playing and sound.Parent then
                sound:Destroy()
                if tempEmitter and tempEmitter.Parent then tempEmitter:Destroy() end
                if isLoop then
                    if loops[key] and loops[key].sound == sound then
                        loops[key] = nil
                        loopCount = math.max(0, loopCount - 1)
                    end
                elseif exclusive[key] and exclusive[key].sound == sound then
                    exclusive[key] = nil
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        if not isLoop then
            if exclusive[key] and exclusive[key].sound == sound then
                exclusive[key] = nil
            end
        else
            if loops[key] and loops[key].sound == sound then
                loops[key] = nil
                loopCount = math.max(0, loopCount - 1)
            end
        end
        if sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end
        if tempEmitter and tempEmitter.Parent then tempEmitter:Destroy() end
    end)
    return sound
end

local function handleRemote(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    stats.received += 1
    options = options or {}
    local command = options._Command
    local key = options._ExclusiveKey

    if command == "StartExclusive" then
        startExclusive(name, key, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, false)
    elseif command == "PauseExclusive" then
        stopExclusive(key, true)
    elseif command == "StopExclusive" then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    elseif command == "StartLoop" then
        startExclusive(name, key, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, true)
    elseif command == "StopLoop" then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    elseif name then
        playLocal(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    end
end

            for _, name in ipairs(batch) do
                local sound = AudioHelper:GetEffectSound(name)
                if sound and sound:IsA("Sound") then
                    table.insert(prefabs, sound)
                end
            end
            if #prefabs > 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(prefabs)
                end)
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

function AudioHelper:PlayEffect(name, emitter, options)
    options = options or {}
    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name) or AudioConfig:GetFallback(name)
    if isClient then
        if config.PlaybackMode == "Exclusive" then
            return startExclusive(name, options.ExclusiveKey or options.SourceKey or name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, false)
        elseif config.PlaybackMode == "ControlledLoop" then
            return startExclusive(name, options.ExclusiveKey or options.SourceKey or name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, true)
        end
        return playLocal(name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options)
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options)
end

function AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player, name, emitter, options)
    options = copyOptions(options)
    if typeof(emitter) == "Vector3" then
        options.FallbackPosition = emitter
        emitter = nil
    elseif type(emitter) == "table" and options.FallbackPosition == nil then
        options = copyOptions(emitter)
        emitter = options.Emitter
        options.Emitter = nil
    end

    if isClient then
        if player == nil or player == Players.LocalPlayer then
            return playLocal(name, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options)
        end
        return
    end

    if player then
        options.TargetUserId = player.UserId
        local config = AudioConfig:Get(name)
        if config and (config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local") then
            dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, resolvePosition(emitter, options.FallbackPosition), options)
            return
        end
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options)
end

function AudioHelper:PlayExclusive(name, key, emitter, options)
    options = copyOptions(options)
    options._ExclusiveKey = key
    if isClient then
        return startExclusive(name, key, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, false)
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options, "StartExclusive")
end

function AudioHelper:PauseExclusive(key)
    if isClient then
        stopExclusive(key, true)
    else
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(nil, nil, nil, {_Command = "PauseExclusive", _ExclusiveKey = key})
    end
end

function AudioHelper:StopExclusive(key)
    if isClient then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    else
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(nil, nil, nil, {_Command = "StopExclusive", _ExclusiveKey = key})
    end
end

function AudioHelper:StartLoop(name, key, emitter, options)
    options = copyOptions(options)
    options._ExclusiveKey = key
    if isClient then
        return startExclusive(name, key, emitter, options.FallbackPosition, options, true)
    end
    dispatch(name, emitter, options, "StartLoop")
end

function AudioHelper:StopLoop(key)
    if isClient then
        stopExclusive(key, false)
    else
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(nil, nil, nil, {_Command = "StopLoop", _ExclusiveKey = key})
    end
end

function AudioHelper:BindCharacterWalkSound(character, name)
    if not character or not character:IsA("Model") or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return
    end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
        local sound = root:FindFirstChild("WalkSound")
        if not sound then
            local soundPrefab = SoundService:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not soundPrefab or not soundPrefab:IsA("Sound") then return end
            sound = soundPrefab:Clone()
            sound.Name = "WalkSound"
            sound.Looped = true
            sound.Parent = root
        end

        if speed > 0 and not sound.Playing then
            sound:Play()
        elseif speed <= 0 and sound.Playing then
            sound:Stop()
        end
    end)
end

function UIHelper:BindDescriptionTipsEvent(item:GuiObject,getContentCall:()->(string,string))
	if not item or not getContentCall then
		return
	end

    local Tip_Description:Frame = nil
    local onPositionChanged = function(position:Vector2)
        if not Tip_Description then return end

		local CanvasGroup:CanvasGroup = Tip_Description.CanvasGroup
		local frameSize = CanvasGroup.AbsoluteSize
		local winSize = Tip_Description.AbsoluteSize
		local anchorX = 0
		local anchorY = 0
		if position.X > winSize.X - frameSize.X then
			anchorX = 1
		end
		if position.Y > winSize.Y - frameSize.Y then
			anchorY = 1
		end

		CanvasGroup.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(anchorX,anchorY)
		CanvasGroup.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X,position.Y)
    end

    local onEnded = function()
        if Tip_Description then
            Tip_Description:Destroy()
            Tip_Description = nil
        end
    end

	local enter = item.MouseEnter:Connect(function(x: number, y: number)
		local title,desc = getContentCall()
        if Tip_Description then Tip_Description:Destroy() end

        local UIGameTip:ScreenGui = UIHelper:GetScreen("UIGameTip")
        Tip_Description = UIGameTip:WaitForChild("Tip_Description"):Clone()
        Tip_Description.Parent = UIGameTip
        Tip_Description.Visible = true

        Tip_Description.CanvasGroup.NameText.Text = title or ""
	    Tip_Description.CanvasGroup.DescText.Text = desc or ""

		onPositionChanged(Vector2.new(x,y))
	end)
	local moved = item.MouseMoved:Connect(function(x: number, y: number)
		onPositionChanged(Vector2.new(x,y))
	end)
	local leave = item.MouseLeave:Connect(onEnded)
    local ended = item.InputEnded:Connect(onEnded)

	return enter,moved,leave,ended
end

    local root = ins:FindFirstChild(_RootName)

    for _,v in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do

function InteractiveHelper:GetMouseFocusDragItem()
    local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

    local dragItem:Model = nil

	local inFirstPerson = (camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom and
		(camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude < 1.5)

	if inFirstPerson then
		local rayOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
		local rayDirection = camera.CFrame.LookVector * InteractiveHelper.DragRange
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local result:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDirection, raycastParams)

		if result then
			-- target = result.Instance
    		dragItem = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(result.Instance,GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
		end
	else
		local mouseTarget = mouse.Target
		if mouseTarget then
			local distance = (mouseTarget.Position - character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
			if distance <= InteractiveHelper.DragRange then
				dragItem = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(mouseTarget,GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
			end
		end
	end
    return dragItem
end

return InteractiveHelper

function AccessoryHelper:EquipById(player:Player,id:number)
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not resLo then return end
    -- 脱掉原有的饰品
    AccessoryHelper:Discard(player,resLo.ItemType)

    local character = player.Character
    if resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Chestplate then
        -- 记录新的胸甲
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId,resLo.id)
    elseif resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.FaceMask then
        -- 记录新面罩
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId,resLo.id)
        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonResistance,resLo.ItemType,tonumber(resLo.param) or 0)
    elseif resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Scarf then
        -- 记录新的围巾
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId,resLo.id)
        ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.freezeResistance,resLo.ItemType,tonumber(resLo.param) or 0)
    elseif resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Shoe then
        -- 记录新鞋子
        ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId,resLo.id)
        -- ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,resLo.ItemType,tonumber(resLo.param) or 0)
        character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.ImmunityMud)
    end

    -- 创建饰品
    local prefab = ResourcesItemHelper:GetPrefab(resLo.id)
    for _,child:Accessory in ipairs(prefab:GetChildren()) do
        if not child:IsA("Accessory") then continue end
        local accessory:Accessory = child:Clone()
        -- 屏蔽饰品的碰撞
        CommonFunc:SetCanCollision(accessory,false)
        accessory:AddTag(resLo.ItemType)
        accessory.Parent = character
    end

end

function AccessoryHelper:Discard(player:Player,itemType:string)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    for _,accessory:Accessory in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
            if accessory:HasTag(itemType) then
                if itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Chestplate then
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.chestplateId,0)
                elseif itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.FaceMask then
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.faceMaskId,0)
                    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonResistance,itemType,0)
                elseif itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Scarf then
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.scarfId,0)
                    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.freezeResistance,itemType,0)
                elseif itemType == GameEnum.EquipmentType.Shoe then
                    -- 记录新鞋子
                    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.shoeId,0)
                    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(character,CharacterValue.WalkSpeedBonus,itemType,0)
                    character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.ImmunityMud)
                end

                accessory:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end

function CraftItemHelper:DestroyCraft(craft:Instance,lifeTime:number?)
    if not craft then return end
    if not craft:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Craft) then return end
    if not lifeTime then lifeTime = 0 end

    -- 粉碎
    if lifeTime > 0 then
        -- 清理所有Tag
        local tags = craft:GetTags()
        for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
            craft:RemoveTag(tag)
        end

        -- 粉碎掉
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(math.min(lifeTime * 0.5,1),Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
        for _,child:Instance in ipairs(craft:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                local basePart:BasePart = child
                if basePart.Transparency == 1 then continue end
                basePart.Anchored = false
                basePart.CanCollide = true
                basePart.CanQuery = false
                basePart.CanTouch = false
                basePart.Massless = true
                local randomVec3 = CommonFunc:RandomVector3(20)
                basePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(randomVec3.X,20,randomVec3.Z)
                -- basePart:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(Vector3.yAxis * 50,basePart.Position)
                TweenService:Create(basePart,tweenInfo,{
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
            elseif child:IsA("Script") or child:IsA("WeldConstraint") or child:IsA("JointInstance") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        -- 延迟置空
        task.delay(lifeTime,function()
            craft.Parent = nil
        end)
    else
        craft.Parent = nil
    end
    Debris:AddItem(craft,lifeTime + 2)
end

    local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)

        ValueHelper:SetValue(craft,CraftValue.id,id)
        ValueHelper:SetValue(craft,CraftValue.builder,builder)
        craft:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Craft)
        if lo.ItemType then

        end
        if lo.HP then

            if not v_hp then
                v_hp = Instance.new("NumberValue")
                v_hp.Name = "HP"
                v_hp.Parent = craft

                v_hpMax.Name = "HPMax"
                v_hpMax.Parent = craft
            end
            v_hp.Value = lo.HP
            v_hpMax.Value = lo.HP
        end
    else
        -- 关闭交互
        CommonFunc:ForDescendant(prefab,function(ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt)
            if ProximityPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                ProximityPrompt.Enabled = false
            end
        end)
    end

    return craft

local function fireEnemyGunVisual(source, targetPlayer, damage)
    local sourceRoot = source and (source:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or source.PrimaryPart)
    local sourcePosition = sourceRoot and sourceRoot.Position
    if not sourcePosition then return end
    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local otherRoot = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local isTarget = otherPlayer == targetPlayer
        local inRange = false
        if otherRoot then
            local delta = otherRoot.Position - sourcePosition
            inRange = delta:Dot(delta) <= 250 * 250
        end
        if isTarget or inRange then
            EnemyGunAttackS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, source, targetPlayer, damage)
        end
    end
end

function EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId:number,parent:Instance)
    local enemyLo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(enemyId)
    if not enemyLo then return end

    local enemy:Model
    if enemyLo.isMounted then
        enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateMountedEnemyV2(enemyId,parent)
    elseif enemyLo.isAnimal then
        enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyId,parent)
    else
        enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(enemyId,parent)
    end
    return enemy
end

function EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(id:number,parent:Instance,isRevive:boolean?)
    local prefab = EnemyHelper:GetPrefab(id)
    if not prefab then return end

    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    local enemy:Model = prefab:Clone()
    enemy.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
    local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,EnemyValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,NpcAttributeValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id,id)
    -- ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage,"基础",(lo.atkDamage or 0) * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyDamageRateValue().Value)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.hungerDamage,"基础",(lo.hungerDamage or 0))
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"基础移速",lo.speed)
    if lo.reviveTimes and lo.reviveTimes > 0 then
        if not isRevive then
            -- 初始化复活次数
            ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.reviveTimes,lo.reviveTimes)
        end

        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            -- 因为关系到重复创建，这里有重复创建的大部分参数，所以把复活逻辑放在这里
            local reviveTimes = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.reviveTimes)
            if reviveTimes > 0 then
                enemy.Parent = workspace -- 确保在工作区内才能创建特效

                reviveTimes -= 1
                Debris:AddItem(enemy,5)

                task.wait(1)
                local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                humanoidRootPart.Anchored = true

                TweenService:Create(humanoidRootPart,TweenInfo.new(1),{
                    CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                }):Play()

                -- 创建复活特效
                local fire:Attachment = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect("僵尸复活")
                fire.CFrame = CFrame.new()
                fire.Parent = humanoidRootPart

                task.wait(2) -- 等待3秒后复活
                local pos = enemy:GetPivot().Position

                -- 创建新敌人
                local reviveEnemy = EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(id,parent,true)
                reviveEnemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
                ValueHelper:SetValue(reviveEnemy,EnemyValue.reviveTimes,reviveTimes)

                -- 把复活火焰，设置到新的敌人身上
                local reviveHumanoidRootPart:Part = reviveEnemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                fire.Parent = reviveHumanoidRootPart
                EffectHelper:AddItem(fire,1)
                
                -- 移除旧敌人
                enemy.Parent = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    humanoid.DisplayName = lo.name
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = lo.speed
    humanoid.MaxHealth = lo.hp * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyHPRateValue().Value
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth


    if parent then
        enemy.Parent = parent
    end

    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit) -- 强盗
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
    if lo.isDestroyer then
        enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Destroyer)
    end
    if lo.isGhost then
        enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost)
    end
    if lo.isZombie then
        enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Zombie)
    end
    return enemy
end

-- 是否有阻挡
function EnemyHelper:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(origin:Model,target:Model)
	local originRootPart:Part = origin:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targetRootPart:Part = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams:AddToFilter({origin,target})
	raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
	raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Horse))
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	raycastParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment

	local offset = (targetRootPart.Position - originRootPart.Position)
	local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(originRootPart.Position,offset.Unit*offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
	return hitResult ~= nil
end

-- 是否有阻挡
function EnemyHelper:IsInAttackRange(origin:Model,target:Model,ranged:number)
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(target)
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(origin:GetPivot(),Vector3.one * ranged,overlapParams)
	return #hits > 0
end

-- Mounted enemies are authored as complete prefabs. The cloned root is the rider
-- and the horse is already attached through MountedEnemyMotor.
function EnemyHelper:CreateMountedEnemyV2(id:number,parent:Instance)
    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not lo then return end

    local prefab = EnemyHelper:GetPrefab(id)
    if not prefab then
        warn("[EnemyHelper] mounted prefab missing:", id, lo.name)
        return
    end

    local enemy = prefab:Clone()
    enemy.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic

    local riderHumanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local riderRoot = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or enemy.PrimaryPart
    local horse = enemy:FindFirstChild("MountedHorse")
    local horseHumanoid = horse and horse:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local horseRoot = horse and (horse:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or horse.PrimaryPart)
    local motor = enemy:FindFirstChild("MountedEnemyMotor", true)
    if not riderHumanoid or not riderRoot or not horse or not horseHumanoid or not horseRoot or not motor then
        enemy:Destroy()
        warn("[EnemyHelper] invalid mounted prefab:", lo.name)
        return
    end

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,EnemyValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,NpcAttributeValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id,id)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage,"基础",(lo.atkDamage or 0) * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyDamageRateValue().Value)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.hungerDamage,"基础",(lo.hungerDamage or 0))
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"基础移速",lo.speed)

    riderHumanoid.DisplayName = lo.name
    riderHumanoid.MaxHealth = lo.hp * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyHPRateValue().Value
    riderHumanoid.Health = riderHumanoid.MaxHealth
    riderHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
    riderHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
    -- Keep the rider-to-horse Motor6D intact while the shared EnemyDeathService
    -- fades and destroys the complete mounted root model.
    riderHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    pcall(function()
        riderHumanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
    end)

    for _, descendant in ipairs(enemy:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BaseScript") then
            descendant.Enabled = false
        elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            descendant.Anchored = false
        end
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(enemy:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant:IsDescendantOf(horse) then
            descendant.Massless = false
        elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and not descendant:IsDescendantOf(horse) then
            descendant.CanCollide = false
            descendant.CanTouch = false
            descendant.Massless = true
        end
    end

    enemy.PrimaryPart = riderRoot
    if parent then
        enemy.Parent = parent
    else
        enemy.Parent = workspace
    end

    local seat = horse:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat",true)
    if seat then
        seat.Disabled = true
        seat.CanTouch = false
    end
    horse:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Horse)
    horse:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedHorse)

    enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit)
    enemy:SetAttribute("MountedEnemyId",id)
    enemy:SetAttribute("MountedStyle",lo.attackType == "Gun" and "Gunslinger" or "Lancer")
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy)
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)

    for _, descendant in ipairs(enemy:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                descendant:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
            end)
        end
    end

    return enemy
end

function EffectHelper:PlayWorldPrefabsPartEffect(name:string, parent:BasePart, lifeTime:number)
	local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild(name)
	local effect:Part = prefab:Clone()

	if parent:IsA("Model") then
		local model:Model = parent
		parent = model.PrimaryPart
	end
	effect.CFrame = parent.CFrame
	effect.Parent = parent

	local weld = CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(parent,effect)
	weld.Parent = effect

	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end
	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:PlayAnchoredWorldEffect(name:string, position:Vector3, parent:Instance,lifeTime:number)
	local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild(name)
	local effect:Part = prefab:Clone()
	effect.Anchored = true
	effect.CanCollide = false
	effect.CanQuery = false
	effect.CanTouch = false
	effect.CastShadow = false
	if position then
		effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
	end

	if not parent then
		parent = workspace
	end
	effect.Parent = parent

	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end

	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:AddItem(effect:Instance,lifeTime:number,fadeOut:boolean)
	if not lifeTime then
		lifeTime = 0
	end

	task.delay(lifeTime,function()
		if not effect:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
		
		CommonFunc:ForDescendant(effect,function(child:ParticleEmitter)
			if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Fire") or child:IsA("Smoke") then
				child.Enabled = false
			end
		end)

		if fadeOut then
			CommonFunc:ForDescendant(effect,function(child:BasePart)
				if child:IsA("BasePart") then
					TweenService:Create(child,TweenInfo.new(1),{
						Transparency = 1
					}):Play()
				end
			end,true)
		end
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(effect, lifeTime+5)
end

function EffectHelper:PlayHalo(name,rootPart:Part,lifeTime,isSole:boolean)
	if isSole == nil then
		isSole = true
	end

	local character:Model = CommonFunc:GetCharacter(rootPart)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
	if isSole then
		local characterHeight = character:GetExtentsSize().Y
		position += Vector3.new(0,-characterHeight * 0.5,0)
	end
	local halo:Part
	if type(name) == "string" then
		halo = EffectHelper:PlayEffect(name,position,humanoidRootPart,nil)
	else
		halo = name
	end
	halo.Transparency = 1
	halo.Anchored = false
	halo.CanCollide = false
	halo.CanQuery = false
	halo.CanTouch = false
	halo.CastShadow = false

	local weldConstraint:WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weldConstraint.Part0 = humanoidRootPart
	weldConstraint.Part1 = halo
	weldConstraint.Parent = halo
	
	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(halo,lifeTime)
	end
	
	return halo
end

	end

	if type(name) == "string" then
		effect = EffectHelper:PlayEffect(name,position,rootPart,nil)
	else
		effect = name
	end
	effect.Transparency = 1
	effect.Anchored = false
	effect.CanCollide = false
	effect.CanQuery = false
	effect.CanTouch = false
	effect.CastShadow = false

	local weldConstraint:WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weldConstraint.Part0 = rootPart
	weldConstraint.Part1 = effect
	weldConstraint.Parent = effect
	
	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end
	
	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect(name:string,position:Vector3,parent:Instance,lifeTime:number)
	local effectPrefab:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild(name)
	local effect = effectPrefab:Clone()
	if position then
		if effect:IsA("Model") then
			local primaryPart = effect.PrimaryPart
			if primaryPart then
				effect:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(position))
			else
				effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
			end
		else
			effect.Position = position
		end
	end
	if effect:IsA("Attachment") then
		if position then
			effect.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		else
			effect.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		end
	end
	effect.Parent = parent or workspace

	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(effect,function(child:ParticleEmitter)
		if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			child.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end

	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect(name:string)
	local effectPrefab:Part = _effectFolder:WaitForChild(name)
	if not effectPrefab then 
		warn("Effect prefab not found:", name)
		return nil
	end
	local effect = effectPrefab:Clone()
	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:CreateKillMonsterGem(monster:Model)
	if not monster then return end

	local torso = monster:FindFirstChild("Torso") or monster:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or monster:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local cframe = torso.CFrame
	local gem:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Items"):WaitForChild("Gem"):Clone()
	gem.CFrame = cframe + Vector3.new(math.random(-2,2),0,math.random(-2,2))
	gem.Parent = workspace

	local r = 5
	local forceXZ = 20
	local forceY = 100
    local dir = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),0,math.random(-r,r)).Unit
    gem.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * forceXZ + Vector3.new(0,math.random(forceY * 0.5,forceY),0)

	task.delay(1,function()
		gem.Anchored = true
		local lifeTime = 0.5
		Debris:AddItem(gem,lifeTime)
		local t = 0
		local startPosition = gem.Position
		local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		while gem and gem:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			if t > lifeTime then
				t = lifeTime
			end

			local endPosition = character:GetPivot().Position
			local position = startPosition:Lerp(endPosition,math.clamp(t / lifeTime,0,1))
			gem.Position = position
		end
	end)
end

function EffectHelper:PlaySmash(pos:Vector3,num:number?,force:number?,prefab:BasePart?)
	-- local force = 50

	local lifeTime = 3
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifeTime * 0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
    if not num then num = 20 end
	for i = 1,num do
		local part:BasePart
		if prefab then
			part = prefab:Clone()
		else
			part = _effectFolder:WaitForChild("碎片"):Clone()
		end
		part.Anchored = false
		part:AddTag("Debris")

		local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
		part.Size = part.Size * (1 + math.random() * 2)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + offset)

		local tween = game.TweenService:Create(part,tweenInfo,{
