function MapHelper:CreateBuilding(spawnGrid1X:number,spawnGrid1Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,gridType:number,landmarkPrefab:Model,groundName:string?)
        local groundPosY = nil
        for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
            for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
                local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - 1
                local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - 1
                -- print(grid1X, grid1Z)
                local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                if groundName and ground then
                    if not groundPosY then
                        groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                    end

                    local newGround = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                    -- 复制Tag
                    local tags = ground:GetTags()
                    for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
                        newGround:AddTag(tag)
                    end
                    ground:Destroy()
                    ground = newGround
                end
                if not ground then
                    ground = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                end
                if groundPosY then
                    local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                    ground:PivotTo(cframe.Rotation + Vector3.new(cframe.Position.X,groundPosY,cframe.Position.Z))
                else
                    groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                end

                MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,gridType or MapHelper.GridType.building)
            end
        end

        local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
        posX += sizeX / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
        posZ += sizeZ / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
        local ground:Part = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
        local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
        local position = Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ)
        local rotationY:number
        if sizeX == sizeZ then
            -- 360度随机旋转
            -- building:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position,position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),0,math.random(-1,1))))
            -- rotationY = math.random() * 360
            -- 90度随机旋转
            rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
        else
            -- 只接受180度旋转
            rotationY = math.random(1,2) == 1 and 0 or 180
            if sizeZ > sizeX then
                rotationY += 90
            end
        end
        local landmark = landmarkPrefab:Clone()
        landmark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
        landmark.Parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

        return landmark
end

function MapHelper:CreateBuildingOnCenter(spawnGrid1X:number,spawnGrid1Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,gridType:number,landmarkPrefab:Model,groundName:string?)
    local groundPosY = nil
    local minPos = MapHelper:GetGridPos3(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
    local maxPos = minPos
    for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
        for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
            local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - math.ceil(sizeX / 2)
            local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - math.ceil(sizeZ / 2)
            -- print(grid1X, grid1Z)
            local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if groundName and ground then
                if not groundPosY then
                    groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                end

                local newGround = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                -- 复制Tag
                local tags = ground:GetTags()
                for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
                    newGround:AddTag(tag)
                end
                ground:Destroy()
                ground = newGround
            end
            if not ground then
                ground = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
            end
            if groundPosY then
                local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                ground:PivotTo(cframe.Rotation + Vector3.new(cframe.Position.X,groundPosY,cframe.Position.Z))
            else
                groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
            end

            local tempPos = MapHelper:GetGridPos3(grid1X,grid1Z)
            minPos = Vector3.min(minPos,tempPos)
            maxPos = Vector3.max(maxPos,tempPos)

            MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,gridType or MapHelper.GridType.building)
        end
    end

    -- local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
    local posX = minPos.X + (maxPos.X - minPos.X) / 2
    local posZ = minPos.Z + (maxPos.Z - minPos.Z) / 2
    local ground:Part = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local position = Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ)
    local rotationY:number
    if sizeX == sizeZ then
        -- 360度随机旋转
        -- building:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position,position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),0,math.random(-1,1))))
        -- rotationY = math.random() * 360
        -- 90度随机旋转
        rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
    else
        -- 只接受180度旋转
        rotationY = math.random(1,2) == 1 and 0 or 180
        if sizeZ > sizeX then
            rotationY += 90
        end
    end
    local landmark = landmarkPrefab:Clone()
    landmark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
    landmark.Parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

    return landmark
end

function MapHelper:initBuilding(building:BasePart,grid2X:number,grid2Z:number)
    if not building then return end
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(building,BuildingValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(building,BuildingValue.grid2,Vector3.new(grid2X,0,grid2Z))
    ValueHelper:SetValue(building,BuildingValue.level,MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid2Pos(grid2X,grid2Z))
    building:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Building)
end

function MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,posY:number,prefabName:string?)
    if not prefabName then
        -- prefabName = string.format("%d级地块",zoneLv)
        prefabName = "Grassland"
    end
    local groundFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("地块")
    local groundPrefab = groundFolder:FindFirstChild(prefabName)
    if not groundPrefab then
        groundPrefab = groundFolder:FindFirstChild("Grassland")
    end
    local ground:Part = groundPrefab:Clone()
    local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X,grid1Z)
    -- if MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z) then
    --     error("重复创建了")
    -- end

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(ground,GroundValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(ground,GroundValue.grid,Vector3.new(grid1X,0,grid1Z))

    ground.Name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
    -- ground.Size = Vector3.new(MapHelper.gridSize_1,ground.Size.Y,MapHelper.gridSize_1)
    ground:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(math.random(0,3) * 90),0) + Vector3.new(posX,posY or 0,posZ))
    ground.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Ground
    ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground)
    
    ground.Parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

    local surface:SurfaceGui = ground:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui",true)
    if surface then
        if RunService:IsStudio() and MapHelper.GridInfoEnable then
            surface.Enabled = true
            -- local grid2X = math.ceil(grid1X / MapHelper.gridSize_2)
            -- local grid2Z = math.ceil(grid1Z / MapHelper.gridSize_2)
            local grid2X,grid2Z = MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z)
            -- local c1 = grid2X / MapHelper.gridSize_2
            -- local c2 = grid2Z / MapHelper.gridSize_2
            -- ground.Color = Color3.new(c1,c2,(c1+c2)/(MapHelper.gridSize_2*2))

            local t_index:TextLabel = surface:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
            if t_index then
                t_index.Text = string.format("%s\nlv:%d",ground.Name,MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid2Pos(grid2X,grid2Z))
            end
        else
            surface.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    return ground
end

function MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(sizeX:number,sizeZ:number)
    if sizeX ~= sizeZ and math.random(1,2) == 1 then
        local oldZ = sizeZ
        sizeZ = sizeX
        sizeX = oldZ
    end
    return sizeX,sizeZ
end

function MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    if grid1X < 1 or grid1X > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
        return false
    end
    if grid1Z < 1 or grid1Z > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(spawnGrid1X:number,spawnGrid1Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,safeGridType:number?)
    if not safeGridType then
        safeGridType = MapHelper.GridType.land
    end

    for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
        for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
            local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - 1
            local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - 1
            local tempGridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if tempGridType and tempGridType ~= safeGridType then
                return false
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

local raycastGroundDir = Vector3.new(0,-100,0)
function MapHelper:RaycastGroundFromPart(part:BasePart,tag:string)
    local grounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)
    if #grounds == 0 then return end

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(grounds)
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(part.Position,raycastGroundDir,raycastParams)
    return hitResult
end

function MapHelper:SpawnSnow(ground:Part)
    -- 随机雪块
    local posX = ground.Position.X
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z
    local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local num = math.random(1,3)
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Map"):FindFirstChild("雪块")
    for i=1,num do
        local childs = folder:GetChildren()
        local snowX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
        local snowZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
        -- local rotationY = math.random() * 360
        local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
        local prefab:Model = childs[math.random(1,#childs)]
        local snow = prefab:Clone()
        snow:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0)+Vector3.new(snowX,groundY,snowZ))
        -- stone:PivotTo(prefab:GetPivot().Rotation + Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
        snow.Parent = workspace
    end
end

function MapHelper:GetBuildingEnterPlayerKey(Player:Player)
    return string.format("EnterBuildingPlayer_%d",Player.UserId)
end

function MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building:Model)
    if not building then return false end

    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if building:HasTag(MapHelper:GetBuildingEnterPlayerKey(player)) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

return MapHelper

function GameHelper:Eat(player:Player,item:Model)
    if RunService:IsClient() then
        GameHelper.EatC2S:FireServer(item)
    else
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        if not ResourcesItemHelper:IsCanEat(item) then return end

        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatRawMeat) then
            -- 只能吃生肉
            if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat)
            or item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.CookedFood) then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You can only eat raw meat.")
                return
            end
        end

        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatMeat) then
            -- 只能吃肉
            if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You can only eat meat.")
                return
            end
        end

        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        local maxHunger = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.maxHunger)
        local foodAddHunger = tonumber(resLo.param) or 1
        local HungerRecoveryBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HungerRecoveryBonus)
        local addHunger = foodAddHunger + foodAddHunger * HungerRecoveryBonus

        local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
        if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.CookedFood) then
            if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
                -- 吃了生肉扣血
                if not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatRawMeat) then
                    -- 扣除血量
                    humanoid.Health = math.clamp(humanoid.Health - 10,0,humanoid.MaxHealth)
                end
            elseif item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DetoxMushroom) then
                -- 吃了解毒蘑菇
                -- local v_poisonMeter:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonMeter)
                -- v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value - 10,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
                GameHelper:PlayerAddPoisionMeter(player,-10)
            elseif item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ToxicMushroom) then
                -- 吃了毒蘑菇
                -- local v_poisonMeter:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonMeter)
                -- v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value + 10,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
                GameHelper:PlayerAddPoisionMeter(player,10)
            end
        end

        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Soup) then
            -- 喝汤次数
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.eatSoup)
        end

        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
            -- 吃肉次数
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.eatMeat)
            if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.CookedFood) then
                -- 吃生肉次数
                GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.eatRawMeat)
            end
        end

        local v_warm:IntValue = item:FindFirstChild("降低寒冷值")
        if v_warm then
            GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,v_warm.Value)
        end

        GameHelper:SetEatMark(player,resLo.id)

        v_hunger.Value = math.clamp(v_hunger.Value + addHunger,1,maxHunger)
        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("吃东西",player.Character.PrimaryPart)
    end
end

function GameHelper:TakeBullet(player:Player,item:Model)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
    if not ResourcesItemHelper:IsBullet(item) then return end

    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
    local addCount = tonumber(resLo.param) or 1
    local v_bullet:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue:FindFirstChild(resLo.ItemType))
    if not v_bullet then
        error("玩家身上无法访问未注册的子弹类型："..resLo.ItemType)
        return
    end

    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("储存/装备",player.Character.PrimaryPart)
    v_bullet.Value += addCount
    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
end

function GameHelper:PlayerDied(player:Player)
    InteractiveHelper:UndragItemServer(player)
    local character:Model = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(character,DragItemValue)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.CanStore)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerDeath)
    GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player).alive = false

    ToolHelper:UnequipTools(player)

    local dropCFrame:CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.yAxis * 3

    -- 书包里的东西掉落出来
    local bagParent = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    for i=1,#bagParent:GetChildren() do
        BagHelper:Unstore(player,dropCFrame)
    end

    -- backpack里东西都掉落出来
    local offsetY = 0
    local backpack = ToolHelper:GetBackpack(player)
    for _,tool:Tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if not tool:IsA("Tool") then continue end
        if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Heal) or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bell) then -- 如果是医疗包/铃铛，掉落到地上
            tool.Parent = workspace
            -- tool:PivotTo(dropCFrame) -- 都放在一个位置会造成卡顿，估计是物理引擎计算排挤压力问题
            -- tool:PivotTo(dropCFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),math.random(1,2),math.random(-1,1))) -- 方案1
            tool:PivotTo(dropCFrame + Vector3.new(0,offsetY,0)) -- 方案2
            offsetY += 1

            -- 加个高光
            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Name = "死亡掉落高光"
            highlight.FillTransparency = 1
            highlight.Parent = tool
            tool.AncestryChanged:Once(function(child, parent)
                highlight:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

function GameHelper:PlayerRevive(player:Player,safeRevive:boolean)
    GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player).alive = true

    local position:Vector3
    if not safeRevive and player.Character then
        position = player.Character:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
    end

    player:LoadCharacter()
    local newCharacter:Model = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

    -- 只剩下一半饥饿值
    local maxHunger = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.maxHunger)
    local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
    v_hunger.Value = maxHunger * 0.5

    if position then
        newCharacter:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
    end
end

function GameHelper:PlayerExitGame(player:Player)
    local storeParent = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    if not storeParent then return end

    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local dropPos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(campfire:GetPivot().Position)
    local spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(dropPos)
    local inBagItem = storeParent:GetChildren()
    for _,child:Instance in ipairs(inBagItem) do
        if child:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) or child:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then
            BagHelper:Unstore(player,spawnCFrame,child)
        end
    end
end

function GameHelper:isAlive(player:Player)
    if not player then
        return false
    end

    return GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(player.Character)
end

function GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character:Model)
    if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return false
    end

    local v_HP:NumberValue = character:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if v_HP then
        return v_HP.Value > 0
    end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return false end

    return humanoid.Health > 0
end

function GameHelper:ValidateGroundSpawnRequest(player:Player, ground:Instance, maxDistance:number):Vector3?
    if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return nil end
    if typeof(ground) ~= "Instance" or not ground:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
    if not ground:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground) then return nil end
    if type(maxDistance) ~= "number" or maxDistance <= 0 then return nil end
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return nil end

    local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoidRootPart:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end

    local offset = humanoidRootPart.Position - ground.Position
    if offset:Dot(offset) > maxDistance * maxDistance then return nil end

    local gridPoint = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    if typeof(gridPoint) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end

    return gridPoint
end

-- 是否在营火内
function GameHelper:IsInCampfire(pos:Vector3,rangeOffset:number?)
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local heat = GameHelper:GetCampfireHeat()
    local range = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange()
    local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position
    
    if heat > 0 then
        local offset = pos * CommonEnum.XZ - campfirePos * CommonEnum.XZ -- 水平距离
        local distance = offset.Magnitude
        return distance < range + (rangeOffset or 5)
    end
end

function GameHelper:GetCampfireDistance(pos:Vector3)
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position
    local offset = pos * CommonEnum.XZ - campfirePos * CommonEnum.XZ -- 水平距离
    return offset.Magnitude
end

function GameHelper:IsInGemTower(pos:Vector3)
    if RunService:IsClient() then
        local gemTower = MapHelper:GetGemTowerModel()
        if gemTower then
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams:AddToFilter(gemTower)
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(pos,Vector3.yAxis * -500,raycastParams)
            return hitResult ~= nil
        end
    else
        local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(pos)
        local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.GemTower then
            return true
        end
    end
end

function GameHelper:IsInDeerNoEntryZone(pos:Vector3)
    local op = OverlapParams.new()
    op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DeerNoEntryZone))
    op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    op.BruteForceAllSlow = true

    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos,1,op)
    return #hits > 0
end

-- 小鹿登场
function GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(state:number?)
    if not state then
        state = GameEnum.DeerState.Nromal
    end
    local deer = GameHelper:GetDeerController()
    if not deer then return end
    if deer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Deer) then return end
    if deer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DeerLeave) then return end

    -- math.randomseed(tick())
    local spawnCFrame:CFrame
    if state ~= GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then
        local players = game.Players:GetPlayers()
        local count = #players
        for i=1,count do
            local player:Player = table.remove(players,math.random(1,#players))
            -- 角色死亡，不刷
            if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
            local character = player.Character
            -- 在野猪战场，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsOnCave(player) then continue end

            local playerPos = character:GetPivot().Position
            -- 在营火附近，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(playerPos,50) then continue end
            -- 在钻石塔里，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsInGemTower(playerPos) then continue end
            -- 在小鹿禁入区，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsInDeerNoEntryZone(playerPos) then continue end

            -- local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(playerPos)
            -- local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X,grid1Z)
            for j=1,20 do
                -- 确保这个格子已经被初始化
                local dirX,dirZ = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random(0,359))
                local spawnPosition = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(playerPos + Vector3.new(dirX,0,dirZ) * 30)
                if spawnPosition then
                    if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(spawnPosition) then continue end
                    if GameHelper:IsInGemTower(spawnPosition) then continue end
                    if GameHelper:IsInDeerNoEntryZone(spawnPosition) then continue end
                    spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPosition,playerPos)
                    break
                end
            end

            ValueHelper:SetValue(deer,DeerValue.targetPlayer,player)
            break
        end
    end

    if not spawnCFrame then
        if state ~= GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then return end
        state = GameEnum.DeerState.Peep
        local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
        local range = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 90
        local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position

        local x,z = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random()*360)
        local deerPos = Vector3.new(x*range,campfirePos.Y,z*range)
        spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(deerPos,campfirePos)
    end

    GameHelper:PivotDeer(spawnCFrame + Vector3.yAxis * 15)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(deer,DeerValue.state,state)
    deer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Deer)
end

function GameHelper:CraftTakeDamage(attacker:Model,craft:Model,damage:number)
    if not craft or not attacker then return end
    if not craft:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft) then return end
    local v_hp:NumberValue = craft:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if not v_hp then return end
    local beforeHp = v_hp.Value
    v_hp.Value = math.max(v_hp.Value - damage,0)
    if beforeHp > 0 and v_hp.Value <= 0 then
        CraftItemHelper:DestroyCraft(craft,2)
    end
end

function GameHelper:LodeTakeDamage(player:Player,lode:Model,damage:number)
    local v_HP:NumberValue = lode:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if v_HP then
        v_HP.Value = math.max(v_HP.Value - damage,0)
    end

    if not v_HP or v_HP.Value <= 0 then
        lode:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget)
        if lode:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Lode) then
            local dropRandomId = lode:GetAttribute("dropRandomId")
            if dropRandomId then
                -- 矿石掉落
                ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(dropRandomId,lode:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0))
            end

            -- 矿脉破碎
            GameHelper.onLodeDied:Fire(player,lode,dropRandomId)
        end

        -- 解体后消失
        GameHelper:DestroyAndSmashTarget(lode,2)
    end
end

function GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player:Player,damage:number,attacker:Model,trueDamage:boolean,hitContext)
    if not trueDamage then
        -- 计算防御减免
        local def = AccessoryHelper:GetDef(player)
        damage -= def

        -- 伤害减免
        local damageReduction = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.damageReduction)
        damage -= damage * damageReduction
    end

    if damage <= 0 then
        if damage > -100 then
            damage = 1
        else
            -- 伤害免疫：返回未受理，调用方不得播放命中反馈。
            return false,0
        end
    end

    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
        return false,0
    end

    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.lastHurttime,workspace.DistributedGameTime)
    local humanoid:Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

    local delayTime = 0
    if damage >= humanoid.Health then
        -- 玩家即将死亡，解除坐骑,不然马会跟着死，超无语
        if humanoid.Sit then
            humanoid.Sit = false
            delayTime = 0.1
        end
    end

    if delayTime > 0 then
        task.delay(delayTime,function()
            if humanoid.Parent and player.Parent then
                humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
                GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage:Fire(player,damage,attacker,hitContext)
            end
        end)
    else
        humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage:Fire(player,damage,attacker,hitContext)
    end

    -- 兼容旧调用方：只新增返回值，不改变原有副作用和事件时序。
    return true,damage
end

local function createNpcOverlapParams()
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    for _,tag in ipairs(_npcTags) do
        overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag))
    end
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    return overlapParams
end

local function collectNpcsFromParts(parts:{BasePart})
    local npcs:{Model} = {}
    local seen = {}
    for _,hit in ipairs(parts) do
        local npcModel:Model? = nil
        for _,tag in ipairs(_npcTags) do
            npcModel = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,tag)
            if npcModel then
                break
            end
        end
        if npcModel and not seen[npcModel] then
            seen[npcModel] = true
            table.insert(npcs,npcModel)
        end
    end
    return npcs
end

function GameHelper:NPCCollect(position:Vector3,ranged:number)
    local overlapParams = createNpcOverlapParams()
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position,ranged,overlapParams)
    return collectNpcsFromParts(hits)
end

function GameHelper:NPCCollectInBox(cframe:CFrame,size:Vector3)
    local overlapParams = createNpcOverlapParams()
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe,size,overlapParams)
    return collectNpcsFromParts(hits)
end

function GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(attacker:Instance,npc:Model,damage:number,damageSource:number?,hitContext)
    if not npc then return false end
    -- Mounted horses are collision shells; all damage must resolve on the rider root.
    local mountedRoot = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(npc,GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy)
    if mountedRoot and mountedRoot:IsA("Model") then
        npc = mountedRoot
    end
    if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost) then
        -- if damageSource ~= GameEnum.DamageSource.Light and damageSource ~= GameEnum.DamageSource.HolyWater and damageSource ~= GameEnum.DamageSource.HolySword then
        --     -- 鬼魂免疫伤害,只有光才能伤害幽灵
        --     return false
        -- end
        if not damageSource or not table.find(GameEnum.GhostHitDamageSource,damageSource) then
            -- 鬼魂免疫伤害,只有指定的伤害来源才能伤害幽灵
            return false
        end
    end

    local player:Player = nil
    local pet:Model = nil
    if attacker then
        if attacker:IsA("Player") then
            player = attacker
        elseif attacker:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy) then
            pet = attacker
            player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(pet,AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
        end
    end

    local suppressKillRewards = npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher)

    if isProtectedOldCowboy(npc) then
        if player or not isHostileOldCowboyAttacker(attacker) then
            return false
        end
        if typeof(damage) ~= "number" or damage ~= damage or damage <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        humanoid.Health = math.max(humanoid.Health - damage,0)
        GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage:Fire(attacker,npc,damage,damageSource,hitContext)
        return true
    end

    if GameHelper:IsNPC(npc) then
        local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local v_hp:NumberValue = npc:FindFirstChild("HP")
        if humanoid then
            if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
            humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)

            if humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then
                    if player then
                        -- 转移仇恨
                        ValueHelper:SetValue(npc,EnemyValue.targetPlayer,player)               
                    end
                end
            else
                if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) and not suppressKillRewards then
                    -- 击杀敌人统计
                    GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.killEnemy)
                end
                if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Animal) or npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DocileAnimal) or npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Buddy) then
                    -- 击杀动物统计
                    GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.killAnimals)
                    -- 动物死亡
                    GameHelper.onAnimalDeath:Fire(player,npc,damageSource)
                end
                if player and not suppressKillRewards then
                    GameHelper.onNPCDeath:Fire(player,npc,damageSource)
                end
            end
            if player then
                npc:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.GetDamageDeathTag(player))
            end
            
            GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage:Fire(attacker,npc,damage,damageSource,hitContext)
            return true
        elseif v_hp and v_hp.Value > 0 then
            local value = v_hp.Value - damage
            if value < 0 then value = 0 end
            v_hp.Value = value
            if player then
                npc:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.GetDamageDeathTag(player))
            end

            GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage:Fire(attacker,npc,damage,damageSource,hitContext)
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function GameHelper:PlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget(player:Player,npc:Model,baseDamage:number,damageSource:number?)
    if not damageSource then
        damageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.MeleeWeapon
    end
    local attackBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.attackBonus)
    local meleeAttackBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.meleeAttackBonus)
    local damage = baseDamage
    damage += baseDamage * attackBonus
    damage += baseDamage * meleeAttackBonus
    local isTakeDamage = GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,damageSource)
    if isTakeDamage then
        GameHelper:AddMuscle(player,0.5)
        GameHelper.onPlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget:Fire(player,npc,damage)
        GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
    end
    return isTakeDamage == true
end

local HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS = 120
local HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS_SQUARED = HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS * HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS

local function sendHealEffect(character:Model)
    local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    local recipients = {}
    if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
        recipients[targetPlayer] = true
    end

    local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
    if targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
        local targetPosition = targetRoot.Position
        for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if recipients[player] then
                continue
            end
            local observerCharacter = player.Character
            local observerRoot = observerCharacter and (observerCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or observerCharacter.PrimaryPart)
            if observerRoot and observerRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
                local delta = observerRoot.Position - targetPosition
                if delta:Dot(delta) <= HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS_SQUARED then
                    recipients[player] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for player in pairs(recipients) do
        EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireClient(player,"回血",character)
    end
end

function GameHelper:CharacterForceHeal(character:Model,heal:number,showEffect:boolean?):number
    if not RunService:IsServer()
        or not character
        or not character:IsA("Model")
        or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
        or typeof(heal) ~= "number"
        or heal ~= heal
        or heal == math.huge
        or heal <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
        return 0
    end

    local healthBefore = humanoid.Health
    local healthAfter = math.clamp(healthBefore + heal,0,humanoid.MaxHealth)
    local healed = healthAfter - healthBefore
    if healed <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    humanoid.Health = healthAfter
    if showEffect ~= false then
        sendHealEffect(character)
    end
    return healed
end

function GameHelper:GetClosestPlayer(enemy:Model,aggroDistance:number)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy.PrimaryPart
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = aggroDistance
	for _, player in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
        local character:Model = player.Character
		if character and character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            -- if not player.Character.HumanoidRootPart or not player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position then
            --     print("玩家没有位置")
            -- end
            -- if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoidRootPart.Position then
            --     print("敌人没有位置")
            -- end
			local dist = (player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if dist <= shortestDist then
                -- 障碍判断
                if not CommonFunc:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(enemy,player.Character,GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment) then
                    closest = player
                    shortestDist = dist
                end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest
end

function GameHelper:GetClosestDestructibleCraft(destroyer:Model,radius:number)
    if not radius then radius = 100 end

    local humanoidRootPart:Part = destroyer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end
	local closest = nil
	local shortestDist = radius

    local op = OverlapParams.new()
    op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft))
    op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local checkedCraft = {}
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoidRootPart.Position,radius,op)
    for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
        local craft:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft)
        if checkedCraft[craft] then continue end
        checkedCraft[craft] = true

		local dist = (craft:GetPivot().Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
        if dist <= shortestDist then
            closest = craft
            shortestDist = dist
        end
    end

	return closest
end

function GameHelper:TreeTakeDamge(player:Player,tree:Model,damage:number)
    local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
    if not hp or hp <= 0 then return false end
    hp = hp - damage
    tree:SetAttribute("hp", hp)

    if hp <= 0 then
        -- math.randomseed(tick())

        local woodCount = 3
        local seekCount = 0
        if tree:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) then
            woodCount = 16
            seekCount = 4
        else
            local r = math.random(1,4)
            local isSpawn = r > 1
            -- print("是否生成树",r)
            if isSpawn then
                seekCount = 1
            end
        end

        if player then
            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WoodV2) then
                -- math.randomseed(tick())
                local isTrigger = math.random(1,5) == 1
                if isTrigger then
                    woodCount += math.random(1,2)
                end
            elseif player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WoodV1) then
                -- math.randomseed(tick())
                local isTrigger = math.random(1,5) == 1
                if isTrigger then
                    woodCount += 1
                end
            end

            if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.WoodSeedV1) then
                if seekCount > 0 then
                    -- math.randomseed(tick())
                    local isTrigger = math.random(1,4) == 1
                    if isTrigger then
                        seekCount *= 2
                    end
                end
            end
            
            GameHelper.FelledTreeS2C:FireClient(player,tree)
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.cutTree)
        end

        local cframe = tree:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        for i=1,woodCount do
            local wook = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateWood()
            wook:PivotTo(cframe * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359))))
        end

        if not tree:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SeedlessTree) then
            -- 非无籽树才会生成树苗
            for i=1,seekCount do
                local seek = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateTreeSeek()
                seek:PivotTo(cframe * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359)),math.rad(math.random(0,359))))
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

function GameHelper:TryPinkup(player:Player,item:Model)
    if not item or not item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

    if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(item) then
        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
        if not resLo or not resLo.IsTool then return end

        local owned:Player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(item,DragItemValue.owner)
        if owned and owned ~= player then
            -- 属于其他玩家，无法拾取
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,string.format("This item belongs to %s.",owned.DisplayName),UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            return
        end

        if resLo.lv then
            local curTool = ToolHelper:GetToolByType(player,resLo.ItemType)
            if curTool then
                -- 判断等级
                local curToolLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(curTool)
                if curToolLo.lv and resLo.lv <= curToolLo.lv then
                    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You already have better tools.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) or item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bell) or resLo.noStack then
            -- 不能重复捡起相同的工具，检查下有没有这个工具
            local tools = ToolHelper:GetToolsById(player,resLo.id)
            if #tools > 0 then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You already have better tools.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
                return
            end
        end

        -- 捡起工具
        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
		AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"储存/装备")
        return true
    elseif CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(item) then
        -- 捡起工具
        ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
		AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player,"储存/装备")
        return true
    end
end

function GameHelper:TryPlayerMeleeAttack(character:Model,atkDistance:number?)
    if not character then return end
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end

    local isHit = false
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cframe.Position, atkDistance or GameHelper.SwordAtkDistance, overlapParams)
    local checkedModels:{Model} = {}
    for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        if not model then continue end
        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(model) then continue end

        if table.find(checkedModels, model) then continue end
        table.insert(checkedModels, model)

        if GameHelper:IsNPC(model) then
            if character == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
                -- 如果是玩家自己，才发攻击命中给服务端
                GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S:FireServer(model)
                isHit = true
            end
        end
    end
    return isHit
end

function GameHelper:FindOnePlayerAttackTarget(character:Model,distance:number)
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end

    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cframe.Position, distance, overlapParams)
    local checkedModels:{Model} = {}
    local closeTarget:Model = nil
    local closeDistance:number
    for _,part:BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        if not model then continue end
        if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(model) then continue end

        if table.find(checkedModels, model) then continue end
        table.insert(checkedModels, model)

        if GameHelper:IsNPC(model) then
            local dis = (model:GetPivot().Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude
            if not closeTarget or dis < closeDistance then
                closeTarget = model
                closeDistance = dis
            end
        end
    end

    return closeTarget
end

function GameHelper:PlayDuang(model:Model)
	task.spawn(function()
		local originScale = model:GetScale()
		local t = 0
		local tt = 0.2
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(0.5 * originScale + alpha * 0.8 * originScale)
		end
		
		t = 0
		tt = 0.1
		while t < tt do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			local alpha = 1 - math.clamp(t/tt,0,1)
			--local duang = math.cos(alpha * math.pi)
			--local base = 1 -math.abs(duang)
			model:ScaleTo(originScale + 0.3 * originScale * alpha)
		end
		--Enum.EasingDirection.
		model:ScaleTo(originScale)
	end)
end

function GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
    -- 获取鼠标屏幕位置
    -- local mouseLocation = Vector2.new(mouse.X,mouse.Y)
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

    -- 从摄像机发射射线
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)

    -- 射线检测
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    -- raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character} -- 排除玩家角色
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character)
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local raycastResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)

    if raycastResult then
        return raycastResult.Position -- 返回碰撞点
    end

    -- 如果没有碰撞，返回射线方向上的一个点
    return ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 1000
end

-- 快速旅行
function GameHelper:FastTravel(player:Player,pos:Vector3,dismount:boolean?)
	local character:Model = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid.Sit then
        local horse:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(humanoid.SeatPart,GameEnum.Tag.Horse)
        if horse then
            if dismount then
                -- 下马
                for i=1,10 do
                    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding) then
                        character.Humanoid.Sit = false
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    else
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
                -- 直接用坐骑传送
                horse:PivotTo(horse:GetPivot().Rotation+pos)
                task.defer(function()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    local horseHumanoid:Humanoid = horse:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
                    horseHumanoid.Jump = true
                end)
                return
            end

        end
    end

    character:PivotTo(character:GetPivot().Rotation+pos)
end

function GameHelper:CalculateCDDiminishing(baseCooldown, cooldownReduction)
    -- 递减计算公式：实际冷却缩减 = 1 - (1 / (1 + 冷却缩减))
    local effectiveCDR = 1 - (1 / (1 + cooldownReduction))
    -- effectiveCDR = math.min(effectiveCDR, MAX_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION or 0.4)
    if effectiveCDR < 0 then
        baseCooldown = 0
    end

    return baseCooldown * (1 - effectiveCDR)
end

local _waterGunSkinEffectTag = "WaterGunSkinEffect"
local _waterGunTrailColor = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170,244,255),Color3.fromRGB(44,125,255))
local _waterGunMuzzleEmitCount = 6
local _waterGunHitEmitCount = 10

local function emitParticleBurst(root:Instance,emitCount:number):boolean
    if not root then return false end

    local hasEmitter = false
    for _,descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            hasEmitter = true
            descendant:Emit(emitCount)
        end
    end

    return hasEmitter
end

local function playDefaultGunMuzzle(gun:Tool,firePoint:Attachment?)
    local fireAtt:Attachment = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect("枪口火")
    fireAtt.CFrame = CFrame.new()
    fireAtt.Parent = firePoint or gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    EffectHelper:AddItem(fireAtt,0.1)

    local fire:ParticleEmitter = fireAtt:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ParticleEmitter")
    if fire then
        fire:Emit(5)
    end
end

local function playBulletHitEffect(effectName:string,endPos:Vector3,lifeTime:number,emitCount:number?)
    local effect = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect(effectName)
    if not effect then return end

    local anchorAtt = effect:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment",true)
    if anchorAtt then
        effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(endPos) * anchorAtt.CFrame:Inverse())
    elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") then
        effect.Position = endPos
    else
        effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(endPos))
    end

    effect.Parent = workspace
    if emitCount then
        if not emitParticleBurst(effect,emitCount) then
            CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(effect,true)
        end
    else
        CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(effect,true)
    end
    EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
end

function GameHelper:PlayRegularBulletStyle(gun:Tool,endPos:Vector3,FirePoint:Attachment?,hitCharacter:boolean?)
    if not FirePoint then
        FirePoint = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint",true)
    end
    local PointLight:PointLight = gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("PointLight",true)
    local cframe:CFrame
    if FirePoint then
        cframe = FirePoint.WorldCFrame
    else
        cframe = gun:GetPivot()
    end

    local isWaterGunSkin = gun:HasTag(_waterGunSkinEffectTag)
    local bullet:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Bullet"):Clone()
    bullet.Anchored = true
    bullet.Parent = workspace
    bullet.CFrame = cframe

    if isWaterGunSkin then
        local trail:Trail = bullet:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Trail",true)
        if trail then
            trail.Color = _waterGunTrailColor
        end

        local hasWaterMuzzle = FirePoint and emitParticleBurst(FirePoint,_waterGunMuzzleEmitCount)
        if not hasWaterMuzzle then
            playDefaultGunMuzzle(gun,FirePoint)
        end
    else
        playDefaultGunMuzzle(gun,FirePoint)
    end

    local distance = (cframe.Position - endPos).Magnitude
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(distance / 500,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,0.1)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(bullet,tweenInfo,{
        CFrame = cframe.Rotation + endPos
    })
    tween:Play()
    EffectHelper:AddItem(bullet,tweenInfo.Time,true)

    if not hitCharacter then
        if isWaterGunSkin then
            playBulletHitEffect("BulletWaterHit",endPos,0.8,_waterGunHitEmitCount)
        else
            playBulletHitEffect("BulletHit",endPos,0.15,nil)
        end
    end

    local sourcePlayer = gun.Parent and gun.Parent:IsA("Model") and game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(gun.Parent)
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("GunSound", gun.Parent, {
        SourceUserId = sourcePlayer and sourcePlayer.UserId,
        FallbackPosition = cframe.Position,
        SourceKey = sourcePlayer and ("gun:" .. tostring(sourcePlayer.UserId)) or nil,
    })

    if PointLight then
        PointLight.Enabled = true
        task.wait(0.1)
        PointLight.Enabled = false
    end
end

function GameHelper:UpdateCharacterInArea(ZonePart:Part,onZoneTag:string)
	local characters:{Model} = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player)

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartsInPart(ZonePart,overlapParams)
	for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
		local character:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
		local index = table.find(characters,character)
		if index then
			table.remove(characters,index)
			if not character:HasTag(onZoneTag) then
				print(character.Name, "AddTag",onZoneTag)
				character:AddTag(onZoneTag)
			end
		end
	end

	for _,character in ipairs(characters) do
		if character:HasTag(onZoneTag) then
			print(character.Name, "RemoveTag",onZoneTag)
			character:RemoveTag(onZoneTag)
		end
	end
end

function GameHelper:PlaySnowSmash(pos:Vector3,num:number?,force:number?)
	local color = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	-- local force = 50
    if not force then force = 50 end

	local lifeTime = 3
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifeTime * 0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
    if not num then num = 20 end
	for i = 1,num do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Color = color
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Snow
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part:AddTag("SnowballDebris")

		local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
		part.Size = Vector3.one * (1 + math.random() * 2)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + offset)
		part.Parent = workspace

		local force3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-force,force),force,math.random(-force,force)) 
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = force3
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = force3.Unit * 20

		local tween = game.TweenService:Create(part,tweenInfo,{
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(part,lifeTime)
	end
end

-- 清理周边障碍
function GameHelper:TryRemoveObstaclesAround(rootModel:Model)
    task.delay(1,function()
        if not rootModel or not rootModel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

        -- 移除周边的装饰物
        local tags = {
            GameEnum.Tag.DecorativeStones,
            GameEnum.Tag.Tree,
            GameEnum.Tag.BigTree,
        }
        
        local cframe,size = rootModel:GetBoundingBox()
        local op = OverlapParams.new()
        for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
            op:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(tag))
        end
        op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe,size,op)
        for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
            for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
                local model:BasePart = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,tag)
                if model then
                    model:RemoveTag(tag)
                    model:Destroy()
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

function GameHelper:DestroyAndSmashTarget(target:Instance,lifeTime:number?,force:number?)
    if not target then return end
    if not lifeTime then lifeTime = 0 end
    if not force then force = 20 end

    Debris:AddItem(target,lifeTime + 2)
    -- 粉碎
    if lifeTime > 0 then
        -- 清理所有Tag
        local tags = target:GetTags()
        for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
            target:RemoveTag(tag)
        end

        -- 粉碎掉
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(math.min(lifeTime * 0.5,1),Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
        for _,child:Instance in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                local basePart:BasePart = child
                if basePart.Transparency == 1 then continue end
                basePart.Anchored = false
                basePart.CanCollide = true
                basePart.CanQuery = false
                basePart.CanTouch = false
                basePart.Massless = true
                basePart.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment
                local randomVec3 = CommonFunc:RandomVector3(force)
                basePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(randomVec3.X,force,randomVec3.Z)
                -- basePart:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(Vector3.yAxis * 50,basePart.Position)
                TweenService:Create(basePart,tweenInfo,{
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
            elseif child:IsA("Script") or child:IsA("WeldConstraint") or child:IsA("JointInstance") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        -- 延迟置空
        task.delay(lifeTime,function()
            target.Parent = nil
        end)
    else
        target.Parent = nil
    end
end

function ToolHelper:Pinkup(player:Player,newTool:Tool)

    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.dragItem,nil)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(newTool,DragItemValue.dragPlayer,nil)
    if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(newTool) then
        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(newTool)
        if resLo.lv then
            -- 移除同款工具
            local oldTool = ToolHelper:GetToolByType(player,resLo.ItemType)
            if oldTool then
                -- oldTool.Parent = nil
                -- ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(oldTool,1)
                if player.Character and oldTool.CanBeDropped then
                    if oldTool.Parent == player.Character then
                        ToolHelper:DropTool(player)
                    else
                        local cframe = player.Character:GetPivot()
                        oldTool.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
                        oldTool.Parent = workspace
                        task.delay(0.1,function()
                            oldTool:PivotTo(cframe)
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    oldTool.Parent = nil
                    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(oldTool,1)
                end

            end
        end

        if not newTool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EquipedSkinResItem) then
            local skinId = DataHelper:GetInUseSkin(player,CommonEnum.SkinType.ResItem,resLo.id)
            -- print(resLo.id)
            -- if resLo.id == 103 then
            --     skinId = 6
            -- end
            if skinId then
                local skinLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetSkinLo(skinId)
                if skinLo then
                    local prefab = ResourcesItemHelper:FindSkinPrefabByName(skinLo.prefabName)
                    if prefab then
                        local cframe = newTool:GetPivot()
                        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(newTool)
                        newTool = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(resLo.id,cframe,nil,prefab)
                        newTool:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.EquipedSkinResItem)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        GameAnalytics:LogPinkupTool(player,resLo.id)
    end

    ToolHelper:Store(player,newTool)
end

    item:AddTag(lo.ItemType)

    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
    item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
    if item:IsA("Tool") then
        item:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tool)

function ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(id:number,cframe:CFrame?,owner:Player?,skinPrefab:Instance?)
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not resLo then
        error(string.format("创建物品失败，无效物品的id:%d",id))
    end
    if resLo.ItemType == GameEnum.Tag.BluePrint and resLo.param then
        local craftItem = CraftItemHelper:CreateItem(tonumber(resLo.param))
        if cframe then
            craftItem:PivotTo(cframe)
        end
        return craftItem
    end

    local prefab = skinPrefab or ResourcesItemHelper:GetPrefab(id)
    if not prefab then return end

    local item:Model = prefab:Clone()
    item.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
    if item:IsA("Tool") and not item.PrimaryPart then
        item.PrimaryPart = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    end
    ResourcesItemHelper:InitItem(id,item,owner)
    if cframe then
        item:PivotTo(cframe)
    end
    item.Parent = workspace

    return item
end

            table.insert(resItemLos,resItemLo)
        end
        _randomResItemLos[randomId] = resItemLos
    end

    local resItemLo:RandomItemsSetting.Type = CommonFunc:WeightedRandomV1(resItemLos)
    if resItemLo then
        -- 生成Gem时，才指定拥有者

            owner = nil
        end
        local cframe = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(0,360)),math.rad(math.random(0,360)),math.rad(math.random(0,360))) + position
        local item:Model = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(resItemLo.id,cframe,owner)

function AudioConfig:Validate(effectFolder)
    local missing = {}
    local extras = {}
    local seen = {}

    for name in pairs(self.Effects) do
        local sound = effectFolder and effectFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not sound or not sound:IsA("Sound") then
            table.insert(missing, name)
        else
            seen[name] = true
        end
    end

    if effectFolder then
        for _, child in ipairs(effectFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("Sound") and not self.Effects[child.Name] then
                table.insert(extras, child.Name)
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(missing)
    table.sort(extras)
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(self.Effects) do
        count += 1
    end
    return {
        Missing = missing,
        Extras = extras,
        Count = count,
    }
end

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local HitReactionHelper = {}

local EFFECT_NAMES = {
    [1] = "Punch-01",
    [2] = "Punch-02",
    [3] = "Punch-03",
}

local MAX_PER_VARIANT = 4
local MAX_ACTIVE = 12
local LIFETIME = 0.55
local TARGET_INTERVAL = 0.08
local random = Random.new()

local skippedSources = {}
for _, sourceName in ipairs({
    "Poisoned",
    "Burning",
    "Trap",
    "Light",
    "HolyWater",
    "HolySword",
    "Explosion",
}) do
    local source = GameEnum.DamageSource and GameEnum.DamageSource[sourceName]
    if source ~= nil then
        skippedSources[source] = true
    end
end

local lastVariantByTarget = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function isFiniteNumber(value)
    return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

function HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(value)
    return typeof(value) == "Vector3"
        and isFiniteNumber(value.X)
        and isFiniteNumber(value.Y)
        and isFiniteNumber(value.Z)
end

function HitReactionHelper.ShouldPlay(attacker, target, damage, damageSource, context)
    if not attacker or not target then
        return false
    end
    if typeof(damage) ~= "number" or damage <= 0 or damage ~= damage then
        return false
    end
    if context and context.SuppressHitReaction == true then
        return false
    end
    local source = damageSource or (context and context.DamageSource)
    if source ~= nil and skippedSources[source] then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getTargetPosition(target)
    if not target then
        return nil
    end
    for _, name in ipairs({"UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart"}) do
        local part = target:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            return part.Position
        end
    end
    local primary = target.PrimaryPart
    if primary and primary:IsA("BasePart") then
        return primary.Position
    end
    local ok, pivot = pcall(target.GetPivot, target)
    if ok and pivot then
        return pivot.Position
    end
    return nil
end

function HitReactionHelper.ResolvePosition(target, context)
    local requested = context and context.HitPosition
    if HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(requested) and target then
        local ok, boxCFrame, boxSize = pcall(target.GetBoundingBox, target)
        if ok and boxCFrame and boxSize then
            local localPosition = boxCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(requested)
            local limit = boxSize * 0.5 + Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            if math.abs(localPosition.X) <= limit.X
                and math.abs(localPosition.Y) <= limit.Y
                and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= limit.Z then
                return requested
            end
        end
    end

    return getTargetPosition(target) or requested
end

function HitReactionHelper.ResolveDirection(attacker, target, context, hitPosition)
    local requested = context and context.HitDirection
    if HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(requested) and requested.Magnitude > 0.001 then
        return requested.Unit
    end

    local attackerPosition
    if attacker and attacker:IsA("Model") then
        attackerPosition = getTargetPosition(attacker)
    elseif attacker and attacker:IsA("BasePart") then
        attackerPosition = attacker.Position
    end
    local targetPosition = hitPosition or getTargetPosition(target)
    if attackerPosition and targetPosition then
        local direction = targetPosition - attackerPosition
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            return direction.Unit
        end
    end
    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
end

function HitReactionHelper.ChooseVariant(target, critical)
    if critical then
        lastVariantByTarget[target] = 3
        return 3
    end

    local last = lastVariantByTarget[target]
    local variant = random:NextInteger(1, 3)
    if last and variant == last then
        variant = variant % 3 + 1
    end
    lastVariantByTarget[target] = variant
    return variant
end

function HitReactionHelper.GetTargetInterval()
    return TARGET_INTERVAL
end

function HitReactionHelper.IsEnabled()
    local gameplaySwitches = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("玩法开关")
    local toggle = gameplaySwitches and gameplaySwitches:FindFirstChild("EnablePunchHitReaction")
    return not toggle or toggle.Value ~= false
end

local clientReady = false
local clientStartPending = false
local retryScheduled = false
local pendingBatches = {}
local prefabs
local pools = {
    [1] = {available = {}, created = 0},
    [2] = {available = {}, created = 0},
    [3] = {available = {}, created = 0},
}
local activeRecords = {}
local activeCount = 0
local clientLastByTarget = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function getEffectFolder()
    local prefabsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs")
    return prefabsFolder and prefabsFolder:FindFirstChild("Effects")
end

local function disableAndHide(instance)
    local function normalizePart(part)
        part.Transparency = 1
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.CanTouch = false
        part.CanQuery = false
        part.CastShadow = false
    end

    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        normalizePart(instance)
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            normalizePart(descendant)
        elseif descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            descendant.Enabled = false
            descendant.Rate = 0
        end
    end
end

local function makeInstance(variant)
    local template = prefabs and prefabs[variant]
    if not template then
        return nil
    end
    local instance = template:Clone()
    disableAndHide(instance)
    return instance
end

local function release(instance, variant)
    local record = activeRecords[instance]
    if not record then
        return
    end
    activeRecords[instance] = nil
    activeCount = math.max(activeCount - 1, 0)
    if instance and instance.Parent then
        instance.Parent = nil
    end
    if instance and instance.Parent == nil then
        local pool = pools[variant]
        if pool and instance.Parent == nil then
            table.insert(pool.available, instance)
        elseif instance then
            instance:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function acquire(variant)
    if activeCount >= MAX_ACTIVE then
        return nil
    end
    local pool = pools[variant]
    if not pool then
        return nil
    end

    local instance = table.remove(pool.available)
    if not instance then
        if pool.created >= MAX_PER_VARIANT then
            return nil
        end
        instance = makeInstance(variant)
        if not instance then
            return nil
        end
        pool.created += 1
    end

    activeCount += 1
    activeRecords[instance] = {variant = variant}
    return instance
end

function HitReactionHelper.InitializeClient()
    if clientReady or clientStartPending then
        return
    end
    clientStartPending = true

    local effects = getEffectFolder()
    if not effects then
        clientStartPending = false
        if not retryScheduled then
            retryScheduled = true
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                retryScheduled = false
                if not clientReady then
                    HitReactionHelper.InitializeClient()
                end
            end)
        end
        return
    end

    prefabs = {
        [1] = effects:FindFirstChild(EFFECT_NAMES[1]),
        [2] = effects:FindFirstChild(EFFECT_NAMES[2]),
        [3] = effects:FindFirstChild(EFFECT_NAMES[3]),
    }

    local preloadList = {}
    for variant = 1, 3 do
        if prefabs[variant] then
            table.insert(preloadList, prefabs[variant])
        else
            warn("[HitReaction] Missing effect prefab: " .. EFFECT_NAMES[variant])
        end
    end

    clientReady = true
    clientStartPending = false
    local queued = pendingBatches
    pendingBatches = {}
    for _, batch in ipairs(queued) do
        HitReactionHelper.PlayBatch(batch)
    end

    if #preloadList > 0 then
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(preloadList)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

function HitReactionHelper.PlayBatch(packets)
    if typeof(packets) ~= "table" then
        return
    end
    if not HitReactionHelper.IsEnabled() then
        return
    end
    if not clientReady then
        HitReactionHelper.InitializeClient()
        if not clientReady then
            if #pendingBatches < 8 then
                table.insert(pendingBatches, packets)
            end
            return
        end
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    for _, packet in ipairs(packets) do
        if typeof(packet) ~= "table" then
            continue
        end
        local position = packet.Position
        local direction = packet.Direction
        local variant = packet.Variant
        if not HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(position) then
            continue
        end
        if not HitReactionHelper.IsFiniteVector3(direction) or direction.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
            direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
        else
            direction = direction.Unit
        end
        if typeof(variant) ~= "number" or variant < 1 or variant > 3 then
            continue
        end

        local target = packet.Target
        local critical = packet.Critical == true
        if target then
            local last = clientLastByTarget[target]
            if last and now - last < TARGET_INTERVAL and not critical then
                continue
            end
            clientLastByTarget[target] = now
        end

        local instance = acquire(math.floor(variant))
        if not instance then
            continue
        end

        local frame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction)
        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
            instance.CFrame = frame
        else
            instance:PivotTo(frame)
        end
        instance.Parent = workspace

        local emitter = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ParticleEmitter", true)
        if emitter then
            emitter.Enabled = false
            emitter:Emit(1)
        end

        local usedVariant = math.floor(variant)
        task.delay(LIFETIME, function()
            release(instance, usedVariant)
        end)
    end
end

function HitReactionHelper.GetDebugStats()
    local created = {}
    local available = {}
    for variant = 1, 3 do
        created[variant] = pools[variant].created
        available[variant] = #pools[variant].available
    end
    return {
        Active = activeCount,
        MaxActive = MAX_ACTIVE,
        Created = created,
        Available = available,
        Ready = clientReady,
        Pending = #pendingBatches,
    }
end

local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))

local MeleeAttackC2S = Events:WaitForChild("MeleeAttackC2S")
local MeleeHitS2C = Events:WaitForChild("MeleeHitS2C")

local hitSounds = {"近战武器Hit1", "近战武器Hit2"}
local swingCounter = 0
local pending = {}
local toolCooldowns = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local MeleeCombatClient = {}

local function getRoot(model: Model): BasePart?
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
end

local function isValidEnemy(enemy: Model, character: Model): boolean
    if not enemy or enemy == character or not enemy:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    if not GameHelper:IsNPC(enemy) or enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath) then return false end
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return getRoot(enemy) ~= nil
end

local function findNearestEnemy(character: Model, root: BasePart, radius: number): Model?
    local params = OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    params.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    params.MaxParts = 128

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.AutoFace.Query")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, math.min(radius, 12), params)
    debug.profileend()

    local nearest
    local nearestDistance = math.min(radius, 12) ^ 2
    local seen = {}
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
        if model and not seen[model] and isValidEnemy(model, character) then
            seen[model] = true
            local enemyRoot = getRoot(model)
            local delta = enemyRoot.Position - root.Position
            local distance = delta:Dot(delta)
            if distance <= nearestDistance then
                nearestDistance = distance
                nearest = model
            end
        end
    end
    return nearest
end

local function faceTarget(character: Model, target: Model, duration: number)
    task.spawn(function()
        local endAt = os.clock() + duration
        while os.clock() < endAt and character == LocalPlayer.Character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
            local root = getRoot(character)
            local targetRoot = getRoot(target)
            if not root or not targetRoot or not isValidEnemy(target, character) then return end
            local rootPos = root.Position
            local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
            local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, rootPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
            if (flatTarget - rootPos).Magnitude > 0.1 then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, flatTarget)
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

local function scheduleCooldownRestore(tool: Tool, state)
    local remaining = math.max(0, state.endsAt - workspace.DistributedGameTime)
    task.delay(remaining, function()
        if toolCooldowns[tool] ~= state then return end

        local timeLeft = state.endsAt - workspace.DistributedGameTime
        if timeLeft > 0 then
            scheduleCooldownRestore(tool, state)
            return
        end

        -- The tool may be temporarily unparented while another system moves it.
        -- Keep the expired record in that case so the next equip can restore it.
        if tool.Parent then
            toolCooldowns[tool] = nil
            tool.Enabled = true
        end
    end)
end

function MeleeCombatClient.TryBeginCooldown(tool: Tool, duration: number): boolean
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end

    local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
    local current = toolCooldowns[tool]
    if current and timeNow < current.endsAt then
        tool.Enabled = false
        return false
    end

    local state = {
        endsAt = timeNow + math.max(0, tonumber(duration) or 0),
    }
    toolCooldowns[tool] = state
    tool.Enabled = false
    scheduleCooldownRestore(tool, state)
    return true
end

function MeleeCombatClient.RefreshCooldown(tool: Tool): boolean
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end

    local state = toolCooldowns[tool]
    if not state then
        return false
    end
    if workspace.DistributedGameTime >= state.endsAt then
        toolCooldowns[tool] = nil
        tool.Enabled = true
        return false
    end

    tool.Enabled = false
    return true
end

function MeleeCombatClient.GetProfile(tool: Tool)
    local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local id = lo and tonumber(lo.id)
    return id and MeleeWeaponSetting.GetById(id), lo
end

function MeleeCombatClient.BeginSwing(tool: Tool, character: Model)
    if not tool or not character or character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local profile = MeleeCombatClient.GetProfile(tool)
    if not profile then return nil end

    swingCounter += 1
    local swingId = swingCounter
    pending[swingId] = tool

    if autoFaceSwitch.Value then
        local root = getRoot(character)
        if root then
            local target = findNearestEnemy(character, root, profile.reach + profile.autoFaceExtraRange)
            if target then
                faceTarget(character, target, profile.autoFaceDuration)
            end
        end
    end

    task.delay(profile.windup, function()
        if pending[swingId] == tool and tool.Parent == character and character == LocalPlayer.Character then
            MeleeAttackC2S:FireServer(swingId)
        end
    end)
    task.delay(profile.cooldown + profile.autoFaceDuration + 1, function()
        if pending[swingId] == tool then
            pending[swingId] = nil
        end
    end)
    return swingId, profile
end

MeleeHitS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(swingId: number, hitCount: number)
    local tool = pending[swingId]
    if not tool or not tool:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
    if hitCount and hitCount > 0 then
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(hitSounds[math.random(1, #hitSounds)], tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), {
            SourceUserId = LocalPlayer.UserId,
            SourceKey = "melee-hit:" .. tool.Name,
        })
    end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    for tool in pairs(toolCooldowns) do
        if tool.Parent then
            tool.Enabled = true
        end
    end
    table.clear(toolCooldowns)
    table.clear(pending)
end)

return MeleeCombatClient

local function cancelTweens()
