local function refreshCrosshair()
	local visible = featureSwitch.Value
		and isTouchPrimary()
		and boundTool ~= nil
		and boundTool.Parent == player.Character
		and isMobileShiftLockActive()
	if visible then
		ensureOverlay()
	end
	if crosshair then
		crosshair.Visible = visible
		crosshair.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		local responsiveScale = crosshair:FindFirstChild("ResponsiveScale")
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if responsiveScale and responsiveScale:IsA("UIScale") and camera then
			local shortSide = math.min(camera.ViewportSize.X, camera.ViewportSize.Y)
			responsiveScale.Scale = math.clamp(shortSide * 0.06, 18, 26) / 24
		end
	end
	if not visible and hitmarker then
		hitmarker.Visible = false
	end
end

local function connectShiftLockSignal()
	if shiftLockSignal then
		shiftLockSignal:Disconnect()
		shiftLockSignal = nil
	end
	local button = getShiftLockButton()
	if button then
		shiftLockSignal = button:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ShiftLockActive"):Connect(refreshCrosshair)
	end

local function removeToken(token:number)
	if not tokenRecords[token] then return end
	tokenRecords[token] = nil
	for index, value in tokenOrder do
		if value == token then
			table.remove(tokenOrder, index)
			break
		end
	end
end

local function rememberToken(token:number, record)
	tokenRecords[token] = record
	table.insert(tokenOrder, token)
	while #tokenOrder > MAX_TOKENS do
		local oldest = table.remove(tokenOrder, 1)
		tokenRecords[oldest] = nil
	end
	task.delay(TOKEN_TTL, function()
		removeToken(token)
	end)
end

local function buildRay(screenPoint:Vector2?, centerLock:boolean)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return nil end

	if centerLock then
		local viewportPoint = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
		local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewportPoint.X, viewportPoint.Y)
		local topLeftInset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		return camera, ray, viewportPoint, viewportPoint - topLeftInset
	end

	local actualScreenPoint = screenPoint
	if typeof(actualScreenPoint) ~= "Vector2" then
		if isTouchPrimary() then
			return nil
		end
		actualScreenPoint = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end
	-- TouchTapInWorld already reports device-safe viewport coordinates.
	-- ScreenPointToRay would apply the Core UI inset a second time on notched devices.
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(actualScreenPoint.X, actualScreenPoint.Y)
	return camera, ray, actualScreenPoint, actualScreenPoint
end

local function raycastAim(ray:Ray)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	if player.Character then
		params:AddToFilter(player.Character)
	end
	params:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_AIM_DISTANCE, params)
	return result and result.Position or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * MAX_AIM_DISTANCE)
end

function RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled()
	-- The switch intentionally gates only the touch-primary experience.
	-- Desktop callers therefore continue through their established mouse paths.
	return featureSwitch.Value == true and isTouchPrimary()
end

	return isTouchPrimary()

function RangedCombatClient.SampleAim(options)
	options = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	local touchMode = isTouchPrimary()
	local centerLock = touchMode and (
		isMobileShiftLockActive()
		or options.Trigger == "CenterButton"
	)
	local camera, ray, viewportPoint, screenPoint = buildRay(options.ScreenPoint, centerLock)
	if not camera or not ray then
		return nil
	end
	return {
		AimWorldPosition = raycastAim(ray),
		ScreenPoint = screenPoint,
		ViewportPoint = viewportPoint,
		IsCenterLock = centerLock,
	}
end

function RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(options)
	local aimContext = RangedCombatClient.SampleAim(options)
	if not aimContext then return nil end

	nextToken += 1
	if nextToken >= 2147483647 then nextToken = 1 end
	aimContext.ShotToken = nextToken
	rememberToken(aimContext.ShotToken, {
		ScreenPoint = aimContext.ScreenPoint,
		ViewportPoint = aimContext.ViewportPoint,
		IsCenterLock = aimContext.IsCenterLock,
		Tool = boundTool,
	})
	return aimContext
end

local function stopHaptics()
	hapticSerial += 1
	pcall(function()
		HapticService:SetMotor(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, 0)
		HapticService:SetMotor(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, 0)
	end)
end

local function playHaptic(isKill:boolean, isHeadshot:boolean)
	if not isTouchPrimary() or (not isKill and not isHeadshot) then return end
	local inputType = Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
	local motor = isKill and Enum.VibrationMotor.Large or Enum.VibrationMotor.Small
	local supported = false
	pcall(function()
		supported = HapticService:IsVibrationSupported(inputType)
			and HapticService:IsMotorSupported(inputType, motor)
	end)
	if not supported then return end
	hapticSerial += 1
	local serial = hapticSerial
	local magnitude = isKill and 0.35 or 0.2
	pcall(function()
		HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Small, 0)
		HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, Enum.VibrationMotor.Large, 0)
		HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, motor, magnitude)
	end)
	task.delay(isKill and 0.04 or 0.025, function()
		if serial ~= hapticSerial then return end
		pcall(function() HapticService:SetMotor(inputType, motor, 0) end)
	end)
end

local function pulseHitmarker(record, payload)
	local _, _, marker = ensureOverlay()
	if not marker then return end

	pulseSerial += 1
	local serial = pulseSerial
	cancelTweens()
	setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
	setGraphicTransparency(marker, 0)

	local isKill = payload.IsKill == true
	local isHeadshot = payload.IsHeadshot == true
	local color = isKill and KILL_COLOR or (isHeadshot and CRITICAL_COLOR or BODY_COLOR)
	local startSize = isKill and 24 or (isHeadshot and 22 or 18)
	local peakSize = isKill and 31 or (isHeadshot and 27 or 21)
	local expandTime = isKill and 0.08 or 0.065
	local fadeTime = isKill and 0.18 or (isHeadshot and 0.13 or 0.1)

	local markerPoint = record.ViewportPoint
	marker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(markerPoint.X, markerPoint.Y)
	marker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
	marker.Visible = true
	setGraphicColor(marker, color)
	setGraphicTransparency(marker, 0)
	local markerScale = marker:FindFirstChild("PulseScale")
	if not markerScale or not markerScale:IsA("UIScale") then return end
	markerScale.Scale = startSize / 20

	if (isKill or isHeadshot) and crosshair and record.IsCenterLock then
		setGraphicColor(crosshair, CRITICAL_COLOR)
	end
	playHaptic(isKill, isHeadshot)

	local expand = TweenService:Create(markerScale, TweenInfo.new(expandTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Scale = peakSize / 20,
	})
	table.insert(activeTweens, expand)
	expand:Play()
	expand.Completed:Once(function()
		if serial ~= pulseSerial or not marker.Parent then return end
		local fade = TweenService:Create(markerScale, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Scale = startSize / 20,
		})
		table.insert(activeTweens, fade)
		for _, descendant in marker:GetDescendants() do
			if descendant:IsA("Frame") then
				local lineFade = TweenService:Create(descendant, TweenInfo.new(fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				})
				table.insert(activeTweens, lineFade)
				lineFade:Play()
			end
		end
		fade:Play()
		task.delay(fadeTime, function()
			if serial ~= pulseSerial or not marker.Parent then return end
			marker.Visible = false
			setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
		end)
	end)
end

function RangedCombatClient.PulseHit(payload)
	if not featureSwitch.Value or not isTouchPrimary() or type(payload) ~= "table" then return end
	local token = payload.ShotToken
	if type(token) ~= "number" then return end
	local record = tokenRecords[token]
	if not record then return end
	pulseHitmarker(record, payload)
	if payload.IsKill == true then
		removeToken(token)
	end
end

local function finishBinding(binding, context)
	if not binding.held then return end
	binding.held = false
	binding.activeInput = nil
	if binding.onEnded then
		binding.onEnded(context)
	end
end

function RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool:Tool)
	local binding = fireBindings[tool]
	if not binding then return end
	finishBinding(binding, {Trigger = "Cancelled"})
	for _, connection in binding.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	fireBindings[tool] = nil
end

function RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(tool:Tool, onBegan:(any)->(), onEnded:((any)->())?)
	if not isRangedWeapon(tool) or type(onBegan) ~= "function" then return end
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then return end

	local binding = {
		connections = {},
		held = false,
		activeInput = nil,
		onEnded = onEnded,
	}
	fireBindings[tool] = binding

	local function isUsable()
		return RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled()
			and tool.Parent == player.Character
			and fireBindings[tool] == binding
	end

	local function begin(context, continuous:boolean)
		if not isUsable() then return end
		if continuous then
			if binding.held then return end
			binding.held = true
		end
		onBegan(context)
	end

	local fireButton = getFireButton()
	if fireButton then
		table.insert(binding.connections, fireButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input:InputObject)
			if not fireButton.Visible then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if not isMobileShiftLockActive() or binding.held then return end
			binding.activeInput = input
			begin({
				Trigger = "CenterButton",
				ScreenPoint = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y),
			}, true)
		end))
		table.insert(binding.connections, fireButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input:InputObject)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if input ~= binding.activeInput then return end
			finishBinding(binding, {Trigger = "CenterButton"})
		end))
		table.insert(binding.connections, fireButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if not fireButton.Visible then
				finishBinding(binding, {Trigger = "Cancelled"})
			end
		end))
	end

	table.insert(binding.connections, UserInputService.TouchTapInWorld:Connect(function(position:Vector2, processedByUI:boolean)
		if processedByUI or isMobileShiftLockActive() then return end
		begin({
			Trigger = "WorldTap",
			ScreenPoint = position,
		}, false)
		if onEnded then
			onEnded({Trigger = "WorldTap", ScreenPoint = position})
		end
	end))
end

function RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(tool:Tool)
	if not isRangedWeapon(tool) then return end
	boundTool = tool
	connectShiftLockSignal()
	refreshCrosshair()
end

function RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(tool:Tool?)
	if tool and boundTool and tool ~= boundTool then return end
	if tool then
		RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
		local ownedTokens = {}
		for token, record in tokenRecords do
			if record.Tool == tool then
				table.insert(ownedTokens, token)
			end
		end
		for _, token in ownedTokens do
			removeToken(token)
		end
	end
	boundTool = nil
	if shiftLockSignal then
		shiftLockSignal:Disconnect()
		shiftLockSignal = nil
	end
	pulseSerial += 1
	cancelTweens()
	stopHaptics()
	if crosshair then
		crosshair.Visible = false
		setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
	end
	if hitmarker then hitmarker.Visible = false end
end

local function clearNewMode()
	local toolsToUnbind = {}
	for tool in fireBindings do
		table.insert(toolsToUnbind, tool)
	end
	for _, tool in toolsToUnbind do
		RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	end
	table.clear(tokenRecords)
	table.clear(tokenOrder)
	pulseSerial += 1
	cancelTweens()
	stopHaptics()
	if crosshair then
		crosshair.Visible = false
		setGraphicColor(crosshair, BODY_COLOR)
	end
	if hitmarker then hitmarker.Visible = false end
end

type ConfigVo = {
	name:string,
	data:any,
	cacheMap:any,
}

export type SameKeyVo = {
	k:any,
	v:any,
}

local _configVos = {}


function getKey(configName,key,value,all)
	if not all then
		all = false
	end
	return configName.."_"..key.."_"..value.."_"..tostring(all)
end

function getConfigVo(configName)
	if typeof(configName) == "table" then
		return configName
	end
	if not configName then
		return
	end
	
	local configVo:ConfigVo = _configVos[configName]
	if not configVo then
		local configData = require(_configParent:WaitForChild(configName,5))
		if configData then
			configVo = {
				data = configData,
				cacheMap = {}
			}
			_configVos[configName] = configVo
		else
			warn("ConfigHelper:Get() - config not found: ",configName)
			return
		end
	end
	
	return configVo
end

function getCache(configVo:ConfigVo,mapKey)
	local suc = false
	local vo = nil
	local rw = configVo.cacheMap[mapKey] or nil
	if rw then
		suc = true
		if typeof(rw) == "number" and rw <= 0 then
			vo = nil
		else
			vo = configVo.cacheMap[mapKey]
		end
	end

	
	return suc,vo
end

function ConfigHelper:Get(configName,key,value,all)
	local map = rawset({},key,value)
	return ConfigHelper:GetMulti(configName,map,all)
end

function ConfigHelper:GetById(configName,value,all)
	return ConfigHelper:Get(configName,"id",value,all)
end

function ConfigHelper:GetMulti(configName,map,all)	
	local configVo:ConfigVo = getConfigVo(configName)
	if not configVo then
		return
	end

	if not all then
		all = false
	end

	local mapKey = getKey(configVo.name,game.HttpService:JSONEncode(map),0,all)
	local suc,ret = getCache(configVo,mapKey)
	if suc then
		return ret
	end
	
	local allTable = {}	
	for i,vo in ipairs(configVo.data) do
		local match = true
		for k,v in pairs(map) do
			if vo[k] ~= v then
				match = false
			end
		end
		
		if match then
			table.insert(allTable,vo)
			if not all then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	
	if all then
		configVo.cacheMap[mapKey] = allTable
		return allTable		
	end
	
	if #allTable > 0 then
		local ret = allTable[1]
		configVo.cacheMap[mapKey] = ret
		return ret
	end

	configVo.cacheMap[mapKey] = -1
	return nil
end

function ConfigHelper:GetMultiBySameKey(configName,map)	
	if not map	 then
		return
	end

	local configVo:ConfigVo = getConfigVo(configName)
	if not configVo then
		return
	end
	
	local mapKey = getKey(configVo.name,game.HttpService:JSONEncode(map),0,true)
	local suc,ret = getCache(configVo,mapKey)
	if suc then
		return ret
	end
	
	local ret = {}
	for _,matchMap in ipairs(map) do
		local result = ConfigHelper:GetMulti(configName,matchMap,true)
		for _,lo in ipairs(result) do
			table.insert(ret,lo)
		end
	end
	
	configVo.cacheMap[mapKey] = ret
	
	return ret
end

return ConfigHelper

local Formula = {}

-- 角色等级数值增长公式
function Formula.segmentGrowth(initVal, targetVal, initLv, targetLv,lv)
	-- 定义阶段划分点（实际关卡数）
	local stage1End = 3  -- 阶段1结束于第3级
	local stage2End = 7  -- 阶段2结束于第7级

	-- print("\n各级数值结果：")
	local value

	if lv <= stage1End then
		-- 阶段1：线性增长（占总增长的30%）
		local progress = (lv - initLv) / (stage1End - initLv)
		value = initVal + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.3 * progress

	elseif lv <= stage2End then
		-- 阶段2：指数增长（占总增长的40%）
		local stage1Value = initVal + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.3  -- 阶段1结束值
		local stage2Progress = (lv - stage1End) / (stage2End - stage1End)
		local exponent = math.pow(2, stage2Progress)  -- 指数从1增长到2
		value = stage1Value + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.4 * (exponent - 1)

	else
		-- 阶段3：线性调整（占总增长的30%）
		local stage2Value = initVal + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.7  -- 阶段2结束值
		local stage3Progress = (lv - stage2End) / (targetLv - stage2End)
		value = stage2Value + (targetVal - initVal) * 0.3 * stage3Progress
	end

	-- print(string.format("    %d级: %.2f", lv, value))
    return value
end

-- 怪物三阶段多项式成长函数
function Formula.multiStageGrowth(level, base, stage1, stage2, stage3)
    local phase1 = 20
    local phase2 = 40
    if level <= phase1 then  -- 阶段1：平滑增长
        return base * (1 + stage1.linear * level + stage1.quad * level^2)
    elseif level <= phase2 then  -- 阶段2：中等增速
        local baseValue = Formula.multiStageGrowth(phase1, base, stage1, stage2, stage3)
        local deltaLevel = level - phase1
        return baseValue * (1 + stage2.linear * deltaLevel + stage2.quad * deltaLevel^2)
    else  -- 阶段3：快速增长（加入指数项）
        local baseValue = Formula.multiStageGrowth(phase2, base, stage1, stage2, stage3)
        local deltaLevel = level - phase2
        return baseValue * (1 + stage3.linear * deltaLevel + stage3.quad * deltaLevel^2 + stage3.exp * 2^(deltaLevel/3))
    end
end

-- 计算攻击力
function Formula.calculateAttack(level, baseAttack, multiplier)
    multiplier = multiplier or 1

    local attack = Formula.multiStageGrowth(level, baseAttack,
        {linear=0.1, quad=0.01},    -- 阶段1
        {linear=0.15, quad=0.02},   -- 阶段2
        {linear=0.2, quad=0.03, exp=0.05}  -- 阶段3
    )

    -- 难度乘数
    attack = attack * multiplier

    -- 随机波动 (±10%)
    attack = attack * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.2)

    return math.floor(attack)
end

-- 计算血量
function Formula.calculateHP(level, baseHP, multiplier)
    multiplier = multiplier or 1

    local hp = Formula.multiStageGrowth(level, baseHP,
        {linear=0.15, quad=0.015},  -- 阶段1（血量增长略快于攻击）
        {linear=0.25, quad=0.03},   -- 阶段2
        {linear=0.35, quad=0.05, exp=0.1}  -- 阶段3（血量大幅增长）
    )

    -- 难度乘数
    hp = hp * multiplier

    -- 随机波动 (±15%)
    -- hp = hp * (0.85 + math.random() * 0.3)

    return math.floor(hp)
end

return Formula

function Effect.play(character, position, castTime, travelTime)
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		if not character then
			return
		end
		
		local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")

		if not hand then
			return
		end

		local grip = hand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")

		if not grip then
			return
		end

		wait(castTime / 2)

		local castSound = character.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("grapple_cast_sound")

		if not castSound then
			castSound = CastSound:Clone()
			castSound.Parent = character.PrimaryPart
		end

		castSound:Play()

		local rootEmitter = character.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("grapple_root_emitter")
		if not rootEmitter then
			rootEmitter = RootEmitter:Clone()
			rootEmitter.Parent = character.PrimaryPart
		end

		rootEmitter.Enabled = true

		local hook = Hook:Clone()
		hook.Beam.Attachment0 = grip
		hook.CFrame = hand.CFrame
		hook.Parent = character

		local castInfo = TweenInfo.new(castTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local castTween = TweenService:Create(hook, castInfo, {CFrame = CFrame.new(position)})

		castTween:Play()
		castTween.Completed:Wait()

		local effectPart = EffectPart:Clone()
		effectPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		effectPart.Parent = character

		effectPart.DustEmitter:Emit(2)
		effectPart.SparkEmitter:Emit(20)

		Debris:AddItem(effectPart, 0.5)

		wait(travelTime - castTime)

		rootEmitter.Enabled = false
		hook:Destroy()
	end))
end

function PickupClass.PickupObject(Pickupbool) 

	if Pickupbool == false then
		grapple.CurrentObject = nil
		return
	end

	local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	if not grapple.Target then
		return
	end
	grapple.CurrentObject = grapple.Target
	grapple.CurrentObjectBool = true

	local root:BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local RightHand = character.RightHand.RightGripAttachment
	PickupClass.pickpart = grapple.CurrentObject
	PickupClass.Event()
	local attachment = PickupClass.CreateAttachment()

	--beam.Enabled = true
	--beam.Attachment0 = attachment
	--beam.Attachment1 = RightHand

	local success,err = pcall(function()

			local newPos = (root.CFrame + root.CFrame.LookVector*5 + root.CFrame.UpVector*7 + root.CFrame.RightVector*3).Position

			task.wait(1/PickupClass.PICKUP_UPDATE_HZ) -- Update obj Position at Pickup Frequency

	if not success then

	end

	if BP and BP.Parent then

	end
	--beam.Enabled = false
	PickUpFunction:InvokeServer(PickupClass.pickpart,false)
	PickupClass.pickpart = nil
	grapple.CurrentObjectBool = false

	elseif PickupClass.pickpart and PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then
		return PickupClass.pickpart:FindFirstChild("Attachment")
	end

		Beam.Width1 = 0.1

		Beam.CurveSize1 = -10
		Beam.FaceCamera = true
		Beam.Color = ColorSequence.new{

		Beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{

		}

	end

	BP.P = 10500000
	BP.D = 15000

	return BP
end

		local ok, moduleResult = pcall(require, playerModule)
		if not ok then return cachedControls end
		cachedPlayerModuleScript = playerModule
		cachedPlayerModule = moduleResult
		cachedControls = nil
	end
	if cachedControls ~= nil then return cachedControls end
	local ok, controls = pcall(function()
		if type(cachedPlayerModule) == "table" and type(cachedPlayerModule.GetControls) == "function" then
			return cachedPlayerModule:GetControls()
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if not ok then return nil end
	cachedControls = controls
	return cachedControls
end

local function suppressTouchControls()
	if not hasActiveOwners() or controlsSuppressedByHelper or not shouldSuppressTouchControls() then return end
	local controls = getPlayerControls()
	if not controls or type(controls.Disable) ~= "function" then return end
	local ok = pcall(function() controls:Disable() end)
	if ok then controlsSuppressedByHelper = true end
end

local function restoreTouchControls()
	if not controlsSuppressedByHelper then return end
	local controls = getPlayerControls()
	if not controls or type(controls.Enable) ~= "function" then
		controlsSuppressedByHelper = false
		return
	end
	pcall(function() controls:Enable() end)
	controlsSuppressedByHelper = false
end

local function ensureTrackedProperty(instance:Instance, propertyName:string, hiddenValue:any)
	local state = trackedInstances[instance]
	if not state then
		state = { originalValues = {}, observedProps = {}, connections = {} }
		trackedInstances[instance] = state
	end
	if state.observedProps[propertyName] ~= nil then
		safeSet(instance, propertyName, hiddenValue)
		return
	end
	local ok, currentValue = pcall(function() return instance[propertyName] end)
	if not ok then return end
	state.originalValues[propertyName] = currentValue
	state.observedProps[propertyName] = hiddenValue
	state.connections[#state.connections + 1] = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal(propertyName):Connect(function()
		if hasActiveOwners() then safeSet(instance, propertyName, hiddenValue) end
	end)
	safeSet(instance, propertyName, hiddenValue)
end

local function hideInstanceAppearance(instance:Instance)
	if instance:IsA("GuiObject") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Visible", false)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Interactable", false)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Active", false)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "BackgroundTransparency", 1)
	end
	if instance:IsA("ImageLabel") or instance:IsA("ImageButton") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "ImageTransparency", 1)
	end
	if instance:IsA("TextLabel") or instance:IsA("TextButton") or instance:IsA("TextBox") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "TextTransparency", 1)
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "TextStrokeTransparency", 1)
	end
	if instance:IsA("UIStroke") then
		ensureTrackedProperty(instance, "Transparency", 1)
	end
end

local function hideSubtree(root:Instance)
	hideInstanceAppearance(root)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		hideInstanceAppearance(descendant)
	end
end

local function collectTargetRoots(): {Instance}
	local roots = {}
	local touchControlFrame: Instance? = nil
	local playerGui = getPlayerGui()
	if playerGui then
		local touchGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
		if touchGui then
			touchControlFrame = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
			if touchControlFrame then
				roots[#roots + 1] = touchControlFrame
			end
		end
	end
	local shouldUseFallback = GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled or touchControlFrame ~= nil
	if shouldUseFallback then
		pcall(function()
			local robloxGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
			local controlFrame = robloxGui and robloxGui:FindFirstChild("ControlFrame")
			if controlFrame then
				local bottomLeftControl = controlFrame:FindFirstChild("BottomLeftControl")
				local bottomRightControl = controlFrame:FindFirstChild("BottomRightControl")
				if bottomLeftControl then roots[#roots + 1] = bottomLeftControl end
				if bottomRightControl then roots[#roots + 1] = bottomRightControl end
			end
		end)
	end
	return roots
end

local function restoreTrackedInstances()
	for instance, state in pairs(trackedInstances) do
		for propertyName, originalValue in pairs(state.originalValues) do
			pcall(function() instance[propertyName] = originalValue end)
		end
		disconnectConnections(state.connections)
		trackedInstances[instance] = nil
	end
end

local function queueRefresh()
	if not hasActiveOwners() or refreshQueued then return end
	refreshQueued = true
	task.defer(function()
		refreshQueued = false
		if not hasActiveOwners() then return end
		suppressTouchControls()
		for _, root in ipairs(collectTargetRoots()) do
			hideSubtree(root)
		end
	end)
end

local function bindPlayerGuiConnections(playerGui: PlayerGui?)
	if watchedPlayerGui == playerGui then return end
	disconnectConnections(playerGuiConnections)
	watchedPlayerGui = playerGui
	if not playerGui then return end
	playerGuiConnections[#playerGuiConnections + 1] = playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(queueRefresh)
	playerGuiConnections[#playerGuiConnections + 1] = playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(queueRefresh)
end

local function startWatching()
	if #watchConnections > 0 then return end
	local localPlayer = getLocalPlayer()
	if not localPlayer then return end
	bindPlayerGuiConnections(getPlayerGui())
	watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = localPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("PlayerGui") then
			bindPlayerGuiConnections(child)
			queueRefresh()
		end
	end)
	watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(function()
			invalidateControlsCache()
			bindPlayerGuiConnections(getPlayerGui())
			suppressTouchControls()
			queueRefresh()
		end)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = CoreGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(queueRefresh)
	end)
	watchConnections[#watchConnections + 1] = GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TouchControlsEnabled"):Connect(queueRefresh)
	queueRefresh()
end

local function stopWatching()
	refreshQueued = false
	disconnectConnections(watchConnections)
	disconnectConnections(playerGuiConnections)
	watchedPlayerGui = nil
end

function MobileTouchImmersionHelper:SetHidden(ownerKey:string, hidden:boolean)
	if type(ownerKey) ~= "string" or ownerKey == "" then
		warn("[MobileTouchImmersionHelper] ownerKey is required")
		return
	end
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	if not TOUCH_IMMERSION_ENABLED then
		if hasActiveOwners() or next(trackedInstances) ~= nil or controlsSuppressedByHelper then
			MobileTouchImmersionHelper:ForceRestore()
		end
		return
	end
	local hadOwners = hasActiveOwners()
	if hidden then
		activeOwners[ownerKey] = true
	else
		activeOwners[ownerKey] = nil
	end
	local hasOwnersNow = hasActiveOwners()
	if hasOwnersNow and not hadOwners then
		startWatching()
		suppressTouchControls()
	elseif hadOwners and not hasOwnersNow then
		stopWatching()
		restoreTrackedInstances()
		restoreTouchControls()
		return
	end
	if hasOwnersNow then
		suppressTouchControls()
		queueRefresh()
	end
end

function MobileTouchImmersionHelper:ForceRestore()
	if not RunService:IsClient() then return end
	table.clear(activeOwners)
	stopWatching()
	restoreTrackedInstances()
	restoreTouchControls()
end

return MobileTouchImmersionHelper

function onTagAdded(tree:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local t = 0
    local originCFrame = tree:GetPivot()
    table.insert(connections,tree:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hp"):Connect(function()
        local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
        if hp > 0 then
            -- 跳一下
            t = _speed
        else
            t = 0
            tree:PivotTo(originCFrame)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if t <= 0 then return end

        t -= dt
        if t < 0 then t = 0 end
        local scale = t / _speed
        local rate = math.sin(scale * math.pi)
        tree:PivotTo(originCFrame - _offset * rate)
    end))
end

function onTagAdded(axe: Tool, connections: {RBXScriptConnection})
    local woodSounds = {}
    for _, soundInfo in ipairs(Sounds) do
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = "http://www.roblox.com/Asset/?id=" .. soundInfo[1]
        sound.Parent = axe
        sound.Volume = 1
        if soundInfo[2] == "Wood" then
            table.insert(woodSounds, sound)
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections, axe.Activated:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.2)

        local character: Model = axe.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        local humanoidRootPart: Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then return end

        local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Tree))
        if axe:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PowerAxe) then
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree))
        end
        overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

        local radius = GameHelper.SwordAtkDistance
        local v_range: NumberValue = axe:FindFirstChild("Range")
        -- Known axe prefabs carry the synchronized Range value. Only resolve
        -- the shared profile for tools that lack the legacy fallback.
        local meleeProfile = if v_range then nil else MeleeWeaponSetting.GetByTool(axe)
        if v_range then
            radius = v_range.Value
        elseif meleeProfile and meleeProfile.reach then
            radius = meleeProfile.reach
        end

        local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(humanoidRootPart.Position, radius, overlapParams)
        local hitModels = {}
        local hitSound
        for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
            local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
            if not model or table.find(hitModels, model) then continue end
            table.insert(hitModels, model)
            hitSound = woodSounds[math.random(1, #woodSounds)]
            if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then
                GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S:FireServer(model)
            end
        end

        if hitSound and not hitSound.Playing then
            hitSound:Play()
        end
    end))
end

function onEnemyGunAttack(enemy:Model,targetPlayer:Player,damage:number)
    local target:Model = targetPlayer.Character

    local id = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id)
    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    local bulletRanged = lo.attackDistance + 10

    local enemyRootPart:Part = enemy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRootPart:Part = target:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local startCFrame = enemyRootPart.CFrame
    
    local tool = enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if tool then
        local FirePoint:Attachment = tool:FindFirstChild("FirePoint")
        if FirePoint then
            startCFrame = startCFrame.Rotation + FirePoint.WorldPosition
        end
    end

    local offset = targetRootPart.Position - startCFrame.Position

    local bullet:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Bullet"):Clone()
    bullet.Anchored = true
    bullet.Parent = workspace
    bullet.CFrame = startCFrame
    local targetCFrame:CFrame = startCFrame + offset.Unit * bulletRanged
    local tween = TweenService:Create(bullet,bulletTweenInfo,{
        CFrame = targetCFrame
    })
    tween:Play()
    -- tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
    EffectHelper:AddItem(bullet,bulletTweenInfo.Time,true)

    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("敌人手枪射击", enemyRootPart, {
        TargetUserId = targetPlayer.UserId,
        SourceKey = enemy,
        FallbackPosition = enemyRootPart.Position,
    })

    local lastPos:Vector3 = nil
    -- 每个玩家只负责检测自己的碰撞
    while bullet:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) do
        if lastPos then
            -- print("检测")
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams:AddToFilter({LocalPlayer.Character})
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            local offset = bullet.Position - lastPos
            local hitResult = workspace:Raycast(lastPos,offset.Unit * offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
            if hitResult then
                if LocalPlayer.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BlockAttack) then
                    -- 反伤
                    GameHelper.BlockBulletC2S:FireServer(enemy,damage * 2)
                else
                    -- 承受伤害
                    GameHelper.CharacterTakeDamageC2S:FireServer(damage,enemy)
                end
                -- 命中自己后停止检测，避免重复命中
                break
            end
        end

        if tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
            break
        end
        lastPos = bullet.Position
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end

function onEnemyPoisonedArrowAttack(enemy:Model,targetPlayer:Player,damage:number)
	local isLocalPlayer = targetPlayer == LocalPlayer

    local enemyRootPart:Part = enemy:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local endPos:Vector3 = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head").Position
	local arrow = prefab:Clone()

	arrow.Transparency = 1

				arrow.Transparency = 0
				arrow.Parent = hit
				CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(arrow,hit)

                con:Disconnect()
                return
			end
			lastPos = arrow.Position
        else
            con:Disconnect()
        end
    end)

function onTagAdded(tool:Tool,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if not tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Pickaxe) then return end

    -- local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local nextAttackTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if tool.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end

        local v_PickaxeActivatedCD:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(tool,PickaxeValue.PickaxeActivatedCD)
        local v_PickaxeRange:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(tool,PickaxeValue.PickaxeRange)

        local atkTrack:AnimationTrack = nil

        local ActivatedCon = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local gameTimeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            if gameTimeNow < nextAttackTime then return end
            
            -- 计算CD
            local activatedCD = math.max(v_PickaxeActivatedCD.Value,0.1)
            nextAttackTime = gameTimeNow + activatedCD

            -- 动画
            if not atkTrack then
                local animation:Animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
                atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character, animation or "rbxassetid://90717545543382") -- 砍动作
                atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
                atkTrack.Looped = false
                atkTrack:GetMarkerReachedSignal("Hit"):Connect(function(paramString)
                    -- print("触发事件帧",paramString)
                    -- print("触发采掘伤害判定")
                    local op = OverlapParams.new()
                    op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget))
                    op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

                    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(tool:GetPivot().Position,v_PickaxeRange.Value,op)
                    local hitTargets:{BasePart} = {}
                    for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                        local target = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget)
                        if not target then continue end
                        if table.find(hitTargets,target) then continue end
                        table.insert(hitTargets,target)
                    end

                    GameHelper.PickaxeHitC2S:FireServer(hitTargets)
                end)
            end
            atkTrack:Play()
            atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(1/activatedCD) -- 动画速度匹配攻速
        end)

        tool.Unequipped:Once(function()
            if ActivatedCon then
                ActivatedCon:Disconnect()
                ActivatedCon = nil
            end
            if atkTrack then
                atkTrack:Destroy()
                atkTrack = nil
            end
        end)
    end))
end

local _speed = 0.1
local _offset = Vector3.yAxis * 0.5
function onTagAdded(lode:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_HP:NumberValue = lode:WaitForChild("HP")
    local originCFrame = lode:GetPivot()

    local t = 0
    table.insert(connections,v_HP.Changed:Connect(function(value)
        if v_HP.Value > 0 then
            -- 跳一下
            t = _speed
        else
            t = 0
            lode:PivotTo(originCFrame)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt:number)
        if t <= 0 then return end

        t -= dt
        if t < 0 then t = 0 end
        local scale = t / _speed
        local rate = math.sin(scale * math.pi)
        lode:PivotTo(originCFrame - _offset * rate)
    end))
end

local function getWorldPosition(instance)
	if not instance then
		return nil
	end
	if instance:IsA("Attachment") then
		return instance.WorldPosition
	end
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		return instance.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function findMuzzle(source)
	local tool = source and source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
	if tool then
		local firePoint = tool:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
		local position = getWorldPosition(firePoint)
		if position then
			return position, firePoint
		end
	end
	local head = source and source:FindFirstChild("Head")
	return head and head.Position, head
end

visualEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(source, target)
	if not source or not target or not source:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not target:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return
	end
	local fromPosition, soundParent = findMuzzle(source)
	local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.PrimaryPart
	local toPosition = targetRoot and targetRoot.Position
	if not fromPosition or not toPosition then
		return
	end
	local distance = (toPosition - fromPosition).Magnitude
	if distance <= 0.1 or distance > 500 then
		return
	end

	local tracer = Instance.new("Part")
	tracer.Name = "OldCowboyBulletVisual"
	tracer.Anchored = true
	tracer.CanCollide = false
	tracer.CanQuery = false
	tracer.CanTouch = false
	tracer.CastShadow = false
	tracer.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	tracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 213, 92)
	tracer.Size = Vector3.new(0.07, 0.07, distance)
	tracer.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((fromPosition + toPosition) / 2, toPosition)
	tracer.Parent = workspace

	TweenService:Create(tracer, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
		Transparency = 1,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, distance),
	}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(tracer, 0.15)
	pcall(function()
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect("敌人手枪射击", soundParent, {
            SourceKey = source,
            TargetUserId = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target).UserId or nil,
            FallbackPosition = fromPosition,
        })
	end)
end)

function onMarkerSnapshot(markers:{CommonType.MapMarkerVo})
    table.clear(_markersByUserId)
    for _,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo in ipairs(markers) do
        _markersByUserId[markerVo.userId] = markerVo
    end
    syncAllMapMarkers()
    updateWorldMarkerBillboards()
end

function onMarkerUpsert(markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo)
    _markersByUserId[markerVo.userId] = markerVo
    syncAllMapMarkers()
    updateWorldMarkerBillboard(markerVo.userId,markerVo)
end

function onMarkerRemove(userId:number)
    _markersByUserId[userId] = nil
    setWorldMarkerBillboardVisible(userId,false)
    for map:GuiObject,_ in pairs(_markerGuis) do
        removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map,userId)
    end
end

function init()
    for grid1X=MapHelper.centerGrid1-5,MapHelper.centerGrid1+5 do
        for grid1Z=MapHelper.centerGrid1-5,MapHelper.centerGrid1+5 do
            setIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z,false)
            setFogUI(grid1X,grid1Z,false)
        end

end

function worldPosToMapPos(position:Vector3)
    local pos = position + (MapHelper.mapSize_1 / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1) * CommonEnum.XZ
    local scaleX = pos.X / MapHelper.mapSize
    local scaleZ = pos.Z / MapHelper.mapSize
    return UDim2.fromScale(scaleX,scaleZ)
end

function getMarkerGuiMap(map:GuiObject)
    local markerGuis = _markerGuis[map]
    if not markerGuis then
        markerGuis = {}
        _markerGuis[map] = markerGuis
    end
    return markerGuis
end

function getMarkerDistanceText(position:Vector3)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return "--m" end
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return "--m" end
    return string.format("%dm",math.round((humanoidRootPart.Position - position).Magnitude))
end

function getWorldMarkerModel(userId:number)
    local markerFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("MapMarkers")
    if not markerFolder then return end
    return markerFolder:FindFirstChild(string.format("MapMarker_%d",userId))
end

function getWorldMarkerBillboard(userId:number)
    local markerModel:Model = getWorldMarkerModel(userId)
    if not markerModel then return end

    local root = markerModel:FindFirstChild("Root")
    if root then
        return root:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
    end

    return markerModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui",true)
end

function setWorldMarkerBillboardVisible(userId:number,isVisible:boolean)
    local billboard:BillboardGui = getWorldMarkerBillboard(userId)
    if billboard then
        billboard.Enabled = isVisible
    end
end

function updateWorldMarkerBillboard(userId:number,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo)
    local billboard:BillboardGui = getWorldMarkerBillboard(userId)
    if not billboard then return end

    billboard.Enabled = true

    local t_name:TextLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local t_distance:TextLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("t_distance")
    if t_name then
        t_name.Text = markerVo.nickname
    end
    if t_distance then
        t_distance.Text = getMarkerDistanceText(markerVo.position)
    end
end

function updateWorldMarkerBillboards()
    for userId,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo in pairs(_markersByUserId) do
        updateWorldMarkerBillboard(userId,markerVo)
    end
end

function updateMarkerPortrait(userId:number,img_icon:ImageLabel)
    local portrait = _markerPortraits[userId]
    if portrait then
        img_icon.Image = portrait
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local content, isReady = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
        if not isReady then return end
        _markerPortraits[userId] = content
        if img_icon and img_icon.Parent then
            img_icon.Image = content
        end
    end)
end

function removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map:GuiObject,userId:number)
    local markerGuis = _markerGuis[map]
    if not markerGuis then return end

    local markerGui = markerGuis[userId]
    if markerGui then
        markerGui:Destroy()
        markerGuis[userId] = nil
    end
end

function upsertMarkerGui(map:GuiObject,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo)
    local prefab:GuiObject = findPrefab("MapMarker")
    if not prefab then return end

    local markerGuis = getMarkerGuiMap(map)
    local markerGui:ImageButton = markerGuis[markerVo.userId]
    if not markerGui then
        markerGui = prefab:Clone()
        markerGui.Visible = true
        markerGui.Parent = map
        markerGuis[markerVo.userId] = markerGui

        local markerUserId = markerVo.userId
        markerGui.Activated:Connect(function()
            if markerUserId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                GameHelper.RemoveMapMarkerC2S:FireServer()
            end
        end)
    end

    markerGui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(markerVo.position)
    markerGui.ZIndex = Fog_Z + 40
    markerGui:SetAttribute("userId",markerVo.userId)

    local img_icon:ImageLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("img_icon")
    local t_name:TextLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local t_distance:TextLabel = markerGui:FindFirstChild("t_distance")
    if img_icon then
        img_icon.ZIndex = markerGui.ZIndex + 1
        updateMarkerPortrait(markerVo.userId,img_icon)
    end
    if t_name then
        t_name.ZIndex = markerGui.ZIndex + 2
        t_name.Text = markerVo.nickname
    end
    if t_distance then
        t_distance.ZIndex = markerGui.ZIndex + 2
        t_distance.Text = getMarkerDistanceText(markerVo.position)
    end

    if markerVo.userId == LocalPlayer.UserId then
        markerGui.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,232,160)
    else
        markerGui.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    end
end

function syncMapMarkers(map:GuiObject)
    local markerGuis = getMarkerGuiMap(map)
    for userId,_ in pairs(markerGuis) do
        if not _markersByUserId[userId] then
            removeMarkerGuiByUserId(map,userId)
        end
    end

    for _,markerVo:CommonType.MapMarkerVo in pairs(_markersByUserId) do
        upsertMarkerGui(map,markerVo)
    end
end

function syncAllMapMarkers()
    local maps = CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag_UIMap)
    for _,map:GuiObject in ipairs(maps) do
        syncMapMarkers(map)
    end
end

function canPlaceMarkerAtWorldPos(worldPos:Vector3,campfireLevel:number,campfireHeat:number)
    if campfireHeat <= 0 then
        return false,"Reignite the campfire to place a marker."
    end

    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(worldPos)
    if not MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) then
        return false
    end
    if MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) > campfireLevel then
        return false,"You can't place a marker in a locked area."
    end

    return true
end

function onMarkerMapInput(map:GuiObject,v_heat:NumberValue,v_level:NumberValue,input:InputObject)
    if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end

    local absolutePosition = map.AbsolutePosition
    local absoluteSize = map.AbsoluteSize
    if absoluteSize.X <= 0 or absoluteSize.Y <= 0 then return end

    local scaleX = (input.Position.X - absolutePosition.X) / absoluteSize.X
    local scaleZ = (input.Position.Y - absolutePosition.Y) / absoluteSize.Y
    if scaleX < 0 or scaleX > 1 or scaleZ < 0 or scaleZ > 1 then return end

    local worldPos = MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scaleX,scaleZ)
    local canPlace,tips = canPlaceMarkerAtWorldPos(worldPos,v_level.Value,v_heat.Value)
    if not canPlace then
        if tips then
            UIHelper:PopCenterTips(tips,UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        end
        return
    end

    GameHelper.PlaceMapMarkerC2S:FireServer(Vector2.new(scaleX,scaleZ))
end

function getIsFog(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    if not GameHelper.FogEnable then return false end
    local isFog
    if _explored[grid1X] then
        isFog = _explored[grid1X][grid1Z]
    end
    if isFog == nil then
        isFog = true
    end
    return isFog
end

function setIsFog(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,isFog)
    -- 已经探索过的格子
    if not _explored[grid1X] then _explored[grid1X] = {} end
    _explored[grid1X][grid1Z] = isFog
end

function onClearFog(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    local isFog = getIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z)
    if not isFog then return end

    setIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z,false)
    local r = 2
    for x=grid1X-r,grid1X+r do
        for z=grid1Z-r,grid1Z+r do
            setFogUI(x,z,false)
        end
    end
end

function setFogUIByMap(map:Frame,grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,isFog:boolean)
    local parent:Folder = map:FindFirstChild("迷雾")
    if not parent then
        parent = Instance.new("Folder")
        parent.Name = "迷雾"
        parent.Parent = map
    end
    local name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
    local fog:Frame = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
    if isFog then
        if not fog then
            fog = Instance.new("Frame")
            fog.Name = name
            fog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(146, 140, 121)
            fog.BorderSizePixel = 0
            fog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fogSize,fogSize)
            fog.Position = UDim2.fromScale((grid1X-1) * fogSize,(grid1Z-1) * fogSize)
            fog.ZIndex = Fog_Z
            fog.Parent = parent
        end
    else
        if fog then
            fog:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

function updateLockFog(map:Frame)
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire,CampfireValue.level)

    local parent:Folder = map:FindFirstChild("禁区")
    if not parent then
        parent = Instance.new("Folder")
        parent.Name = "禁区"
        parent.Parent = map
    end
    local ZIndex = Fog_Z + 30
    local offset = 1
    for grid1X = 1-offset,MapHelper.mapSize_1 + offset do
        for grid1Z = 1-offset,MapHelper.mapSize_1 + offset do
            local name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
            local lockFog:Frame = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
            local isLock = true
            if grid1X >= 1 and grid1X <= MapHelper.mapSize_1 and grid1Z >=1 and grid1Z <= MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
                isLock = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z) > v_level.Value
            end

            if isLock then
                if not lockFog then
                    lockFog = Instance.new("Frame")
                    lockFog.Name = name
                    lockFog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(27, 27, 27)
                    lockFog.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    lockFog.Size = UDim2.fromScale(fogSize,fogSize)
                    lockFog.Position = UDim2.fromScale((grid1X-1) * fogSize,(grid1Z-1) * fogSize)
                    lockFog.ZIndex = ZIndex
                    lockFog.Parent = parent
                end
            else
                if lockFog then
                    lockFog:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function setFogUI(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,isFog:boolean)
    if grid1X <= 0 or grid1X > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then return end
    if grid1Z <= 0 or grid1Z > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then return end

    local maps = CollectionService:GetTagged(Tag_UIMap)
    for _,map:Frame in ipairs(maps) do
        setFogUIByMap(map,grid1X,grid1Z,isFog)
    end

    -- 雾霾被清理时，置顶图标
    if not isFog then
        local gridName = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
        if _uiMapPoints[gridName] then
            for _,mapPoint:GuiObject in ipairs(_uiMapPoints[gridName]) do
                mapPoint.ZIndex += Fog_Z
                -- print("置顶图标")
            end
            table.clear(_uiMapPoints[gridName])
        end
    end
end

function drawMapPoint(map:Frame,ins:Model)
    local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(ins:GetPivot().Position)
    local gridName = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)

    if not _uiMapPoints[gridName] then
        _uiMapPoints[gridName] = {}
    end

    local prefab:GuiObject = tryGetPrefabByTargetTag(ins)
    -- if ins:HasTag("UIBuilding") then
    --     prefabName = "building"
    -- elseif ins:HasTag("UITreasure") then
    --     prefabName = "treasure"
    -- elseif ins:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Stronghold) then
    --     prefabName = "wantedman"
    -- elseif ins:HasTag("UIGemTower") then
    --     prefabName = "gemtower"
    -- else
        
    -- end
    if not prefab then return end
    local position:Vector3 = ins:GetPivot().Position
    -- print(prefabName)
    local mapPoint:GuiObject = prefab:Clone()
    mapPoint.Position = worldPosToMapPos(position)
    mapPoint.Visible = true
    mapPoint.Parent = map

    table.insert(_uiMapPoints[gridName],mapPoint)

    if ins:HasTag("UITreasure") then
        if not _treasureGuis[map] then _treasureGuis[map] = {} end
        _treasureGuis[map][ins] = mapPoint

        checkTickTreasure(map,ins)
    elseif ins:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Horse) then
        if not _horseGuis[map] then _horseGuis[map] = {} end
        _horseGuis[map][ins] = mapPoint
    elseif ins:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Train) then
        if not _trainGuis[map] then _trainGuis[map] = {} end

        local dir = ins:GetPivot().LookVector
        local angle = math.atan2(dir.Z, dir.X)
        -- 转换为角度（0-360度）
        local degrees = math.deg(angle)
        local img_dir:ImageLabel = mapPoint:FindFirstChild("img_dir")
        img_dir.Visible = true
        img_dir.Rotation = degrees
        _trainGuis[map][ins] = mapPoint
    end
end

function getGearSourceGuiMap(map:GuiObject)
    local sourceGuis = _gearSourceGuis[map]
    if not sourceGuis then
        sourceGuis = {}
        _gearSourceGuis[map] = sourceGuis
    end
    return sourceGuis
end

function removeGearSourceGui(map:GuiObject, marker:Model)
    local sourceGuis = _gearSourceGuis[map]
    if not sourceGuis then return end
    local gui = sourceGuis[marker]
    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
        sourceGuis[marker] = nil
    end
end

function syncGearSourceGui(map:GuiObject, marker:Model)
    local sourceGuis = getGearSourceGuiMap(map)
    local gui = sourceGuis[marker]
    if not gui then
        local prefab = findPrefab("GearSource")
        if not prefab then return end
        gui = prefab:Clone()
        gui.Name = "GearSource_" .. tostring(marker:GetAttribute("GearSourceId") or marker.Name)
        gui.Parent = map
        sourceGuis[marker] = gui
    end

    if not marker.Parent then
        removeGearSourceGui(map, marker)
        return
    end

    gui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(marker:GetPivot().Position)
    gui.ZIndex = Fog_Z + 45
    gui.Visible = marker:GetAttribute("GearSourceVisible") == true

    local state = marker:GetAttribute("GearSourceState") or "Guarded"
    local color = GearSourceStateColors[state] or GearSourceStateColors.Guarded
    if gui:IsA("ImageLabel") or gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
        gui.ImageColor3 = color
    end
end

function syncGearSourcePoints(map:GuiObject)
    local sourceGuis = getGearSourceGuiMap(map)
    for marker, _ in pairs(sourceGuis) do
        if not marker.Parent then
            removeGearSourceGui(map, marker)
        end
    end

    for _, marker in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GearSourceMarkerTag)) do
        syncGearSourceGui(map, marker)
    end
end

function onTagAdded(map:Frame,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local playerPointPrefab:ImageLabel = findPrefab("playerPointPrefab")
    local Empty:Frame = map:WaitForChild("Empty")
    local campfireGui:ImageLabel = map:WaitForChild("campfire")
    local clickCatcher:GuiButton = map:WaitForChild("btn_clickCatcher")
    local markerTip:TextLabel = map:FindFirstChild("t_markerTip")
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local v_heat:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire,CampfireValue.heat)
    local v_level:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(campfire,CampfireValue.level)

    local playerPoints:{ImageLabel} = {}
    local prefabs:Frame = map:WaitForChild("prefabs")
    prefabs.Visible = false

    if markerTip then
        markerTip.Text = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and MarkerTipTouch or MarkerTipMouse
    end

    local nextStepTime = 0

    -- 初始化营火位置
    campfireGui.Position = worldPosToMapPos(campfire:GetPivot().Position)
    Empty.Visible = v_heat.Value <= 0

    for grid1X = 1,MapHelper.mapSize_1 do
        for grid1Z = 1,MapHelper.mapSize_1 do
            setFogUIByMap(map,grid1X,grid1Z,getIsFog(grid1X,grid1Z))
        end
    end

    for _,building:Model in ipairs(_buildings) do
        drawMapPoint(map,building)
    end
    syncGearSourcePoints(map)
    syncMapMarkers(map)

    updateLockFog(map)
    table.insert(connections,v_level.Changed:Connect(function()
        updateLockFog(map)
    end))
    table.insert(connections,v_heat.Changed:Connect(function(value)
        Empty.Visible = v_heat.Value <= 0
    end))
    table.insert(connections,clickCatcher.InputBegan:Connect(function(input:InputObject)
        onMarkerMapInput(map,v_heat,v_level,input)
    end))
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt:number)

local function getEnemyRoot(enemy: Model): BasePart?
    return enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or enemy.PrimaryPart
end

local function isValidAutoFaceEnemy(enemy: Model)
    if not enemy or not enemy:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    if enemy:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyDeath) then return false end

    local humanoid: Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

    return getEnemyRoot(enemy) ~= nil
end

local function findNearestEnemy(character: Model, humanoidRootPart: BasePart, searchRange: number): Model?
    local nearestEnemy: Model? = nil
    local nearestDistanceSquared = searchRange * searchRange
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
    overlapParams.MaxParts = 128

    debug.profilebegin("Melee.LegacyAutoFace.Query")
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
        humanoidRootPart.Position,
        math.min(searchRange, 25),
        overlapParams
    )
    debug.profileend()

    local seen = {}
    for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
        local taggedEnemy = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(part, GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
        local enemy = taggedEnemy and (taggedEnemy:IsA("Model") and taggedEnemy or CommonFunc:GetModel(taggedEnemy)) or nil
        if enemy
            and not seen[enemy]
            and enemy ~= character
            and isValidAutoFaceEnemy(enemy) then
            seen[enemy] = true
            local enemyRoot = getEnemyRoot(enemy)
            local offset = enemyRoot.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
            local distanceSquared = offset:Dot(offset)
            if distanceSquared <= nearestDistanceSquared then
                nearestDistanceSquared = distanceSquared
                nearestEnemy = enemy
            end
        end
    end

    return nearestEnemy
end

local function faceEnemy(character: Model, humanoidRootPart: BasePart, enemy: Model)
    local humanoid: Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit then return end

    local enemyRoot = getEnemyRoot(enemy)
    if not enemyRoot then return end

    local rootPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
    local enemyPos = enemyRoot.Position
    local flatTarget = Vector3.new(enemyPos.X, rootPos.Y, enemyPos.Z)
    if (flatTarget - rootPos).Magnitude <= 0.1 then return end

    humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, flatTarget)
end

local function startAutoFaceNearestEnemy(character: Model, searchRange: number)
    if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
    local humanoidRootPart: BasePart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart then return end

    local autoFaceSwitch: BoolValue = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("近战自动朝向")
    if not autoFaceSwitch.Value then return end

    -- Query once at swing start, then keep following the locked target.
    -- This preserves the original 0.35s turn feel without repeatedly scanning
    -- every enemy while the player is moving.
    local enemy = findNearestEnemy(character, humanoidRootPart, searchRange)
    if not enemy then return end

    local faceEndTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.35
    task.spawn(function()
        while not newMeleeSwitch.Value
            and character == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            and workspace.DistributedGameTime <= faceEndTime do
            if not autoFaceSwitch.Value or not isValidAutoFaceEnemy(enemy) then return end

            faceEnemy(character, humanoidRootPart, enemy)
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

local function onTagAdded(tool: Tool, connections: {RBXScriptConnection})
    local atkTrack: AnimationTrack?
    local range = GameHelper.SwordAtkDistance
    local atkCD = GameHelper.SwordAtkCD
    local v_range: NumberValue = tool:FindFirstChild("Range")
    local v_AtkCD: NumberValue = tool:FindFirstChild("AtkCD")
    -- Known melee prefabs carry the synchronized Range value. Avoid a cold
    -- ResourcesItemHelper lookup during the first tool registration; only
    -- resolve the shared profile when a tool has no compatible Range fallback.
    local meleeProfile = if v_range then nil else MeleeWeaponSetting.GetByTool(tool)
    if v_range then
        range = v_range.Value
    elseif meleeProfile and meleeProfile.reach then
        range = meleeProfile.reach
    end
    if v_AtkCD then atkCD = v_AtkCD.Value end

    table.insert(connections, tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        local character: Model = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        MeleeCombatClient.RefreshCooldown(tool)
        local animation: Animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
        atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, animation or "rbxassetid://104248433730006")
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
            atkTrack.Looped = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Stop()
            atkTrack:Destroy()
            atkTrack = nil
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        local character: Model = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        if not MeleeCombatClient.TryBeginCooldown(tool, atkCD) then return end

        startAutoFaceNearestEnemy(character, math.clamp(range + 10, 12, 25))

        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Play()
            local speed = 2 * GameHelper.SwordAtkCD / atkCD
            atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed)
        end

        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(swingSounds[math.random(1, #swingSounds)], tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), {
            SourceUserId = game.Players.LocalPlayer.UserId,
            SourceKey = "melee-legacy:" .. tool.Name,
        })

        task.wait(0.2)
        if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end

        local humanoidRootPart: Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoidRootPart then return end

        local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
        overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        overlapParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.IgnorePlayer
        local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cframe.Position, range, overlapParams)
        local hitModels: {Model} = {}
        local hitEnemy = false
        local hitTree = false

        for _, part: BasePart in ipairs(parts) do
            local model = CommonFunc:GetModel(part)
            if not model or table.find(hitModels, model) then continue end
            table.insert(hitModels, model)

            if GameHelper:IsNPC(model) then
                if character == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and not newMeleeSwitch.Value then
                    GameHelper.CharacterHitTargetC2S:FireServer(model)
                end
                hitEnemy = true
            elseif model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Tree) or model:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BigTree) then
                hitTree = true
            end
        end

        if hitEnemy then
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("近战武器Hit1", tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
        elseif hitTree then
            AudioHelper:PlayEffect("砍树", tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
        end
    end))
end

local function onOldCowboyTagAdded(npc:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local humanoidRootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    local hpBillboard = humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if not humanoid or not hpBillboard or not hpBillboard:IsA("BillboardGui") then
        warn("Old Cowboy is missing its authored HumanoidRootPart.HP BillboardGui")
        return
    end

    local canvasGroup = hpBillboard:FindFirstChild("CanvasGroup")
    local bg = canvasGroup and canvasGroup:FindFirstChild("Bg")
    local slide = bg and bg:FindFirstChild("Slide")
    local healthText = canvasGroup and canvasGroup:FindFirstChild("t_health")
    if not canvasGroup or not canvasGroup:IsA("CanvasGroup")
        or not slide or not slide:IsA("GuiObject")
        or not healthText or not healthText:IsA("TextLabel") then
        warn("Old Cowboy authored HP BillboardGui has an invalid hierarchy")
        hpBillboard.Enabled = false
        return
    end

    local function updateHealth()
        if not humanoid.Parent or not hpBillboard.Parent then
            return
        end
        local maxHealth = math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth,1)
        local health = math.clamp(humanoid.Health,0,maxHealth)
        hpBillboard.Enabled = true
        canvasGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
        slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(health / maxHealth,slide.Size.Y.Scale)
        healthText.Text = string.format("%d/%d",math.floor(health + 0.5),math.floor(maxHealth + 0.5))
    end

    updateHealth()
    table.insert(connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(updateHealth))
    table.insert(connections,humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(updateHealth))
end

local function createTracer(origin:Vector3, endPosition:Vector3, color:Color3, width:number, lifetime:number)
    local distance = (endPosition - origin).Magnitude
    if distance <= 0.01 then return end

    local tracer = Instance.new("Part")
    tracer.Name = "SteamWeaponTracer"
    tracer.Anchored = true
    tracer.CanCollide = false
    tracer.CanQuery = false
    tracer.CanTouch = false
    tracer.CastShadow = false
    tracer.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    tracer.Color = color
    tracer.Transparency = 0.15
    tracer.Size = Vector3.new(width, width, distance)
    tracer.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, endPosition) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2)
    tracer.Parent = workspace

    TweenService:Create(tracer, TweenInfo.new(lifetime), {
        Transparency = 1,
        Size = Vector3.new(width * 0.25, width * 0.25, distance),
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(tracer, lifetime + 0.05)
end

local function createGearPulse(position:Vector3, direction:Vector3, color:Color3, diameter:number)
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.01 then return end
    local base = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction.Unit)
    local radius = diameter * 0.42
    local lifetime = 0.2

    for index = 1, 6 do
        local angle = math.rad((index - 1) * 60)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
        local y = math.sin(angle) * radius
        local tooth = Instance.new("Part")
        tooth.Name = "SteamPierceGearPulse"
        tooth.Anchored = true
        tooth.CanCollide = false
        tooth.CanQuery = false
        tooth.CanTouch = false
        tooth.CastShadow = false
        tooth.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        tooth.Color = color
        tooth.Transparency = 0.25
        tooth.Size = Vector3.new(diameter * 0.24, diameter * 0.075, 0.045)
        tooth.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x, y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle)
        tooth.Parent = workspace

        TweenService:Create(tooth, TweenInfo.new(lifetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x * 1.55, y * 1.55, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle),
            Size = Vector3.new(diameter * 0.32, diameter * 0.04, 0.02),
            Transparency = 1,
        }):Play()
        Debris:AddItem(tooth, lifetime + 0.05)
    end
end

GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(gun:Tool, endPos:Vector3, effectData)
    if not gun or typeof(effectData) ~= "table" then return end

    local origin = getFireOrigin(gun)
    if effectData.EffectType == "SteamBurst" then
        if origin and typeof(endPos) == "Vector3" then
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(165, 48, 16), 0.3, 0.18)
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 192, 86), 0.09, 0.1)
            local delta = endPos - origin
            for _, alpha in ipairs({0.22, 0.42, 0.62, 0.82}) do
                createSteamWisp(origin + delta * alpha, Color3.fromRGB(255, 134, 52), 0.9, 0.2)
            end
        end
        local impactPosition = effectData.ImpactPosition
        if typeof(impactPosition) == "Vector3" then
            local blastRadius = tonumber(effectData.BlastRadius) or 12
            createSteamShockwave(impactPosition, blastRadius * 2)
            createSteamPuff(impactPosition, Color3.fromRGB(255, 115, 30), 18)
        end
        if typeof(effectData.HitPositions) == "table" then
            for index, hitPosition in ipairs(effectData.HitPositions) do
