                if typeof(hitPosition) == "Vector3" then
                    createSteamPuff(hitPosition, Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 55), 4.5)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif effectData.EffectType == "SteamPierce" then
        local hitDirection = Vector3.zAxis
        if origin and typeof(endPos) == "Vector3" then
            local delta = endPos - origin
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                hitDirection = delta.Unit
            end
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(190, 104, 20), 0.48, 0.24)
            createTracer(origin, endPos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 184), 0.12, 0.16)
            createGearPulse(origin + delta * 0.35, hitDirection, Color3.fromRGB(255, 187, 54), 2.2)
            createGearPulse(origin + delta * 0.7, hitDirection, Color3.fromRGB(255, 222, 112), 2.8)
        end
        if typeof(effectData.HitPositions) == "table" then
            local hitDiameter = math.max(3.6, (tonumber(effectData.PierceRadius) or 2) * 1.8)
            for index, hitPosition in ipairs(effectData.HitPositions) do
                if index > 4 then break end
                if typeof(hitPosition) == "Vector3" then
                    createSteamPuff(hitPosition, Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 55), 5)
                    createGearPulse(hitPosition, hitDirection, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 92), hitDiameter)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local STEAM_WEAPON_IDS = {
    [614] = true,
    [615] = true,
}
local NORMAL_STEAM_COLOR = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(220, 218, 205), Color3.fromRGB(160, 150, 135))
local HOT_STEAM_COLOR = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 178), Color3.fromRGB(216, 113, 38))
local OVERHEAT_STEAM_COLOR = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 218), Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 28))
local activeHeatVisuals = {}
local playerBindings = {}
local visualHeartbeat
local heartbeatAccumulator = 0

local function getSteamWeaponId(tool:Tool?)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return nil end
    local itemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
    local itemId = itemLo and tonumber(itemLo.id) or tonumber(tool.Name)
    return STEAM_WEAPON_IDS[itemId] and itemId or nil
end

local function getPredictedHeat(player:Player)
    local heat = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamHeat")) or 0
    local state = player:GetAttribute("SteamHeatState") or "Normal"
    local updatedAt = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamHeatUpdatedAt")) or 0
    local coolStartAt = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamHeatCoolStartAt")) or updatedAt
    local ventEndAt = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SteamVentEndAt")) or 0
    local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

    if state == "Normal" then
        local coolingFrom = math.max(updatedAt, coolStartAt)
        if timeNow > coolingFrom then
            heat = math.max(0, heat - (timeNow - coolingFrom) * 14)
        end
    elseif ventEndAt > updatedAt and timeNow < ventEndAt then
        heat *= math.clamp((ventEndAt - timeNow) / (ventEndAt - updatedAt), 0, 1)
    elseif ventEndAt > 0 and timeNow >= ventEndAt then
        heat = 0
        state = "Normal"
    end
    return heat, state
end

local function destroyHeatVisual(tool:Tool)
    local data = activeHeatVisuals[tool]
    if not data then return end
    if data.highlight and data.highlight.Parent then
        data.highlight.Enabled = false
        data.highlight.FillTransparency = 1
    end
    if data.attachment and data.attachment.Parent then
        data.attachment:Destroy()
    end
    activeHeatVisuals[tool] = nil
end

local function updateHeatVisual(data)
    if not data.tool.Parent or data.tool.Parent ~= data.player.Character then
        destroyHeatVisual(data.tool)
        return false
    end

    local heat, state = getPredictedHeat(data.player)
    local active = heat > 0.05 or state ~= "Normal"
    if data.highlight and data.highlight.Parent then
        data.highlight.Enabled = active
        if state == "Overheated" then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 18)
        elseif heat >= 70 then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.62
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(236, 63, 18)
        elseif heat >= 40 then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.78
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 72, 20)
        elseif heat > 0.05 then
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 0.9
            data.highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(148, 46, 13)
        else
            data.highlight.FillTransparency = 1
        end
    end
    data.emitter.Enabled = active
    if not active then
        data.emitter.Rate = 0
        return false
    end

    if state == "Overheated" then
        data.emitter.Color = OVERHEAT_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 46
    elseif state == "ManualVent" then
        data.emitter.Color = HOT_STEAM_COLOR
        if heat >= 70 then
            data.emitter.Rate = 38
        elseif heat >= 40 then
            data.emitter.Rate = 28
        else
            data.emitter.Rate = 18
        end
    elseif heat >= 70 then
        data.emitter.Color = HOT_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 34
    elseif heat >= 40 then
        data.emitter.Color = HOT_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 22
    else
        data.emitter.Color = NORMAL_STEAM_COLOR
        data.emitter.Rate = 10
    end
    return true
end

local function stopVisualHeartbeatIfIdle()
    if visualHeartbeat then
        visualHeartbeat:Disconnect()
        visualHeartbeat = nil
    end
    heartbeatAccumulator = 0
end

local function ensureVisualHeartbeat()
    if visualHeartbeat then return end
    visualHeartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        heartbeatAccumulator += dt
        if heartbeatAccumulator < 0.1 then return end
        heartbeatAccumulator = 0

        local hasActiveSteam = false
        for _, data in pairs(activeHeatVisuals) do
            if updateHeatVisual(data) then
                hasActiveSteam = true
            end
        end
        if not hasActiveSteam then
            stopVisualHeartbeatIfIdle()
        end
    end)
end

local function createHeatVisual(player:Player, tool:Tool)
    if activeHeatVisuals[tool] then return activeHeatVisuals[tool] end
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end

    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Name = "SteamHeatVentAttachment"
    attachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, handle.Size.Y * 0.35, 0)
    attachment.Parent = handle

    local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    emitter.Name = "SteamHeatEmitter"
    emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"
    emitter.Enabled = false
    emitter.Rate = 0
    emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35, 0.65)
    emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 3.2)
    emitter.Drag = 2
    emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
    emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(38, 38)
    emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-25, 25)
    emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
    emitter.LightEmission = 0.25
    emitter.LightInfluence = 0.25
    emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, 0.62),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.65),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.1),
    })
    emitter.Parent = attachment

    local data = {
        player = player,
        tool = tool,
        attachment = attachment,
        emitter = emitter,
        highlight = tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Highlight", true),
    }
    activeHeatVisuals[tool] = data
    if updateHeatVisual(data) then
        ensureVisualHeartbeat()
    end
    return data
end

local function refreshPlayerWeapon(player:Player)
    local character = player.Character
    local equipped = {}
    if character then
        for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") and getSteamWeaponId(child) then
                equipped[child] = true
                local data = createHeatVisual(player, child)
                if data and updateHeatVisual(data) then
                    ensureVisualHeartbeat()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local stale = {}
    for tool, data in pairs(activeHeatVisuals) do
        if data.player == player and not equipped[tool] then
            table.insert(stale, tool)
        end
    end
    for _, tool in ipairs(stale) do
        destroyHeatVisual(tool)
    end
end

local function disconnectConnections(connections)
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(connections)
end

local function bindCharacter(player:Player, character:Model)
    local binding = playerBindings[player]
    if not binding then return end
    disconnectConnections(binding.character)
    table.insert(binding.character, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
        task.defer(refreshPlayerWeapon, player)
    end))
    table.insert(binding.character, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
        task.defer(refreshPlayerWeapon, player)
    end))
    task.defer(refreshPlayerWeapon, player)
end

local function bindPlayer(player:Player)
    if playerBindings[player] then return end
    local binding = {persistent = {}, character = {}}
    playerBindings[player] = binding

    for _, attributeName in ipairs({"SteamHeat", "SteamHeatUpdatedAt", "SteamHeatCoolStartAt", "SteamHeatState", "SteamVentEndAt"}) do
        table.insert(binding.persistent, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attributeName):Connect(function()
            refreshPlayerWeapon(player)
        end))
    end
    table.insert(binding.persistent, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        bindCharacter(player, character)
    end))
    table.insert(binding.persistent, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        refreshPlayerWeapon(player)
    end))
    if player.Character then
        bindCharacter(player, player.Character)
    end
end

local function unbindPlayer(player:Player)
    local binding = playerBindings[player]
    if binding then
        disconnectConnections(binding.persistent)
        disconnectConnections(binding.character)
        playerBindings[player] = nil
    end
    local stale = {}
    for tool, data in pairs(activeHeatVisuals) do
        if data.player == player then
            table.insert(stale, tool)
        end
    end
    for _, tool in ipairs(stale) do
        destroyHeatVisual(tool)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unbindPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    bindPlayer(player)
end

function checkRefreshLight()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local FilmMode:ScreenGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("FilmMode")
    local newStats = LightState.daytime
    if character and character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InSnowstorm) then
        -- 在暴风雪中,优先级高于一切
        newStats = LightState.snowstorm
    elseif FilmMode and FilmMode.Enabled then
        -- 播放CG中
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            newStats = LightState.daytime
        else
            if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightInCampfire
            else
                newStats = LightState.nightInCampfire
            end
        end
    else
        if v_isDaytime.Value then
            newStats = LightState.daytime
        else
            local isAlive = GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character)
            if isAlive then
                if GameHelper:IsOnCave() then
                    newStats = LightState.daytime
                elseif GameHelper:IsInCampfire(character:GetPivot().Position) then
                    if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                        newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightInCampfire
                    else
                        newStats = LightState.nightInCampfire
                    end
                else
                    if GameHelper:IsLampLight() then
                        if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                            newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightLampOn
                        else
                            newStats = LightState.nightLampOn
                        end
                    else
                        if v_isFullMoon.Value then
                            -- 满月关灯状态
                            newStats = LightState.fullMoonNightLampOff
                        else
                            -- 普通关灯状态
                            newStats = LightState.nightLampOff
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    setLightState(newStats)
end

-- 砍树
function fellTreesStart()
    setTipVisible("Tip_砍树",true)

    local campfirePos = _campfire:GetPivot().Position

    _campfireUI = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("Guide"):WaitForChild("Campfire"):Clone()
    _campfireUI.Position = campfirePos
    _campfireUI.Parent = workspace

    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Tree))
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(campfirePos,100,overlapParams)
    for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
        local tree:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Tree)
        if _treeUIs[tree] then continue end

        local treeUI:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("Guide"):WaitForChild("Wood"):Clone()
        treeUI.Position = tree:GetPivot().Position
        treeUI.Parent = workspace
        _treeUIs[tree] = treeUI

        local removeGuideUI = function()
            if _treeUIs[tree] then
                _treeUIs[tree]:Destroy()
                _treeUIs[tree] = nil
            end
        end
        tree:GetAttributeChangedSignal("hp"):Connect(function()
            local hp = tree:GetAttribute("hp")
            if hp <= 0 then
                removeGuideUI()
            end
        end)
        tree.Destroying:Connect(removeGuideUI)
    end
    -- local storeCon:RBXScriptConnection
    -- storeCon = BagHelper.onBagStore.Event:Connect(function(item:Model)
    --     if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Wood) then
    --         storeCon:Disconnect()
    --         fellTreesEnd()
    --         lightFireStart()
    --     end
    -- end)
    -- _fellTreeCon = CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.Tree,function()

    -- end)
    _fellTreeCon = GameHelper.FelledTreeS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(tree:Model)
        if _treeUIs[tree] then
            _treeUIs[tree]:Destroy()
            _treeUIs[tree] = nil
        end
        setTipVisible("Tip_砍树",false)
        setTipVisible("Tip_生火",true)
    end)
end

function lightFireEnd()
    setTipVisible("Tip_砍树",false)
    setTipVisible("Tip_生火",false)
    if _fellTreeCon then
        _fellTreeCon:Disconnect()
        _fellTreeCon = nil
    end
    if _campfireUI then
        _campfireUI:Destroy()
        _campfireUI = nil
    end
    for _,treeUI in pairs(_treeUIs) do
        treeUI:Destroy()
    end
    _treeUIs = {}
end

function updateFogColor(fog:Part)
    local v_originColor:Color3Value = fog:WaitForChild("originColor")
    if v_isDaytime.Value then
        fog.Color = v_originColor.Value
    else
        fog.Color = Color3.fromRGB(83, 83, 83)
    end
end

function onGoundTagAdded(ground:Part,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local grid:Vector3 = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(ground, GroundValue.grid)
    -- local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid.X,grid.Z)
    -- local pos = Vector3.new(posX,0,posZ)
    local pos = ground.Position
    -- local isFog = (centerPos - pos).Magnitude > distance
    if GameHelper.FogEnable then
        local name = string.format("迷雾%s",ground.Name)
        local fog:Part = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
        -- 创建雾霾
        if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ClearFog)  then
            if fog then fog:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Fog) end
        else
            if not fog then
                fog = _fogPrefab:Clone()
                fog.Anchored = true
                fog.Name = name
                fog.Size = fog.Size * Vector3.yAxis + ground.Size * CommonEnum.XZ - SIZE_OFFSET
                fog.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
                fog:SetAttribute("grid1X",grid.X)
                fog:SetAttribute("grid1Z",grid.Z)
                fog:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Fog)
                fog.Parent = workspace

                local v_originColor:Color3Value = fog:WaitForChild("originColor")
                if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SnowfieldGround) then
                    v_originColor.Value = Color3.new(1,1,1)
                else
                    v_originColor.Value = _fogPrefab.Color
                end
                -- CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(ground,fog,fog)
                updateFogColor(fog)
            end
        end
    end
end

function onFogTagAdded(fog:Part, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    table.insert(connections,fog.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
        local character = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player)
        if character then
            GameHelper:ClearFog(fog)
        end
    end))
end

function onFogTagRemoved(fog:Part)
    fog.Parent = workspace

    fog.CanQuery = false
    TweenService:Create(fog,TweenInfo.new(1),{
        Transparency = 1
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(fog,2)
end

function checkPlayBossFightMusic()
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then
        return
    end

    local isPlay = false
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround) then
        local boss = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.BullKing)[1]
        if boss then
            local v_sleep:BoolValue = boss:WaitForChild("Values"):WaitForChild("Sleep")
            if v_sleep.Value then
                v_sleep.Changed:Once(checkPlayBossFightMusic)
            else
                isPlay = true
            end
        end
    elseif character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround) then
        local boss = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.WildBoarKing)[1]
        if boss then
            local v_sleep:BoolValue = boss:WaitForChild("Sleeping")
            if v_sleep.Value then
                v_sleep.Changed:Once(checkPlayBossFightMusic)
            else
                isPlay = true
            end
        end
    end

    local music:Sound = SoundService:WaitForChild("Boss战斗")
    if music then
        if isPlay then
            if not music.Playing then
                music:Play()
            end
        else
            if music.Playing then
                music:Stop()
            end
        end
    end

end

function addUseTimes(animal:Model)
    local v_useTimes: IntValue = animal:FindFirstChild("听铃铛次数")
    if not v_useTimes then
        v_useTimes = Instance.new("IntValue")
        v_useTimes.Name = "听铃铛次数"
        v_useTimes.Value = 0
        v_useTimes.Parent = animal

        local IntimacyGUIPrefab:BillboardGui = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("驯服"):WaitForChild("IntimacyGUIPrefab"):Clone()
        local t_num:TextLabel = IntimacyGUIPrefab:WaitForChild("t_num")
        v_useTimes.Changed:Connect(function(value)
            local text = ""
            for i=1,value do
                text = text.."🔔"
            end
            t_num.Text = text
        end)
        IntimacyGUIPrefab.Parent = animal:WaitForChild("Head")
    end
    v_useTimes.Value += 1
    return v_useTimes.Value
end

function getIds(bell:Tool)
    local v_ids:StringValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(bell,"可驯服敌人ID")
    local ids:{number} = {}
    local strIds = string.split(v_ids.Value,",")
    for _,strId in ipairs(strIds) do
        local id = tonumber(strId)
        if id then
            table.insert(ids, id)
        end
    end
    return ids
end

function onTagAdded(bell:Tool,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local useTrack:AnimationTrack = nil
    local v_buddy:ObjectValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(bell,BellValue.buddy)

    local ActivatedSound:Sound = bell:FindFirstChild("触发音效",true)
    local nextUseTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,bell.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if bell.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end

        local r = 15
        local beam:Beam = nil

        if not v_buddy.Value then
            beam = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("BuddyBeam"):Clone()
            beam.Attachment0.CFrame = CFrame.new()
            beam.Attachment1 = nil
            beam.Parent = bell:WaitForChild("Handle")
        end

        local ids = getIds(bell)

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        useTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, "rbxassetid://104248433730006") -- 砍动作
        useTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
        useTrack.Looped = false

        local closestAnimal:Model = nil
        local con = bell.Activated:Connect(function()
            local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
            if timeNow < nextUseTime then return end
            nextUseTime = timeNow + 1 -- 1秒使用间隔


            if v_buddy.Value then
                local buddy:Model = v_buddy.Value
                GameHelper.CallBuddyC2S:FireServer(buddy)

                local head:Part = buddy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    EffectHelper:PlayAttachmentEffect("摇铃",head,1)
                end
            else
                if closestAnimal then
                    local times = addUseTimes(closestAnimal)
                    if times >= 5 then
                        -- print("驯服",animal.Name)
                        GameHelper.TameAnimalC2S:FireServer(closestAnimal,closestAnimal:GetPivot())
                    end

                    local head:Part = closestAnimal:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if head then
                        EffectHelper:PlayAttachmentEffect("摇铃",head,1)
                    end
                end
            end

            useTrack:Play()
            if ActivatedSound then
                ActivatedSound:Play()
            else
                AudioHelper:PlayEffect("铃铛")
            end
            EffectHelper:PlayAttachmentEffect("摇铃",bell:WaitForChild("Handle"),1)
        end)

        local onClear = function()
            if beam then
                beam:Destroy()
                beam = nil
            end
        end
        v_buddy.Changed:Once(function()
            if v_buddy.Value then
                onClear()
            end
        end)
        bell.Unequipped:Once(function()
            if con then
                con:Disconnect()
                con = nil
            end
            if useTrack then
                useTrack:Destroy()
                useTrack = nil
            end
            onClear()
        end)

        while true do
            task.wait(0.2)
            if bell.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then break end
            if v_buddy.Value then break end

            -- 查找身边的动物
            local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
            overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Animal))
            overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local checkedAnimals = {}
            local closestDistance = 999999
            closestAnimal = nil
            local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(bell:GetPivot().Position,r,overlapParams)
            for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
                if not hit.Parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Animal) then continue end
                local animal:Model = hit.Parent
                if table.find(checkedAnimals,animal) then continue end
                table.insert(checkedAnimals,animal)

                local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLoByEnemy(animal)
                if not lo then continue end
                if not table.find(ids,lo.id) then continue end -- 不能驯服这个

                local distance = CommonFunc:GetDistance(animal,bell,false)
                if distance < closestDistance then
                    closestDistance = distance
                    closestAnimal = animal
                end
            end

            if beam then
                if closestAnimal then
                    local Attachment1Parent = closestAnimal:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local BuddyBeamAttachment1:Attachment = Attachment1Parent:FindFirstChild("BuddyBeamAttachment1")
                    if not BuddyBeamAttachment1 then
                        BuddyBeamAttachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        BuddyBeamAttachment1.Name = "BuddyBeamAttachment1"
                        BuddyBeamAttachment1.Parent = Attachment1Parent
                    end
                    beam.Attachment1 = BuddyBeamAttachment1
                else
                    beam.Attachment1 = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

local swingSounds = {"近战武器Swing1", "近战武器Swing2"}

local function onTagAdded(tool: Tool, connections: {RBXScriptConnection})
    local atkTrack: AnimationTrack?
    table.insert(connections, tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end

        local character = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        MeleeCombatClient.RefreshCooldown(tool)
        local animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
        atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, animation or "rbxassetid://104248433730006")
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
            atkTrack.Looped = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Stop()
            atkTrack:Destroy()
            atkTrack = nil
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        if not newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
        local character = tool.Parent
        if character ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then return end

        local profile = MeleeCombatClient.GetProfile(tool)
        if not profile then return end
        local cooldown = profile.cooldown or GameHelper.SwordAtkCD
        if not MeleeCombatClient.TryBeginCooldown(tool, cooldown) then return end

        if not atkTrack then
            local animation = tool:FindFirstChild("AttackAnimation")
            atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character, animation or "rbxassetid://104248433730006")
            if atkTrack then
                atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
                atkTrack.Looped = false
            end
        end

        if atkTrack then
            atkTrack:Play()
            atkTrack:AdjustSpeed(2 * GameHelper.SwordAtkCD / cooldown)
        end
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect(swingSounds[math.random(1, #swingSounds)], tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), {
            SourceUserId = game.Players.LocalPlayer.UserId,
            SourceKey = "melee-swing-v2:" .. tool.Name,
        })

        MeleeCombatClient.BeginSwing(tool, character)
    end))
end

local HEAL_HIGHLIGHT_DURATION = 0.8
local healHighlightPrefab:Highlight = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Highlights"):WaitForChild("CraftHighlight")
local activeHealHighlights = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function showHealHighlight(target:Model)
	local state = activeHealHighlights[target]
	local highlight = state and state.highlight
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
		highlight = healHighlightPrefab:Clone()
		highlight.Name = "HealHighlight"
		highlight.Adornee = target
		highlight.FillTransparency = 1
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
		highlight.Enabled = true
		highlight.Parent = target
		local tween = TweenService:Create(highlight,TweenInfo.new(0.4,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),{
			FillTransparency = 0.35,
			OutlineTransparency = 0.15,
		})
		tween:Play()
		state = {
			highlight = highlight,
			tween = tween,
			generation = 0,
		}
		activeHealHighlights[target] = state
	end

	state.generation += 1
	local generation = state.generation
	task.delay(HEAL_HIGHLIGHT_DURATION,function()
		if activeHealHighlights[target] ~= state or state.generation ~= generation then
			return
		end
		activeHealHighlights[target] = nil
		if state.tween then
			state.tween:Cancel()
		end
		if highlight.Parent then
			highlight:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

	splashAttachments = {}
	rainAttachments = {}
	
	for i = 1, RAIN_SPLASH_NUM do
		
		-- splashes on ground
		local splashAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		splashAttachment.Name = "__RainSplashAttachment"
		local splash = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		splash.LightEmission = RAIN_DEFAULT_LIGHTEMISSION
		splash.LightInfluence = RAIN_DEFAULT_LIGHTINFLUENCE
		splash.Size = RAIN_SPLASH_SIZE
		splash.Texture = RAIN_SPLASH_ASSET
		splash.Rotation = RAIN_SPLASH_ROTATION
		splash.Lifetime = RAIN_SPLASH_LIFETIME
		splash.Transparency = NumberSequence.new {
			NSK010;
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T1, RAIN_SPLASH_ALPHA_LOW, 0);
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T2, RAIN_SPLASH_ALPHA_LOW, 0);
			NSK110;
		}
		splash.Enabled = false
		splash.Rate = 0
		splash.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
		splash.Name = "RainSplash"
		splash.Parent = splashAttachment
		splashAttachment.Archivable = false
		table.insert(splashAttachments, splashAttachment)
		
		-- occluded rain particle generation
		local rainAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		rainAttachment.Name = "__RainOccludedAttachment"
		local straightOccluded = Emitter.RainStraight:Clone()
		straightOccluded.Speed = NumberRange.new(RAIN_OCCLUDED_MINSPEED, RAIN_OCCLUDED_MAXSPEED)
		straightOccluded.SpreadAngle = RAIN_OCCLUDED_SPREAD
		straightOccluded.LockedToPart = false
		straightOccluded.Enabled = false
		straightOccluded.Parent = rainAttachment
		local topdownOccluded = Emitter.RainTopDown:Clone()
		topdownOccluded.Speed = NumberRange.new(RAIN_OCCLUDED_MINSPEED, RAIN_OCCLUDED_MAXSPEED)
		topdownOccluded.SpreadAngle = RAIN_OCCLUDED_SPREAD
		topdownOccluded.LockedToPart = false
		topdownOccluded.Enabled = false
		topdownOccluded.Parent = rainAttachment
		rainAttachment.Archivable = false
		table.insert(rainAttachments, rainAttachment)
		
	end
	
end


-- Helper methods:

local ignoreEmitterList = { Emitter }

local raycastFunctions = {
	[CollisionMode.None] = function(ray, ignoreCharacter)
		return workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, ignoreCharacter and {Emitter, Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer.Character} or ignoreEmitterList)
	end;
	[CollisionMode.Blacklist] = function(ray)
		return workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, collisionList)
	end;
	[CollisionMode.Whitelist] = function(ray)
		return workspace:FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist(ray, collisionList)
	end;
	[CollisionMode.Function] = function(ray)
		local destination = ray.Origin + ray.Direction
		-- draw multiple raycasts concatenated to each other until no hit / valid hit found
		while ray.Direction.magnitude > 0.001 do
			local part, pos, norm, mat = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, ignoreEmitterList)
			if not part or collisionFunc(part) then
				return part, pos, norm, mat
			end
			local start = pos + ray.Direction.Unit * 0.001
			ray = Ray.new(start, destination - start)
		end
	end;
}
local raycast = raycastFunctions[collisionMode]

local function connectLoop()
	
	local rand = Random.new()
	
	local inside = true					-- Whether camera is currently in a spot occluded from the sky
	local frame = RAIN_UPDATE_PERIOD	-- Frame counter, and force update cycle right now
	
	-- Update Emitter on RenderStepped since it needs to be synced to Camera
	table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:connect(function()
		
		-- Check if camera is outside or inside
		local part, position = raycast(Ray.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.p, -rainDirection * RAIN_SCANHEIGHT), true)
		
		if (not currentCeiling or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.p.y <= currentCeiling) and not part then
			
			-- Camera is outside and under ceiling
				
			if volumeTarget < 1 and not disabled then
				volumeTarget = 1
				TweenService:Create(Sound, TweenInfo.new(.5), {Volume = 1}):Play()
			end
			
			frame = RAIN_UPDATE_PERIOD
			
			local t = math.abs(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.lookVector:Dot(rainDirection))
			
			local center = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.p
			local right = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.lookVector:Cross(-rainDirection)
			right = right.magnitude > 0.001 and right.unit or -rainDirection
			local forward = rainDirection:Cross(right).unit
			
			Emitter.Size = v3(
				RAIN_EMITTER_DIM_DEFAULT,
				RAIN_EMITTER_DIM_DEFAULT,
				RAIN_EMITTER_DIM_DEFAULT + (1 - t)*(RAIN_EMITTER_DIM_MAXFORWARD - RAIN_EMITTER_DIM_DEFAULT)
			)
			
			Emitter.CFrame =
				CFrame.new(
					center.x, center.y, center.z,
					right.x, -rainDirection.x, forward.x,
					right.y, -rainDirection.y, forward.y,
					right.z, -rainDirection.z, forward.z
				)
				+ (1 - t) * workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.lookVector * Emitter.Size.Z/3
				- t * rainDirection * RAIN_EMITTER_UP_MODIFIER
			
			Emitter.RainStraight.Enabled = true
			Emitter.RainTopDown.Enabled = true
			
			inside = false
			
		else
			
			-- Camera is inside / above ceiling
			
			Emitter.RainStraight.Enabled = false
			Emitter.RainTopDown.Enabled = false
		
			inside = true
			
		end
		
	end))

	-- Do the other effects on Stepped
	local signal = RunService:IsRunning() and RunService.Stepped or RunService.RenderStepped
	table.insert(connections, signal:connect(function()
		
		frame = frame + 1
		
		-- Only do some updates once every few frames
		if frame >= RAIN_UPDATE_PERIOD then
			
			-- Measure of how much camera is facing down (0-1)
			local t = math.abs(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.lookVector:Dot(rainDirection))
			
			-- More looking down = see straight particles less and see top-down particles more
			local straightSequence = NumberSequence.new {
				NSK010;
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T1, (1 - t)*straightLowAlpha + t, 0);
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T2, (1 - t)*straightLowAlpha + t, 0);
				NSK110;
			}
			local topdownSequence = NumberSequence.new {
				NSK010;
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T1, t*topdownLowAlpha + (1 - t), 0);
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T2, t*topdownLowAlpha + (1 - t), 0);
				NSK110;
			}
			
			-- Find desired rotation for the straight rain particles
			local mapped = workspace.Camera.CFrame:inverse() * (workspace.Camera.CFrame.p - rainDirection)
			local straightRotation = NumberRange.new(math.deg(math.atan2(-mapped.x, mapped.y)))
			
			if inside then
				
				-- Update emitter properties
				for _,v in pairs(rainAttachments) do
					v.RainStraight.Transparency = straightSequence
					v.RainStraight.Rotation = straightRotation
					v.RainTopDown.Transparency = topdownSequence
				end
				
				if not disabled then
					
					-- Only do occluded volume check if not moving towards disabled state
					
					local volume = 0
					
					if (not currentCeiling or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.p.y <= currentCeiling) then
						
						-- Check how far away camera is from a space open to the sky using volume scan grid
						
						local minDistance = RAIN_VOLUME_SCAN_RADIUS
						local rayDirection = -rainDirection * RAIN_SCANHEIGHT
						
						for i = 1, #volumeScanGrid do -- In order, so first hit is closest
							if not raycast(Ray.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * volumeScanGrid[i], rayDirection), true) then
								minDistance = volumeScanGrid[i].magnitude
								break
							end
						end
						
						-- Volume is inversely proportionate to minimum distance
						volume = 1 - minDistance / RAIN_VOLUME_SCAN_RADIUS
						
					end
					
					if math.abs(volume - volumeTarget) > .01 then
						-- Value is sufficiently different from previous target, overwrite it
						volumeTarget = volume
						TweenService:Create(Sound, TweenInfo.new(1), {Volume = volumeTarget}):Play()
					end
					
				end
				
			else
				
				-- Update emitter properties
				Emitter.RainStraight.Transparency = straightSequence
				Emitter.RainStraight.Rotation = straightRotation
				Emitter.RainTopDown.Transparency = topdownSequence
				
			end
			
			-- Reset frame counter
			frame = 0
			
		end
		
		local center = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.p
		local right = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.lookVector:Cross(-rainDirection)
		right = right.magnitude > 0.001 and right.unit or -rainDirection
		local forward = rainDirection:Cross(right).unit
		local transform = CFrame.new(
			center.x, center.y, center.z,
			right.x, -rainDirection.x, forward.x,
			right.y, -rainDirection.y, forward.y,
			right.z, -rainDirection.z, forward.z
		)
		local rayDirection = rainDirection * RAIN_OCCLUDECHECK_SCAN_Y
		
		-- Splash and occlusion effects
		for i = 1, numSplashes do
			
			local splashAttachment = splashAttachments[i]
			local rainAttachment = rainAttachments[i]
			
			-- Sample random splash position
			local x = rand:NextNumber(RAIN_OCCLUDECHECK_OFFSET_XZ_MIN, RAIN_OCCLUDECHECK_OFFSET_XZ_MAX)
			local z = rand:NextNumber(RAIN_OCCLUDECHECK_OFFSET_XZ_MIN, RAIN_OCCLUDECHECK_OFFSET_XZ_MAX)
			local part, position, normal = raycast(Ray.new(transform * v3(x, RAIN_OCCLUDECHECK_OFFSET_Y, z), rayDirection))
			
			if part then
				
				-- Draw a splash at hit
				splashAttachment.Position = position + normal * RAIN_SPLASH_CORRECTION_Y
				splashAttachment.RainSplash:Emit(1)
				
				if inside then
					
					-- Draw occlusion rain particles a little bit above the splash position
					local corrected = position - rainDirection * RAIN_SPLASH_STRAIGHT_OFFSET_Y
					if currentCeiling and corrected.Y > currentCeiling and rainDirection.Y < 0 then
						corrected = corrected + rainDirection * (currentCeiling - corrected.Y) / rainDirection.Y
					end
					rainAttachment.CFrame = transform - transform.p + corrected
					rainAttachment.RainStraight:Emit(intensityOccludedRain)
					rainAttachment.RainTopDown:Emit(intensityOccludedRain)
					
				end
				
			elseif inside then
				
				-- Draw occlusion rain particles on the XZ-position at around the camera's height
				local corrected = transform * v3(x, rand:NextNumber(RAIN_NOSPLASH_STRAIGHT_OFFSET_Y_MIN, RAIN_NOSPLASH_STRAIGHT_OFFSET_Y_MAX), z)
				if currentCeiling and corrected.Y > currentCeiling and rainDirection.Y < 0 then
					corrected = corrected + rainDirection * (currentCeiling - corrected.Y) / rainDirection.Y
				end
				rainAttachment.CFrame = transform - transform.p + corrected
				rainAttachment.RainStraight:Emit(intensityOccludedRain)
				rainAttachment.RainTopDown:Emit(intensityOccludedRain)
				
			end
			
		end
		
	end))

end

local function disconnectLoop()
	-- If present, disconnect all RunService connections
	if #connections > 0 then
		for _,v in pairs(connections) do
			v:disconnect()
		end
		connections = {}
	end
end

local function disableSound(tweenInfo)
	
	-- Tween the rain sound to be mute over a given easing function
	volumeTarget = 0
	local tween = TweenService:Create(Sound, tweenInfo, {Volume = 0})
	tween.Completed:connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
			Sound:Stop()
		end
		tween:Destroy()
	end)
	tween:Play()
	
end

local function disable()
	
	disconnectLoop()
	
	-- Hide Emitter
	Emitter.RainStraight.Enabled = false
	Emitter.RainTopDown.Enabled = false
	Emitter.Size = MIN_SIZE
	
	-- Disable sound now if not tweened into disabled state beforehand
	if not disabled then
		disableSound(TweenInfo.new(RAIN_SOUND_FADEOUT_TIME))
	end
	
end

-- Shorthand for creating a tweenable "variable" using value object
local function makeProperty(valueObjectClass, defaultValue, setter)
	local valueObject = Instance.new(valueObjectClass)
	if defaultValue then
		valueObject.Value = defaultValue
	end
	valueObject.Changed:connect(setter)
	setter(valueObject.Value)
	return valueObject
end

local Color = makeProperty("Color3Value", RAIN_DEFAULT_COLOR, function(value)
	
	local value = ColorSequence.new(value)
	
	Emitter.RainStraight.Color = value
	Emitter.RainTopDown.Color = value
	
	for _,v in pairs(splashAttachments) do
		v.RainSplash.Color = value
	end
	for _,v in pairs(rainAttachments) do
		v.RainStraight.Color = value
		v.RainTopDown.Color = value
	end
	
end)

local function updateTransparency(value)
	
	local opacity = (1 - value) * (1 - GlobalModifier.Value)
	local transparency = 1 - opacity
	
	straightLowAlpha = RAIN_STRAIGHT_ALPHA_LOW * opacity + transparency
	topdownLowAlpha = RAIN_TOPDOWN_ALPHA_LOW * opacity + transparency
	
	local splashSequence = NumberSequence.new {
		NSK010;
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T1, opacity*RAIN_SPLASH_ALPHA_LOW + transparency, 0);
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(RAIN_TRANSPARENCY_T2, opacity*RAIN_SPLASH_ALPHA_LOW + transparency, 0);
		NSK110;
	}
	
	for _,v in pairs(splashAttachments) do
		v.RainSplash.Transparency = splashSequence
	end
	
end
local Transparency = makeProperty("NumberValue", RAIN_DEFAULT_TRANSPARENCY, updateTransparency)
GlobalModifier.Changed:connect(updateTransparency)

local SpeedRatio = makeProperty("NumberValue", RAIN_DEFAULT_SPEEDRATIO, function(value)
	
	Emitter.RainStraight.Speed = NumberRange.new(value * RAIN_STRAIGHT_MAX_SPEED)
	Emitter.RainTopDown.Speed = NumberRange.new(value * RAIN_TOPDOWN_MAX_SPEED)
	
end)

local IntensityRatio = makeProperty("NumberValue", RAIN_DEFAULT_INTENSITYRATIO, function(value)
	
	Emitter.RainStraight.Rate = RAIN_STRAIGHT_MAX_RATE * value
	Emitter.RainTopDown.Rate = RAIN_TOPDOWN_MAX_RATE * value
	
	intensityOccludedRain = math.ceil(RAIN_OCCLUDED_MAXINTENSITY * value)
	numSplashes = RAIN_SPLASH_NUM * value
	
end)

local LightEmission = makeProperty("NumberValue", RAIN_DEFAULT_LIGHTEMISSION, function(value)
	
	Emitter.RainStraight.LightEmission = value
	Emitter.RainTopDown.LightEmission = value
	
	for _,v in pairs(rainAttachments) do
		v.RainStraight.LightEmission = value
		v.RainTopDown.LightEmission = value
	end
	for _,v in pairs(splashAttachments) do
		v.RainSplash.LightEmission = value
	end
	
end)

local LightInfluence = makeProperty("NumberValue", RAIN_DEFAULT_LIGHTINFLUENCE, function(value)
	
	Emitter.RainStraight.LightInfluence = value
	Emitter.RainTopDown.LightInfluence = value
	
	for _,v in pairs(rainAttachments) do
		v.RainStraight.LightInfluence = value
		v.RainTopDown.LightInfluence = value
	end
	for _,v in pairs(splashAttachments) do
		v.RainSplash.LightInfluence = value
	end
	
end)

local RainDirection = makeProperty("Vector3Value", RAIN_DEFAULT_DIRECTION, function(value)
	if value.magnitude > 0.001 then
		rainDirection = value.unit
	end
end)


-- Exposed API:

local Rain = {}

Rain.CollisionMode = CollisionMode

function Rain:Enable(tweenInfo)
	
	if tweenInfo ~= nil and typeof(tweenInfo) ~= "TweenInfo" then
		error("bad argument #1 to 'Enable' (TweenInfo expected, got " .. typeof(tweenInfo) .. ")", 2)
	end
	
	disconnectLoop() -- Just in case :Enable(..) is called multiple times on accident
	
	Emitter.RainStraight.Enabled = true
	Emitter.RainTopDown.Enabled = true
	Emitter.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	
	for i = 1, RAIN_SPLASH_NUM do
		splashAttachments[i].Parent = workspace.Terrain
		rainAttachments[i].Parent = workspace.Terrain
	end
	
	if RunService:IsRunning() then -- don't need sound in studio preview, it won't work anyway
		SoundGroup.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
	end
	
	connectLoop()
	
	if tweenInfo then
		TweenService:Create(GlobalModifier, tweenInfo, {Value = 0}):Play()
	else
		GlobalModifier.Value = 0
	end
	
	if not Sound.Playing then
		Sound:Play()
		Sound.TimePosition = math.random()*Sound.TimeLength
	end
	
	disabled = false
	
end

function Rain:Disable(tweenInfo)
	
	if tweenInfo ~= nil and typeof(tweenInfo) ~= "TweenInfo" then
		error("bad argument #1 to 'Disable' (TweenInfo expected, got " .. typeof(tweenInfo) .. ")", 2)
	end
	
	if tweenInfo then
		local tween = TweenService:Create(GlobalModifier, tweenInfo, {Value = 1})
		tween.Completed:connect(function(state)
			if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
				-- Only disable the rain completely once the visual effects are faded out
				disable()
			end
			tween:Destroy()
		end)
		tween:Play()
		-- Start tweening out sound now as well
		disableSound(tweenInfo)
	else
		GlobalModifier.Value = 1
		disable()
	end
	
	disabled = true
	
end

function Rain:SetColor(value, tweenInfo)
		
	if typeof(value) ~= "Color3" then
		error("bad argument #1 to 'SetColor' (Color3 expected, got " .. typeof(value) .. ")", 2)
	elseif tweenInfo ~= nil and typeof(tweenInfo) ~= "TweenInfo" then
		error("bad argument #2 to 'SetColor' (TweenInfo expected, got " .. typeof(tweenInfo) .. ")", 2)
	end
	
	if tweenInfo then
		TweenService:Create(Color, tweenInfo, {Value = value}):Play()
	else
		Color.Value = value
	end
	
end

local function makeRatioSetter(methodName, valueObject)
	-- Shorthand because most of the remaining property setters are very similar
	return function(_, value, tweenInfo)
		
		if typeof(value) ~= "number" then
			error("bad argument #1 to '" .. methodName .. "' (number expected, got " .. typeof(value) .. ")", 2)
		elseif tweenInfo ~= nil and typeof(tweenInfo) ~= "TweenInfo" then
			error("bad argument #2 to '" .. methodName .. "' (TweenInfo expected, got " .. typeof(tweenInfo) .. ")", 2)
		end
		
		value = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
		
		if tweenInfo then
			TweenService:Create(valueObject, tweenInfo, {Value = value}):Play()
		else
			valueObject.Value = value
		end
		
	end
end

Rain.SetTransparency = makeRatioSetter("SetTransparency", Transparency)
Rain.SetSpeedRatio = makeRatioSetter("SetSpeedRatio", SpeedRatio)
Rain.SetIntensityRatio = makeRatioSetter("SetIntensityRatio", IntensityRatio)
Rain.SetLightEmission = makeRatioSetter("SetLightEmission", LightEmission)
Rain.SetLightInfluence = makeRatioSetter("SetLightInfluence", LightInfluence)

function Rain:SetDirection(direction, tweenInfo)
	
	if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then
		error("bad argument #1 to 'SetDirection' (Vector3 expected, got " .. typeof(direction) .. ")", 2)
	elseif tweenInfo ~= nil and typeof(tweenInfo) ~= "TweenInfo" then
		error("bad argument #2 to 'SetDirection' (TweenInfo expected, got " .. typeof(tweenInfo) .. ")", 2)
	end
	
	if not (direction.unit.magnitude > 0) then -- intentional statement formatting since NaN comparison
		warn("Attempt to set rain direction to a zero-length vector, falling back on default direction = (" .. tostring(RAIN_DEFAULT_DIRECTION) .. ")")
		direction = RAIN_DEFAULT_DIRECTION
	end
	
	if tweenInfo then
		TweenService:Create(RainDirection, tweenInfo, {Value = direction}):Play()
	else
		RainDirection.Value = direction
	end
	
end

end

end

	for _,v in pairs(splashAttachments) do

	end

function Rain:SetSoundId(asset)

		error("bad argument #1 to 'SetSoundId' (string expected, got " .. typeof(asset) .. ")", 2)
	end

end

function Rain:SetCollisionMode(mode, param)
	
	if mode == CollisionMode.None then
		
		-- Regular mode needs no white/blacklist or test function
		collisionList = nil
		collisionFunc = nil
		
	elseif mode == CollisionMode.Blacklist then
		
		if typeof(param) == "Instance" then
			-- Add Emitter anyway, since users will probably not expect collisions with emitter block regardless
			collisionList = {param, Emitter}
		elseif typeof(param) == "table" then
			for i = 1, #param do
				if typeof(param[i]) ~= "Instance" then
					error("bad argument #2 to 'SetCollisionMode' (blacklist contained a " .. typeof(param[i]) .. " on index " .. tostring(i) .. " which is not an Instance)", 2)
				end
			end
			collisionList = {Emitter} -- see above
			for i = 1, #param do
				table.insert(collisionList, param[i])
			end
		else
			error("bad argument #2 to 'SetCollisionMode (Instance or array of Instance expected, got " .. typeof(param) .. ")'", 2)
		end
		
		-- Blacklist does not need a test function
		collisionFunc = nil
		
	elseif mode == CollisionMode.Whitelist then
		
		if typeof(param) == "Instance" then
			collisionList = {param}
		elseif typeof(param) == "table" then
			for i = 1, #param do
				if typeof(param[i]) ~= "Instance" then
					error("bad argument #2 to 'SetCollisionMode' (whitelist contained a " .. typeof(param[i])  .. " on index " .. tostring(i) .. " which is not an Instance)", 2)
				end
			end
			collisionList = {}
			for i = 1, #param do
				table.insert(collisionList, param[i])
			end
		else
			error("bad argument #2 to 'SetCollisionMode (Instance or array of Instance expected, got " .. typeof(param) .. ")'", 2)
		end
		
		-- Whitelist does not need a test function
		collisionFunc = nil
		
	elseif mode == CollisionMode.Function then
		
		if typeof(param) ~= "function" then
			error("bad argument #2 to 'SetCollisionMode' (function expected, got " .. typeof(param) .. ")", 2)
		end
		
		-- Test function does not need a list
		collisionList = nil
		
		collisionFunc = param
		
	else
		error("bad argument #1 to 'SetCollisionMode (Rain.CollisionMode expected, got " .. typeof(param) .. ")'", 2)
	end
	
	collisionMode = mode
	raycast = raycastFunctions[mode]
	
end

return Rain

function getStoreKey(storeName:string?)
    local key = _storagePrefix..(storeName or "Default")
    return key
end

function diffTable(originTable,thistable)
	for i,v in pairs(originTable) do
		if thistable[i] == nil then
			thistable[i] = v
        elseif type(thistable[i]) == "table" then
            thistable[i] = diffTable(v,thistable[i])
		end
	end
	return thistable
end

function TableClone(obj)
	if not obj then
		return
	end
	local object = {}
	for key, var in pairs(obj) do
		if type(var) == "table" then
			object[key] = TableClone(var)
		else
			object[key] = var
		end

	end
	return object
end

function getDataStore(storeName:string?)
    local key = getStoreKey(storeName)
    local dataStore = _dataStore[key]
    if not dataStore then
        dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(key)
        _dataStore[key] = dataStore
    end

    return dataStore
end

function markDirty(userId:number,storeName:string?)
	local userKey = getUserKey(userId)
    local storeKey = getStoreKey(storeName)

    _dirtyCache[storeKey][userKey] = true
end

function getOriginData(storeName:string?)
    local storeKey = getStoreKey(storeName)
    return _originDatas[storeKey]
end

function DataStoreHelper:init(originData:table,storeName:string?)
    local storeKey = getStoreKey(storeName)
    getDataStore(storeName)
    _dataCache[storeKey] = {}
    _originDatas[storeKey] = originData or {}
    _dirtyCache[storeKey] = {}
end

function DataStoreHelper:InitUser(userId:number,storeName:string?)
	local userKey = getUserKey(userId)
    local dataStore = getDataStore(storeName)

    local isOK = false
    local ret = nil
    local reTryTimes = 0
    while not isOK do
	    local suc,vo = pcall(function()
	    	return dataStore:GetAsync(userKey)
	    end)
	    if suc then
            local originData = getOriginData(storeName)
	    	if vo then
	    		vo = diffTable(TableClone(originData),vo)
	    	else
	    		vo = TableClone(originData)
	    	end

            local storeKey = getStoreKey(storeName)
	    	_dataCache[storeKey][userKey] = vo
	    end
        isOK = suc
        ret = vo
        reTryTimes += 1
        if reTryTimes >= 3 then
            break
        end
    end
    DataStoreHelper.onUserDataInit:Fire(userId,storeName,ret)
	return ret
end

function DataStoreHelper:UpdateVo(userId:number,vo:any,storeName:string?)
	local userKey = getUserKey(userId)
    local storeKey = getStoreKey(storeName)
	_dataCache[storeKey][userKey] = vo
    markDirty(userId,storeName)
    DataStoreHelper.onUserDataChanged:Fire(userId,storeName,vo)
end

function DataStoreHelper:GetVo(userId:number,storeName:string?)
	local userKey = getUserKey(userId)
    local storeKey = getStoreKey(storeName)
    return _dataCache[storeKey][userKey]
end

function DataStoreHelper:SaveUser(userId:number)
	local userKey = getUserKey(userId)

    for storeKey,vos in pairs(_dataCache) do
        if not _dirtyCache[storeKey][userKey] then continue end

        local dataStore = _dataStore[storeKey]
        local vo = vos[userKey]
        local success = true
        if vo then
            local tries = 0
            repeat
                tries += 1
                success = pcall(function()
                    dataStore:UpdateAsync(userKey,function(oldVo)
                        return vo
                    end)
                end)
                if not success then task.wait(1) end
            until tries == 20 or success
        end

        if success then
            print("Save data for player! UserId:"..userId.." Vo:"..game.HttpService:JSONEncode(vo))
            _dirtyCache[storeKey][userKey] = nil
        else
            warn("Cannot save data for player! UserId:"..userId)
        end
    end
end

function DataStoreHelper:Offline(userId:number)
    DataStoreHelper:SaveUser(userId)

    -- 清空缓存数据
	local userKey = getUserKey(userId)
    for _,vos in pairs(_dataCache) do
        vos[userKey] = nil
    end
end

return DataStoreHelper

function playPanelAnim(panel:Frame,isOpen:boolean?)	
	local UIScale = panel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
	if not UIScale then
		UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		UIScale.Parent = panel
	end 
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local propertyTable = {
		Scale = 1
	}
	if isOpen ~= false then
		UIScale.Scale = 0
		propertyTable.Scale = 1
	else
		UIScale.Scale = 1
		propertyTable.Scale = 0
	end

	local tween =  game.TweenService:Create(UIScale, tweenInfo,propertyTable)
	if isOpen == false then
		tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
			panel.Visible = false
		end)
	end
	tween:Play() --播放tween动画
end

local function isGamepadInputType(inputType)
	local inputName = inputType and inputType.Name
	return type(inputName) == "string" and inputName:match("^Gamepad") ~= nil
end

local function hasConnectedGamepad()
	return #UserInputService:GetConnectedGamepads() > 0
end

local function shouldShowGamepadUI()
	return hasConnectedGamepad() and isGamepadInputType(UserInputService:GetLastInputType())
end

local function refreshAllTagged()
	local visible = shouldShowGamepadUI()
	for _, inst in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and inst:GetAttribute("GamepadOnly") then
			inst.Visible = visible
		end
	end
end

PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
	if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and inst:GetAttribute("GamepadOnly") then
		inst.Visible = shouldShowGamepadUI()
	end
end)

UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(refreshAllTagged)
UserInputService.GamepadConnected:Connect(refreshAllTagged)
UserInputService.GamepadDisconnected:Connect(refreshAllTagged)
task.defer(refreshAllTagged)

-- UI 栈：追踪当前打开的 RootFrame，B键兜底关闭
-- 各 UI 自身已通过 ContextActionService / InputBegan 处理 B 键，
-- 此处仅作兜底以防漏网。
-- ============================================================

local openStack = {}

local function stackRemove(frame)
	for i = #openStack, 1, -1 do
		if openStack[i] == frame then
			table.remove(openStack, i)
			return
		end
	end
end

local function watchFrame(frame)
	if not frame then return end
	frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if frame.Visible then
			stackRemove(frame)
			table.insert(openStack, frame)
		else
			stackRemove(frame)
		end
	end)
	if frame.Visible then
		table.insert(openStack, frame)
	end
end

-- 监听 Wild West 实际存在的主面板
local function setupWatchers()
	local function getRootFrame(screenName)
		local screen = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(screenName)
		return screen and screen:FindFirstChild("RootFrame")
	end
	watchFrame(getRootFrame("UICraftItem"))
	watchFrame(getRootFrame("UIBusiness"))
	watchFrame(getRootFrame("UICraftBullet"))
	--watchFrame(getRootFrame("UIMap"))
end

task.defer(setupWatchers)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then return end
	refreshAllTagged()
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB and #openStack > 0 then
		openStack[#openStack].Visible = false
	end
end)

function getClassParent(class:string)
    local ItemParent:Frame = _RootFrame:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame"):FindFirstChild("ItemParent")
    local classParent:Frame = ItemParent:FindFirstChild(class)
    if not classParent then
        classParent = ItemParent:FindFirstChild("ClassParentPrefab"):Clone()
        classParent.Name = class
        classParent.Visible = true
        classParent.Parent = ItemParent

        local t_title:TextLabel = classParent:FindFirstChild("t_title")
        t_title.Text = class
    end

    return classParent
end

function createBtn(name:string,class:string)
    local ScrollingFrame:ScrollingFrame = _RootFrame:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")
    local ItemParent:Frame = ScrollingFrame:FindFirstChild("ItemParent")
    local ButtonPrefab:GuiButton = ItemParent:FindFirstChild("ButtonPrefab")

    local item = ButtonPrefab:Clone()
    item.Name = name
    item.Visible = true
    if class then
        item.Parent = getClassParent(class)
    else
        item.Parent = ItemParent
    end

    local btn:TextButton = item:FindFirstChild("Btn")
    btn.Text = name
    return btn
end

function getKey(tool:Tool)
    if CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(tool) then
        local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        return string.format("BluePrint_%d",lo.id)
    elseif ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(tool) then
        local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        return string.format("ResItem_%d",lo.id)
    end

    return tool.Name
end

function init()
    local isNeedSort = #_myToolsByKey == 0
    local equippedTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if equippedTool then
        onAddedTool(equippedTool)
    end
    for _,tool:Tool in ipairs(Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if tool.ClassName == "Tool" then
            onAddedTool(tool)
        end
    end
    _changed = true
    if isNeedSort then
        task.delay(1,sortTools)
    end
end

function sortTools()

function onAddedTool(tool:Tool)
    local key = getKey(tool)
    if not key then return end

    if not table.find(_myToolsByKey,key) then
        local layoutOrder = nil
        if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(tool) then
            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
            if resItemLo then
                layoutOrder = _indexMap[resItemLo.ItemType]
            end
        end
        if layoutOrder then

                table.insert(_myToolsByKey,layoutOrder,key)
            else
                _myToolsByKey[layoutOrder] = key

            if not slot then

                _slots[i] = slot

            local t_name:TextLabel = slot.t_name

function init()
    for _,rootFrame:Frame in ipairs(rootFrames) do
        for _,child:GuiObject in ipairs(rootFrame:GetChildren()) do
            local btn:GuiButton
            if child:IsA("Frame") then
                btn = Instance.new("ImageButton")
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                btn.ImageTransparency = 1
                btn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                btn.Parent = child
            elseif child:IsA("GuiButton") then
                btn = child
            else
                continue
            end

            btn.Activated:Connect(function(inputObject, clickCount)
                onTriggerBtn(child)
            end)
        end
    end

    -- if not isPC then
    --     UIInteractive.Size = UDim2.fromScale(UIInteractive.Size.X.Scale,0.75)
    -- end
end

function setBtnVisible(name:string,visible:boolean)
    for _,rootFrame:Frame in ipairs(rootFrames) do
        local child:GuiObject = rootFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
        if child then
            child.Visible = visible
        end
    end
end

function onTargetChanged()

    local target:Instance = v_dragItem.Value or InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget()
    local StoreVisible = false
    local UnstoreVisible = false
    local EatVisible = false
    local EquipVisible = false
    local DropVisible = false
    local HealVisible = false
    local ReloadVisible = false
    local VentVisible = false
    local enabled = false

        enabled = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(target,DragItemValue.enable)

function onTriggerBtn(gui:Frame)
    if not gui.Visible then return end
    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end

    if gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Store or gui == btn_stone then
        local target:Model = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        if target then
            local curNum = BagHelper:GetHasNum()
            local maxNum = BagHelper:GetSize()
            if curNum < maxNum then
                task.spawn(function()

                    local originCFrame:CFrame = nil
                    if not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) and not table.find(_storeHideResItems,target) then
                        originCFrame = target:GetPivot()
                        -- print("暂时隐藏 originCFrame",originCFrame.Position)
                        target:PivotTo(originCFrame - Vector3.new(0,200,0)) -- 提前隐藏
                        table.insert(_storeHideResItems,target)
                    end

                    local suc:CFrame = BagHelper.BagStoreC2S:InvokeServer(target)
                    if suc then
                        BagHelper.onBagStore:Fire(target)
                    else
                        if not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) and not target:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.InBag) then
                            if originCFrame then
                                -- print("恢复限时 originCFrame",originCFrame.Position)
                                if target.PrimaryPart then
                                    target.PrimaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                    target.PrimaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                end
                                target:PivotTo(originCFrame) -- 储存失败，还原位置
                                local index = table.find(_storeHideResItems,target)
                                if index then
                                    table.remove(_storeHideResItems,index)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            else
                UIHelper:PopCenterTips("The bag is full",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
            end
        end
        -- print(gui.Name)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Unstore then
        local humanoidRootPart:Part = LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        local spawnCFrame:CFrame
        -- 射线检测
        local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
        raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
        raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

        local offsetY = Vector3.yAxis * 3
        local dir = cframe.LookVector * 3
        local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(cframe.Position + offsetY,dir,raycastParams)
        if hitResult then
            spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(hitResult.Position)
        else
            spawnCFrame = cframe + dir + offsetY
        end

        BagHelper.BagUnstoreC2S:FireServer(spawnCFrame)
        -- print(gui.Name)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Eat then
        local target:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        GameHelper.EatC2S:FireServer(target)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Equip then
        local target:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        if target then
            if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(target) then
                local resLo = target and ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(target)
                if resLo.IsTool then
                    ToolHelper.PinkupToolC2S:FireServer(target)
                elseif resLo.IsAccessory then
                    ToolHelper.EquipAccessoryC2S:FireServer(target)
                end
            elseif CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(target) then
                ToolHelper.PinkupToolC2S:FireServer(target)
            end
        end
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Take then
        local target:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        GameHelper.TakeC2S:FireServer(target)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Drag then

    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Undrag then
		InteractiveHelper:UndragItem()
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Plant then
        local treeSeek:Instance = InteractiveHelper:GetFocusTarget() or v_dragItem.Value
        local groundPoint = MapHelper:GetTreeSeekPlantPoint(treeSeek)
        if groundPoint then
            GameHelper.PlantTreeC2S:FireServer(groundPoint,treeSeek)
        end
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Reload then
        GameHelper.GunReloadC2S:FireServer()
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Vent then
        SteamWeaponActionC2S:FireServer("BeginVent")
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Drop then
        ToolHelper.DropToolC2S:FireServer()
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Dismount then
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    elseif gui.Name == BTN_NAME.Run then
        if isRun() then
            onStopRun()
            if gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
                gui.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            end
        else
            onRun()
            if gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
                gui.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1)
            end
        end
    end
end

    end

function onInputBegan(input:InputObject, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    -- print(input.KeyCode)
	if not UIInterface.Enabled then
		return
	end

    if UIInteractive.Visible or UIInteractiveMobile.Visible then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
            if isRun() then
                onStopRun()
            else
                onRun()
            end
        else
            local btns = keybordInputBtns[input.KeyCode]
            if btns then
                for _,btn in ipairs(btns) do
                    onTriggerBtn(btn)
                end
            end
        end

        -- 手柄映射
        local btns = gamepadInputBtns[input.KeyCode]
        if btns then
            local handled = false
            for _,btn in ipairs(btns) do
                if btn.Visible then
                    onTriggerBtn(btn)
                    handled = true
                end
            end

            if not handled then
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
                    requestBackpackToggle()
                elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then
                    requestUnequipTool()
                end
            end
        end
        -- if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3 then
        --     onTriggerBtn(btn_run)
        -- end
    end
end

local function isGamepadInputType(inputType)
    local inputName = inputType and inputType.Name
    return type(inputName) == "string" and inputName:match("^Gamepad") ~= nil
end

local function isKeyboardMouseInputType(inputType)
    return inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel or
    inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
end

local function shouldUseTouchUI(inputType)
    if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return true
    end
    if isGamepadInputType(inputType) then
        return false
    end
    return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
end

function onLastInputTypeChanged()

    local isgamepad = false
    local LastInputType = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()

        map = gamepadInputBtns
        isgamepad = true
        newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.GamePad
    elseif isKeyboardMouseInputType(LastInputType) then
        map = keybordInputBtns
        newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.Keyboard
    elseif useTouchUI then
        map = nil
        newInputType = GameEnum.InputType.Touch
    end

    if newInputType and _inputType ~= newInputType then
        _inputType = newInputType
        onTargetChanged()
    end

        for inputType:Enum.UserInputType,btns in pairs(map) do

                local img_icon:ImageLabel = btn:FindFirstChild("img_icon")

                local img_gamepadIcon:ImageLabel = btn:FindFirstChild("img_gamepadIcon")

                --     img_gamepadIcon.AnchorPoint = img_icon.AnchorPoint
                --     img_gamepadIcon.SizeConstraint = img_icon.SizeConstraint
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Position = img_icon.Position
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Size = img_icon.Size
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Image = UserInputService:GetImageForKeyCode(inputType)
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Visible = false
                --     img_gamepadIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                --     img_gamepadIcon.Parent = btn
                -- end
                -- print(img_gamepadIcon.Image,img_gamepadIcon.Image ~= "")
                if isgamepad and img_gamepadIcon then
                    local init = img_gamepadIcon:GetAttribute("init")
                    if not init then
                        img_gamepadIcon.Image = UserInputService:GetImageForKeyCode(inputType)

function onDayChanged()
    onRefreshDayText()
    local t_newDay:TextLabel = Tip_NewDay.t_newDay
    local t_mul:TextLabel = Tip_NewDay.MulFrame.t_mul
    local t_emoji:TextLabel = Tip_NewDay.t_emoji

    t_newDay.Text = string.format("Day %d", v_day.Value)
    t_mul.Text = string.format("x%d",GameHelper:GetDayMultiplier())
    local emoji = ""
    for _,_ in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Bed)) do
        emoji = emoji.."🛏"
    end

    for _,v_kill in ipairs(GameHelper:GetWantedKillList()) do
        if v_kill.Value then
            emoji = emoji.."🤠"
        end
    end
    t_emoji.Text = emoji

    -- 动画
    t_day.Visible = false
    Tip_NewDay.Visible = true
    Tip_NewDay.GroupTransparency = 1

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1)
    TweenService:Create(Tip_NewDay,tweenInfo,{
        GroupTransparency = 0
    }):Play()
    task.wait(2)
    TweenService:Create(Tip_NewDay,tweenInfo,{
        GroupTransparency = 1
    }):Play()

local function getDisplayedHeat(timeNow:number)
    local heat = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeat")) or 0
    local updatedAt = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatUpdatedAt")) or timeNow
    local coolStartAt = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatCoolStartAt")) or updatedAt
    local state = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamHeatState") or HEAT_STATE_NORMAL
    local ventEndAt = tonumber(LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteamVentEndAt")) or 0

    if state == HEAT_STATE_NORMAL then
        local coolingFrom = math.max(updatedAt, coolStartAt)
        if timeNow > coolingFrom then
            heat = math.max(0, heat - (timeNow - coolingFrom) * HEAT_COOL_PER_SECOND)
        end
    elseif ventEndAt > updatedAt then
        local remainingAlpha = math.clamp((ventEndAt - timeNow) / (ventEndAt - updatedAt), 0, 1)
        heat *= remainingAlpha
    end

    return math.clamp(heat, 0, HEAT_MAX), state, ventEndAt
end

local function stopHeatRender()
    if heatRenderConnection then
        heatRenderConnection:Disconnect()
        heatRenderConnection = nil
    end
end

local function renderHeat()
    local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local heat, state, ventEndAt = getDisplayedHeat(timeNow)
    local steamEquipped = isSteamWeaponEquipped()
    local visible = steamEquipped or heat > 0.01 or state ~= HEAT_STATE_NORMAL

    HeatFrame.Visible = visible
    if not visible then
        HeatSlide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
        HeatCooldown.Visible = false
        HeatFrame.Rotation = 0
        if HeatStroke then
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0
        end
        stopHeatRender()
        return
    end

    local alpha = heat / HEAT_MAX
    HeatSlide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(alpha, 1)
    HeatCooldown.Visible = state ~= HEAT_STATE_NORMAL

    HeatCooldown.Rotation = 0
    if HeatCooldown.Visible then
        local pulse = (math.sin(timeNow * 10) + 1) * 0.5
        HeatCooldown.ImageTransparency = 0.05 + pulse * 0.2
    else
        HeatCooldown.ImageTransparency = 0
    end

    if HeatStroke then
        if state ~= HEAT_STATE_NORMAL then
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0.1 + (math.sin(timeNow * 14) + 1) * 0.2
        elseif heat >= 70 then
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0.15 + (math.sin(timeNow * 6) + 1) * 0.2
        else
            HeatStroke.Transparency = 0
        end
    end
end

local function ensureHeatRender()
    if not heatRenderConnection then
        heatRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(renderHeat)
    end
    renderHeat()
end

local function cancelOffsetTween()
	if offsetTween then
		offsetTween:Cancel()
		offsetTween = nil
	end
end

local function unbindOffsetRender()
	if offsetRenderBound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAMERA_OFFSET_BINDING)
		offsetRenderBound = false
	end
end

local function saveNativeState()
	if savedRotationType == nil then
		savedRotationType = UserGameSettings.RotationType
	end
	if humanoid and savedAutoRotate == nil then
		savedAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
		savedCameraOffset = humanoid.CameraOffset
	end
end

local function tweenCameraOffset(target:Vector3, duration:number)
	if not humanoid then return end
	cancelOffsetTween()
	if duration <= 0 then
		humanoid.CameraOffset = target
		return
	end
	offsetTween = TweenService:Create(
		humanoid,
		TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{CameraOffset = target}
	)
	offsetTween:Play()
end

local function getShoulderWeight()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return 1 end
	local focusDistance = (camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude
	return math.clamp(
		(focusDistance - FIRST_PERSON_FADE_END) / (FIRST_PERSON_FADE_START - FIRST_PERSON_FADE_END),
		0,
		1
	)
end

local function bindOffsetRender()
	if offsetRenderBound then return end
	offsetRenderBound = true
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(CAMERA_OFFSET_BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		if not nativeModeActive or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
		local weightedOffset = SHOULDER_CAMERA_OFFSET * getShoulderWeight()
		if (weightedOffset - currentShoulderBase).Magnitude <= 0.001 then
			return
		end
		local oldBase = currentShoulderBase
		currentShoulderBase = weightedOffset
		humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", weightedOffset)
		-- Preserve an in-progress shake by moving its displacement along with the base.
		humanoid.CameraOffset += weightedOffset - oldBase
	end)
end

local function applyNativeShoulderMode()
	if not humanoid then return end
	saveNativeState()
	nativeModeActive = true
	humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))
	pcall(function()
		UserGameSettings.RotationType = Enum.RotationType.CameraRelative
	end)
	humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	currentShoulderBase = SHOULDER_CAMERA_OFFSET * getShoulderWeight()
	humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", currentShoulderBase)
	tweenCameraOffset(currentShoulderBase, ENTER_TWEEN_TIME)
	bindOffsetRender()
end

local function restoreNativeState(immediate:boolean?)
	nativeModeActive = false
	unbindOffsetRender()
	cancelOffsetTween()

	local restoreHumanoid = humanoid
	local restoreOffset = savedCameraOffset or Vector3.zero
	pendingRestoreCameraOffset = restoreOffset
	if restoreHumanoid then
		restoreHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", nil)
		restoreHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
		if savedAutoRotate ~= nil then
			restoreHumanoid.AutoRotate = savedAutoRotate
		end
		if immediate then
			restoreHumanoid.CameraOffset = restoreOffset
			pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
		else
			local tween = TweenService:Create(
				restoreHumanoid,
				TweenInfo.new(EXIT_TWEEN_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{CameraOffset = restoreOffset}
			)
			offsetTween = tween
			tween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if offsetTween == tween then
					offsetTween = nil
					pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
				end
			end)
			tween:Play()
		end
	end
	if savedRotationType ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			UserGameSettings.RotationType = savedRotationType
		end)
	end
	savedRotationType = nil
	savedAutoRotate = nil
	savedCameraOffset = nil
	currentShoulderBase = Vector3.zero
end

local function finishPendingRestore()
	if not humanoid or pendingRestoreCameraOffset == nil then return end
	cancelOffsetTween()
	humanoid.CameraOffset = pendingRestoreCameraOffset
	pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
end

local function cleanupPreviousCharacter(previousHumanoid:Humanoid?)
	if not previousHumanoid then return end
	if offsetTween then
		offsetTween:Cancel()
		offsetTween = nil
	end
	previousHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", nil)
	previousHumanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
	if savedAutoRotate ~= nil then
		previousHumanoid.AutoRotate = savedAutoRotate
	end
	local restoreOffset = pendingRestoreCameraOffset or savedCameraOffset
	if restoreOffset ~= nil then
		previousHumanoid.CameraOffset = restoreOffset
	end
	if savedRotationType ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			UserGameSettings.RotationType = savedRotationType
		end)
	end
	savedRotationType = nil
	savedAutoRotate = nil
	savedCameraOffset = nil
	nativeModeActive = false
	currentShoulderBase = Vector3.zero
	pendingRestoreCameraOffset = nil
	legacyModeActive = false
	unbindOffsetRender()
end

local function bindCharacter(newCharacter:Model?)
	local previousCharacter = character
	local previousHumanoid = humanoid
	character = newCharacter or player.Character
	root = nil
	humanoid = nil
	if humanoidDiedConnection then
		humanoidDiedConnection:Disconnect()
		humanoidDiedConnection = nil
	end
	if previousHumanoid and previousCharacter ~= character then
		cleanupPreviousCharacter(previousHumanoid)
	end
	if not character then return end
	root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if humanoid then
		humanoidDiedConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
			activeReasons[RANGED_SHIFTLOCK_REASON] = nil
			manualDisabled = false

		end)
	end
end
