stopShiftLock = function()
	if renderConnection then
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
		renderConnection = nil
	end
	if nativeModeActive or savedRotationType ~= nil or savedAutoRotate ~= nil or savedCameraOffset ~= nil then
		restoreNativeState()
	elseif humanoid and not legacyModeActive then
		humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
	end
	if legacyModeActive and humanoid then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
	end
	legacyModeActive = false
	configureLegacyCrosshair()
	updateButtonImage(false)
end

local function startShiftLock()
	finishPendingRestore()
	legacyModeActive = not featureSwitch.Value
	if featureSwitch.Value then
		applyNativeShoulderMode()
	end
	if renderConnection then return end
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not character or not character.Parent or not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
			bindCharacter(player.Character)
			if featureSwitch.Value then applyNativeShoulderMode() end
		end
		if not root or not humanoid then return end

		if featureSwitch.Value then
			if not nativeModeActive then
				applyNativeShoulderMode()
			end
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local lookVector = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local flatLook = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
		if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false
			humanoid.CameraOffset = LEGACY_CAMERA_OFFSET
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook.Unit * LOOK_DISTANCE)
		end
		configureLegacyCrosshair()
	end)
	updateButtonImage(true)
end

refreshShiftLock = function()
	local active = shouldBeActive()
	local wantsNative = active and featureSwitch.Value
	local wantsLegacy = active and not featureSwitch.Value
	local alreadyCorrect = renderConnection ~= nil
		and ((wantsNative and nativeModeActive) or (wantsLegacy and legacyModeActive))
	if not alreadyCorrect then
		if renderConnection or nativeModeActive or legacyModeActive then
			stopShiftLock()
		end
		if active then
			startShiftLock()
		else
			stopShiftLock()
		end
	end
	configureLegacyCrosshair()
	if setFireVisible then
		setFireVisible(shouldShowRangedCombatUI())
	end
end

function MobileCameraFramework.Enable(reason:string?)

	local owner = reason or "Manual"
	activeReasons[owner] = true

		manualDisabled = false
	end
	refreshShiftLock()
end

function MobileCameraFramework.Disable(reason:string?)
	local owner = reason or "Manual"
	activeReasons[owner] = nil
	if next(activeReasons) == nil then
		manualDisabled = false
	end
	refreshShiftLock()
end

function MobileCameraFramework.ToggleManual()
	if not isMobileInput() then return end
	if shouldBeActive() then
		manualDisabled = true
		refreshShiftLock()
	else
		manualDisabled = false
		if next(activeReasons) == nil then
			activeReasons.Manual = true
		end
		refreshShiftLock()
	end
end

local function getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, level: number)
	if not characterLo or level >= 3 then
		return nil
	end

	local upgradeLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterUpgradeSetting, characterLo.missionId)
	if not upgradeLo then
		return nil
	end

	local questStr = level == 1 and upgradeLo.Level2Quest or upgradeLo.Level3Quest
	if not questStr then
		return nil
	end

	return CommonFunc:ParseKV_Number(questStr)
end

local function collectCharacterTasks()
	local rows = {}
	local completedCount = 0
	local totalCount = 0

	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local characterId = playerVo and playerVo.characterId
	if not characterId then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "No Character Equipped", cur = 0, target = 0, completed = false })
		return rows, completedCount, totalCount
	end

	local characterVo = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(nil, characterId)
	local characterLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterSetting, characterId)
	if not characterVo or not characterLo then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "No Character Equipped", cur = 0, target = 0, completed = false })
		return rows, completedCount, totalCount
	end

	if characterVo.lv >= 3 then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "Max Level", cur = 1, target = 1, completed = true })
		return rows, 1, 1
	end

	local quest = getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, characterVo.lv)
	if not quest then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "No Character Quest", cur = 0, target = 0, completed = false })
		return rows, completedCount, totalCount
	end

	for statsName, targetValue in pairs(quest) do
		local statsLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterStatsSetting, statsName)
		local curValue = tonumber(DataHelper:GetCharacterStats(nil, characterVo.id, statsName)) or 0
		local safeTarget = math.max(tonumber(targetValue) or 0, 0)
		local completed = safeTarget <= 0 or curValue >= safeTarget

		totalCount += 1
		if completed then
			completedCount += 1
		end

		table.insert(rows, {
			desc = statsLo and statsLo.desc or tostring(statsName),
			cur = curValue,
			target = safeTarget,
			completed = completed,
		})
	end

	return rows, completedCount, totalCount
end

local function collectDailyTasks()
	local rows = {}
	local completedCount = 0
	local totalCount = #dailyClassOrder
	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local records = playerVo and playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords

	for _, className in ipairs(dailyClassOrder) do
		local dailyQuestVo = records and records[className]
		local descText = string.format("%s: No Quest", tostring(className))
		local curValue = 0
		local targetValue = 0
		local completed = false

		if dailyQuestVo and dailyQuestVo.questId then
			local lo = ConfigHelper:GetById(DailyQuestsSetting, dailyQuestVo.questId)
			if lo then
				targetValue = math.max(tonumber(lo.times) or 0, 0)
				curValue = tonumber(dailyQuestVo.progress) or 0
				completed = targetValue <= 0 or curValue >= targetValue
				descText = lo.desc or tostring(dailyQuestVo.questId)
			else
				descText = string.format("%s: Invalid Quest", tostring(className))
			end
		end

		if completed then
			completedCount += 1
		end

		table.insert(rows, {
			desc = descText,
			cur = curValue,
			target = targetValue,
			completed = completed,
		})
	end

	return rows, completedCount, totalCount
end

-- 获取所有可见且可选择的物品
local function getAllVisibleItems()
	local items = {}
	for _, canvasGroup in ipairs(itemArr) do
		if canvasGroup:IsA('CanvasGroup') and canvasGroup.Visible then
			for _, item in ipairs(canvasGroup:GetChildren()) do
				if item:IsA('ImageButton') and item.Visible and not item.img_Hide.Visible then
					table.insert(items, item)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return items
end

-- 创建高亮框
local function createHighlight()
	if selectedHighlight then return end
	
	selectedHighlight = Instance.new("Frame")
	selectedHighlight.Name = "GamepadHighlight"
	selectedHighlight.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	selectedHighlight.ZIndex = 10
	selectedHighlight.Parent = ScrollingFrame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Parent = selectedHighlight
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = selectedHighlight
	
	-- 添加 GamepadOnly 标签，手柄断开时自动隐藏
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
	CollectionService:AddTag(selectedHighlight, "GamepadOnly")
end

-- 高亮当前选中的物品
local function highlightSelectedItem()
	if not selectedHighlight then
		createHighlight()
	end
	
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then
		selectedHighlight.Visible = false
		return
	end
	
	-- 确保索引在有效范围内
	if currentSelectedIndex < 1 then
		currentSelectedIndex = #allVisibleItems
	elseif currentSelectedIndex > #allVisibleItems then
		currentSelectedIndex = 1
	end
	
	local selectedItem = allVisibleItems[currentSelectedIndex]
	if selectedItem then
		selectedHighlight.Visible = true

		-- 用绝对坐标换算光标在 ScrollingFrame 画布中的位置
		local itemAbs = selectedItem.AbsolutePosition
		local scrollAbs = ScrollingFrame.AbsolutePosition
		local canvas = ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition
		local relX = itemAbs.X - scrollAbs.X + canvas.X
		local relY = itemAbs.Y - scrollAbs.Y + canvas.Y
		selectedHighlight.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(selectedItem.AbsoluteSize.X, selectedItem.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		selectedHighlight.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(relX, relY)

		-- 自动滚动到选中项
		local itemPosY = itemAbs.Y
		local itemSizeY = selectedItem.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local scrollPosY = scrollAbs.Y
		local scrollSizeY = ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if itemPosY < scrollPosY then
			ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, canvas.Y - (scrollPosY - itemPosY) - 10)
		elseif itemPosY + itemSizeY > scrollPosY + scrollSizeY then
			ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, canvas.Y + (itemPosY + itemSizeY - scrollPosY - scrollSizeY) + 10)
		end
	else
		selectedHighlight.Visible = false
	end
end

local selectCurrentItem

-- 手柄导航：向上
local function navigateUp()
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then return end
	
	currentSelectedIndex = currentSelectedIndex - 1
	if currentSelectedIndex < 1 then
		currentSelectedIndex = #allVisibleItems -- 循环到最后
	end
	
	highlightSelectedItem()
	selectCurrentItem()
end

-- 手柄导航：向下
local function navigateDown()
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then return end
	
	currentSelectedIndex = currentSelectedIndex + 1
	if currentSelectedIndex > #allVisibleItems then
		currentSelectedIndex = 1 -- 循环到开头
	end
	
	highlightSelectedItem()
	selectCurrentItem()
end

-- 手柄选择当前物品
selectCurrentItem = function()
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then return end
	
	local temp = allVisibleItems[currentSelectedIndex]
	if not temp or temp.img_Hide.Visible then
		return
	end
	
	-- 获取物品ID和数据
	local itemId = tonumber(temp.Name)
	if not itemId then return end
	
	local item:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting, itemId)
	if not item then return end
	
	-- 执行与 Activated 事件相同的逻辑（第332-370行）
	selectItemCraft = item.id
	selectItemBtn = temp
	
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Visible = true
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').t_Name.Text = item.ItemName
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Icon.Image = item.icon
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('Detail'):WaitForChild('t_value').Text = item.ItemDesc
	
	for a,b in ipairs(mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Price:GetChildren()) do
		if b:IsA('Frame') then
			b:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for c,d in ipairs(temp.Price:GetChildren()) do
		if d:IsA('Frame') then
			local priceClone = d:Clone()
			priceClone.Parent = mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Price
		end
	end

	if temp.img_lock.Visible then
		mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = false
		mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Lock').Visible = true
	else
		mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = true
		mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Lock').Visible = false
		
		local craftTimes  = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(item.id)
		local itemConfig:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting, item.id)

		if craftTimes.Value >= itemConfig.ItemLimit then
			mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = false
			mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Limit').Visible = true
		else
			mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = true
			mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Limit').Visible = false
		end
	end
end

-- 手柄触发制作
local function triggerCraft()
	if not selectItemCraft or not waitCraft then return end
	local btnCraft = mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft')
	if not mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Visible or not btnCraft.Visible then return end

	waitCraft = false
	local craftTimes = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(selectItemCraft)
	local item:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting, selectItemCraft)

	if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
		UIHelper:PopCenterTips("Craft reach to limit")
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect("UIError")
	else
		local success = GameHelper.MakeCraftItemC2S:InvokeServer(selectItemCraft)

		if item.ItemLimit == 999 then
			selectItemBtn:WaitForChild('ItemLimit'):WaitForChild('t_Limit').Text = '∞'
		else
			selectItemBtn:WaitForChild('ItemLimit'):WaitForChild('t_Limit').Text = tostring(item.ItemLimit - craftTimes.Value)
			if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
				selectItemBtn:WaitForChild('soldPrefab').Visible = true
			end
		end

		if success then
			AudioHelper:PlayEffect("WorkShopCrafted")
			craftTimes = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(selectItemCraft)
			if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = false
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Limit').Visible = true
			else
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = true
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Limit').Visible = false
			end
		else
			AudioHelper:PlayEffect("UIError")
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.2)
	waitCraft = true
	checkVal()
	refreshCraftTime()
end

function refreshCraftTime()
	for k, v in ipairs(allItemCollect) do
		
		local craftTimes  = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(tonumber(v.Name))
		local item:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting, tonumber(v.Name))
		
		if item.ItemLimit == 999 then
			v:WaitForChild('ItemLimit'):WaitForChild('t_Limit').Text = '∞'
		else
			v:WaitForChild('ItemLimit'):WaitForChild('t_Limit').Text = tostring((item.ItemLimit - craftTimes.Value))
			
			v:WaitForChild('soldPrefab').Visible = craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit
			--if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
			--	v:WaitForChild('soldPrefab').Visible = true
			--end
		end
	end
end

local function handleGamepadAction(actionName, inputState, inputObject)
	if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	local keyCode = inputObject.KeyCode
	if keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then
		script.Parent.RootFrame.Visible = false
		workspace.Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp or keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
		navigateUp()
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown or keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then
		navigateDown()
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
		triggerCraft()
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

local function bindGamepadActions()
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(
		GAMEPAD_ACTION_NAME,
		handleGamepadAction,
		false,
		Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value,
		Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight,
		Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA
	)
end

local function unbindGamepadActions()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction(GAMEPAD_ACTION_NAME)
end

function onPlayerDeath(deadCharacter:Model)
	local isAllDied = true
	for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do 
		if not player.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerDeath) then
			isAllDied = false
			break
		end
	end

	if isAllDied then
		--没救了
		SelfDead.Visible = false
		if not AllDead.Visible then
			count = 30
			AllDead.Visible = true
			refreshCD()
		end
	else
		--local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(deadCharacter)
		--如果有活的，那就有救
		if character == deadCharacter and not SelfDead.Visible then
			count = 30
			SelfDead.Visible = true
			refreshCD()
		end
	end	
end

function refreshCD()
	if AllDead.Visible then
		local t_cd:TextLabel = AllDead.t_cd
		t_cd.Text = string.format("Restart in: %d",count)
	elseif SelfDead.Visible then
		local t_cd = SelfDead.btn_selfRevive.t_cd
		t_cd.Text = string.format("Self-Revive( %d )",count)
	end
end

end

    if not label then

    end

    label.TextScaled = true
    label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 35, 21)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25

    local constraint = label:FindFirstChild("GameBackpackTextConstraint")
    if not constraint then
        constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
        constraint.Name = "GameBackpackTextConstraint"

local function ensureKeySequence(key)
    if keySequence[key] then
        return
    end

    keySequence[key] = nextKeySequence

local function sortKeys(keys)
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b)
        return (keySequence[a] or 0) < (keySequence[b] or 0)
    end)
end

local function collectToolGroups()
    local groups = {}

    local function addTool(tool)
        if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
            return
        end

        local key = getKey(tool)
        if not key then
            return
        end

        ensureKeySequence(key)
        local group = groups[key]
        if not group then
            group = {
                key = key,
                tools = {},
                tool = tool,
            }
            groups[key] = group
        end

        table.insert(group.tools, tool)
    end

    if currentCharacter then
        for _, tool in ipairs(currentCharacter:GetChildren()) do
            addTool(tool)
        end
    end

    for _, tool in ipairs(Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        addTool(tool)
    end

    return groups
end

local function buildLayoutState()
    local groups = collectToolGroups()
    for key in pairs(preferredSlots) do
        if not groups[key] then
            preferredSlots[key] = nil
        end
    end

    local slotToKey = {}
    local assignedKeys = {}
    local nonCoreKeys = {}

    for key, group in pairs(groups) do
        local coreSlot = getCoreSlotForTool(group.tool)
        if coreSlot then
            slotToKey[coreSlot] = key
            assignedKeys[key] = true
        else
            table.insert(nonCoreKeys, key)
        end
    end

    sortKeys(nonCoreKeys)

    for _, key in ipairs(nonCoreKeys) do
        local preferredSlot = preferredSlots[key]
        if type(preferredSlot) == "number"
            and preferredSlot >= FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT
            and preferredSlot <= getEffectiveHotbarSize()
            and not slotToKey[preferredSlot] then
            slotToKey[preferredSlot] = key
            assignedKeys[key] = true
        end
    end

    local pendingAutoKeys = {}
    local inventoryKeys = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(nonCoreKeys) do
        if not assignedKeys[key] then
            if preferredSlots[key] == "inventory" then
                table.insert(inventoryKeys, key)
            else
                table.insert(pendingAutoKeys, key)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, key in ipairs(pendingAutoKeys) do
        local assigned = false
        for slot = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
            if not slotToKey[slot] then
                slotToKey[slot] = key
                assignedKeys[key] = true
                assigned = true
                break
            end
        end

        if not assigned then
            table.insert(inventoryKeys, key)
        end
    end

    for slot = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
        local key = slotToKey[slot]
        if key and preferredSlots[key] == nil then
            preferredSlots[key] = slot
        end
    end

    sortKeys(inventoryKeys)

    return {
        groups = groups,
        slotToKey = slotToKey,
        inventoryKeys = inventoryKeys,
        equippedKey = getEquippedToolKey(),
    }
end

local function expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, guiObject)
    if not guiObject or not guiObject.Visible then
        return leftEdge, rightEdge
    end
    if guiObject.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 or guiObject.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 then
        return leftEdge, rightEdge
    end

    local candidateLeft = guiObject.AbsolutePosition.X
    local candidateRight = candidateLeft + guiObject.AbsoluteSize.X
    if leftEdge == nil or candidateLeft < leftEdge then
        leftEdge = candidateLeft
    end
    if rightEdge == nil or candidateRight > rightEdge then
        rightEdge = candidateRight
    end
    return leftEdge, rightEdge
end

local function getGuiHorizontalBounds(rootGui)
    if not rootGui then
        return nil, nil
    end

    local leftEdge, rightEdge = nil, nil
    for _, descendant in ipairs(rootGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") then
            leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, descendant)
        end
    end

    if leftEdge == nil or rightEdge == nil then
        leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, rootGui)
    end

    return leftEdge, rightEdge
end

local function getBackpackHorizontalBounds()
    local leftEdge, rightEdge = nil, nil

    for _, child in ipairs(HotBar:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
            leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, child)
        end
    end

    if Inventory.Visible then
        leftEdge, rightEdge = expandBounds(leftEdge, rightEdge, Inventory)
    end

    if leftEdge == nil or rightEdge == nil then
        leftEdge = HotBar.AbsolutePosition.X
        rightEdge = leftEdge + HotBar.AbsoluteSize.X
    end

    return leftEdge, rightEdge
end

local function applyBackpackPlacement(horizontalOffset)
    local hotbarPosition = getResponsiveHotbarPosition()
    local inventoryPosition = getResponsiveInventoryPosition()

    HotBar.Position = UDim2.new(
        hotbarPosition.X.Scale,
        hotbarPosition.X.Offset + horizontalOffset,
        hotbarPosition.Y.Scale,
        hotbarPosition.Y.Offset
    )
    Inventory.Position = UDim2.new(
        inventoryPosition.X.Scale,
        inventoryPosition.X.Offset + horizontalOffset,
        inventoryPosition.Y.Scale,
        inventoryPosition.Y.Offset
    )
end

local function updateBackpackPlacement()
    applyResponsiveLayout()
    applyHotbarScale(getBaseHotbarScale())
    applyBackpackPlacement(0)
    task.defer(function()
        local safeGap = getHotbarSafeGap()
        local screenWidth = math.max(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local screenPadding = isMobileLayout() and MOBILE_SCREEN_PADDING or 0
        local leftBlocker = getLeftBlockerRoot()
        local rightBlocker = getRightBlockerRoot()
        local minimumLeftEdge = screenPadding
        if leftBlocker then
            local _, blockerRight = getGuiHorizontalBounds(leftBlocker)
            minimumLeftEdge = (blockerRight or (leftBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X + leftBlocker.AbsoluteSize.X)) + safeGap
        end

        local maximumRightEdge = screenWidth - screenPadding
        if rightBlocker then
            local blockerLeft = getGuiHorizontalBounds(rightBlocker)
            maximumRightEdge = (blockerLeft or rightBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X) - safeGap
        end

        local leftEdge, rightEdge = getBackpackHorizontalBounds()
        local width = math.max(0, rightEdge - leftEdge)
        local availableWidth = maximumRightEdge - minimumLeftEdge
        if availableWidth > 0 and width > availableWidth then
            local targetScale = getBaseHotbarScale() * (availableWidth / width)
            applyHotbarScale(math.max(getHotbarMinimumScale(), math.min(getBaseHotbarScale(), targetScale)))
        end

        task.defer(function()
            local finalLeftEdge, finalRightEdge = getBackpackHorizontalBounds()
            local finalWidth = math.max(0, finalRightEdge - finalLeftEdge)
            local currentCenter = finalLeftEdge + finalWidth / 2
            local minimumCenter = minimumLeftEdge + finalWidth / 2
            local maximumCenter = maximumRightEdge - finalWidth / 2
            local targetCenter = currentCenter

            if minimumCenter <= maximumCenter then
                targetCenter = math.clamp(currentCenter, minimumCenter, maximumCenter)
            else
                targetCenter = (minimumCenter + maximumCenter) / 2
            end

            local horizontalOffset = targetCenter - currentCenter
            if horizontalOffset >= 0 then
                horizontalOffset = math.floor(horizontalOffset + 0.5)
            else
                horizontalOffset = math.ceil(horizontalOffset - 0.5)
            end

            applyBackpackPlacement(horizontalOffset)
            updateInventoryGridLayout()
        end)
    end)
end

local function bindPlacementWatchers()
    local interface = getInterfaceRoot()
    if not interface then
        return
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(placementConnections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(placementConnections)

    for _, guiName in ipairs({"UIInteractive", "UIInteractiveMobile", "UIGunBulletFrame"}) do
        local guiObject = interface:FindFirstChild(guiName)
        if guiObject then
            table.insert(placementConnections, guiObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(updateBackpackPlacement))
            table.insert(placementConnections, guiObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(updateBackpackPlacement))
            table.insert(placementConnections, guiObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(updateBackpackPlacement))
        end
    end
end

local function getPlacementSignature()
    local leftBlocker = getLeftBlockerRoot()
    local rightBlocker = getRightBlockerRoot()
    local leftSignature = "none"
    if leftBlocker then
        local leftBound, rightBound = getGuiHorizontalBounds(leftBlocker)
        leftSignature = string.format(
            "%d:%d",
            math.floor((leftBound or leftBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X) + 0.5),
            math.floor((rightBound or (leftBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X + leftBlocker.AbsoluteSize.X)) + 0.5)
        )
    end

    local rightSignature = "none"
    if rightBlocker then
        local leftBound, rightBound = getGuiHorizontalBounds(rightBlocker)
        rightSignature = string.format(
            "%d:%d",
            math.floor((leftBound or rightBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X) + 0.5),
            math.floor((rightBound or (rightBlocker.AbsolutePosition.X + rightBlocker.AbsoluteSize.X)) + 0.5)
        )
    end

    return table.concat({
        isMobileLayout() and "mobile" or "desktop",
        tostring(math.floor(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.X + 0.5)),
        tostring(math.floor(GameBackpack.AbsoluteSize.Y + 0.5)),
        inventoryOpen and "open" or "closed",
        leftSignature,
        rightSignature,
    }, "|")
end

local function shouldShowHotbarSlot(slotIndex, key)
    if slotIndex > getEffectiveHotbarSize() then
        return false
    end

    if slotIndex <= 2 then
        return key ~= nil or not shouldHideEmptyCoreHotbarSlots()
    end

    if inventoryOpen then
        return true
    end

    return key ~= nil
end

local function configureHotbarButton(button, slotIndex, key)
    applyButtonTextStyle(button)
    local nameLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local valueLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_value")
    local group = key and layoutState.groups[key] or nil
    local amount = group and #group.tools or 0
    local isCore = slotIndex <= 2
    local slotLabel = getSlotLabel(slotIndex)
    local equipped = key ~= nil and key == layoutState.equippedKey
    local isVisible = shouldShowHotbarSlot(slotIndex, key)

    button.LayoutOrder = slotIndex
    button.Visible = isVisible
    button.Active = isVisible
    button.Name = string.format("HotbarSlot_%d", slotIndex)
    button:SetAttribute("SlotIndex", slotIndex)
    button:SetAttribute("ToolKey", key or "")

    if nameLabel then
        if group then
            nameLabel.Text = group.tool.Name
        elseif isCore then
            nameLabel.Text = CORE_SLOT_LABELS[slotIndex]
        else
            nameLabel.Text = ""
        end
        if isMobileLayout() then
            nameLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        else
            nameLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
            nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.512602866, 0, 0.0222559497, 0)
        end
    end

    if valueLabel then
        if isMobileLayout() then
            valueLabel.Visible = false
        else
            valueLabel.Visible = true
            if amount > 1 then
                valueLabel.Text = string.format("%s x%d", slotLabel, amount)
            else
                valueLabel.Text = slotLabel
            end
        end
    end

    setButtonPalette(button, equipped, isCore, key == nil)
end

local function configureInventoryButton(button, key)
    applyButtonTextStyle(button)
    local nameLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_name")
    local valueLabel = button:FindFirstChild("t_value")
    local group = layoutState.groups[key]
    local equipped = key == layoutState.equippedKey

    button.Name = "InventoryItem_" .. key
    button.Size = SlotTemplate.Size
    button.AnchorPoint = SlotTemplate.AnchorPoint
    button.Position = SlotTemplate.Position
    button.LayoutOrder = keySequence[key] or 0
    button.Visible = true
    button:SetAttribute("ToolKey", key)

    if nameLabel then
        nameLabel.Text = group and group.tool.Name or key
    end

    if valueLabel then
        if group and #group.tools > 1 then
            valueLabel.Text = string.format("x%d", #group.tools)
        else
            valueLabel.Text = ""
        end
    end

    setButtonPalette(button, equipped, false, false)
end

local function resolveSourceKey(source)
    if not source then
        return nil
    end
    if source.kind == "inventory" then
        return source.key
    end
    if source.kind == "hotbar" then
        return layoutState.slotToKey[source.slotIndex]
    end
    return nil
end

local function triggerSlot(key)
    if not key or not canInteract() then
        return
    end

    local group = layoutState.groups[key]
    if not group or not group.tools[1] then
        return
    end

    if key == layoutState.equippedKey then
        ToolHelper.UnequipToolsC2S:FireServer()
    else
        ToolHelper.EquipToolC2S:FireServer(group.tools[1])
    end
    markDirty()
end

local function canDragSource(source)
    local key = resolveSourceKey(source)
    if not key then
        return false
    end
    if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex <= 2 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getDropTarget(point)
    local pt = Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y)

    if isMobileLayout() then
        local bestSlot, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
            local btn = hotbarButtons[slotIndex]
            if btn and btn.Visible then
                local center = btn.AbsolutePosition + btn.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
                local dist = (pt - center).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestSlot = slotIndex
                end
            end
        end
        local refBtn = hotbarButtons[FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT]
        local snapRadius = refBtn and refBtn.AbsoluteSize.X * 1.5 or 80
        if bestSlot and bestDist <= snapRadius then
            return { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = bestSlot }
        end
    else
        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, getEffectiveHotbarSize() do
            if isPointInGui(hotbarButtons[slotIndex], point) then
                return { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = slotIndex }
            end
        end
    end

    if inventoryOpen and (isPointInGui(ScrollingFrame, point) or isPointInGui(InventoryFrame, point)) then
        return { kind = "inventory" }
    end

    return nil
end

local function applyDrop(source, target)
    if not source or not target then
        return
    end

    local sourceKey = resolveSourceKey(source)
    if not sourceKey then
        return
    end

    if target.kind == "inventory" then
        if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex >= FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT then
            preferredSlots[sourceKey] = "inventory"
            markDirty()
        end
        return
    end

    if target.kind ~= "hotbar" or target.slotIndex < FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT then
        return
    end

    local targetKey = layoutState.slotToKey[target.slotIndex]
    if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex == target.slotIndex then
        return
    end

    preferredSlots[sourceKey] = target.slotIndex
    if source.kind == "hotbar" and source.slotIndex >= FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT then
        if targetKey and targetKey ~= sourceKey then
            preferredSlots[targetKey] = source.slotIndex
        end
    elseif targetKey and targetKey ~= sourceKey then
        preferredSlots[targetKey] = "inventory"
    end

    markDirty()
end

local function stopDragging()
    if dragState and dragState.ghost then
        dragState.ghost:Destroy()
    end
    dragState = nil
end

local function finishHold()
    if not dragState then
        return
    end

    local activeDrag = dragState
    local pointer = activeDrag.pointerPosition or normalizePointerPosition()
    stopDragging()

    if activeDrag.dragging and canDragSource(activeDrag.source) then
        local target = getDropTarget(pointer)
        applyDrop(activeDrag.source, target)
        return
    end

    triggerSlot(resolveSourceKey(activeDrag.source))
end

local function cycleHotbar(direction)
    local occupiedSlots = {}
    for slotIndex = 1, HOTBAR_SIZE do
        if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] then
            table.insert(occupiedSlots, slotIndex)
        end
    end
    if #occupiedSlots == 0 then
        return
    end
    local currentPos = nil
    for i, slotIndex in ipairs(occupiedSlots) do
        if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey then
            currentPos = i
            break
        end
    end
    local nextPos
    if currentPos then
        nextPos = (currentPos - 1 + direction) % #occupiedSlots + 1
    else
        nextPos = direction == 1 and 1 or #occupiedSlots
    end
    triggerSlot(layoutState.slotToKey[occupiedSlots[nextPos]])
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if inventoryOpen then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB
            or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
            toggleInventory(false)
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                local key = layoutState.inventoryKeys[gamepadInventoryCursor]
                if key then
                    local targetSlot = nil
                    for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                        if not layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] then
                            targetSlot = slotIndex
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not targetSlot then
                        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                            if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey then
                                targetSlot = slotIndex
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if targetSlot then
                        applyDrop({ kind = "inventory", key = key }, { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = targetSlot })
                        triggerSlot(key)
                        game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                            Title = "Equipped", Text = "Item added to hotbar", Duration = 2
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                local key = layoutState.inventoryKeys[gamepadInventoryCursor]
                if key then
                    local targetSlot = gamepadHotbarLock
                    if not targetSlot then
                        for slotIndex = FIRST_DYNAMIC_SLOT, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                            if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey then
                                targetSlot = slotIndex
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if targetSlot then
                        applyDrop({ kind = "inventory", key = key }, { kind = "hotbar", slotIndex = targetSlot })
                    end
                    toggleInventory(false)
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                gamepadInventoryCursor = gamepadInventoryCursor % #layoutState.inventoryKeys + 1
                markDirty()
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
            if gamepadInventoryCursor ~= nil and #layoutState.inventoryKeys > 0 then
                gamepadInventoryCursor = (gamepadInventoryCursor - 2) % #layoutState.inventoryKeys + 1
                markDirty()
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
            local direction = input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight and 1 or -1
            local occupiedSlots = {}
            for slotIndex = 1, HOTBAR_SIZE do
                if layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] then
                    table.insert(occupiedSlots, slotIndex)
                end
            end
            if #occupiedSlots > 0 then
                local currentPos = nil
                for i, slotIndex in ipairs(occupiedSlots) do
                    if slotIndex == gamepadHotbarLock
                        or (not gamepadHotbarLock and layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex] == layoutState.equippedKey) then
                        currentPos = i; break
                    end
                end
                local nextPos = currentPos
                    and (currentPos - 1 + direction) % #occupiedSlots + 1
                    or (direction == 1 and 1 or #occupiedSlots)
                local nextSlot = occupiedSlots[nextPos]
                removeLockStroke(gamepadHotbarLock)
                gamepadHotbarLock = nextSlot
                applyLockStroke(nextSlot)
                triggerSlot(layoutState.slotToKey[nextSlot])
            end
            return
        end
    end

    if gameProcessed then
        return
    end
    if not canInteract() then
        return
    end

    for slotIndex, keyCode in ipairs(KEYBOARD_BINDS) do
        if input.KeyCode == keyCode then
            triggerSlot(layoutState.slotToKey[slotIndex])
            return
        end
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Zero then
        toggleInventory()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
        cycleHotbar(1)
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
        cycleHotbar(-1)
    end
end)

local RobloxMaxImageSize = 1024
local function AnimateGif(ImageLabel:ImageLabel,ImageWidth,ImageHeight,Rows,Columns,NumberOfFrames,ImageId,FPS)
	
	--if ImageId then ImageLabel.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. ImageId end
	
	local RealWidth, RealHeight

	if math.max(ImageWidth,ImageHeight) > RobloxMaxImageSize then -- Compensate roblox size

		local Longest = ImageWidth > ImageHeight and "Width" or "Height"

		if Longest == "Width" then

			RealWidth = RobloxMaxImageSize
			RealHeight = (RealWidth / ImageWidth) * ImageHeight

		elseif Longest == "Height" then

			RealHeight = RobloxMaxImageSize
			RealWidth = (RealHeight / ImageHeight) * ImageWidth

		end

	else
		RealWidth,RealHeight = ImageWidth,ImageHeight
	end

	local FrameSize = Vector2.new(RealWidth/Columns,RealHeight/Rows)
	ImageLabel.ImageRectSize = FrameSize

	local CurrentRow, CurrentColumn = 0,0
	local Offsets = {}

	for i = 1,NumberOfFrames do

		local CurrentX = CurrentColumn * FrameSize.X
		local CurrentY = CurrentRow * FrameSize.Y

		table.insert(Offsets,Vector2.new(CurrentX,CurrentY))

		CurrentColumn += 1

		if CurrentColumn >= Columns then
			CurrentColumn = 0
			CurrentRow += 1
		end

	end
	
	local TimeInterval = FPS and 1/FPS or 0.1
	
	local Index = 0
	task.spawn(function()

		while task.wait(TimeInterval) and ImageLabel:IsDescendantOf(game) do
			Index += 1

			ImageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Offsets[Index]

			if Index >= NumberOfFrames then
				Index = 0
			end

		end

	end)

end

local function OnExplosionHit(hitPart, hitDistance, blastCenter)
	if hitPart and hitDistance then

		if hitPart.Name ~= 'Handle' then
			hitPart:BreakJoints()
			local fire = Instance.new('Fire')
			fire.Parent = hitPart
			local blastForce = Instance.new('BodyForce', hitPart) --NOTE: We will multiply by mass so bigger parts get blasted more
			blastForce.Force = (hitPart.Position - blastCenter).unit * BLAST_FORCE * hitPart:GetMass()
			DebrisService:AddItem(blastForce, 0.1)
		end

	end
end

local function playOldCowboyCemeteryFilm(cam1Source, cam2Source)
	if oldCowboyFilmActive then
		return
	end
	local cam1CFrame
	local cam2CFrame
	if typeof(cam1Source) == "CFrame" and typeof(cam2Source) == "CFrame" then
		cam1CFrame = cam1Source
		cam2CFrame = cam2Source
	elseif typeof(cam1Source) == "Instance" then
		local cam1 = cam1Source:FindFirstChild("cam1")
		local cam2 = cam1Source:FindFirstChild("cam2")
		cam1CFrame = cam1 and cam1:IsA("Attachment") and cam1.WorldCFrame or nil
		cam2CFrame = cam2 and cam2:IsA("Attachment") and cam2.WorldCFrame or nil
	end
	if not cam1CFrame or not cam2CFrame then
		oldCowboyFilmFinishedEvent:FireServer()
		return
	end

	oldCowboyFilmActive = true
	oldCowboyFilmSerial += 1
	local serial = oldCowboyFilmSerial

	task.spawn(function()
		showFilmUi(true)
		if isSkip or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			finishOldCowboyFilm()
			return
		end

		dark:Play()
		dark.Completed:Wait()
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		camera.CFrame = cam1CFrame
		up.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		down.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		script.Parent:WaitForChild("Language").Text = "The old cowboy stopped at the edge of the cemetery."

		blight:Play()
		blight.Completed:Wait()
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		local cameraTween = TweenService:Create(
			camera,
			TweenInfo.new(5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
			{CFrame = cam2CFrame}
		)
		cameraTween:Play()
		cameraTween.Completed:Wait()
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		script.Parent:WaitForChild("Language").Text = "For a long while, he said nothing."
		task.wait(2)
		if not oldCowboyFilmActive or serial ~= oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			return
		end

		hideFilmUi()
		task.wait(3.2)
		if oldCowboyFilmActive and serial == oldCowboyFilmSerial then
			restoreOldCowboyView()
			finishOldCowboyFilm()
		end
	end)
end

local referenceResolution = Vector2.new(1920, 1080) -- Reference screen size
local referenceTextSize = 30 -- Desired TextSize at the reference resolution 

local function updateTextSize()
	local currentSize = screenGui.AbsoluteSize -- Get the current screen size
	local scaleFactor = math.min(currentSize.X / referenceResolution.X, currentSize.Y / referenceResolution.Y) -- Uniform scaling factor
	local newTextSize = math.max(9, referenceTextSize * scaleFactor) -- Ensure TextSize doesn't go below 9
	textLabel.TextSize = newTextSize
end 


-- Update whenever the screen size changes
screenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(updateTextSize)

local function isMobileLayout(): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and (not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled or viewport.X <= 1400 or viewport.Y <= 900)
end

local function getTaskRowHeight(): number
	return isMobileLayout() and 34 or 44
end

local function applyTaskRowSize(item: GuiObject)
	item.Size = UDim2.new(item.Size.X.Scale, item.Size.X.Offset, 0, getTaskRowHeight())
end

local function setSubtitle(group: Instance, text: string)
	local subtitle = group:FindFirstChild("t_subtitle")
	if subtitle and subtitle:IsA("TextLabel") then
		subtitle.Text = text
	end
end

local function normalizeGroup(group: Instance)
	local keptPrefab: Frame? = nil
	for _, child in ipairs(group:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name == "TaskPrefab" then
			if not keptPrefab then
				keptPrefab = child
			else
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	if keptPrefab then
		keptPrefab.Visible = false
		applyTaskRowSize(keptPrefab)
	end

	return keptPrefab
end

local characterTaskPrefab = normalizeGroup(characterQuestGroup)
local dailyTaskPrefab = normalizeGroup(dailyQuestGroup)

local function getOrCreateTaskItem(group: Instance, prefab: Frame?, index: number): Frame?
	if not prefab then
		return nil
	end

	local item = group:FindFirstChild(tostring(index))
	if item and item:IsA("Frame") then
		applyTaskRowSize(item)
		return item
	end

	item = prefab:Clone()
	item.Name = tostring(index)
	item.LayoutOrder = index
	applyTaskRowSize(item)
	item.Parent = group
	return item
end

local function hideTaskItems(group: Instance, fromIndex: number)
	for _, child in ipairs(group:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and tonumber(child.Name) then
			local index = tonumber(child.Name)
			if index and index >= fromIndex then
				child.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setTaskItem(group: Instance, prefab: Frame?, index: number, descText: string, curValue: number, targetValue: number, completed: boolean)
	local item = getOrCreateTaskItem(group, prefab, index)
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local desc = item:FindFirstChild("t_desc")
	local value = item:FindFirstChild("t_value")
	local tick = item:FindFirstChild("img_tick")

	item.Visible = true
	if desc and desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
		desc.Text = descText
	end
	if tick and tick:IsA("GuiObject") then
		tick.Visible = completed
	end
	if value and value:IsA("TextLabel") then
		value.Visible = not completed
		value.Text = string.format("%d/%d", curValue, targetValue)
	end
end

local function getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, level: number)
	if not characterLo or level >= 3 then
		return nil
	end

	local upgradeLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterUpgradeSetting, characterLo.missionId)
	if not upgradeLo then
		return nil
	end

	local questStr = level == 1 and upgradeLo.Level2Quest or upgradeLo.Level3Quest
	if not questStr then
		return nil
	end

	return CommonFunc:ParseKV_Number(questStr)
end

	end

	local characterVo = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(nil, characterId)
	local characterLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterSetting, characterId)
	if not characterVo or not characterLo then
		setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, "No Character Equipped")
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "No Character Equipped", 0, 0, false)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	if characterVo.lv >= 3 then
		setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, "Lv.3 Max Level")
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "Max Level", 1, 1, true)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	setSubtitle(characterQuestGroup, string.format("Lv.%d -> Lv.%d", characterVo.lv, characterVo.lv + 1))

	local quest = getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, characterVo.lv)
	if not quest then
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, 1, "No Character Quest", 0, 0, false)
		hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, 2)
		return
	end

	local index = 0
	for statsName, targetValue in pairs(quest) do
		index += 1
		local statsLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterStatsSetting, statsName)
		local curValue = tonumber(DataHelper:GetCharacterStats(nil, characterVo.id, statsName)) or 0
		local safeTarget = math.max(tonumber(targetValue) or 0, 0)
		local completed = safeTarget <= 0 or curValue >= safeTarget
		setTaskItem(characterQuestGroup, characterTaskPrefab, index, statsLo and statsLo.desc or tostring(statsName), curValue, safeTarget, completed)
	end

	hideTaskItems(characterQuestGroup, index + 1)
end

local function renderDailyTasks()
	if not DataHelper:IsInit() then
		setSubtitle(dailyQuestGroup, "Loading...")
		hideTaskItems(dailyQuestGroup, 1)
		return
	end

	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local records = playerVo and playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords
	local completedCount = 0

	for index, className in ipairs(dailyClassOrder) do
		local dailyQuestVo = records and records[className]
		local descText = string.format("%s: No Quest", tostring(className))
		local curValue = 0
		local targetValue = 0
		local completed = false

		if dailyQuestVo and dailyQuestVo.questId then
			local lo = ConfigHelper:GetById(DailyQuestsSetting, dailyQuestVo.questId)
			if lo then
				curValue = tonumber(dailyQuestVo.progress) or 0
				targetValue = math.max(tonumber(lo.times) or 0, 0)
				completed = targetValue <= 0 or curValue >= targetValue
				descText = lo.desc or tostring(dailyQuestVo.questId)
			else
				descText = string.format("%s: Invalid Quest", tostring(className))
			end
		end

		if completed then
			completedCount += 1
		end
		setTaskItem(dailyQuestGroup, dailyTaskPrefab, index, descText, curValue, targetValue, completed)
	end

	setSubtitle(dailyQuestGroup, string.format("Completed %d/%d", completedCount, #dailyClassOrder))
	hideTaskItems(dailyQuestGroup, #dailyClassOrder + 1)
end

local function getPlayerControls()
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local playerModule = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
    if not playerModule or not playerModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end

    local ok, playerModuleResult = pcall(require, playerModule)
    if not ok or type(playerModuleResult) ~= "table" or type(playerModuleResult.GetControls) ~= "function" then return nil end

    local controlsOk, controls = pcall(function()
        return playerModuleResult:GetControls()
    end)
    if not controlsOk then return nil end

    return controls
end

local function restoreDefaultTouchControls()
    if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then return end

    local playerGui:PlayerGui? = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local controls = getPlayerControls()
    if not playerGui or not controls then return end

    GuiService.TouchControlsEnabled = true
    pcall(function()
        controls:Enable()
    end)

    local touchGui = rawget(controls, "touchGui")
    local touchControlFrame = rawget(controls, "touchControlFrame")
    local touchGuiCount = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == "TouchGui" and child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            touchGuiCount += 1
        end
    end

    local missingContainer = typeof(touchGui) ~= "Instance" or touchGui.Parent ~= playerGui or typeof(touchControlFrame) ~= "Instance" or touchControlFrame.Parent ~= touchGui
    if missingContainer and type(controls.CreateTouchGuiContainer) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            controls:CreateTouchGuiContainer()
        end)
        touchGui = rawget(controls, "touchGui")
        touchControlFrame = rawget(controls, "touchControlFrame")
    end

    if typeof(touchGui) == "Instance" and touchGui.Parent == playerGui then
        for _, child in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "TouchGui" and child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child ~= touchGui then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    local activeController = rawget(controls, "activeController") or rawget(controls, "activeControlModule")
    local touchJumpController = rawget(controls, "touchJumpController")
    local thumbstickFrame = type(activeController) == "table" and rawget(activeController, "thumbstickFrame") or nil
    local jumpButton = type(touchJumpController) == "table" and rawget(touchJumpController, "jumpButton") or nil
    local thumbstickInvalid = typeof(thumbstickFrame) == "Instance" and thumbstickFrame.Parent ~= touchControlFrame
    local jumpButtonInvalid = typeof(jumpButton) == "Instance" and jumpButton.Parent ~= touchControlFrame
    local touchWasLocked = type(activeController) == "table" and rawget(activeController, "moveTouchLockedIn") == true
    local shouldResetController = missingContainer or touchGuiCount ~= 1 or thumbstickInvalid or jumpButtonInvalid or touchWasLocked

    if shouldResetController and typeof(touchControlFrame) == "Instance" then
        if typeof(touchGui) == "Instance" and touchGui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            touchGui.Enabled = true
        end
        if typeof(touchControlFrame) == "Instance" and touchControlFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then
            touchControlFrame.Visible = true
        end

        if type(activeController) == "table" and type(activeController.Enable) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                activeController:Enable(false)
            end)
            if thumbstickInvalid then
                activeController.thumbstickFrame = nil
                activeController.startImage = nil
                activeController.endImage = nil
                activeController.middleImages = {}
                activeController.middleImageFadeTweens = {}
                activeController.startImageFadeTween = nil
                activeController.endImageFadeTween = nil
            end
            activeController.moveTouchLockedIn = false
            activeController.moveTouchFirstChanged = false
            activeController.moveTouchStartPosition = nil
            activeController.moveVector = Vector3.zero
            activeController.isJumping = false
            pcall(function()
                activeController:Enable(true, touchControlFrame)
            end)
        end

        if type(touchJumpController) == "table" and type(touchJumpController.Enable) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                touchJumpController:Enable(false)
            end)
            if jumpButtonInvalid then
                touchJumpController.jumpButton = nil
            end
            touchJumpController.parentUIFrame = touchControlFrame
            touchJumpController.isJumping = false
            pcall(function()
                touchJumpController:Enable(true, touchControlFrame)
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            controls:Enable()
        end)
    end
end

local function restoreMobileControls(resetCharacterState:boolean?)
    local playerGui:PlayerGui? = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
        for _,screenName in ipairs(IMMERSIVE_SCREEN_NAMES) do
            local screen = playerGui:FindFirstChild(screenName)
            local rootFrame = screen and screen:FindFirstChild("RootFrame")
            if rootFrame and rootFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then
                rootFrame.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    MobileTouchImmersionHelper:ForceRestore()
    restoreDefaultTouchControls()

    if resetCharacterState then
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid? = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Jump = false
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
            humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end
    end
end

local function bindCharacter(character:Model)
    task.defer(function()
        restoreMobileControls(true)
    end)
    task.delay(0.25, function()
        if LocalPlayer.Character == character then
            restoreMobileControls(true)
        end
    end)

    local humanoid:Humanoid? = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            restoreMobileControls(false)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                restoreMobileControls(false)
            end)
        end)
    end
end

function LeftClick()
	if currentTarget ~= nil and currentTarget.Parent then
		if currentTarget.ServerOwner.Value == false then return end

		carrying = true
		if currentTarget == nil then return end
		RP.Remotes.PickupItem:FireServer(currentTarget)
		for _, d in ipairs(currentTarget:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:IsA("Part") then
				d.CollisionGroup = "Item"
			end
		end
	end
end

function LeftUnClick()
	carrying = false
	if currentTarget then
		DropItem(true)
	end
end

function DropItem(AddForce : boolean ?)
	if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then return end

	local velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	if AddForce then
		velocity = (targetPos - currentTarget.PrimaryPart.Position) * throwBoost
	end

	RP.Remotes.DropItem:FireServer(currentTarget, velocity)
	for _, d in ipairs(currentTarget:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:IsA("Part") then
			d.CollisionGroup = "Default"
		end
	end
	carrying = false
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")

local EMPTY_TABLE = {}
local OFFSET = Vector3.new(0,0.1,0)

local module = {}

module.UpdateQueue = table.create(10)

function module:Init(Settings)
	-- Set defaults
	module.Lifetime = Settings.Lifetime or 3
	module.Direction = Settings.Direction or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
	module.Speed = Settings.Speed or 6
	
	-- Clear any old stuff
	if module.UpdateConnection then
		module.UpdateConnection:Disconnect()
		module.UpdateConnection = nil
	end
	
	for _, WindLine in ipairs(module.UpdateQueue) do
		WindLine.Attachment0:Destroy()
		WindLine.Attachment1:Destroy()
		WindLine.Trail:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(module.UpdateQueue)
	
	module.LastSpawned = os.clock()
	local SpawnRate = 1/(Settings.SpawnRate or 25)
	
	-- Setup logic loop
	module.UpdateConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local Clock = os.clock()
		
		-- Spawn handler
		if Clock-module.LastSpawned > SpawnRate then
			module:Create()
			module.LastSpawned = Clock
		end
		
		-- Update queue handler
		debug.profilebegin("Wind Lines")
		for i, WindLine in ipairs(module.UpdateQueue) do
			
			local AliveTime = Clock-WindLine.StartClock
			if AliveTime >= WindLine.Lifetime then
				-- Destroy the objects
				WindLine.Attachment0:Destroy()
				WindLine.Attachment1:Destroy()
				WindLine.Trail:Destroy()
				
				-- unordered remove at this index
				local Length = #module.UpdateQueue
				module.UpdateQueue[i] = module.UpdateQueue[Length]
				module.UpdateQueue[Length] = nil
				
				continue
			end
			
			WindLine.Trail.MaxLength = 20 - (20*(AliveTime/WindLine.Lifetime))
			
			local SeededClock = (Clock+WindLine.Seed)*(WindLine.Speed*0.2)
			local StartPos = WindLine.Position
			WindLine.Attachment0.WorldPosition = (
				CFrame.new(StartPos, StartPos+WindLine.Direction) * CFrame.new(0,0,WindLine.Speed * -AliveTime)
			).Position + Vector3.new(math.sin(SeededClock)*0.5,math.sin(SeededClock)*0.8,math.sin(SeededClock)*0.5)
			
			WindLine.Attachment1.WorldPosition = WindLine.Attachment0.WorldPosition + OFFSET
			
		end
		debug.profileend()
	end)


end

function module:Cleanup()
	
	if module.UpdateConnection then
		module.UpdateConnection:Disconnect()
		module.UpdateConnection = nil
	end

	for _, WindLine in ipairs(module.UpdateQueue) do
		WindLine.Attachment0:Destroy()
		WindLine.Attachment1:Destroy()
		WindLine.Trail:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(module.UpdateQueue)
	
end

function module:Create(Settings)
	debug.profilebegin("Add Wind Line")
	
	Settings = Settings or EMPTY_TABLE

	local Lifetime = Settings.Lifetime or module.Lifetime
	local Position = Settings.Position or (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(-30,70)),math.rad(math.random(-80,80)),0))*CFrame.new(0,0,math.random(200,600)*-0.1).Position
	local Direction = Settings.Direction or module.Direction
	local Speed = Settings.Speed or module.Speed
	if Speed <= 0 then return end

	local Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	local Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	
	local Trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	Trail.Attachment0 = Attachment0
	Trail.Attachment1 = Attachment1
	Trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.3),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2,1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8,1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.3),
	})
	Trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.7)
	Trail.FaceCamera = true
	Trail.Parent = Attachment0

	Attachment0.WorldPosition = Position
	Attachment1.WorldPosition = Position+OFFSET
	
	local WindLine = {
		Attachment0 = Attachment0;
		Attachment1 = Attachment1;
		Trail = Trail;
		Lifetime = Lifetime+(math.random(-10,10)*0.1);
		Position = Position;
		Direction = Direction;
		Speed = Speed+(math.random(-10,10)*0.1);
		StartClock = os.clock();
		Seed = math.random(1,1000)*0.1;
	}
	
	module.UpdateQueue[#module.UpdateQueue+1] = WindLine

	Attachment0.Parent = Terrain
	Attachment1.Parent = Terrain
	
	debug.profileend()
end

return module

by: boatbomber, CloneTrooper1019

Docs: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/wind-shake-high-performance-wind-effect-for-leaves-and-foliage/1039806/1

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Settings = require(script.Settings)
local Octree = require(script.Octree)

local COLLECTION_TAG = "WindShake" -- The CollectionService tag to be watched and mounted automatically
local UPDATE_HZ = 1/45 -- Update the object positions at 45 Hz.
local COMPUTE_HZ = 1/30 -- Compute the object targets at 30 Hz.

-- Use the script's attributes as the default settings.
-- The table provided is a fallback if the attributes
-- are undefined or using the wrong value types.

local DEFAULT_SETTINGS = Settings.new(script, {
	WindDirection = Vector3.new(0.5, 0, 0.5);
	WindSpeed = 20;
	WindPower = 0.5;
})

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local ObjectShakeAddedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local ObjectShakeRemovedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local PausedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local ResumedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

local WindShake = {
	ObjectMetadata = {};
	Octree = Octree.new();

	Handled = 0;
	Active = 0;
	LastUpdate = os.clock();

	ObjectShakeAdded = ObjectShakeAddedEvent.Event;
	ObjectShakeRemoved = ObjectShakeRemovedEvent.Event;
	ObjectShakeUpdated = ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent.Event;
	Paused = PausedEvent.Event;
	Resumed = ResumedEvent.Event;

}

export type WindShakeSettings = {
	WindDirection: Vector3?,
	WindSpeed: number?,
	WindPower: number?,
}

function WindShake:Connect(funcName: string, event: RBXScriptSignal): RBXScriptConnection
	local callback = self[funcName]
	assert(typeof(callback) == "function", "Unknown function: " .. funcName)

	return event:Connect(function (...)
		return callback(self, ...)
	end)
end

function WindShake:AddObjectShake(object: BasePart, settingsTable: WindShakeSettings?)
	if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end

	if not object:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	local metadata = self.ObjectMetadata

	if metadata[object] then
		return
	else
		self.Handled += 1
	end

	metadata[object] = {
		Node = self.Octree:CreateNode(object.Position, object);
		Settings = Settings.new(object, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);

		Seed = math.random(1000) * 0.1;
		Origin = object.CFrame;
	}

	self:UpdateObjectSettings(object, settingsTable)

	ObjectShakeAddedEvent:Fire(object)
end

function WindShake:RemoveObjectShake(object: BasePart)
	if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end

	local metadata = self.ObjectMetadata
	local objMeta = metadata[object]

	if objMeta then
		self.Handled -= 1
		metadata[object] = nil
		objMeta.Settings:Destroy()
		objMeta.Node:Destroy()

		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.CFrame = objMeta.Origin
		end
	end

	ObjectShakeRemovedEvent:Fire(object)
end

function WindShake:Update()
	local now = os.clock()
	local dt = now - self.LastUpdate

	if dt < UPDATE_HZ then
		return
	end

	self.LastUpdate = now

	debug.profilebegin("WindShake")

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local cameraCF = camera and camera.CFrame

	debug.profilebegin("Octree Search")
	local updateObjects = self.Octree:RadiusSearch(cameraCF.Position + (cameraCF.LookVector * 115), 120)
	debug.profileend()

	local activeCount = #updateObjects

	self.Active = activeCount

	if activeCount < 1 then
		return
	end

	local step = math.min(1, dt * 8)
	local cfTable = table.create(activeCount)
	local objectMetadata = self.ObjectMetadata

	debug.profilebegin("Calc")
	for i, object in ipairs(updateObjects) do
		local objMeta = objectMetadata[object]
		local lastComp = objMeta.LastCompute or 0

		local origin = objMeta.Origin
		local current = objMeta.CFrame or origin

		if (now - lastComp) > COMPUTE_HZ then
			local objSettings = objMeta.Settings

			local seed = objMeta.Seed
			local amp = objSettings.WindPower * 0.1

			local freq = now * (objSettings.WindSpeed * 0.08)
			local rotX = math.noise(freq, 0, seed) * amp
			local rotY = math.noise(freq, 0, -seed) * amp
			local rotZ = math.noise(freq, 0, seed+seed) * amp
			local offset = object.PivotOffset
			local worldpivot = origin * offset

			objMeta.Target = (worldpivot * CFrame.Angles(rotX, rotY, rotZ) + objSettings.WindDirection * ((0.5 + math.noise(freq, seed, seed)) * amp)) * offset:Inverse()

			objMeta.LastCompute = now
		end

		current = current:Lerp(objMeta.Target, step)
		objMeta.CFrame = current
		cfTable[i] = current
	end
	debug.profileend()

	workspace:BulkMoveTo(updateObjects, cfTable, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	debug.profileend()
end

function WindShake:Pause()
	if self.UpdateConnection then
		self.UpdateConnection:Disconnect()
		self.UpdateConnection = nil
	end

	self.Active = 0
	self.Running = false

	PausedEvent:Fire()
end

function WindShake:Resume()
	if self.Running then
		return
	else
		self.Running = true
	end

	-- Connect updater
	self.UpdateConnection = self:Connect("Update", RunService.Heartbeat)

	ResumedEvent:Fire()
end

function WindShake:Init()
	if self.Initialized then
		return
	else
		self.Initialized = true
	end

	-- Define attributes if they're undefined.
	local power = script:GetAttribute("WindPower")
	local speed = script:GetAttribute("WindSpeed")
	local direction = script:GetAttribute("WindDirection")

	if typeof(power) ~= "number" then
		script:SetAttribute("WindPower", DEFAULT_SETTINGS.WindPower)
	end

	if typeof(speed) ~= "number" then
		script:SetAttribute("WindSpeed", DEFAULT_SETTINGS.WindSpeed)
	end

	if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then
		script:SetAttribute("WindDirection", DEFAULT_SETTINGS.WindDirection)
	end

	-- Clear any old stuff.
	self:Cleanup()

	-- Wire up tag listeners.
	local windShakeAdded = CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(COLLECTION_TAG)
	self.AddedConnection = self:Connect("AddObjectShake", windShakeAdded)

	local windShakeRemoved = CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(COLLECTION_TAG)
	self.RemovedConnection = self:Connect("RemoveObjectShake", windShakeRemoved)

	for _,object in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(COLLECTION_TAG)) do
		self:AddObjectShake(object)
	end

	-- Automatically start.
	self:Resume()
end

function WindShake:Cleanup()
	if not self.Initialized then
		return
	end

	self:Pause()

	if self.AddedConnection then
		self.AddedConnection:Disconnect()
		self.AddedConnection = nil
	end

	if self.RemovedConnection then
		self.RemovedConnection:Disconnect()
		self.RemovedConnection = nil
	end

	table.clear(self.ObjectMetadata)
	self.Octree:ClearNodes()

	self.Handled = 0
	self.Active = 0
	self.Initialized = false
end

function WindShake:UpdateObjectSettings(object: Instance, settingsTable: WindShakeSettings)
	if typeof(object) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end

	if typeof(settingsTable) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	if (not self.ObjectMetadata[object]) and (object ~= script) then
		return
	end

	for key, value in pairs(settingsTable) do
		object:SetAttribute(key, value)
	end

	ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent:Fire(object)
end

function WindShake:UpdateAllObjectSettings(settingsTable: WindShakeSettings)
	if typeof(settingsTable) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	for obj, objMeta in pairs(self.ObjectMetadata) do
		for key, value in pairs(settingsTable) do
			obj:SetAttribute(key, value)
		end
		ObjectShakeUpdatedEvent:Fire(obj)
	end
end

function WindShake:SetDefaultSettings(settingsTable: WindShakeSettings)
	self:UpdateObjectSettings(script, settingsTable)
end

return WindShake

local Settings = {}

local SettingTypes = {
	WindPower = "number";
	WindSpeed = "number";
	WindDirection = "Vector3";
}

function Settings.new(object, base)
	local inst = table.create(3)

	-- Initial settings

	local WindPower = object:GetAttribute("WindPower")
	local WindSpeed = object:GetAttribute("WindSpeed")
	local WindDirection = object:GetAttribute("WindDirection")

	inst.WindPower = typeof(WindPower) == SettingTypes.WindPower and WindPower or base.WindPower
	inst.WindSpeed = typeof(WindSpeed) == SettingTypes.WindSpeed and WindSpeed or base.WindSpeed
	inst.WindDirection = typeof(WindDirection) == SettingTypes.WindDirection and WindDirection or base.WindDirection

	-- Update settings on event

	local PowerConnection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WindPower"):Connect(function()
		WindPower = object:GetAttribute("WindPower")
		inst.WindPower = typeof(WindPower) == SettingTypes.WindPower and WindPower or base.WindPower
	end)

	local SpeedConnection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WindSpeed"):Connect(function()
		WindSpeed = object:GetAttribute("WindSpeed")
		inst.WindSpeed = typeof(WindSpeed) == SettingTypes.WindSpeed and WindSpeed or base.WindSpeed
	end)

	local DirectionConnection = object:GetAttributeChangedSignal("WindDirection"):Connect(function()
		WindDirection = object:GetAttribute("WindDirection")
		inst.WindDirection = typeof(WindDirection) == SettingTypes.WindDirection and WindDirection or base.WindDirection
	end)

	-- Cleanup function for when shake is removed or object is unloaded

	function inst:Destroy()
		PowerConnection:Disconnect()
		SpeedConnection:Disconnect()
		DirectionConnection:Disconnect()
		table.clear(inst)
	end

	return inst
end

return Settings
